title: Verification & Test Engineer
description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability

At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.

By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.

We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do

- Own the system architecture and system model for Hypersonica’s high‑speed flight vehicles, ensuring mission intent, vehicle dynamics, avionics, and GNC form a coherent, verifiable whole.

- Lead aerospace systems architecture design, taking responsibility for how the vehicle is defined across disciplines from early concept through Preliminary Design Review (PDR) and beyond.

- Build and maintain the authoritative system requirements model, decomposing mission‑level objectives into clear, testable system and sub‑system requirements.

- Define and own the end‑to‑end system V‑model, including requirements validation, verification strategy, and clear readiness gates for Kick‑off and PDR.

- Apply model‑based systems engineering (MBSE) as a practical engineering tool, not a documentation exercise, ensuring traceability between requirements, models, analyses, and tests.

- Develop and deliver a 6‑DoF Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) model to PDR standard, in close collaboration with flight physics and avionics engineers.

- Apply closed‑loop control theory in the context of high‑speed flight and military guidance, ensuring controllability, stability, and performance are understood at the system level.

- Integrate vehicle dynamics, control laws, sensors, and actuators into a coherent closed‑loop system representation.

- Identify system‑level risks early particularly around requirements gaps, controllability, observability, and verification — and drive mitigations decisively.

- Act as a technical authority across disciplines, keeping architectural decisions coherent as designs evolve at pace.

Who you are

- An experienced Systems Engineer with a strong track record in system architecture, requirements decomposition, and delivery in safety‑ or mission‑critical environments.

- Deeply fluent in model‑based systems engineering, with practical experience owning requirements models and using MBSE to drive real engineering decisions.

- Strong grounding in closed‑loop control theory, applied to high‑speed flight, guidance, and defence or military systems.

- Comfortable developing and working with 6‑DoF flight and GNC models, and understanding their implications at vehicle level.

- Experienced taking systems through early design gates (Kick‑off, PDR), not just theoretical or paper studies.

- Someone who thinks in system behaviours, interfaces, and failure modes, not isolated components.

- Confident operating in ambiguous, fast‑moving environments where decisions must be made with incomplete data.

- Technically credible across disciplines, able to challenge assumptions and close decisions without consensus theatre.

- Motivated by working on systems where performance, robustness, and national‑level impact genuinely matter.

What we offer

- A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.

- Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.

- High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.

- A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.

- A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.

- Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.

Security and Elgibility Requirement
Due to the nature of the work with the UK MOD, applicants must be a British Citizen (or Dual UK national with British citizenship) and eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and, where required, Developed Vetting (DV)

At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.

Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.

You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

title: [31687] - Senior HR Business Partner
description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced and commercially minded Senior HR Business Partner to join our People & Culture team and partner closely with senior leaders across EMEA.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role for an HR professional who thrives in fast-paced, evolving environments and enjoys operating at both a strategic and operational level. You’ll play a key role in translating business priorities into people strategies that enable growth, strengthen organisational culture and deliver measurable business outcomes.

With teams across the UK, Portugal and Brazil, you’ll bring a strong understanding of working across different cultures and markets, while helping the organisation navigate transformation and change.

You’ll have the opportunity to influence leadership decisions, shape organisational design, develop talent and succession pipelines, strengthen performance management, and lead initiatives that enhance the overall employee experience.

What You’ll Do

Partner with Senior Leadership

- Act as a trusted strategic partner to senior leaders across EMEA, providing insight and challenge on people, organisational structure, performance and workforce matters.

- Translate business strategy and evolving priorities into practical People & Culture solutions.

- Support leaders in making informed, people-focused decisions in a fast-moving environment.

Drive People Strategy & Transformation

- Develop and deliver People & Culture initiatives that directly support business objectives and deliver measurable impact.

- Lead and contribute to organisational transformation and change initiatives across the region.

- Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, policies and ways of working, ensuring they remain agile and fit for purpose.

Lead Core HR Processes

- Own and support end-to-end workforce planning and headcount management.

- Drive succession planning and talent development pipelines.

- Lead performance management cycles, including calibration and development planning.

- Support employee engagement, culture and organisational effectiveness initiatives.

Use Data to Drive Decisions

- Leverage people analytics and HR metrics to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.

- Turn data and insights into clear recommendations for leaders.

- Use evidence-based approaches to continuously improve people processes and employee experience across diverse teams.

Coach & Develop Leaders

- Provide hands-on coaching to leaders on effective people management, feedback, performance, conflict resolution and leadership development.

- Help leaders build high-performing, inclusive teams and foster a culture of open communication and continuous improvement.

Collaborate Across People & Culture

- Work closely with Talent Acquisition, People Development, Compensation & Benefits and Culture teams.

- Ensure HR policies, programmes and practices are aligned, consistent and responsive to the needs of the business and our people.

What We’re Looking For

You’ll bring:

- Proven experience in an HR Business Partner, People Partner or strategic HR role, ideally within an organisation experiencing significant growth, transformation or change.

- A strong track record of partnering with senior leaders in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

- A hands-on approach, with the ability to move confidently between strategic thinking and operational delivery.

- Strong experience across performance management, talent development, succession planning and organisational culture.

- Excellent commercial and strategic thinking, with the ability to understand business priorities and translate them into effective people solutions.

- Experience working across different countries, cultures and organisational contexts within EMEA.

- A strong analytical mindset, with experience using people data, HR metrics and reporting to inform decisions and improve processes.

- Exceptional communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.

- The ability to build trusted relationships at all levels and confidently challenge and coach senior leaders.

- A proven ability to operate effectively through ambiguity, change and evolving organisational priorities.

Nice to Have

- Experience working within a technology, startup or high-growth environment.

- Experience leading organisational transformation or change management initiatives across multiple regions.

- Knowledge of Portuguese would be an advantage.

Collaboration is our superpower, diversity unites us, and excellence is our standard.

We value diverse identities and life experiences, fostering a diverse, inclusive, and safe work environment. We encourage applications from diverse and underrepresented groups to our job positions.

title: Trading Analytics Developer, Quantitative Trading
description:
The Quant Trading team is responsible for trading and managing risks associated with different crypto products, including spots and derivatives. The team develops and implements trading strategies in fast-paced and complex trading environments.

We are seeking an experienced Trading Analytics Developer to join our Quant Trading team and play a pivotal role in advancing our data and AI infrastructure. This role combines traditional quantitative development with cutting-edge AI platform engineering, focusing on building robust, scalable systems that serve both data analytics and artificial intelligence workloads. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between high-performance trading systems and modern AI capabilities, ensuring reliability, performance, and actionable insights across both domains.

Job Responsibilities
Data Platform & Analytics

- Design, build, and operate high throughput batch and streaming data pipelines using Kafka, Flink, and ETL technologies
- Design and build unified analytics engine designed for processing large-scale data using Apache Spark and related tools
- Develop and optimize analytical data models for time-series, financial metrics, and trading activity
- Implement and manage analytical databases (ClickHouse, MongoDB, BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar) with cost-aware architecture
- Build idempotent data pipelines with robust backfill and reconciliation capabilities
- Create comprehensive monitoring for data quality, freshness, and pipeline reliability

AI Platform Development

- Design, build, and operate internal AI platforms serving multiple trading teams
- Build reusable AI tooling including standardized RAG pipelines, prompt management, and self-service workflows
- Create and maintain agent systems using modern frameworks (LangGraph, A2A, MCP) with focus on controllability and auditability

Job Requirements
Mandatory Foundations

- 5+ years production experience with both Python and Java in high-performance environments
- Strong software engineering fundamentals: system design, data structures, algorithms, data integrity, accuracy and performance optimization
- Expertise in Linux, Github, and modern CI/CD practices
- Proven experience with AWS cloud services and Kubernetes orchestration
- Comfort working with large-scale, complex datasets in financial/trading contexts

Data Platform Expertise

- Advanced SQL with window functions and query optimization, realtime data synchronization together with database design and infrastructure support
- Experience with data workflow and messaging orchestration (Airflow, Jenkins, AMPS etc.)
- Metric design and implementation for trading analytics (PnL, risk, balance and trade reconciliation, backfill and performance tuning)
- Time-series data visualization with Grafana, TradingView, web-based interactive dashboards and BI tools etc.
- Kafka, Flink, and event processing in production environments

AI Platform Capabilities

- Retrieval system evaluation methodologies and quality frameworks
- RAG pipeline architecture and optimization techniques
- LLMOps practices including model lifecycle and prompt management
- Experience with AI agent frameworks in production settings like A2A and MCP

Preferred Qualifications
Financial/Trading Domain

- Experience in trading systems, quantitative finance, or financial technology
- Understanding of market data, data subscription using Rest API / Web Socket
- Knowledge of cryptocurrency markets, defi and related technologies

Professional Attributes

- Excellent problem-solving skills with ability to perform under pressure
- Strong communication skills for cross-team collaboration
- Proactive approach to system reliability and performance optimization
- Continuous learning mindset in rapidly evolving AI/ML landscape
- Balance of practical engineering rigor with innovative solution development

Life @ Crypto.com

Empowered to think big. Try new opportunities while working with a talented, ambitious and supportive team.

Transformational and proactive working environment. Elevate employees to find thoughtful and innovative solutions.

Growth from within. We help to develop new skill-sets that would impact the shaping of your personal and professional growth.

Work Culture. Our colleagues are some of the best in the industry; we are all here to help and support one another.

One cohesive team. Engage stakeholders to achieve our ultimate goal - Cryptocurrency in every wallet.

Are you ready to kickstart your future with us?

Benefits

Competitive salary

Medical insurance package with extended coverage to dependents

Attractive annual leave entitlement including: birthday, work anniversary

Work Flexibility Adoption. Flexi-work hour and hybrid or remote set-up

Aspire career alternatives through us. Our internal mobility program can offer employees a diverse scope.

Work Perks: crypto.com visa card provided upon joining

Our Crypto.com benefits packages vary depending on region requirements, you can learn more from our talent acquisition team.

About Crypto.com:

Founded in 2016, Crypto.com serves more than 150 million customers and is the world's fastest growing global cryptocurrency platform. Our vision is simple: Cryptocurrency in Every Wallet™. Built on a foundation of security, privacy, and compliance, Crypto.com is committed to accelerating the adoption of cryptocurrency through innovation and empowering the next generation of builders, creators, and entrepreneurs to develop a fairer and more equitable digital ecosystem.

Learn more at https://crypto.com.

Crypto.com is an equal opportunities employer and we are committed to creating an environment where opportunities are presented to everyone in a fair and transparent way. Crypto.com values diversity and inclusion, seeking candidates with a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills that complement and strengthen our team.

Personal data provided by applicants will be used for recruitment purposes only.

title: Graduate Character Artist
description:
Frontier is an independent video game developer and publisher, crafting immersive gaming experiences with fun gameplay and unparalleled artistic quality. Renowned for its iconic creative management simulation games, Frontier captivates players worldwide with immersive and authentic game worlds. The modern studio is located in the vibrant technology hub of Cambridge (UK). The talented team at Frontier are dedicated to nurturing our existing portfolio and delivering our exciting future roadmap.

This role is offered on a full in-studio basis or a hybrid basis (minimum 3 days per week in the studio). We can provide a comprehensive relocation support package as part of any offer, should you need to relocate.

We welcome applications from all, however please note that this role is not eligible for visa.

WHAT’S THE ROLE?

We’re looking for a Graduate Character Artist to join our team. As a company we produce a wide spectrum of subject matter from stunningly photorealistic animals to beautifully stylised characters, so populating our games is always a rewarding experience.

This is a fantastic opportunity to contribute to our ambitious future roadmap of games.

*Please note that candidates invited to interview may be asked to complete a role-related assessment in their own time as part of the selection process. Further details regarding the expected time commitment will be provided in advance.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Creating game-ready 3D models and textures using Maya, ZBrush and Substance Painter.
- Collaborating with fellow Character Artists to maintain the highest quality throughout development by delivering models on budget, on time, and in the appropriate art style.
- Bringing a new perspective, and where appropriate, suggesting potential improvements to existing pipelines.
- Actively participating in team meetings and contributing to the overall development process.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- Demonstrated expertise in anatomical and organic sculpting from reference, with a portfolio showcasing work across both stylised and realistic art styles.
- Ability to work collaboratively and take on feedback and guidance from the rest of the team.
- Experience with translating 2D concepts or reference into 3D Character models. Making artistic decisions to troubleshoot the transformative process and refine the final 3D design.
- Ability to adapt to and work within established art styles, ensuring consistency with the concept art.
- An exceptional level of character modelling in ZBrush.
- Extensive knowledge of preferred 3D packages such as Maya.
- Excellent Substance Painter texturing skills and hand painting.
- Familiarity with the entire real-time character pipeline from high-poly sculpting, retopology, UV mapping, baking, texture creation and ending in the set up and exporting of assets to game.
- An awareness of the importance of efficient UV layouts and mesh topology, to ensure that character models are optimised for performance, budgets, and deform well when animated.
- An understanding of development pipelines, including how your work will be used in dependent disciplines.
- Excellent communication skills are essential.

BONUS IF YOU HAVE

- Solid foundational art skills such as 2D drawing.
- An Art degree or relevant game art course.
- Genuine passion for sculpting creatures.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU

You will work with talented and passionate people to support, develop or publish our sophisticated and enduring games, in a creative, collaborative and inclusive environment. We love what we do, and we work hard to provide outstanding experiences for our players.

Wellbeing is a big focus at Frontier, and we are continually evolving how we can support our people. We encourage a healthy work/life balance and provide a range of wellbeing activities, initiatives and sessions to support both mental and physical health.

We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, which includes a success-based annual bonus, share option schemes, life assurance, private family healthcare, flexitime working hours, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, in-house subsidised catering, support with relocation, a Cycle to Work scheme, free bike servicing, and social activities and events.

We strive to create an environment where everyone can fully demonstrate their capability and potential. If you therefore need any reasonable adjustments to support you during the recruitment process, please speak to your Talent Acquisition representative.

For queries, please email: -----Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior GenAI Engineer (UK)
description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning

Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive platform, with AI agents that work alongside every team, from Finance to HR, to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally, passing $100M in ARR in 2026 and doubling revenue for the second year in a row. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake, and Siemens use Pigment every day to make better-informed decisions and navigate any scenario with confidence.

In October 2026, we raised a $250M Series E at a $2.3B valuation, bringing our total funding to $650M+. Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

Pigment is seeking an experienced GenAI Engineer with a strong CS background and experience with Large Language Models (LLM) to join our innovative and fast-paced team.

In this role, you will work on cutting-edge NLP projects and play a crucial part in developing and refining our product. If you are passionate about machine learning, have a strong background in natural language processing, and thrive in a collaborative and high-impact environment, we'd love to hear from you!

What you will do :

- Work on bleeding edge multi-agents features. This includes the improvement of rolled-out features and the conception of new ones.

- Have the opportunity to work on the whole stack. The AI teams have frontend, backend (C# and python), infrastructure and CI skills

- Work on AI features built on top of the Pigment computation engine that provides determinism, auditability and data visualizations

- Work on AI features with an ambitious product vision, that are actively used, have a real world impact and are built to last (high test coverage - you can focus on building the next step, not chasing bugs)

🎧Listen to our podcast on Pigment’s GenAI team

📖Read more about our vision: Agentic AI for Data Analysis

#LI-GP1

#LI-REMOTE

Requierements

- MS or Ph.D. in Computer Science, or experience writing production-grade code
- Strong programming skills in Python, and/or C#, Java, nodejs, or equivalent
- Hands-on experience on prompting large language models. It can be through the usage of vibe coding tools, or having implemented GenAI features
- Knowledge about the recent developments of agents is a plus
- Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Product oriented. GenAI challenges are mainly about translating a user need into a simple technical solution
- If you are passionate about Generative AI and want to work on a cutting-edge business planning platform, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity at Pigment.
- Bonus: experience working with kubernetes
- Bonus: experience building agents using langgraph
- Bonus: experience building and shipping complex products on top of LLMs
- Bonus: experience building evaluation pipelines

What you will get

- Competitive package
- Stock options to ensure you have a stake in Pigment's growth
- The best health insurance with Alan Blue entirely free for you and your family
- Weekly Lunch and Lunch vouchers (Swile card) to cover your lunch breaks with total flexibility
- Subscription to Egym Wellpass (ex-Gymlib) for full access to gyms, studios, and wellness spaces across France
- Trust and flexible working hours
- Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities including New York, San Francisco, Toronto, Paris, and London
- High-end equipment (based on stock/availability) to do your work in the best conditions
- Remote-friendly environment

We conduct background checks as part of our hiring process, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. This may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally permitted, criminal records. Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially.

Pigment is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity is a strength and fosters innovation. We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, social origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We may process your personal data in accordance with our HR Data Protection Notice.

Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake, and Siemens use Pigment every day to make better-informed decisions and navigate any scenario with confidence.

In October 2026, we raised a $250M Series E at a $2.3B valuation, bringing our total funding to $650M+. Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do
As Global Alliance Director you will own and lead Pigment’s EMEA strategy and execution across Global System Integrator (GSI) partnerships. This is a highly visible role responsible for defining and scaling a world-class alliance function that drives significant revenue growth, accelerates enterprise adoption, and expands Pigment’s global footprint.

You will manage GSI strategy and senior relationships across EMEA with the support of regional in-market Partner Sales Managers—shaping long-term vision, influencing executive stakeholders (both internally and externally), and building a high-performing global network.

- Help define and execute Pigment’s EMEA GSI strategy, including partner segmentation, prioritization, and long-term value creation models.

- Build and maintain executive-level relationships (C-suite and global practice leaders) across top-tier GSIs such as Deloitte, EY, PwC, and Accenture.

- Establish and own EMEA joint business plans, including multi-year revenue targets, industry and use case solutions, geographic expansion, and joint assets.

- Drive EMEA GTM strategy plus execution, ensuring tight alignment with regional leadership to accelerate pipeline creation and deal closure.

- Lead EMEA governance frameworks with GSIs, including executive steering committees, QBRs, and performance management, aligning with NAMER peers for Global alignment.

- Scale partner-enabled revenue by building repeatable industry solutions, delivery models, and service offerings in collaboration with GSIs.

- Sponsor and guide global enablement programs to ensure GSI teams are trained, certified, and positioned to successfully sell and deliver Pigment solutions.

- Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Pre-Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to embed GSIs into Pigment’s global go-to-market engine.

- Act as a key member of the EMEA GTM leadership team, contributing to broader company strategy and representing EMEA GSI Alliances at the executive level.

Minimum Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in alliances, partner ecosystems, enterprise SaaS sales, or consulting, with a strong focus on GSIs.

- Proven track record of building and scaling EMEA-wide partnerships that drive significant, measurable revenue.

- Deep understanding of GSI operating models, including how they sell, deliver, and scale transformation programs globally.

- Demonstrated success operating at the executive level, including influencing C-suite stakeholders internally and externally.

- Strong leadership experience, including working with high-performing, geographically distributed teams in a player/coach environment.

- Exceptional strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution capability.

- Outstanding communication, negotiation, and executive presence skills.

- Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environment with global complexity.

- Strong business acumen with the ability to connect customer transformation needs to partner capabilities and Pigment’s value proposition.

Preferred Qualifications

- Prior experience working within a top-tier GSI (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, EY, PwC) in a leadership capacity.

- Experience in enterprise planning, FP&A, ERP, data platforms, or digital transformation ecosystems.

- Background in scaling alliances within a high-growth or category-defining SaaS company.

- Experience building global industry solutions and joint offerings with partners.

- Strong network of senior relationships across GSIs and the broader enterprise technology ecosystem.

- Experience presenting business cases and leading discussions with C-Level Executives of Global 2000 companies.

- Stock options to ensure you have a stake in Pigment’s growth

- Generous time off and flexible working hours

- Access to high-end equipment and tools to support your work

- Remote-friendly environment and global team-wide offsites

- Never Settle: We aim to be the best by delivering with rigor and ambition every day.

- Go For It: We’re biased toward action—every step fuels learning and brings us closer to our mission.

description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning

Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive platform, with AI agents that work alongside every team, from Finance to HR, to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally, passing $100M in ARR in 2026 and doubling revenue for the second year in a row. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake, and Siemens use Pigment every day to make better-informed decisions and navigate any scenario with confidence.

In October 2026, we raised a $250M Series E at a $2.3B valuation, bringing our total funding to $650M+. Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

You’ll join Pigment’s Reporting & Collaboration community, working as a senior hands-on Frontend Engineer on some of the most complex parts of the product.

This community is responsible for how users access, configure and interact with their data. That creates significant frontend challenges around large-scale datasets, filtering, visualisation, complex configuration and increasingly AI-powered experiences.

On the engineering part:

- Spend approximately 80% of your time as a hands-on engineer, designing, building and shipping production features.
- Work on complex, data-heavy frontend problems where performance, usability and scale all matter.
- Build sophisticated interfaces for displaying, filtering and interacting with large datasets.
- Work with React, TypeScript and JavaScript, while contributing to the wider technical decisions behind the product.
- Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Designers and Engineers to take features from problem definition through to production.
- Make pragmatic engineering decisions based on the needs of the product and its users, rather than pursuing technical complexity for its own sake.
- Contribute to areas across Reporting & Collaboration depending on business needs and your interests, including data extraction and filtering, visualisation, complex configuration and emerging AI experiences.
- Use modern engineering tooling, with Pigment teams working across GCP, CircleCI and AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot. This is not a traditional Engineering Manager role where you step away from the code. You will remain a senior individual contributor and be expected to ship.

On the people management part, here is what it entails:
At Pigment, people management and technical leadership are deliberately separated.

Tech Leads lead the technical direction of individual teams. Engineering Managers focus on developing engineers as people while remaining hands-on engineers themselves.

- Spend approximately 20% of your time on people management.
- Gradually take on direct reports after establishing yourself as an IC during your probation period.
- Coach engineers across different teams within the Reporting & Collaboration community.
- Support engineers with career progression, development, feedback and performance.
- Run regular 1:1s and help engineers understand what they need to do to progress.
- Set clear expectations and provide actionable feedback.
- Handle difficult performance conversations when necessary and follow through with clear development plans.
- Partner with Tech Leads to understand how your reports are performing technically without taking ownership of the Tech Lead's responsibilities.
- Help create an environment where strong engineers can continue to develop while doing their best work. Engineering Managers typically support engineers across multiple teams within their community rather than "owning" a single engineering team.

Who you are
We’re looking for someone who is both a strong senior Frontend Engineer and an experienced people manager.

- Significant professional software-engineering experience, with the technical depth expected of a senior engineer.
- Strong recent hands-on frontend engineering experience.
- Production experience with React, TypeScript and/or JavaScript.
- Previous formal people-management experience. Ideally, you have already managed engineers rather than looking for your first management opportunity.
- Experience owning areas such as coaching, career development, feedback and performance management, not simply mentoring engineers or leading projects.
- Experience building complex product interfaces, ideally within B2B SaaS, enterprise software, analytics, data platforms or another sophisticated data-heavy product.
- Experience solving frontend problems involving areas such as large datasets, visualisation, filtering, configuration, performance or complex workflows.
- A strong product mindset. You care about what you're building, who is using it and whether it genuinely solves their problem.
- Strong collaboration skills across Engineering, Product and Design.
- The ability and desire to remain deeply hands-on in the code while managing people.
- The autonomy expected of a senior IC: once you understand the problem, you can work with the team to move it forward without needing constant direction.
- Fluent English. French is not required.
What you will get

- Competitive salary
- Equity
- The best health insurance with Alan Blue is entirely free for you and your family 💙
- Trust and flexible working hours
- Brand new offices in the heart of Paris, London, New York, and, Toronto
- Remote-friendly environment

title: Senior KDB+ Specialist – Fixed Income Algo Trading & Analytics
description:
Join MARGO in the UK (London) – Perm & Contracting Opportunities

MARGO is a tech-native consultancy delivering high value-added IT expertise to the financial services industry. We specialise in data-intensive trading and risk environments where real-time analytics, large data volumes, and high-performance engineering are critical. Joining MARGO means working on highly specialized data platforms while benefiting from a human-sized structure, close follow-up, and tailored career paths.

Business Context

You will work directly within the Front Office Fixed Income Algo Trading IT environment. This role sits in a fast-paced setting focused on real-time pricing, risk management, and trading algorithm performance for FI products.

The platform supports:

- Real-time and intraday market data streaming and time-series capture.

- Fixed Income pricing, hedging, and risk analytics.

- Ad-hoc statistical analysis of algorithm behavior, client behavior, and market impact.

- Real-time trade and algorithm monitoring dashboards (e.g., Panopticon).

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior KDB+ / q Specialist to work on real-time data and algo trading platforms. While centered on robust kdb+ development, the position features short feedback cycles and direct interaction with traders and production teams.

We welcome candidates with strong kdb+ / q experience who thrive across:

- Core kdb+ / q development & time-series architecture

- 3rd line platform support & performance optimization

- Technical business analysis & trader-facing requirement gathering

Key Responsibilities

- Development & Analytics: Design, develop, test, and deliver change on real-time KDB+ processes, including API and schema design for FI Algo desks.

- Business Interaction: Liaise directly with traders to gather requirements, analyze algo performance, and build custom monitoring views (such as Altair Panopticon dashboards).

- Platform & Data Ownership: Maintain and evolve time-series data models, optimize q code performance, and build compliance/monitoring tools.

- Support & Delivery: Provide 3rd line technical support to production teams, participate in release processes (including occasional out-of-hours releases), and ensure software delivery compliance.

Technical Environment

- Core: kdb+ / q, TorQ framework, Linux/UNIX environments.

- Testing & CI/CD: qspec, qunit, Gitlab CI/CD, JFrog Artifactory, Rundeck.

- Visualization & Tools: Altair Panopticon (or similar monitoring tools).

Required Experience & Skills

Essential

- Deep, hands-on experience with q/KDB+ in a front-office time-series environment.

- Solid knowledge of Fixed Income (FI) products or quantitative finance.

- Strong Linux/UNIX OS knowledge and performance monitoring mindset.

- Proven track record in a trader-facing or front-office role with clear communication and systematic reasoning.

- Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or Engineering.

Valued

- Experience with the TorQ framework, qspec, or qunit.

- Exposure to Altair Panopticon dashboards.

- Familiarity with modern software delivery, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile methodologies.

Why Join MARGO

- Direct impact on front-office algorithmic trading and risk architectures.

- Flexible exposure across development, 3rd line support, and quantitative business analysis.

- Agile team culture with short feedback loops and rapid delivery cycles (hours to days).

- Human-sized consultancy with close support and long-term career focus.

Interested? Apply on our website or at ----- data-path-to-node="23,1">.

About the Company

e.l.f. Beauty's purpose is to make the world a better place for every eye, lip, and face.

Our deep commitment to clean, cruelty free beauty at an incredible value has fueled the success of our flagship brand e.l.f. Cosmetics since 2004 and driven our portfolio expansion. Today, our multi-brand portfolio includes e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN, e.l.f. Hair, Well People, Naturium and rhode.

title: Fix Term Contract 8 Months - Senior Client Advisor - Department Store - London
description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS

Jacquemus was founded by Simon Porte Jacquemus in 2009 in Paris, France.

Dedicated to the memory of the designer’s late mother, the brand draws inspiration from a passion for culture. The Jacquemus ready-to-wear and accessories collections for men and women reference the French way of life and universal gestures of beauty, encompassing influences from fine art photography to decorative arts, cinema, painting, and sculpture.

Throughout the years, Jacquemus has staged runway productions in unique and unexpected locations, including a Parisian swimming pool, the Musée Picasso, a lavender field in Provence, a wheat field outside Paris, a salt marsh in the Camargue, and a beach in Hawaii. More recently, the brand has embraced settings such as the canal of the Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), the Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), Casa Malaparte (La Casa) and Auguste Perret’s Parisian apartment (La Croisière).

Based in the 8th arrondissement of Paris, Jacquemus is an independent fashion house with over 300 employees. Renowned for its fast-growing digital presence and its worldwide business spread, the brand has created innovative retail experiences around the world before opening its first permanent flagship store at 58 Avenue Montaigne in Paris in 2022. Following this milestone, international boutiques have opened in New York (SoHo), London (New Bond Street), Los Angeles (Melrose Avenue) and Dubai.

YOUR ROLE

As a Senior Client Advisor, you will be an ambassador of the House and play a crucial role in offering each client a unique experience in line with the values and commitment of the House. You will strive to discover your clients' personalities and identify their desires while introducing them to the DNA of the House and its entire product range.

MISSIONS

- Contribute to the development of sales revenue and achieving the sales targets of the store
- Welcome and advise our clients to provide them with an exceptional experience
- Share your product expertise with our clients
- Show initiative and boldness in suggesting complementary products
- Contribute to the recruitment and loyalty of our clients by building privileged and lasting relationships with each of them
- Ensure the proper maintenance of the store
- Collaborate with the rest of the team to ensure the smooth operation of the store: Visual merchandising, restocking, transfers, customer service, stock management
- Master and adhere to internal procedures and guidelines
- Support the digital evolution of the House
- Embrace the Jacquemus spirit with your creativity and sense of excellence

YOUR PROFILE

- You have a high sensitivity to product and fashion
- You have at least 5 years of professional experience in sales and in the fashion or luxury sector, and ideally experience selling luxury handbags
- You have the ability to understand and go beyond the client's needs to offer the best possible client experience
- You have the ability to transition pre-existing client follow while also absorbing existing boutique clients reassigned to them
- You have a taste for challenges and a desire to collectively achieve set objectives
- Initiative, a sense of service, natural curiosity, open-mindedness, optimism, and empathy are essential for your success at JACQUEMUS
- You are fluent in English. Another language would be a plus
-From end of November to end of July

title: Senior LNG Market Analyst
description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

As a Senior LNG Market Analyst, you will play a central role in driving the accuracy, depth, and strategic value of Kpler’s global Gas & LNG intelligence. Embedded within the Gas & LNG market operations team, you will bridge the gap between physical market dynamics and advanced data analytics to maintain trusted cargo-level data. Working closely with Product, Engineering, News, and Sales teams, you will turn complex trade datasets into actionable insights and shape future platform developments for our global clients.

Key Responsibilities

- Maintain data accuracy and platform coverage: Monitor the Kpler LNG platform daily to ensure the highest standards of accuracy, completeness, and timeliness across cargo data and emerging market sectors like LNG bunkering.
- Perform advanced dataset analysis: Structure, audit, and analyse large, disparate, or unstructured trade datasets to track global energy flows and identify emerging market trends.
- Drive product roadmap collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering teams to convert market observations into technical improvements, refining data pipelines and expanding product features.
- Support sales enablement and client engagement: Conduct technical product demonstrations in partnership with global Sales teams, helping clients extract maximum strategic value from Kpler solutions.
- Track market events and trade flows: Monitor key developments across global gas markets, including infrastructure outages, trade rerouting, and maintenance events, ensuring data models reflect real-time market realities.
- Foster internal and external networks: Collaborate cross-functionally with internal News and Insight teams while building strong industry networks to anticipate client intelligence needs.
Experience & Background

- 4+ years of experience as a Market Analyst (or similar role) focused on Gas or LNG markets - additional prior experience within the broader energy commodities sector would be advantageous.
- Strong technical proficiency in handling datasets using advanced Excel alongside practical knowledge of SQL and programming/scripting languages such as Python or VBA.
- Demonstrated capability in analyzing large, complex, and unstructured datasets to identify trends and inform strategic decisions.
- Are a highly motivated individual, a self-starter who will be passionate about owning responsibilities upholding the trusted accuracy and agility of the Kpler data.
- Demonstrate strong capabilities in logical thinking with attention to detail.
- Experience presenting data findings, platform features, or market insights to external clients and commercial stakeholders.
We are a dynamic company dedicated to nurturing connections and innovating solutions to tackle market challenges head-on. If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us?

We make things happen

We act decisively and with purpose, going the extra mile.

We build together

We foster relationships and develop creative solutions to address market challenges.

We are here to help

We are accessible and supportive to colleagues and clients with a friendly approach.

Our People Pledge

Don’t meet every single requirement? Research shows that women and people of color are less likely than others to apply if they feel like they don’t match 100% of the job requirements. Don’t let the confidence gap stand in your way, we’d love to hear from you! We understand that experience comes in many different forms and are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.

Kpler is committed to providing a fair, inclusive and diverse work-environment. We believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, and better ideas allow us to better understand the needs and interests of our diverse, global community. title: Market Data Analyst - Dry Bulk
description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 700 experts from 35+ countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

Your future position:
Kpler’s Dry Bulk business is expanding, and we are looking for a Market Data Analyst – Dry Bulk to take ownership of data quality and operational processes across assigned geographical regions and product groups.

While the position is internally known as Market Data Analyst - Metals & Minerals, its scope extends across a broader range of dry bulk commodities, including ferrous and non-ferrous metals, solid fuels, and industrial minerals.

This is a role for someone who wants to sit close to how global commodity markets actually move. You will combine strong SQL and Python skills with a curiosity about the real-world events shaping those movements - from shifting trade flows and supply chain disruptions to changes in industrial demand, policy, and pricing dynamics.

You won’t just be processing data. You will play a key role in turning complex, high-volume datasets into reliable market intelligence used by clients to understand what is happening in global physical markets. Your work will directly influence how accurately we reflect real-world commodity flows.

Your mission is to:

- Take charge of specific regions and product groups, ensuring the highest standard of data quality by reviewing internal constraints, validating automated outputs, and ingesting data from diverse external sources.

- Identify and implement technology and process improvements – including contributions to SQL queries, Python scripts, and pipeline tooling – to increase the efficiency and accuracy of our seaborne flow data.

- Track news, trade flows, and industry developments across metals and minerals markets. Extract meaningful patterns and ensure they are well reflected in our data product.

- Lead responses to ad-hoc client requests (email, video call, in-person) with rapid, well-structured analysis. Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to address client data needs and feed insights back into internal systems.

- Engage proactively with the broader data architecture; understand how upstream data sources, internal systems, and client-facing solutions interact, and propose improvements that scale across the team.

- Act as a knowledgeable and self-directed team member capable of picking up complex technical tasks independently and driving them to completion with minimal supervision.

You could be a match if you are or have:

- Experience working with data products and complex datasets. You understand how data is collected, processed, validated, and delivered to end users. You can investigate data inconsistencies, identify root causes, and contribute to improving data quality, reliability, and the overall user experience.
- Strong proficiency in SQL and Python (PostgreSQL, MSSQL, or similar) is a core requirement. You use both to query databases, analyse data, and automate workflows, building and maintaining scripts to remove manual processes and improve efficiency. Strong Excel skills are required for analysis and commercial reporting.

- A genuine interest in physical commodity markets. You are curious about how global trade works in practice and how commodities move around the world. You want to understand the forces shaping supply and demand, trade flows, production, shipping, and pricing, as well as the economic, political, and industrial developments behind market movements. You actively seek to understand not only what is happening, but why it matters. We are looking for someone who can articulate what interests them about these markets and is motivated to deepen their knowledge over time.
- Comfortable managing high-frequency datasets, identifying anomalies, and maintaining high standards of data quality under tight deadlines.

- Strong communicator, able to translate complex technical outputs into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and build effective relationships across teams.

- Proactive and self-directed: takes ownership, anticipates issues, and drives work independently to completion.

- Experience supporting or mentoring junior colleagues, or a clear interest in developing others as the team grows would be highly adventagous.

Desirable:

- Experience working with seaborne commodity data (e.g. AIS, port or vessel data).

- Familiarity with data visualisation tools such as Tableau or similar.

title: Senior Network Automation Engineer (EU)
description:
About Megaport

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

Our Team Culture

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.

We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

You’re a senior engineer who is well respected by your peers, and know how to lead effectively. You find joy in making a product that customers love. You love taking ownership over your work and can balance managing technical debt with improving the user’s experience / adding product features. You are interested in the newest technology and you’d like an environment where you can share your skills with like minded people on a no ego team. We’re a tech company at our core and we have an interesting domain we work in. And we want you to join us!

What You’ll Be Doing

- Contribute to enhancing our existing Perl code base powering our network automation systems and internal toolset. Implement new code using a modular approach with automated testing and reporting on code coverage.

- Identify and reduce technical debt, improve performance and reliability, and participate in scaling decisions across our platform.

- Build and maintain secure, scalable RESTful APIs. Ensure adherence to API standards, versioning practices, and monitoring instrumentation.

- Play a key role in our release process by writing reliable tests, reviewing code rigorously, and contributing to CI/CD pipeline improvements.

- Support the growth of junior engineers through pairing, thoughtful code reviews, and informal coaching. Promote sound design principles and foster a culture of continuous technical learning.

What We Are Looking For

- 5+ years of software development experience using Perl and frameworks like Mojolicious.

- Experience working with relational databases using SQL (preferably PostgreSQL).

- Working knowledge of using distributed datastores and NoSQL (Cassandra or similar).

- Proven experience building backend services and tools within web application ecosystems.

- Ability to act as a technical lead for small projects (typically up to 4 developers), offering architectural and design guidance.

- Excellent collaboration and communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.

- Sharp logical reasoning skills and a habit of asking the right questions, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly and succinctly.

- Determined to automate as much as possible so you can focus on the bigger picture.

- An ability to reason logically, question appropriately and present technical information clearly and concisely.

- Experience maintaining scalable versioned, secure REST APIs

- Experience with networking concepts such as IP routing and MPLS

What We Offer

- Flexible working environment – a remote-first culture with coworking options available

- Generous leave plans – including, parental leave, birthday leave, and a purchased annual leave program

- Health and wellness support – through a wellness allowance and employee wellbeing initiatives

- Comprehensive learning support – generous study and training allowance plus paid study leave

- Creative, modern workspaces – designed to inspire when you're not working remotely, plus access to coworking spaces via our global WeWork membership if you work remotely, but like to get out of the house sometimes

- Motivated, inclusive team – work alongside industry experts and fresh talent

- Recognition programs – celebrate achievements with our Legend and Kudos award

If you have any questions, please reach out to Megaport's Talent Acquisition Team at -----

NOTE: All Megaport business correspondence is conducted via our business email accounts ----- If you have any concerns, please reach out to Megaport's careers team ----- directly and we will verify the legitimacy of any communication. Megaport will not ask you to create an account via Microsoft teams, and does not associate with any email accounts under -----

All applications will be treated in confidence.

Please see Part 2 of our Privacy Policy to see what information Megaport collects from job applicants, why, and how we store and use it. Note that you’re entitled to know what personal data of yours Megaport holds, to request updates, rectification, and in some circumstances restriction or deletion thereof if you object (you being entitled to withdraw your consent to our holding your information at any time). Please see Part 5 of our Privacy Policy for more details on this and how to contact Megaport's data protection officer if you have any further privacy-related questions. Candidates who meet the selection criteria will be invited to attend an interview. Strictly no Recruitment Agencies.

title: Account Director - Financiers
description:
Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?

Purpose of the role

The successful candidate will own Keyloop's relationships with financiers, both captive (OEM-owned) and independent, while maximising client adoption of the Keyloop Retention Hub through a customer retention lens and growing the use of Keyloop's AI-based capabilities within the Retention space. The role is UK-based with a global account book and regular international travel, reporting directly into the Financiers & Fleet Director. The candidate will understand the commercial dynamics of automotive finance and be equally comfortable operating at operational and senior commercial/strategic levels within each financier.

Key Headlines

- First point of contact for existing and new financier accounts, spanning captive and independent financiers.
- Own the senior relationship with financiers and grow the Keyloop Retention Hub agenda across their organisations and, where relevant, their dealer networks.
- Drive adoption of the Keyloop Retention Hub with a specific focus on customer retention outcomes.
- Lead cross-sell of AI-based capabilities within the Retention space (such as AI video and lead nurture), and identify new client opportunities across the wider Keyloop portfolio.
- UK-based role with regular international travel; account book is global.
- Monthly face-to-face team meetings in the UK.

Key Duties & Responsibilities

- Deliver excellent account management across captive and independent financier stakeholders.
- Maintain weekly dialogue with clients on Keyloop Retention Hub adoption and customer retention outcomes.
- Build and maintain multi-level relationships within financier organisations (commercial, risk, retention/customer, operations and IT), from operational teams through to senior leadership.
- Develop and apply a thorough understanding of financier commercial models, the customer ownership lifecycle (including PCP/PCH and trade cycle management) and retention dynamics, and how these intersect with dealer network operations.
- Support contract renewals and commercial negotiations alongside Legal and the Enterprise Team, including liaison with financier procurement and legal teams.
- Position the Keyloop Retention Hub and its AI-based capabilities as drivers of customer retention and commercial value in client conversations.
- Produce Quarterly Review Packs covering retention outcomes, adoption of the Retention Hub and AI-based capabilities, and system development delivered.

title: Software/Data Engineer
description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you.

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.

To help fuel that growth, we need a Data Engineer to join our Engineering team.

This team is the beating heart of Prima.

You’ll be joining over 300 engineers across software development, infrastructure, operations and security. Fueled by curiosity, experimentation and collaboration, you’ll help deliver scalable, impactful solutions that shape the future of insurance.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details

You’ll be joining our pricing and underwriting domain to bridge the gap between machine learning/data science and engineering. You will help build, publish, and maintain our complex data products and pipelines, key elements that have a significant impact on the company’s growth.

What you’ll do

- Shaping the architecture of data products designed for data analytics and data science specifically focusing on use cases like forecasting, feature engineering, customer behaviour, and integration of new data sources.
- Leading the way in data transformation by setting up best practices in areas like Data modelling, performance optimisation, Data Governance etc, ensuring that the data used within Prima is consistent, available and reliable.
- Build reusable technology that enables teams to ingest, store, transform, and serve their own data products.
- Engaging with data scientists and machine learning engineers to explore the product landscape and refine data requirements for enhanced data infrastructure.
- Embrace continuous learning and experimentation to stay updated on emerging technologies, from testing open source tools to engaging in community-building activities like Meetups. Your passion for staying at the forefront of the field will drive your journey.

What we’re looking for

- Expert in batch, distributed data processing and near real-time streaming data pipelines with technologies like Kafka, Flink, Spark etc. Experience in Databricks is a plus.
- Experience in Data Lake / Big Data Analytics platform implementation with cloud based solution; AWS preferred.
- Proficient in Python programming and software engineering best practices.
- Expertise with RDBMS, Data Warehousing, Data Modelling with relational SQL (Redshift, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases.
- Proficiency in DevOps, CI/CD pipeline management, and expertise in infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployment industry-best practices.

Nice-to-Have

- Hands-on experience in Data Quality and Data Governance techniques.
- Knowledge on MLOps and Feature engineering.
- Exposure to common data analysis and ML technologies such as on scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, XGBoost, LightGBM.
- Exposure to tools like Apache Oozie, Apache Airflow.

Why you’ll love it here:

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year.

🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at ----- Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager (French-speaking)
description:
Are you a French-speaking Customer Success professional with a passion for learning and technology? Do you thrive on building strong customer relationships, spotting opportunities for growth, and helping customers succeed? Then the Senior Customer Success Manager role at Kahoot! might be just the right fit for you. Come join us in making learning awesome!

The Role

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you will play a key role in helping medium to large enterprise customers succeed and getting the most out of our products. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will help customers achieve tangible business results with our products while identifying opportunities to strengthen relationships, drive retention, and grow accounts.

You will be part of our International Customer Success team, working with customers across one or more products in the Kahoot! Group's portfolio.

Fluency in French is essential for this role, as you will work closely with customers in France and other French-speaking markets across EMEA.

This role can be based in Copenhagen, Denmark; Paris, France; or Oslo, Norway. You will report to the regional Manager, Customer Success.

Responsibilities

Portfolio Ownership and Customer Outcomes

- Own a portfolio of mid-sized to large Enterprise customers and drive measurable progress towards their business objectives.
- Manage the full customer lifecycle: handover from Sales, onboarding, adoption, value realisation, business reviews (QBRs/EBRs) and renewals (in collaboration with Account Management, where applicable).
- Build and maintain success plans and account plans with clear, customer-agreed success metrics and ROI.

Strategic and Commercial Impact

- Use strong business acumen and our MEDDIC-based methodology to run discovery, uncover customer pain points and their business impact, and map stakeholders, champions and decision-making processes.
- Build multi-threaded relationships, including at executive-sponsor level.
- Own or support renewals and retention targets (GRR/NRR), forecast renewals accurately, and identify expansion opportunities in partnership with Account Managers and Account Executives.

Risk and Health Management

- Monitor customer health and product usage data to spot risks early, and lead mitigation and retention plans.
- Act as the customer’s escalation point, coordinating with Support, Product and leadership to resolve critical issues.
- Analyse customer churn and losses, and share key learnings.

Scaling and Enablement

- Partner with Customer Education to deliver one-to-many programmes, including webinars, live training and help center content.
- Support Sales and Events as a product expert and trusted advisor during customer calls and events.

Voice of the Customer and Advocacy

- Bring structured customer feedback to Product, Sales and Customer Experience to shape our products and services.
- Develop customer advocates through references, case studies and community engagement.

Leadership and operational excellence

- Mentor and coach less experienced colleagues alongside your manager.
- Help develop CS playbooks, processes and best practices.
- Keep CRM data, account plans and forecasts accurate and up to date.

Requirements

- Fluency in French and English, written and spoken.
- Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Consulting, Sales, or from other similar roles.
- Proven track record of managing a portfolio of medium to large enterprise customers, delivering measurable customer value, and driving retention and account growth.
- Commercially minded, with a strong ability to build lasting customer relationships and identify opportunities for growth.
- Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels.
- A proactive, ambitious, and results-driven approach, with the ability to thrive in a fast-growing environment.
- A collaborative team player who works well in an international, distributed environment.
- Experience in SaaS and having industry domain knowledge are a plus.
- Familiarity with the MEDDICC methodology is a plus.

Benefits

- A competitive compensation package
- Insurance and health coverage
- Buddy program
- Centrally located office space
- Being part of a vibrant, diverse and passionate team
- Social and company events

About Kahoot!
The Kahoot! Group is on a mission to make learning awesome! We want to empower everyone, including children, students, and employees to unlock their full learning potential. Our Kahoot! learning platform makes it easy for any individual or corporation to create, share, and host learning sessions that drive compelling engagement.

Since launching in 2013, Kahoot! has become a global leader, hosting hundreds of millions of sessions with over 12 billion cumulative participants across 200+ countries and regions. The Kahoot! Group includes Clever, the top US K-12 EdTech platform, and popular learning apps like DragonBox, Poio, Drops, Actimo and Motimate. Headquartered in Oslo, Norway, we also have offices in the US, UK, France, Finland, Australia, Singapore, Japan, Estonia, Denmark, Spain, and Poland. Let’s play!

Our K!rew

At the Kahoot! Group we champion a positive culture of collaborative learning and innovation. With a global team of more than 600 employees representing over 50 different nationalities, we’re a diverse and fun bunch of people! We work hard and celebrate our wins, tackle challenges with original ideas and learn something new every day.

We are driven by our mission and guided by our values: playful, curious and inclusive.

If you talk to anyone working in the Kahoot! Group, they will tell you that one of the greatest perks is being able to see how the work you do puts a smile on the face of kids, teachers and learners all around the world.

Does this sound like the right opportunity for you? We'd love to hear from you!

Established in 1744, Sotheby’s promotes access and ownership of exceptional art and luxury objects through auctions, private sales and retail. THE ROLE

The focus of Marketing is to support Sotheby's Luxury departments in promoting their auctions and retail. Marketing will crucially reinforce Sotheby's place in the broader art and luxury market ecosystem via partnerships, collaborations, and events.

Reporting to the Senior Marketing Manager in Europe, the Associate Marketing Manager is responsible for creating and implementing marketing strategies for categories within the Luxury division, aligned with company goals. title: Product Manager - Post Booking
description:
About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 40 million active members to share rides across 41 countries each year. Its technology matches drivers with empty seats with passengers heading the same way, so they can share the cost of the trip.

BlaBlaCar’s mission is to be the go-to marketplace for shared travel, bringing carpooling, buses, and trains together in one place. Globally, the BlaBlaCar Group also includes Obilet, the leading online bus ticketing platform in Turkey. By partnering with over 20,000 operators, the Group offers a wide choice of affordable and sustainable transport solutions.

In 2025, the BlaBlaCar community connected 2.7 million meeting points worldwide and enabled 138 million connections between travelers. Drivers saved 568 million euros by carpooling, and all of the BlaBlaCar Group’s mobility services contributed to avoiding 4 million tonnes of CO2 emissions.

Your Mission

As the Product Manager for Post-booking, you will shape the experience passengers have after making a booking, from managing their trips to getting the help they need before, during and after their journey.

You will make post-booking a clear, reliable and useful part of the end-to-end BlaBlaCar experience across carpooling, bus and train. You will help passengers feel informed and in control, while reducing friction for our Customer Relationship Teams (CRT) and supporting the growth of our multimodal marketplace.

You will co-lead the Post-booking squad with an Engineering Manager and work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Customer Relationship and our supply stakeholders.

Your Responsibilities

- Shape the post-booking vision and roadmap: Set a clear direction for the passenger experience after purchase, translating BlaBlaCar’s product strategy and business priorities into a focused roadmap. Take full responsibility for your scope, from strategy through execution.
- Improve the post-booking passenger experience: Identify opportunities to strengthen passenger satisfaction and trust by helping people find the information they need, manage their bookings and feel supported throughout their journey. You will lead the end-to-end product discoveries for those opportunities.
- Optimize CRT contact rate: Partner with CRT teams to understand why passengers get in touch. Improve information on the platform and self-service so passengers can resolve issues with less effort. In particular, you will take over product leadership of our member-facing AI assistant.
- Use insights to guide decisions: Bring together customer feedback, product data and business context to identify opportunities, set priorities and evaluate impact using appropriate KPIs.
- Build alignment across teams: Act as the go-to product partner for Post-booking topics. Communicate the strategy, formalize major decisions and align leadership, Engineering, Design, CRT and other stakeholders.
Your Qualifications

- Experience: 3+ years in Product Management, ideally in a consumer marketplace, travel, mobility or another complex transactional product. Experience building products across markets, platforms or service types is a plus.
- Customer problem-solving: A track record of simplifying complex journeys and helping customers make confident decisions.
- Analytical approach: Comfortable combining product data, customer feedback and operational insights to identify problems, set priorities and measure results.
- Cross-functional influence: Able to bring Product, Engineering, Design, Operations and business stakeholders together around clear decisions and outcomes.
- Languages: Full fluency in English is mandatory. If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you’d still be a great fit for this role in your application!

What we have to offer

- 2 to 3 days at the office per week
- 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves
- 50% healthcare coverage (Alan)
- Financial support for home office equipment
- Minimum 25 days holiday per year
- Local meal plan policy (Swile card)
- 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)
- Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides
Interested in joining the ride? Here’s what your hiring journey will look like.

- A 45-min video-call with Talent Acquisition.
- A 45-minute video call with the Lead Product Manager.
- A Remote use case exercise, followed by a 45-minute presentation to a cross-functional panel of key stakeholders.
- A 30-minute video call with your engineering counterpart for final validation. Our hiring process lasts on average 20-25 days and offers usually come within 48 hours.

BlaBlaCar is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
