title: Staff Product Engineer - AI Native
description:
Ready to be part of the Legal Tech revolution?

Vision:

As a leading software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider, DiliTrust is a global company dedicated to offering an integrated suite of legal and governance products. Our vision is to digitize legal departments worldwide. With an annual growth rate of over 40% since 2020, our ambition is to become the world's leading Legal Tech company, aiming for a valuation exceeding $1 billion by 2026.

Our Impact:

From generating General Meeting reports to leveraging AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our teams in our 8 offices across France, the US, Mexico, MEA, Germany, Spain, Italy, and Canada are the driving force behind our global success. We proudly support 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of our clientele comprising listed companies in major markets such as Europe, North America, and the Middle East.

Our Recognition:

DiliTrust has been at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation, being the first Legal Tech with AI features since 2022. The company is renowned for providing a positive and entrepreneurial work environment. We are honored to have received the "Happy at Work" and "Tech at Work" labels every year since 2019.

The Role:

Lini is DiliTrust's proprietary AI engine, powering Ask Lini, Risk Detector, Document Summarization, Minute Generation, and every AI capability across the suite.

We are building a dedicated squad around it and are looking for a strong Software / Product Engineer, with a focus our platform architecture, to help us bring it to the next level.

As a Software Engineer work at the intersection of AI, product, and engineering. You will contribute to building, improving, and scaling the features that make Lini a reliable and powerful AI layer across the entire DiliTrust suite.

We are looking for an engineer who writes clean, production-ready code and is comfortable taking ownership of features end-to-end, from technical design to deployment. We also care about how you think about AI: whether you bring genuine curiosity to the product, and whether you can translate a model capability into a great user experience.

Missions

- Write specifications as the durable asset of the project. Executable acceptance criteria, and — crucially — the non-functional requirements that specs almost never carry: data classification, endpoint × role authorization matrix, volumetry assumptions, latency and throughput budgets. These are the requirements whose later correction is superlinear, so they get decided before generation, not after.
- Freeze the contracts before any fan-out. API schemas, types, module boundaries, invariants. Agents do not negotiate an interface in the hallway: each will make a plausible and incompatible assumption, discovered at integration.
- Pilot coding agents with a tight brief and a bounded context — narrow tasks, defined input and output artifacts, explicit stop conditions and budgets, full traceability of what produced each change.
- Keep producer and verifier separate. You do not sign off alone on generation you piloted, and you act as independent verifier on your peers' slices — with an adversarial brief ("find what breaks against this spec"), never "confirm this looks fine".
- Build the asymmetric gates that make the slice safe at volume — expensive to satisfy, cheap to check: property tests, contract tests, query-count and allocation budgets, execution-plan checks, policy-as-code, backward-compatibility proofs. Written before the implementation exists, so the agent closes the feedback loop itself without consuming human attention.
- Use code reading as a calibration instrument, not as a gate. Sample deliberately, by risk zone, to measure the real defect rate of the generator-plus-gates pair and to keep the team's mental model of its own system alive.
- Keep work-in-progress low. Capped PR size, thin vertical slices, trunk-based with very short branches, feature flags over long-lived branches, CI as the agent's first task rather than its last. More features in flight does not mean faster delivery when the bottleneck is verification.
- Design for blast radius. Reversibility, progressive delivery, structured logs, traces, metrics and instrumentation generated as a matter of course. On many paths, detecting in five minutes beats three days of review that prevents nothing.

Requirements

Being based in France with full working rights. Fluent in French and English.

Experience & Seniority:

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a significant portion spent building and operating B2B SaaS platforms in production
- Proven ownership of features across their full lifecycle — design, delivery, iteration, maintenance — on long-lived, multi-year products
- Strong background in complex, scalable web architectures, including real modularity: you have seen where coupling stops parallel work dead

AI-Native Practice:

- Demonstrated, sustained use of coding agents in production work — not autocomplete, but delegated implementation with review and accountability
- A concrete, articulated view of where generated code fails: correlated defects rather than idiosyncratic ones, uniform surface quality that destroys the usual "look here" review signals, plausibility with no author to interrogate
- Comfort being accountable for code you did not author, and the discipline to refuse a change you cannot explain

Verification & Quality:

- Real fluency in property-based testing, contract testing, and deriving tests from the specification rather than from the code
- Test-data strategy, including maintaining a volumetrically representative dataset as part of the verification apparatus — not a nice-to-have
- Instinct for the difference between a rigorous check and a scalable one: does the cost of checking grow with the volume produced?

Security & Performance (non-negotiable on this role):

- Authorization modelling in multi-tenant systems, and why declarative, centrally enforced authorization beats reviewing each endpoint. Generated code reliably checks who you are and regularly forgets whether you are allowed
- Awareness of the attack surface specific to an agent-assisted pipeline: prompt injection through ticket descriptions, code comments and dependency READMEs; supply-chain risk on hallucinated package names; least privilege for non-human identities; and the most frequent risk of all — production data or proprietary code leaking into the development loop
- Performance as a measured number rather than a code-reading opinion: query budgets per HTTP request, N+1, unbounded result sets, missing indexes on new query paths, network calls in loops, execution-plan review. These are invisible at test-data scale and expensive in production

Product & Team Collaboration:

- Excellent written communication — specification writing is now a core engineering skill on this role, not documentation overhead
- Extensive experience working directly with product managers, designers and stakeholders in a product-oriented setup
- Strong sense of ownership and sound judgment on risk: what to build, what not to build, what residual risk is acceptable and why

Education:

- Master's degree in Engineering or equivalent practical experience in senior SaaS environments

What this role is not

We would rather say it up front:

- It is not a prompt-engineering role, and it is not an ML/LLM research role.
- It is not a role where green tests are sufficient evidence. On security and performance, "the spec is met and the tests pass" is not a weak signal — it is a null one.
- It is not a ticket queue. The profile that shrinks in an AI-native team is the one whose value was implementing assigned tickets between two boundaries.

Our Tech Stack

- Backend: Node.js / TypeScript
- Frontend: Vue.js 3
- Database: PostgreSQL, MariaDB
- DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
- Cloud: GCP

Engineering apparatus you will use and help build: coding agents orchestrated deterministically in CI, aspect-scoped verification agents (authorization, performance, spec conformance, dependencies), policy-as-code, property-based and contract testing, volumetric test datasets, load and endurance gates on critical paths, feature flags, progressive delivery and end-to-end tracing.

What we offer

- Join a fast-growing company in a friendly, international environment — engineering primarily in Paris, with further engineering presence in Berlin, Montreal and Wilmington (DE), and offices across France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Canada, the USA, Mexico and Dubai;
- Our "Remote Policy" guarantees that you can find the right balance between "Onsite" and "Remote";
- Last but not least, all the day-to-day benefits of the CSE, luncheon vouchers, profit sharing bonuses, etc...

Recruitment process

- Interview with a TA team member (30/45 mins)
- Interview with the Engineering Manager (1h)
- Technical interview (1h30) — two parts: turning an ambiguous requirement into a specification with executable acceptance criteria, then an adversarial review of an agent-generated diff against that specification
- Interview with the CTO (45 mins)

  • Design for blast radius. Reversibility, progressive delivery, structured logs, traces, metrics and instrumentation generated as a matter of course. On many paths, detecting in five minutes beats three days of review that prevents nothing.

Requirements

Being based in France with full working rights. Fluent in French and English.

Experience & Seniority:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a significant portion spent building and operating B2B SaaS platforms in production
  • Proven ownership of features across their full lifecycle — design, delivery, iteration, maintenance — on long-lived, multi-year products
  • Strong background in complex, scalable web architectures, including real modularity: you have seen where coupling stops parallel work dead

AI-Native Practice:

  • Demonstrated, sustained use of coding agents in production work — not autocomplete, but delegated implementation with review and accountability
  • A concrete, articulated view of where generated code fails: correlated defects rather than idiosyncratic ones, uniform surface quality that destroys the usual "look here" review signals, plausibility with no author to interrogate
  • Comfort being accountable for code you did not author, and the discipline to refuse a change you cannot explain

Verification & Quality:

  • Real fluency in property-based testing, contract testing, and deriving tests from the specification rather than from the code
  • Test-data strategy, including maintaining a volumetrically representative dataset as part of the verification apparatus — not a nice-to-have
  • Instinct for the difference between a rigorous check and a scalable one: does the cost of checking grow with the volume produced?

Security & Performance (non-negotiable on this role):

  • Authorization modelling in multi-tenant systems, and why declarative, centrally enforced authorization beats reviewing each endpoint. Generated code reliably checks who you are and regularly forgets whether you are allowed
  • Awareness of the attack surface specific to an agent-assisted pipeline: prompt injection through ticket descriptions, code comments and dependency READMEs; supply-chain risk on hallucinated package names; least privilege for non-human identities; and the most frequent risk of all — production data or proprietary code leaking into the development loop
  • Performance as a measured number rather than a code-reading opinion: query budgets per HTTP request, N+1, unbounded result sets, missing indexes on new query paths, network calls in loops, execution-plan review. These are invisible at test-data scale and expensive in production

Product & Team Collaboration:

  • Excellent written communication — specification writing is now a core engineering skill on this role, not documentation overhead
  • Extensive experience working directly with product managers, designers and stakeholders in a product-oriented setup
  • Strong sense of ownership and sound judgment on risk: what to build, what not to build, what residual risk is acceptable and why

Education:

  • Master's degree in Engineering or equivalent practical experience in senior SaaS environments

What this role is not

We would rather say it up front:

  • It is not a prompt-engineering role, and it is not an ML/LLM research role.
  • It is not a role where green tests are sufficient evidence. On security and performance, "the spec is met and the tests pass" is not a weak signal — it is a null one.
  • It is not a ticket queue. The profile that shrinks in an AI-native team is the one whose value was implementing assigned tickets between two boundaries.

Our Tech Stack

  • Backend: Node.js / TypeScript
  • Frontend: Vue.js 3
  • Database: PostgreSQL, MariaDB
  • DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
  • Cloud: GCP

Engineering apparatus you will use and help build: coding agents orchestrated deterministically in CI, aspect-scoped verification agents (authorization, performance, spec conformance, dependencies), policy-as-code, property-based and contract testing, volumetric test datasets, load and endurance gates on critical paths, feature flags, progressive delivery and end-to-end tracing.

What we offer

  • Join a fast-growing company in a friendly, international environment — engineering primarily in Paris, with further engineering presence in Berlin, Montreal and Wilmington (DE), and offices across France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Canada, the USA, Mexico and Dubai;
  • Our "Remote Policy" guarantees that you can find the right balance between "Onsite" and "Remote";
  • Last but not least, all the day-to-day benefits of the CSE, luncheon vouchers, profit sharing bonuses, etc...

Recruitment process

  • Interview with a TA team member (30/45 mins)
  • Interview with the Engineering Manager (1h)
  • Technical interview (1h30) — two parts: turning an ambiguous requirement into a specification with executable acceptance criteria, then an adversarial review of an agent-generated diff against that specification
  • Interview with the CTO (45 mins)

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
About the role

As Product Marketing Manager, you shape how the market understands our portfolio: positioning, differentiation and outside-in stories that turn complex legal tech into value buyers recognise, and that drive pipeline and revenue.

Scope

You'll join a small Product Marketing team within the global Marketing department. Your focus is the market narrative and making sure GTM teams use it. Product training, documentation and demo environments sit with our Enablement teams. Success means clarity in the market, consistent positioning, and GTM teams who tell our story well.

Core responsibilities

Foundational strategy

- Develop deep market and competitive insight.
- Update and evolve ICPs, personas and use cases.
- Inform product and GTM direction based on market opportunity and customer reality.

Positioning and messaging

- Apply positioning, differentiation and value propositions across all content and assets, internal and external.
- Translate product capabilities into compelling, customer-centric narratives.
- Shape the content and messaging frameworks that guide all customer-facing communication.

Operational impact

- Activate positioning across the GTM organization through launch alignment, messaging briefings and strategic field engagement.
- Partner with Sales Enablement to embed messaging frameworks in the field.
- Drive coherence across website, campaigns, launches and proof points.
- Refine positioning using win/loss insights and market feedback.
- Become a product expert: hold regular syncs with Product Managers on releases and roadmap, and turn each release into clear customer value.

AI and new ways of working

- Design, test and run AI-assisted PMM workflows, for example call and win/loss analysis, competitive monitoring and content review.
- Document what works so the whole Marketing team can reuse it.
- Bring new ideas on how we work, and test them quickly.

Who you work with

- Reports to: Senior Product Marketing Manager
- Daily collaboration: Global Marketing team (10 people), Product Enablement, Sales Enablement, Customer Success Enablement
- Key stakeholders: Product, Sales, Customer Success

What we're looking for

- 3+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, ideally in enterprise or complex software.
- A proven track record shaping positioning, messaging and GTM strategy, not just executing it.
- Cross-functional experience with Product, Sales and Customer Success teams.
- Remote-first: you've built alignment across time zones without a shared office.
- An analytical mindset: data is the foundation of most of our decisions.
- Curious and hands-on with AI: you use it every day, like a colleague. We don't need an AI expert, but someone who enjoys testing new tools and building better ways of working with them.
- Fluent English, written and spoken.

What really sets you apart

Strategic thinker, decisive operator: you know when to challenge and when to ship.

Market-obsessed: you anticipate competitor moves and spot positioning gaps.

Exceptional storyteller: you simplify complexity without diluting substance.

Business-minded: you link your work to pipeline, win rates and deal velocity.

Builder with AI: you've already set up a new process, agent or workflow with AI and can show what changed.

Impact over output: you measure influence, not volume.

Strong opinions, loosely held: you defend your view with evidence and adjust when the market proves otherwise.

Problem solver with energy: you move problems forward at pace, even when they sit outside your job description.

Team player with range: you work easily with Product, Sales and CS, and adapt to what the team needs this week.

Out-of-the-box thinker: you question how things are done, propose new ways and test them.

Recruitment process

1.Phone screening with Talent Acquisition

2.First interview with our Senior Product Marketing Manager

3.Case study

4.Team and stakeholder interviews, including our Global Head of Marketing

5.Final interview with our CEO or another key stakeholder

title: Field Marketing Lead
description:
About the role

As Field Marketing Lead, you make sure our global strategy has local impact: every region turns our positioning, campaigns and content into pipeline in its own market.

Scope

Field marketing takes our global strategy into each market through four areas: pipeline support, partner marketing, events, and content. You'll build and lead a team of 3 Field Marketing Managers (North America, France & MEA, Italy, Spain & DACH).

The team is still being formed, and you'll help hire the regional roles. Success means pipeline sourced and influenced in every region, with field plans that stay aligned with global priorities.

Core responsibilities

Lead the team across the four areas

- Pipeline support: make sure pipeline is generated locally and tracked through every GTM activation, with processes agreed with the sales, BDR and sales enablement managers.
- Partner marketing: build the system that turns partner relationships into visibility, co-marketing, joint GTM motions and shared events, alongside our partnerships team.
- Events: apply the global event strategy locally and bring regional feedback back into the global plan.
- Content: localize global content, feed local insight back to the global content team, and design the media and PR activation program each region runs.

Cross-functional coordination

- Coordinate across departments and functions so global plans and regional execution stay in sync.
- Bring market intelligence back to Product Marketing: local competitors, regulatory differences and what buyers ask.

Team, budget and reporting

- Help hire the regional Field Marketing Managers, then coach them and set shared playbooks so every region works the same way.
- Own the field marketing budget across regions, including local agencies and vendors.
- Define field KPIs (pipeline sourced and influenced, event ROI, partner contribution) and report to the Global Head of Marketing and sales leadership.

Who you work with

- Reports to: Global Head of Marketing
- Manages: Regional Field Marketing Managers (North America, France & MEA, Italy, Spain & DACH)
- Daily collaboration: Global Head of Marketing, Content and Product Marketing leads, regional sales leaders

title: Account Manager and B2B Growth Consultant
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Manager and B2B Growth Consultant based in Switzerland.

In this role, you will manage and grow a portfolio of B2B clients, helping businesses achieve predictable and sustainable revenue growth. You will act as a strategic partner to founders, executives, and sales leaders, translating their commercial objectives into effective growth strategies. Working with an established outbound engine combining software, AI, and operational expertise, you will coordinate campaign execution and drive measurable results. You will take ownership of client relationships from initial strategy workshops through long-term account development. This position offers direct exposure to ambitious B2B businesses, close collaboration with leadership, and the opportunity to build a valuable professional network. Your impact will be reflected in client retention, account expansion, and overall portfolio performance.

Accountabilities
As an Account Manager and B2B Growth Consultant, you will take full ownership of your client portfolio, combining strategic consulting, relationship management, and commercial development.

- Lead strategic workshops with clients to define target audiences, positioning, messaging, and growth objectives.

- Develop tailored B2B acquisition strategies aligned with each client's business model and commercial priorities.

- Coordinate campaign implementation with internal teams responsible for technical execution.

- Monitor campaign performance, analyze results, and identify actionable opportunities for continuous improvement.

- Conduct regular client review calls, address questions, communicate progress, and ensure agreed next steps are delivered.

- Proactively manage client relationships, take ownership of challenges, and maintain high levels of customer satisfaction.

- Identify opportunities for account expansion and recommend relevant additional services and solutions.

- Develop successful client relationships into case studies, referrals, and long-term business partnerships.

- Contribute directly to portfolio growth through retention, upselling, and measurable client outcomes.

Requirements:

You bring relevant B2B experience and a strong understanding of customer relationships, business development, and commercial growth. You are comfortable working with senior decision-makers and taking ownership of client outcomes.

- At least 2 years of experience in Account Management, Consulting, Customer Success, Sales, or a related B2B environment.

- Proven experience managing direct client relationships and taking responsibility for business outcomes.

- Ability to communicate confidently and effectively with founders, managing directors, and sales leaders.

- Understanding of B2B customer acquisition, sales processes, and business development strategies.

- Ability to quickly understand new business models and translate commercial challenges into practical solutions.

- A track record of measurable achievements, supported by concrete examples of previous results.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both German and English.

- Strong ownership mentality, ambition, discipline, and a continuous improvement mindset.

- Openness to feedback and the ability to translate it into meaningful improvements.

- Excellent organizational skills and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

- Reliability, accountability, and a strong commitment to delivering on promises.

Career Changers: Candidates without direct experience in Account Management or B2B Growth may also be considered if they demonstrate exceptional performance in another demanding environment, such as management consulting. You should have outstanding learning agility, strong persuasion skills, and the confidence to develop expertise quickly.

Benefits:

- Competitive earning potential: €7,500–€10,000+ OTE per month after the ramp-up period, depending on portfolio size and individual performance.

- Uncapped commission: Earn performance-based commissions on client retention, upselling, and measurable results, with no fixed earnings ceiling.

- Fully remote flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world.

- Permanent employment contract: Long-term professional stability.

- Full-time position: 40 hours per week.

- Paid time off: 24 days of annual leave.

- Advanced technology: Access to proprietary software, an established outbound engine, and clearly defined processes.

- Dedicated operational support: Collaborate with a team responsible for technical implementation and campaign execution.

- Direct leadership exposure: Work closely with the founder and consulting team.

- Strong professional network: Build relationships with founders, executives, and decision-makers across a wide range of B2B businesses.

- High-performance environment: Join an ambitious startup culture focused on ownership, accountability, execution, and exceptional results.

- Growth opportunities: Build and develop your own client portfolio while directly contributing to business growth.

How Jobgether works:

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

title: Stage de Vente - Paris Saint Germain
description:
À PROPOS DE LA MARQUE

Chez Karl Lagerfeld, nous suivons le mantra suivant : « Profiter du présent et inventer le futur ».

Toujours contemporaine et tournée vers l’avenir, la maison KARL LAGERFELD partage la vision créative et l’esthétique de son fondateur emblématique, Karl Lagerfeld.

Nous sommes la seule maison de couture portant le nom de Karl et nous nous efforçons d’être à la hauteur de cette responsabilité dans tout ce que nous réalisons, chaque jour, avec la plus grande joie et passion.

Nos sièges de Paris et d’Amsterdam accueillent une équipe diversifiée de membres de la famille KARL venant de plus de 35 pays différents. Ensemble, nous visons à créer des histoires pleines de sens ainsi que des produits en lien direct avec l’universet ce qui faisait l’ADN de Karl.

E prêt-à-porter pour femme, les sacs, la petite maroquinerie et les sous-vêtements sont développés en interne depuis le siège d’Amsterdam, tandis que le prêt à porter pour homme, les parfums, la lunetterie etc., sont développés en externe avec les meilleurs partenaires de licence de leur catégorie. La récente ligne KARL LAGERFELD JEANS, qui rencontre un véritable succès commercial, est également développée en externe.

Grâce à une synergie marketing mondiale, à la cohérence de nos communications sur tous nos supports et une stratégie 360°, nous nous efforçons d’optimiser l’engagement de nos clients au sein de plus de 200 magasins KARL LAGERELD dans le monde, partenaires grossistes premium ainsi qu’un site internet karllagerfeld.com , disponible dans 96 pays. Nos canaux numériques représentent en effet plus de 30% de notre activité.

Nous sommes une entreprise dynamiqueet inclusive construite sur des valeurs fortes. Chez KARL KAGERFELD, nous nous engageons à travailler avec desnormes strictes en matière de durabilité et d’intégrité dans tous nos domaines d’activité. En 2019, KARL LAGERFELD a rejoint le Fashion Pact, une initiative de durabilité mondiale cherchant à transformer le secteur de la mode par le biais d’objectifs dans trois différents domaines : climat, biodiversité et protection des océans, en tant que membre fondateur.

POSITION

La Maison KARL LAGERFELD souhaite contribuer à la formation et au succès de futurs jeunes talents de la mode. C’est dans ce but que nous proposons des stages conventionnés à temps plein pour une période de 44 jours en tant qu’assistant(e)s de ventes. Le stage se déroulera au sein de nos corners en Paris Saint Germain.

Ambassadeur de la Maison KARL LAGERFELD, vous aurez pour mission:

- Assurer le meilleur accueil et service auprès d’une clientèle française et internationale

- Participer à la réalisation du chiffre d’affaires

- Participer à la mise en place du Merchandising

- Assurer le Réassort

- S’assurer de la bonne gestion des stocks

- Nous vous garantissons un suivi pédagogique allié un à environnement formateur et enrichissant.

PROFIL

- Pour mener à bien ce stage, le profil suivant est requis :
- Vous êtes doté d’une réelle finesse relationnelle, vous êtes reconnu pour votre sens du service
- Dynamique et enthousiaste, vous avez le goût du challenge et de la vente.
- Vous avez un bon niveau d’anglais
- Vous êtes curieux, doté d'une personnalité cool et dynamique
- Enfin, votre esprit d’équipe, votre implication et votre état d’esprit positif vous assureront une parfaite intégration au sein de notre Maison

- Convention de stage obligatoire - Compensation ou rémunération selon la législation.

REJOIGNEZ LA #TEAMKARL

La vision collective de KARL LAGERFELD est d’être la marque de créateur mondiale la plus connectée, inspirant les consommateurs grâce à de luxueuses collections et les immergeant dans le Monde de Karl. Si cela vous intéresserait de rejoindre la #TEAMKARL, nous vous invitons à nous soumettre votre candidature dès aujourd’hui.

Au sein de la #TEAMKARL, chacun a la liberté de donner son opinion, de faire évoluer sa carrière et de faire partie d’une équipe attentionnée et inclusive. Nous invitons les personnes de différents horizons, avec différentes perspectives, idées et expériences, à travailler avec nous.

IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING JOB POSTINGS

Please be advised that all legitimate job opportunities at KARL LAGERFELD are published exclusively on our official careers page and on selected partner platforms that redirect directly to our career site.

We strongly recommend applicants to only apply through our verified channels and remain vigilant against unofficial job offers.

KARL LAGERFELD will never request any form of payment during the recruitment process.

If you come across suspicious job postings or receive unexpected communication about a position, please contact us immediately at -----Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Chez Karl Lagerfeld, nous suivons le mantra suivant : « Profiter du présent et inventer le futur ».
 
Toujours contemporaine et tournée vers l’avenir, la maison KARL LAGERFELD partage la vision créative et l’esthétique de son fondateur emblématique, Karl Lagerfeld.
 
Nous sommes la seule maison de couture portant le nom de Karl et nous nous efforçons d’être à la hauteur de cette responsabilité dans tout ce que nous réalisons, chaque jour, avec la plus grande joie et passion.
 
Nos sièges de Paris et d’Amsterdam accueillent une équipe diversifiée et motivée de membres de la famille KARL venant de plus de 35 pays différents. Ensemble, nous visons à créer des histoires pleines de sens ainsi que des concepts de produit liés au monde et aux attributs emblématiques de Karl.
 
Le prêt à porter pour femme, les sacs, la petite maroquinerie et les sous-vêtements sont gérés directement depuis notre siège d’Amsterdam, tandis que d’autres catégories, incluant le prêt à porter pour homme, les parfums, la lunetterie et autres, sont développés avec les meilleurs partenaires de licence de leur catégorie. La récente ligne KARL LAGERFELD JEANS est de la même manière gérée en dehors de notre siège d’Amsterdam et est notre gamme connaissant la croissance la plus rapide.
 
Nous sommes en contact avec nos consommateurs à différents niveaux, nous assurant que notre approche à la fois en ligne et hors ligne aillent de pair. Nous nous efforçons d’optimiser l’engagement de nos clients avec plus de 200 magasins KL dans le monde, nos partenaires grossistes premium, et notre couverture numérique, avec à sa position le flagship store KARL.COM, qui est disponible dans 96 pays. Nos canaux numériques représentent plus de 30% de notre activité à plein tarif.
 
Nous sommes une entreprise dynamique, à la croissance rapide et inclusive construite sur le professionnalisme et des valeurs fortes. Chez KARL KAGERFELD, nous nous engageons à travailler avec les plus hautes normes en matière de durabilité et d’intégrité dans tous nos domaines d’activité. En 2019, KARL LAGERFELD a rejoint la Fashion Pact, une initiative de durabilité mondiale cherchant à transformer le secteur de la mode par le biais d’objectifs dans trois différents domaines : climat, biodiversité et protection des océans, en tant que membre fondateur.

POSITION
La Maison KARL LAGERFELD souhaite contribuer à la formation et au succès de futurs jeunes talents de la mode. C’est dans ce but que nous proposons des stages conventionnés à temps plein pour une période de 6 mois en tant qu’assistant(e)s de ventes. Le stage se déroulera au sein de nos corners en Carré Sénart.
 
Ambassadeur de la Maison KARL LAGERFELD, vous aurez pour mission:
- Assurer le meilleur accueil et service auprès d’une clientèle française et internationale
- Participer à la réalisation du chiffre d’affaires
- Participer à la mise en place du Merchandising
- Assurer le Réassort
- S’assurer de la bonne gestion des stocks
- Nous vous garantissons un suivi pédagogique allié un à environnement formateur et enrichissant.

PROFILE
  • Pour mener à bien ce stage, le profil suivant est requis :
  • Vous êtes doté d’une réelle finesse relationnelle, vous êtes reconnu pour votre sens du service
  • Dynamique et enthousiaste, vous avez le goût du challenge et de la vente.
  • Vous avez un bon niveau d’anglais
  • Vous êtes curieux, doté d'une personnalité cool et dynamique
  • Enfin, votre esprit d’équipe, votre implication et votre état d’esprit positif vous assureront une parfaite intégration au sein de notre Maison
    •  
  • Convention de stage obligatoire - Compensation ou rémunération selon la législation.
    • REJOIGNEZ LA #TEAMKARL
     
    La vision collective de KARL LAGERFELD est d’être la marque de créateur mondiale la plus connectée, inspirant les consommateurs grâce à de luxueuses collections et les immergeant dans le Monde de Karl. Si cela vous intéresserait de rejoindre la #TEAMKARL, nous vous invitons à nous soumettre votre candidature dès aujourd’hui.
     
    Au sein de la #TEAMKARL, chacun a la liberté de donner son opinion, de faire évoluer sa carrière et de faire partie d’une équipe attentionnée et inclusive. Nous invitons les personnes de différents horizons, avec différentes perspectives, idées et expériences, à travailler avec nous.
     
     
    IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING JOB POSTINGS
     
    Please be advised that all legitimate job opportunities at KARL LAGERFELD are published exclusively on our official careers page and on selected partner platforms that redirect directly to our career site.
     
    We strongly recommend applicants to only apply through our verified channels and remain vigilant against unofficial job offers.
     
    KARL LAGERFELD will never request any form of payment during the recruitment process.
     
    If you come across suspicious job postings or receive unexpected communication about a position, please contact us immediately at -----

Lever was founded ten years ago to tackle the most strategic challenge that companies face: how to recruit and hire top talent. We’re building the next generation of hiring software that companies like Netflix, Yelp, Cirque du Soleil, Shopify, and Spotify rely on to grow their teams. We've rethought the talent acquisition paradigm and are the innovation leaders in our space and looking for the right people to join us as we scale. We’re extraordinarily proud of the company we’ve built so far (not to mention humbled to be recognized as the #1 place to work in San Francisco, as well as a top workplace in the entire United States). Our people are Lever’s biggest competitive advantage and we’ll continue investing in our “Leveroos” and people-first culture.

Requirements

- 3 years marketing experience
- French language fluency

-
THE LEVER STORY

Lever builds modern recruiting software for teams to source, interview, and hire top talent. Our team strives to set a new bar for enterprise software with modern, well-designed, real-time apps. We participated in Y Combinator in summer 2012, and since then have reached our Series D, raising more than $120 million. As the applicant tracking system of choice for Netflix, Atlassian, KPMG, and McGraw-Hill Education, and thousands more leading companies, Lever means you hire the best by hiring together.

Lever is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations and will work with you to meet your needs. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives. Learn more about our team culture and commitment to diversity and inclusion.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager GTM
description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning

Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive platform, with AI agents that work alongside every team, from Finance to HR, to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally, passing $100M in ARR in 2026 and doubling revenue for the second year in a row. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake, and Siemens use Pigment every day to make better-informed decisions and navigate any scenario with confidence.

In October 2026, we raised a $250M Series E at a $2.3B valuation, bringing our total funding to $650M+. Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

What you'll do

- Headhunt top profiles (Sales / Marketing / Support functions), by sourcing and reaching out to great talents after having identified the needs of team leaders and hiring managers.
- Assess applications, by managing candidates’ screening and by conducting pre-qualification interviews for the positions that will have been assigned to you.
- Provide an excellent candidate experience and apply competency-based assessment methodology.
- Proactively engage and manage internal stakeholders, by coaching and sharing good practices with our hiring managers.
- Track and report talent acquisition metrics to identify best practices and pain points.
Who you are

- You have experience in Talent Acquisition in a fast-growing environment and/or experience in Go-to-market/commercial/business profile hiring.
- Mixed agency/search and internal TA experience.
- Headhunting experience honed through best-in-class Sales-led organisations.
- You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges and being hands-on.
- You have excellent interpersonal and communication skills, you are able to build strong relationships with candidates and employees.
- You like productivity tools and you know how to manage and prioritize your tasks in a structured way.
- You are curious, you like learning and working in autonomy.
- You are pragmatic and know how to solve problems quickly. You are analytical and rigorous.
- You have outstanding writing and verbal communication skills in English.
How we work

- Thrive Together: We can only win as a team. We are all founders and do the right thing for our peers, Pigment customers, partners, and the planet.
- Never Settle: We aim to become the best at what we do by delivering with rigor and ambition every day. Delivering means building a passionate Pigment community.
- Go for it: We are biased towards action. Every action leads to learning and these learnings get us one step closer to our mission.
- Be real, be humble: We are generous with our feedback, open to change our views and we approach it with empathy knowing everyone is trying to do the best for Pigment. We conduct background checks as part of our hiring process, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. This may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally permitted, criminal records. Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially.

Pigment is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity is a strength and fosters innovation. We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, social origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We may process your personal data in accordance with our HR Data Protection Notice.

title: Strategic Account Executive
description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning

Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive platform, with AI agents that work alongside every team, from Finance to HR, to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally, passing $100M in ARR in 2026 and doubling revenue for the second year in a row. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake, and Siemens use Pigment every day to make better-informed decisions and navigate any scenario with confidence.

In October 2026, we raised a $250M Series E at a $2.3B valuation, bringing our total funding to $650M+. Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

Our Strategic Account Executives own the relationship with a small number of the largest and most strategic organisations in France. This is a named account role: you will be responsible for a focused portfolio of 5 strategic pursuit accounts among the CAC40 and SBF120, driving both the initial land and the long-term expansion of Pigment across these global enterprises.

It is a rare opportunity to build a deep, strategic partnership with some of the biggest companies in France, shaping how they plan, forecast and make decisions across their global organisation.

What you'll do

- Own global responsibility for 5 strategic pursuit accounts among the CAC40 and SBF120, headquartered in France

- Build and execute a multi-year account strategy and territory plan designed to land new business and expand Pigment's footprint across functions, business units and geographies

- Engage C-level and executive decision-makers to position Pigment through value-based selling, business case definition, ROI analysis, references and market data

- Lead complex, often multinational, sales cycles from first conversation through to close, coordinating stakeholders across the customer's global organisation

- Coordinate internal teams: Solutions Consultants, Marketing, Business Development, Customer Success, Partnerships and Executives to drive a unified account strategy

- Partner with system integrators and services partners to define and deliver the technical and business delivery plan

- Build lasting relationships with C-suite and executive stakeholders across Finance, HR, Supply Chain and beyond

title: Ingénieur Front Office - Support aux traders - H/F
description:
Qui sommes nous ?

Chez MARGO, nos consultants travaillent sur ce qui compte vraiment : des projets complexes qui allient challenge intellectuel et impact direct sur les marchés financiers.C’est pourquoi nous accompagnons les plus grands acteurs de la finance de marché sur leurs projets les plus stratégiques en systèmes temps réel, trading, risk management et automatisation du cycle de vie des produits financiers.

Pourquoi rejoindre la practice CMT ?

Vous évoluerez au sein d’une équipe encadrée par Christophe El Harake, Practice Manager CMT chez MARGO, ancien Business Analyst chez BNP, ENGIE et Amundi. Travailler à ses côtés, c’est intégrer une équipe d’experts passionnés, bénéficier d’un mentorat de haut niveau, être challengé sur le plan technique et méthodologique, et contribuer à des projets à fort impact sur les marchés financiers.

Vos missions :

Nous recherchons actuellement un(e) ingénieur front office - support aux traders.

Vous interviendrez au sein de la salle des marchés d’une grande banque de financement d'investissement française. Vous ferez partie d’une équipe front office de support des applications de trading. Ainsi, vous serez garant du bon fonctionnement des applications de passage d’ordre, de trading automatique, d’aide à la prise de décision et/ou de traitement des flux marchés.

Vous serez en constante interaction avec les traders pour comprendre leurs besoins et leurs demandes qu’il s’agisse de résolution d’incidents, de monitoring ou bien d’optimisation d’outils existants et de projets d’évolution.

Profil recherché :

Nous cherchons des ingénieurs exigeants, passionnés par la finance de marché et souhaitant évoluer dans des environnements complexes.

-Diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieur ou d’un cursus universitaire Bac +5 / Master ;

-Solides connaissances en finance des marchés

-Bon niveau d’anglais pour évoluer dans un environnement international ;

-Intérêt marqué pour les environnements exigeants où la rigueur et la qualité des livrables sont essentielles ;

-Esprit analytique, sens du challenge et goût pour les projets à forte valeur ajoutée.

Ce que nous offrons :

-Des missions ambitieuses et variées, toujours sélectionnées pour leur valeur ajoutée ;

-Un accompagnement de proximité par des experts reconnus ;

-Une communauté d’ingénieurs passionnés, avec workshops, conférences et échanges réguliers ;

-Une culture d’exigence technique, de partage des connaissances et de développement continu.

La suite ?

-Premier entretien : Échangez avec un recruteur et un business developer

-Entretien Technique : Montrez vos compétences et recevez un retour d'expérience

-Entretien de Motivation : Rencontrez un membre du comité de direction

MARGO s'engage à offrir des opportunités égales à tous, nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif qui valorise la diversité.

title: Senior Field Operations Partner
description:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.

We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.

Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.

Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or ----- domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.

As a Senior Field Operations Partner within the Revenue Operations team, you will report directly to the Head of Field Operations. You will act as the dedicated operational partner for Regional Vice Presidents (RVPs) leading France and South (Italy, Spain), driving commercial cadence, pipeline management, forecasting routines, CRM hygiene, and operational enablement across these regions. In addition to your core regional focus, you will serve as the centralized single point of contact for cross-regional project management and operational initiatives across Field Ops, ensuring seamless execution without duplicating efforts across regional leads.

What you’ll do

- Provide dedicated operational guidance and business partner support to RVPs leading France and South EMEA, translating regional strategic priorities into actionable execution plans.

- Own and manage the weekly commercial cadence, including pipeline reviews, forecasting routines, and performance checkpoints across assigned sales territories.

- Drive CRM hygiene, stage discipline, and data accuracy within Salesforce and Clari to ensure high forecast predictability and pipeline visibility.

- Act as the single point of contact for cross-regional project management and operational initiatives outside the local region, centralizing cross-regional execution rather than dividing tasks across regional field ops leads.

- Proactively identify coverage gaps, sales velocity roadblocks, and performance risks, partnering with RevOps sub-functions to resolve issues before they impact targets.

- Deliver field enablement and practical guidance on operational tools, process updates, and sales playbooks to foster strong process adoption among AEs and FLMs.

- Partner cross-functionally with Strategy Ops, Deal Desk, Enablement, and Data Governance to align global process standards with field reality.

What you’ll need to succeed

- 5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Business Operations within a fast-paced B2B SaaS environment.

- Demonstrated success partnering with senior sales leadership (RVPs, VP-level) to drive pipeline execution, forecast discipline, and regional governance.

- Proven ability to act as a centralized single point of contact for multi-regional projects, coordinating complex operational initiatives across global teams.

- Advanced technical proficiency with Salesforce, Clari, Tableau, and documentation frameworks (Confluence).

- Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with fluency in French and English.

Why you should join Contentsquare

We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are always assessing the perks we offer to ensure we’re aligned with the employees' needs.

Here are a few we want to highlight:

- Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year

- Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies

- Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different)

- Lifestyle allowance

- A Culture Crew in every country we’re based in to coordinate regular activities for employees to get to know each other and bond outside of work

- Every full-time employee receives stock options, allowing them to share in the company’s success

- We have multiple Employee Resource Groups, that offer a safe space for individuals who share common identities, life experiences, or allyship to connect, support one another, and passionately advocate for the issues close to their hearts

- And more benefits tailored to each country

Contentsquare is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Your personal data is used by Contentsquare for recruitment purposes only. Read our Job Candidate Privacy Notice to find out more about data protection at Contentsquare and your rights. You can exercise your rights by using our dedicated Data Subject Rights Portal here.

Your personal data will be securely stored in our hosting provider’s data center in Oregon (US west). We have implemented appropriate transfer mechanisms under applicable data protection laws.

Contentsquare may use AI-assisted tools to help review and screen applications. All decisions involving hiring are made by human reviewers, and your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

Contentsquare is hiring a player-coach Solutions Consulting Manager to lead its France & Southern Europe team: about 5 Solution Consultants covering France, Spain, Portugal and Italy. You will spend roughly half your time leading and developing the team and half personally running the region's most strategic deals.

You will be the pre-sales business partner to regional Sales leaders across Enterprise and Mid-Market, for new business and growth in existing accounts. You will also lead the region's move to the Contentsquare Experience Platform (CSQ XP), for new customers and for the existing customer base.

You report to the Head of Solutions Consulting EMEA and sit on the EMEA Solutions Consulting leadership team. The role is based in Paris.

What you'll do
Own the regional pre-sales plan

- Turn EMEA and global Solutions Consulting priorities into a clear regional plan: objectives, coverage model and operating rhythm

- Allocate SC capacity across segments, accounts and opportunities to get the most revenue impact

- Track and improve regional performance: win rate, attach rate, SC coverage, POC conversion and deal quality

Lead and grow the team

- Coach and develop each Solution Consultant, adapting your style to their skills and motivation

- Own hiring, onboarding, development plans and succession for your team

- Give regular, direct feedback and address performance issues early

- Build a team where people share what works and feel safe to try new ideas

Partner with Sales

- Join the regional Sales leadership rhythm: pipeline reviews, forecast calls, account planning

- Work with Sales on territory and capacity planning, deal prioritisation and pipeline health

- Run joint deal reviews using MEDDICC and Command of the Message, and challenge deals constructively when qualification, value or scope is unclear

Stay hands-on in strategic deals

- Personally lead some of the region's strategic and complex opportunities: executive presentations, competitive situations and high-stakes POCs

- Set the standard for discovery, tailored demos, and Proof of Value (POVs) with clear success criteria

- Tie every engagement to measurable business outcomes across our Product Portfolio (the new Experience Platform as well as Experience Analytics, Product Analytics, Experience Monitoring, Voice of Customer and our AI capabilities).

Lead the CSQ Experience Platform motion in the region

- Position CSQ Experience Platform with new customers and build the team's confidence selling it

- Prepare existing customers for the move to CSQ Experience Platform, working with Sales and Customer Success

- Feed field feedback on XP to Product and Product Marketing

Work across the ecosystem

- Co-sell with agencies, system integrators and technology partners, and help enable their pre-sales teams

- Make handoffs to Customer Success, Professional Services and Implementation seamless, so what we promise is what we deliver

- Share customer and competitive insights with Product and Product Marketing, and best practices with SC peers across EMEA and globally

Who you are

- 5+ years in Solutions Consulting, Pre-Sales or Sales Engineering in B2B SaaS, ideally in analytics, digital experience, martech or adjacent fields

- Proven people management or formal team leadership experience

- A true player-coach: strategic enough to set direction, and still credible running a demo or a POC/POV in front of customers

- Strong track record in complex Enterprise sales cycles: discovery, solution design, demos and POCs/POVs

- Confident partnering with Sales leadership, and able to influence and challenge constructively

- Fluent in structured sales methods (MEDDICC, Command of the Message, value selling)

- Able to turn technical capabilities into a compelling business story for C-level and technical audiences alike

- Curious about AI and comfortable showing how AI-driven insights change the way customers work

- Experience with partner ecosystems (agencies, SIs, technology alliances) and co-selling

- Comfortable discussing data privacy and compliance (GDPR) with customers

- Fluent in French and English; Spanish and/or Italian is a strong plus

Why you should join Contentsquare

We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are always assessing the perks we offer to ensure we’re aligned with the employees' needs.

Here are a few we want to highlight:

- Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year

- Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies

- Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different)

- Lifestyle allowance

- A Culture Crew in every country we’re based in to coordinate regular activities for employees to get to know each other and bond outside of work

- Every full-time employee receives stock options, allowing them to share in the company’s success

- We have multiple Employee Resource Groups, that offer a safe space for individuals who share common identities, life experiences, or allyship to connect, support one another, and passionately advocate for the issues close to their hearts

title: STAGE Fullstack - Refonte d'un moteur de recherche à forte volumétrie (H/F)
description:
Basés en plein cœur de Paris, nous faisons bouger l’industrie des jeux en ligne. Leader du poker et des paris sportifs en France avec 350 000 joueurs et 600 000 parieurs mensuels, nous sommes présents en Espagne, en Allemagne et bientôt en Italie et au Portugal. Nous offrons à nos joueurs une expérience exceptionnelle, à la fois technique, créative et qualitative. Innovation, unité et appartenance : nos valeurs façonnent une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique.

Et si tu avais un futur dans le jeu ?

Techniquement, Winamax c’est :

- Un moteur de jeu puissant et innovant : adaptation dynamique de l'offre de jeu, parties de poker hautement configurables, détection de fraude
- Une architecture distribuée et scalable conçue pour traiter en temps réel les flux de la plateforme
- Une plateforme modulaire soumise à des contraintes de haute disponibilité et de sécurisation des données, capable de gérer de fortes audience

Contexte
Plusieurs moteurs de recherche internes tournent sur nos catalogues, volumineux et à forte fréquence de mise à jour. L'un d'eux renvoie aujourd'hui trop de bruit et hiérarchise mal ses résultats.

Comment améliorer la pertinence et la lisibilité des résultats en étant aussi rapide que le demande un usage temps réel ?

Objectifs du stage

- Reprendre le moteur sur le fond et sur la forme : améliorer l'algorithme pour éliminer les résultats parasites, ajouter des filtres dynamiques, retravailler l'ergonomie et la hiérarchisation de l'information
- Enrichir la saisie avec des suggestions basées sur les tendances de consultation du moment et un historique des dernières recherches reposant sur un cache LRU local La performance déterminera si la fonctionnalité est viable.

Stack technique
Frontend : React, TypeScript, Redux
Backend : Node.js, Redis

Modalités du stage

- Stage de fin d'études (Master 2) à pourvoir à temps plein uniquement à Paris, France
- Opportunité de CDI à la fin du stage
- Rémunération : 2500€ bruts / mois

Processus de recrutement

- Test technique
- Screening RH avec Camille
- Entretien avec manager et maître de stage

POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?

En plus de notre univers poker et paris sportifs, nous avons d’autres avantages !

- Une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique
- Une semaine de travail en 4 jours
- Opportunité de CDI si tu as atteint les objectifs du stage
- Coaching de tes soft skills avec les Cours Florent
- Un cadre de travail convivial, en plein cœur de Paris (rooftop tour Eiffel, salle de jeux vidéo et salle de sport…)
- Une vie d’entreprise riche avec des soirées et événements organisés régulièrement (tournois de poker, soirées thématiques, barbecues tout l'été…)
- Des primes d’intéressement et de participation si tu restes parmi nous à l'issue de ton stage
- Un accès au programme de cooptation (bonus de cooptation jusqu’à 5000 €)
- Un restaurant d’entreprise

Contexte
Notre plateforme de jeu repose sur des microservices stateless : chaque traitement est une fonction pure appliquée à un message et à un état. Sur le papier, c'est le rêve pour débugger. En pratique, l'outillage n'existe pas, et CloudWatch devient vite chronophage dès qu'il faut analyser les interactions entre services.

Comment rejouer les messages et les changements d'états pour reproduire un dysfonctionnement à l'identique ?

Objectifs du stage
Concevoir et déployer un outil réellement opérationnel, en trois briques :

- Ingestion et indexation à l'échelle : capter les messages et les transitions d'états, définir un modèle de stockage scalable sans impacter la production
- Générateur de tests local : isoler une séquence, reconstruire l'arbre d'états, et en sortir des tests de non-régression automatisés
- Replayer : une API et un back-office minimaliste pour visualiser graphiquement les états et les interactions inter-services Les points d'attention : la volumétrie, la fidélité de la reconstruction chronologique, la corrélation d'événements en environnement distribué, et l'industrialisation de l'outil (CI/CD, tests, documentation).

Stack technique
Javascript, React, DynamoDB, Kafka, S3, AWS, GitHub

Notre plateforme de jeu repose sur des microservices stateless : chaque traitement est une fonction pure appliquée à un message et à un état. Sur le papier, c'est le rêve pour débugger. En pratique, l'outillage n'existe pas, et CloudWatch devient vite chronophage dès qu'il faut analyser les interactions entre services.
 
Comment rejouer les messages et les changements d'états pour reproduire un dysfonctionnement à l'identique ?

Objectifs du stage
Concevoir et déployer un outil réellement opérationnel, en trois briques :
  • Ingestion et indexation à l'échelle : capter les messages et les transitions d'états, définir un modèle de stockage scalable sans impacter la production
  • Générateur de tests local : isoler une séquence, reconstruire l'arbre d'états, et en sortir des tests de non-régression automatisés
  • Replayer : une API et un back-office minimaliste pour visualiser graphiquement les états et les interactions inter-services
    • Les points d'attention : la volumétrie, la fidélité de la reconstruction chronologique, la corrélation d'événements en environnement distribué, et l'industrialisation de l'outil (CI/CD, tests, documentation).

- Gestion du parc de fabricants en collaboration avec l’équipe production (identification des forces et faiblesses, contretype)
- Propositions d’alternatives techniques auprès du studio et des fabricants, pour anticiper les problématiques industrialisation et costing dans le respect de l’intention créative
- Pilotage du développement des prototypes et des échantillons dans le respect des délais, de la marge et du niveau de qualité

- Préparation et transmission des dossiers techniques aux équipes industrialisation et production.
- Validations facture et suivi rigoureux des coûts engagés
- Participation à l’amélioration en continue des process

- Bac +3 à Bac +5 (commerce, mode ou équivalent), avec 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en développement produit maroquinerie et/ou petite maroquinerie, idéalement dans l'univers du luxe ou de la mode

- Bonne connaissance du marché et de ses acteurs

- Expérience en gestion fabricants, développement produits et analyse de dossiers techniques

- Maîtrise d'Excel et des outils bureautiques ; connaissance d'un ERP/PLM fortement appréciée

- Anglais professionnel indispensable, italien fortement apprécié

- Forte sensibilité produit alliée à une organisation rigoureuse et un bon sens des priorités

- Aisance relationnelle, esprit d'équipe, proactivité, flexibilité et sens des responsabilités

title: Solutions Consultant - France
description:
Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.

About us

Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable.

Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices. With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search.

We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on.

Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, and the results speak for themselves.

From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.

Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.

What You Will Do

- Develop a deep understanding in Martech domain to qualify prospect's goals and requirements effectively articulate Insider One's value offering
- Engage with prospects as a solution consultant and trusted advisor during the pre-sales process
- Contribute to the sales strategy connecting prospect's requirements and desires with Insider One platform and products
- Craft personalised demos and presentations, and pitch them to business and technical audience
- Take the lead of internal coordination for responding the technical parts of RFIs/RFPs
- Maintain awareness of product roadmap and new features, share the market insights with Product Management Team
- Take the responsibility for handing the new clients over to Insider One Customer Success Team for smooth onboarding experience
- Help sales team to create personalized decks & use cases when required and requested
What You Will Need

- Minimum 5 years experience in in a similar role (Sales Engineer / Solutions Consultant / Solutions Engineer) or other roles that require a strong mix of technical & client-facing skills
- Excellent verbal and written communications skills with a focus on capturing requirements and use cases, developing a solution and articulating business value
- Successful track record for SaaS application selling into complex enterprise environments
- Technical understanding of SAAS solutions, architecture and modern business applications including development frameworks (Web & App) and integrations (APIs)
- Ability to coordinate various parties with different background to solve business and technical problems
- Self-starter, good at multitasking, and committed to upholding the highest level of standards in the team’s execution of the sales process
- English & French is must and Spanish language knowledge is plus
What We Offer

- Be part of a diverse team that’s as global as it gets — where every voice is heard and 50+ nationalities build together.
- Level up with internal trainings covering AI fundamentals, coding, foreign languages, and a wide range of personal development skills.
- Feed your curiosity with access to Spotify, LinkedIn Learning, Blinkist, and MasterClass, and CloudGuru.
- Become a Shareowner through our eligibility-based “ESOP” and own a piece of what you build.
- Help build the team you want to work with and enjoy rewarding referral bonuses.
- Opportunities to give back to your community through volunteering and purpose-driven social impact projects.
- From global retreats to team-building activities, expect year-round events that turn into lifelong memories.

We aren't just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there.

To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good-hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile.

If this sounds like who you are and where you aspire to be, we are excited to meet you.

We provide equal opportunity in a zero-discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.

Please follow Insider One on LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook and Medium!

title: Account Manager
description:
About Megaport

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

Our Team Culture

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.

We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

The Role

Reporting to the Regional Manager of Customer Success, the Customer Success Manager (CSM) will serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of high-value, strategic customers. This is a Sales role with a quota to achieve each quarter, focused on high-touch post-sales engagement, with particular emphasis on driving customer success, enabling upsell and cross-sell opportunities, managing renewals, supporting service performance, and enhancing the overall customer experience.

The CSM will be responsible for maintaining and expanding revenue by developing strong customer relationships, understanding strategic priorities, introducing new product developments and commercial initiatives, and showcasing the full value of the Megaport proposition. This is a quota-carrying role, with defined revenue targets and performance measured against attainment. Success will be evaluated based on your ability to grow and retain revenue within your customer base, contributing to both individual and team objectives.

This position is part of the wider Integrated Accounts Team, working closely with a Direct Sales Executive and Solutions Architect. The CSM will take a leading role in commercial engagement for existing strategic customers within the France portfolio, focused on growth, retention, adoption, and long-term customer satisfaction.
