title: Growth Marketing Manager (F/H)
description:
Chez Younited, nous pensons que le crédit et les services bancaires devraient être aussi simples, rapides et transparents que tout ce qui fait partie de votre vie numérique.

C’est pourquoi nous concevons nos services financiers de cette manière. Nous combinons technologie, données et automatisation pour repenser la façon dont les gens empruntent, paient, épargnent et gèrent leur argent.
Aujourd'hui, plus de 1,5 million de clients nous font confiance et près de 500 collaborateurs contribuent à notre développement dans 4 pays européens.

Ce que nous construisons

-
- Younited Credit : un crédit à la consommation instantané, directement accessible aux clients.
- Younited Pay : des solutions de paiement en plusieurs fois et de financement intégrées aux parcours clients de nos partenaires.
- Younited Cashback : du cashback et des offres personnalisées, enrichis par les données de l’open banking.
- Younited Bank : notre offre bancaire du quotidien, actuellement disponible via helios by Younited et en cours de déploiement.

Notre ambition est de devenir un partenaire financier auquel les gens font véritablement confiance, en combinant simplicité, transparence et finance responsable. En tant qu’entreprise certifiée B Corp, nous intégrons les enjeux sociaux et environnementaux dans la manière dont nous développons notre activité.

Les 5 valeurs qui nous guident

-
- Make it simple : privilégier la simplicité dans les produits, l’expérience client et notre organisation. Faire preuve de transparence.
- Act as an entrepreneur : prendre ses responsabilités, jouer collectif, oser essayer et accepter l’échec.
- Innovate or die : remettre en question le statu quo, aussi impossible que cela puisse paraître.
- Faster is better : privilégier la rapidité à la perfection, et l’alignement au débat.
- No limit : viser la lune tout en restant humble.

Nous offrons à des personnes passionnées par la résolution de problèmes l’espace nécessaire pour donner le meilleur d’elles-mêmes, au sein d’équipes diverses et inclusives réparties à travers l’Europe.

Contexte 📃

Rattaché.e à la Directrice Marketing Partenariats et en lien avec les équipes Commerciales, Product et Data, tu contribues à construire et à déployer une stratégie marketing efficace, génératrice de visibilité, d’opportunités business et de valeur pour nos partenaires.

Ce poste est fait pour toi si tu aimes piloter des dispositifs marketing orientés performance, avec un focus fort sur HubSpot (segmentation, nurturing, automatisation) et la génération de revenues.

Tu évolues avec aisance dans un environnement exigeant, en lien étroit avec les équipes Sales, où l’impact business, la structuration et l’efficacité opérationnelle sont au cœur des priorités.

Missions 🚀

1. Structuration et pilotage de la stratégie outbound

- Piloter les campagnes inbound et outbound (digital et événements)
- Structurer la segmentation, le lead scoring et le nurturing dans HubSpot
- Mettre en place et optimiser les workflows et suivre la contribution au pipeline

2. Pilotage des canaux d’acquisition

- Coordonner les campagnes avec les partenaires médias (SEA, SMO)
- Contribuer aux projets SEO, SEA et refonte du site web
- Suivre la performance des actions et optimiser les dispositifs dans une logique ROI

3. Contenus et activation marketing

- Produire et piloter les contenus (WordPress, newsletters, articles, livres blancs)
- Contribuer à la visibilité SEO et aux actions événementielles
- Collaborer avec les équipes Marketing, Product, Brand et Account Management

À propos de toi 👇

- Tu es diplômé.e d'un Master 2 en marketing opérationnel ou digital avec minimum 3 ans d’expérience (hors stage ou alternance)
- Tu as une première expérience en environnement SaaS BtoB (idéalement en fintech)
- Tu as une très bonne maîtrise d'Hubspot :
- mise en place de workflows, lead scoring et nurturing
- segmentation de base de données et gestion du cycle de vie des leads
- pilotage des campagnes inbound / outbound et suivi de la performance via dashboards

- Tu as une bonne compréhension des enjeux SEA & SEO et une première expérience sur des logiciels CMS
- Tu es à l'aise sur la rédaction de contenus BtoB et tu as une bonne compréhension de la chaîne graphique, capacité à rédiger des briefs design (Figma est un plus)

Processus de recrutement 📅

- Premier entretien en visio avec Arthur, Talent Acquisition Manager pour discuter autour du poste, de tes motivations et de ton adéquation avec les valeurs et la culture Younited (30 min)
- Deuxième entretien en visio avec Anne-Gaëlle, ta future N+1 Directrice Marketing Partenariats pour approfondir les missions du poste, les facteurs clés de succès, la présentation de la stratégie Younited et de l’équipe (1h)
- Etude de cas à restituer en physique pour tester tes compétences appliquées à une problématique marketing BtoB (1h)
- Dernier entretien avec Pauline ta future N+2 Directrice Commerciale & Marketing pour valider l’alignement global sur le poste et les évolutions (30 min)

🎁 Les avantages à rejoindre Younited ?

- Des bureaux situés au cœur de Paris (9ème arrondissement)
- Un environnement de travail international et l’opportunité de partir en mission dans nos bureaux à l’étranger (Barcelone, Lisbonne, Rome)
- Un état d’esprit entrepreneurial et un fort esprit d’équipe
- Un accompagnement managérial et RH individualisé pendant l’onboarding et tout au long de l’aventure Younited
- Un environnement d’apprentissage continu avec la possibilité de bénéficier de formations externes et internes, plateforme de e-learning et des « Friday workshops » au sein de l'équipe Tech, pour accompagner le développement de chacun
- Une attention particulière à l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso
- Une charte de la parentalité pour soutenir tous les projets de famille à travers des mesures clés
- Pour t’accompagner dans les moments clés de ta vie personnelle, des congés exceptionnels souvent bien plus favorables que les dispositions légales
- Une politique de télétravail hybride 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine selon les équipes et la possibilité d’une semaine de full remote deux fois par an
- 33 jours de congés payés soit 8 de plus que les 25 jours légaux (à la place des traditionnelles RTT)
- Un abonnement à la plateforme Wellpass, ex Gymlib (+4000 activités sport et bien-être partout en France) à un tarif préférentiel
- Carte tickets restaurant à hauteur de 10€ pris en charge à 60% par l'employeur
- Des team buildings en France (Summer Party et Winter Party), à l’international et en équipe

Younited is an Equal Opportunity Employer for any minority, disability, gender identity or sexual orientation.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Odaseva provides enterprise data management and security solutions that help organizations exercise sovereignty over their critical data.

Companies representing 10% of global market capitalization trust Odaseva, including Schneider Electric, Volkswagen and Robert Half.

Its Excalibur Data Platform enables customers to protect, secure, move, and use data and code independently of application vendors.

The platform supports complex and high-volume use cases, including backup, archiving, zero-copy, BCDR & High Availability, data federation, and semantic AI orchestration.

Customer-controlled end-to-end encryption raises the bar for enterprise security.

With 11 patents, Odaseva manages 50 trillion records and supports 100 million users.

About the Role

You will join a dynamic Finance team of 7 people in an environment driven by continuous growth and international development. Reporting directly to the Senior Director, you will play a key role in ensuring accounting accuracy while actively contributing to key projects and transformation initiatives.

In this role, you will maintain accounting operations on NetSuite for 6 international entities and participate in group consolidation processes. We are looking for someone with strong technical accounting expertise combined with an appetite for change, eager to drive or participate in major strategic projects within a scaling company.

Key Responsibilities
Accounting & Treasury Management (6 entities):

- Post bank entries weekly and perform monthly bank reconciliations.

- Manage vendor invoices via our digital processing tool, directing them through approval workflows.

- Prepare payment runs, perform accounts payable and expense reports reconciliation, and manage vendor follow-ups/relations.

- Perform payroll accounting entry integration and ensure reconciliation between payroll reports and the general ledger.

- Manage multi-currency and/or multi-entity accounting and treasury transactions, FX revaluations and realized/unrealized FX gain & loss tracking.

- Manage intra-group journal entries.

- Ensure that 100% of accounting entries are assigned to cost centers, in coordination with FP&A, including pre-posting validation and monthly controls.

- Ensure daily maintenance of accounting ledgers in compliance with company rules, accounting standards, quality, and deadlines.

Asset Management, Tax & Group Reporting:

- Ensure the tracking and updating of fixed assets in the general ledger accounting and the Fixed Asset Register, performing regular reconciliations between both systems.

- Prepare monthly closing operations (cut-off entries, accruals, VAT, exchange variance analysis, etc.).

- Prepare French tax declarations (DAS2, VAT, and other local taxes).

- Prepare monthly intra-group reconciliations.

- Contribute to monthly financial reporting.

- Support Group consolidation operations (task scope adapted to your profile, with hands-on learning opportunities).

- Support annual statutory audit processes.

Projects & Change Management:

- Actively lead or participate in high-impact finance projects, process automation, and system enhancements.

- Embrace and drive change to support the scaling of our international finance organization.

Required qualifications
Experience & Technical Skills:

- Degree in Accounting or Finance (e.g., BTS, DCG, DSCG, or equivalent).

- 5+ years of experience in a similar accounting role within an international group or fast-paced environment.

- Excel/Google Sheet skills (data manipulation for reconciliations). AI is a plus.

- Hands-on experience with an ERP (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics), including fixed asset modules, subledger management, custom reporting, data imports (CSV/Excel), and multi-currency/multi-entity setups.

- Solid knowledge of French GAAP (PCG). Familiarity with US GAAP or IFRS is a plus.

- No prior consolidation expertise required — task exposure will be tailored to your skill set and interest in developing consolidation expertise.

Soft Skills & Mindset:

- Appetite for Change & Project-Driven: You thrive in scaling, evolving environments and enjoy driving or contributing to major transformation projects.

- Rigor & Organization: You believe structured methods and precision are the keys to operational success.

- Language: Fluent in French and professional English proficiency (written and spoken) to interact effectively within a global team and environment.

Where you'll be

- Based in Paris (75002), France.
- Hybrid: 3 days in the office / 2 days remote work.
- Full time permanent contract position.

Who We Are

At Odaseva, we believe in fostering an inclusive, supportive work environment where talented people can innovate and grow. Our culture is built on being smart, humble, hardworking, and above all—collaborative.

Our core values define who we are: Trust, Customer Centricity, Engagement, Excellence, Continuous Innovation, and Teamwork.

Inclusive & Diverse – We champion equality and embrace diversity.

Supportive & Collaborative – A team of smart, kind professionals who uplift each other through teamwork, not competition.

Excellence with a Casual Touch – High professional standards in a relaxed, approachable work culture.

Impact-Driven – A place where you can truly make a difference and advance your career.

Innovators in Data & Cloud – Leading the way in cutting-edge technology and solutions.

Competitive & Rewarding – Offering industry-leading compensation and benefits.

Truly Global – With offices in Paris, San Francisco, Sydney, and London, and a worldwide presence.

Flexible Work Environment – We support a hybrid, flexible office culture.

At Odaseva, we are an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. We consider all applicants for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

Companies representing 10% of global market capitalization trust Odaseva, including Schneider Electric, Volkswagen and Robert Half.
Its Excalibur Data Platform enables customers to protect, secure, move, and use data and code independently of application vendors.
The platform supports complex and high-volume use cases, including backup, archiving, zero-copy, BCDR & High Availability, data federation, and semantic AI orchestration.
Customer-controlled end-to-end encryption raises the bar for enterprise security.
With 11 patents, Odaseva manages 50 trillion records and supports 100 million users. 

About the Role

You will join a dynamic Finance team of 7 people in an environment driven by continuous growth and international development. Reporting directly to the Senior Director, you will play a key role in ensuring accounting accuracy while actively contributing to key projects and transformation initiatives.

In this role, you will maintain accounting operations on NetSuite for 6 international entities and participate in group consolidation processes. We are looking for someone with strong technical accounting expertise combined with an appetite for change, eager to drive or participate in major strategic projects within a scaling company.


Key Responsibilities

Accounting & Treasury Management (6 entities):

  • Post bank entries weekly and perform monthly bank reconciliations.

  • Manage vendor invoices via our digital processing tool, directing them through approval workflows.

  • Prepare payment runs, perform accounts payable and expense reports reconciliation, and manage vendor follow-ups/relations.

  • Perform payroll accounting entry integration and ensure reconciliation between payroll reports and the general ledger.

  • Manage multi-currency and/or multi-entity accounting and treasury transactions, FX revaluations and realized/unrealized FX gain & loss tracking.

  • Manage intra-group journal entries.

  • Ensure that 100% of accounting entries are assigned to cost centers, in coordination with FP&A, including pre-posting validation and monthly controls.

  • Ensure daily maintenance of accounting ledgers in compliance with company rules, accounting standards, quality, and deadlines.

    • Asset Management, Tax & Group Reporting:

  • Ensure the tracking and updating of fixed assets in the general ledger accounting and the Fixed Asset Register, performing regular reconciliations between both systems.

  • Prepare monthly closing operations (cut-off entries, accruals, VAT, exchange variance analysis, etc.).

  • Prepare French tax declarations (DAS2, VAT, and other local taxes).

  • Prepare monthly intra-group reconciliations.

  • Contribute to monthly financial reporting.

  • Support Group consolidation operations (task scope adapted to your profile, with hands-on learning opportunities).

  • Support annual statutory audit processes.

    • Projects & Change Management:

  • Actively lead or participate in high-impact finance projects, process automation, and system enhancements.

  • Embrace and drive change to support the scaling of our international finance organization.


    • Required qualifications

    Experience & Technical Skills:

  • Degree in Accounting or Finance (e.g., BTS, DCG, DSCG, or equivalent).

  • 5+ years of experience in a similar accounting role within an international group or fast-paced environment.

  • Excel/Google Sheet skills (data manipulation for reconciliations). AI is a plus. 

  • Hands-on experience with an ERP (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics), including fixed asset modules, subledger management, custom reporting, data imports (CSV/Excel), and multi-currency/multi-entity setups. 

  • Solid knowledge of French GAAP (PCG). Familiarity with US GAAP or IFRS is a plus. 

  • No prior consolidation expertise required — task exposure will be tailored to your skill set and interest in developing consolidation expertise.

    • Soft Skills & Mindset:

  • Appetite for Change & Project-Driven: You thrive in scaling, evolving environments and enjoy driving or contributing to major transformation projects.

  • Rigor & Organization: You believe structured methods and precision are the keys to operational success.

  • Language: Fluent in French and professional English proficiency (written and spoken) to interact effectively within a global team and environment.


    • Where you'll be
  • Based in Paris (75002), France.
  • Hybrid: 3 days in the office / 2 days remote work.
  • Full time permanent contract position.
    • Who We Are
    At Odaseva, we believe in fostering an inclusive, supportive work environment where talented people can innovate and grow. Our culture is built on being smart, humble, hardworking, and above all—collaborative.
     
    Our core values define who we are: Trust, Customer Centricity, Engagement, Excellence, Continuous Innovation, and Teamwork.
     
    Inclusive & Diverse – We champion equality and embrace diversity.
    Supportive & Collaborative – A team of smart, kind professionals who uplift each other through teamwork, not competition.
    Excellence with a Casual Touch – High professional standards in a relaxed, approachable work culture.
    Impact-Driven – A place where you can truly make a difference and advance your career.
    Innovators in Data & Cloud – Leading the way in cutting-edge technology and solutions.
    Competitive & Rewarding – Offering industry-leading compensation and benefits.
    Truly Global – With offices in Paris, San Francisco, Sydney, and London, and a worldwide presence.
    Flexible Work Environment – We support a hybrid, flexible office culture.
     
    At Odaseva, we are an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. We consider all applicants for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

title: UX/UI Designer M/W/X
description:
Pioneer of online flash sales since 2001 and key player in European e-commerce, Veepee collaborates with over 7,000 brands to offer highly discounted products available for a limited time. Operating across various sectors, including fashion, home, wine, travel or beauty... Veepee achieved a turnover of 3.3 billion euros incl. VAT in 2024 and employs 5,000 staff members across 10 countries.

Veepee is looking for a UX/UI Designer for its Growth Marketing team. Attached to the Lead of UX/UI, the person in this position will be responsible for executing the UX vision for the Veepee front experience. You will ensure the optimization of the customer journey across all Veepee sites by analyzing the performance of each step in the user path.

🎯 TASKS

UX/UI Vision and Strategy

- Deliver the UX/UI front vision for all Veepee sites and apps in collaboration with marketing, business, and Tech teams.

- Ensure a flawless and coherent user experience across all devices.

- Contribute to the performance improvement of Veepee platforms by monitoring defined KPIs and business value.

- Propose best practices and innovative solutions to address e-commerce challenges, specifically the flash sales model.

- Contribute to the development and maintenance of the group Design System.

Collaboration Business - Tech

- Work closely with Business and Product Tech teams to design UX/UI solutions that balance business expectations with technical complexity.

- Maintain the quality of business requests and technical deliveries to ensure high-performing evolutions.

- Support the definition of Tech Roadmaps and the prioritization of projects through design validation and delivery.

Team Contribution

- Participate actively in team rituals and collaborative planning to ensure a performing organization.

- Maintain high-quality deliveries and stay updated with the latest UX/UI trends and innovations.

👉 MUST HAVE skills

- At least 3 years of experience as a UX/UI Designer, with a main focus on e-commerce environments.

- Proactive, organized, and autonomous in moving projects forward.

- Strong understanding of the e-commerce universe, particularly platforms with high daily traffic volumes.

- Results-oriented with a capacity to identify and improve process weaknesses.

- Comfortable working with a wide range of departments, including IT, Data Science, Legal, and Finance.

- Fluent level of English is a must.

- International experience is a plus.

❓ TEAM, WHO WE ARE ?

- The Marketing Growth team is dedicated to acquiring new customers, retaining existing customers and improving the user experience on all channels

- You will join a team of 5 UX/UI designers plus a Lead UX/UI, 1 Head of SEO; 2 BPOs (definition of the business needs); and 1 Product analyst.

- We are the owner of the Front roadmaps and SEO strategy at a group level, coordinating and consolidating inputs from a wide range of different teams, from IT teams to Data science, legal, finance, logistics, commercial or operational; and leading several initiatives from the Group

We are convinced that it is up to you to define the way you work, to develop yourself and to progress. At Veepee we guarantee that you can just be yourself! For the service of diversity and inclusion, Veepee is committed to reviewing all applications received on an equal basis.

The Veepee Group processes your data collected as part of the management of your recruitment in order to manage your application file for the position for which you have applied. To find out more about our , we invite you to consult it on our career site.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Site Reliability Engineer- Data Platform (W/M/X)
description:
Pionnier des ventes événementielles en ligne depuis 2001 et acteur incontournable du e-commerce en Europe, Veepee collabore avec plus de 7 000 marques pour proposer des produits à forte décote, disponibles sur une durée limitée. Présent dans de nombreux univers parmi lesquels la mode, la maison, le vin, le voyage, ou encore la beauté ... Veepee a réalisé en 2024 un chiffre d’affaires de 3,3 milliards d’euros TTC et compte 5 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 10 pays.

👉 ABOUT THE TEAM

The Data Platform team builds and runs the platform behind Veepee's data: streaming, query engine, data catalog, storage and Kubernetes. It serves every data team, from BI and analytics to data science, pricing and personalisation.

We are in the middle of our move from GCP to a self-hosted, open-source data platform built on Kafka, Trino, Apache Iceberg, Apache Polaris, Ceph and Kubernetes. Projects like this are rare. You'll help build it, make it production-grade and keep it reliable.

We also work AI-first. We use Claude and GitHub Copilot every day, expose our platform to AI agents through MCP servers, and keep an AI-ready knowledge base.

🎯 TASK
- Run and improve the reliability of our data platform on Kubernetes: availability, performance, capacity, cost.

- Define and track SLOs, and improve monitoring and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana) so that fewer, more useful alerts reach people.

- Automate everything you can: infrastructure as code (Terraform, Crossplane), GitOps (ArgoCD), and CI/CD (GitLab).

- Take part in on-call [rotation details], lead incidents and write blameless postmortems that lead to lasting fixes.

- Work with data engineers and other data teams on production readiness, migrations and tooling.

- Try out AI in operations: agents that investigate incidents, MCP tools, automated runbooks.

👉 MUST HAVE SKILLS
- Kubernetes in production: you have run clusters and the workloads on them, not only deployed to them.

- Infrastructure as code and GitOps: Terraform, plus ArgoCD or a similar tool.

- Observability: Prometheus and Grafana, SLOs, and alerting that people actually act on.

- On-call and incident management: real incidents handled, root causes found, postmortems written.

- Coding: Go or Python for automation and tooling, plus solid Linux and networking basics.

- CI/CD: GitLab CI or similar.

- Curiosity about AI: you already use AI assistants (Claude, GitHub Copilot or similar) in your daily work, and you want to find out how they can change the way we run platforms.

- Professional English, written and spoken.

👉 NICE TO HAVE SKILLS
- Kafka (KRaft, Kafka Connect)

- Trino, Opensource : Apache Iceberg, Apache Polaris

- Object storage (Ceph, S3) and Postgres (Patroni)

- Crossplane, OPA

- GCP

- FinOps practices

- English

✅ BENEFITS
👉 Variable bonus
👉 Profit-sharing and incentive schemes
👉 Remote work possible for up to 2 days per week
👉 Online language-learning platform
👉 Works Council (CSE) with a wide range of benefits
👉 CESU vouchers (service vouchers) and holiday vouchers
👉 Access to corporate dining facilities and smart fridges (Foodles, Kumo, Bolk)
👉 Access to an on-site gym

⚙️ RECRUITMENT PROCESS

- 30-minute HR Screen with a Talent Acquisition Partner

- Interview with the Hiring Manager

- Business & Technical Interview with local Team

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
About the role

Linkup is the web search engine built for AI. Our infrastructure crawls, indexes and serves the live web to AI agents, and it’s scaling fast.

We’re looking for a top‑tier Machine Learning Engineer to join Linkup and work hand‑in‑hand with our CTO, Denis Charrier, and the rest of the tech team.

Your core responsibilities will be to:
Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

- Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

- Bring new ranking signals into the engine, beyond pure relevance

- Build the evaluation framework that tells us what really improves search quality

- Optimize model serving for latency and GPU cost

- Turn customer and benchmark feedback into ranking improvements, with clear before/after numbers

Requirements

You’re a great match if you:

- Are excited to help build Google for AI agents- and believe in Linkup’s mission

- Have strong hands-on experience in information retrieval, ranking or search in production.

- Build rigorous evals and check the data behind every number

- Care about latency, cost and reliability as much as model quality

- Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment

Example Projects

- Ship a new ranking model to production and prove the gain on our eval sets

- Push our models to the next level: better answers, lower latency, lower cost per query

- Build and maintain the evaluations framework that measures every change to our search engine

Our Stack

Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, Ray, Spark / Databricks, Vespa, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform

Details

The ideal candidate will play a central role in our engineering team, partnering closely with the founders. The models you ship will decide what thousands of AI products read every day.

We offer a flexible remote‑work policy- see the details here.

Join us and leverage your expertise to push the boundaries of AI!

About Linkup

Our Vision

We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web. These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information.

AI agents need web search. To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off.

Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs. Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space.

Web 2.0 is sunsetting. The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home.

Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up. We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone.

Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup.

Our Mission

Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve.

Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs.

Our Culture

Our culture is built on the following values:

- Mission. We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents.

- Speed. We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well.

- Ownership. We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion.

- Teamwork. Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset.

- Humility. We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences.

We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture.

Our Team

We are a small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents.

A bit more about our 3 co-founders:

- Philippe Mizrahi- Led the development of Lyft’s Autonomous Vehicles marketplace. Previously launched Amundsen, an open source search engine.

- Denis Charrier- Founding Engineer at Niland, an audio search company (acquired by Spotify), then Staff Engineer at Spotify. 15y of software development experience.

- Boris Toledano- Led robotics at Carrefour, after 3y at McKinsey & Co working on public affairs and digital transformation.

title: SDR/BDR
description:
SDR/BDR Hybrid, Paris
Location: Paris (in-office)
Type: Full-time
Team: Founding GTM Team

About the Role
We're hiring Linkup's first SDR/BDR, a hybrid pipeline-generation role covering both sides of the funnel: qualifying inbound signups and running structured outbound into our priority segments (AI-native companies, GTM tooling providers, enterprise and regulated accounts).
You'll work closely with our VP Sales, picking accounts, drafting outbound, and partnering with AEs to turn interest into qualified pipeline. High ownership, fast feedback loop.

What You'll Do

- Research target accounts and draft personalized multi-channel outreach (email, LinkedIn, phone) for founder-led and AE-assisted outbound

- Monitor and pre-qualify inbound signups against our ICP (AI-native, GTM tooling, enterprise), then route to the right AE

- Support first-touch qualification alongside AEs, learning our lead framework (ICP fit, pain, volume, timing, right entry point) as you go

- Keep every touch logged in Attio

- Help tune outbound messaging and channels as we scale campaigns across segments

Why This Role Matters
This is the first dedicated pipeline-generation hire at Linkup. Get it right and it compounds into every AE's quota.

Our Stack
Attio (CRM), LemList (outbound), Slack, Notion, Apollo/Sales Navigator (prospecting), Snitcher (visitor ID), RB2B

About Linkup
Our Vision

We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web. These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information.

AI agents need web search. To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off.

Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs. Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space.

Web 2.0 is sunsetting. The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home.

Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up. We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone.

Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup.

Our Mission

Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve.

Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs.

Our Culture

Our culture is built on the following values:

- Mission. We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents.

- Speed. We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well.

- Ownership. We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion.

- Teamwork. Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset.

- Humility. We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences.

We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture.

Our Team

We are small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents.

- Philippe Mizrahi- Led the development of Lyft’s Autonomous Vehicles marketplace. Previously launched Amundsen, an open source search engine.

- Denis Charrier- Founding Engineer at Niland, an audio search company (acquired by Spotify), then Staff Engineer at Spotify. 15y of software development experience.

description:
About the Role

We’re looking for a top-tier Forward Deployed Engineer to join Linkup and work hand-in-hand with our founders, customers, and partners. You'll be part of the founding FDE team at Linkup

This is a highly cross-functional role. You’ll operate at the intersection of engineering, GTM, and customer success, turning technical integrations into insights that drive our product roadmap, marketing narratives, and outbound strategy.

You’ll be the connective bridge between what customers build with Linkup and how we tell that story to the world.

What You’ll Do

- Work directly with customers and partners to design, prototype, and deploy integrations of Linkup’s APIs into real-world agentic systems.

- Participate in pre-sales efforts - technical discovery, proof-of-concept design, demo environments.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with backend, ML, and product teams to ensure performance and reliability at scale.

- Partner with the GTM Engineer and DevRel team to turn customer learnings into automation, tutorials, and playbooks.

- Identify and implement technical integrations with our other partners in the value chain (workflow orchestration, AI frameworks, etc.)

- Translate complex technical concepts into clear explanations for both developers and business audiences.

Why This Role Matters

Every integration you build helps define how AI systems connect to live, trusted information.

You’ll operate on the frontier between customers and product - bringing the voice of the field into everything we build and say.

Your work will inform:

- The use cases we automate in our GTM systems.

- The features we prioritize in our roadmap.

- Are comfortable debugging integrations and solving ambiguous technical challenges in customer environments.

- Communicate clearly and empathetically with both technical and business audiences.

- Are curious about AI infrastructure, retrieval, and the emerging agentic ecosystem.

- Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment.

title: Senior Director - West International Cluster, Global Rare BU
description:
Snr Director West International Cluster, Global Rare BU - Closing Date: November 13, 2027.

This role will be responsible to develop and execute all sales and marketing activities in the relative cluster of countries, with immediate focus on driving the development of GIVLAARI and OXLUMO.

This person will:

  • Support and challenge regional and local teams in tailoring the global strategy to the specific markets while maintaining global/regional alignment;
  • Allocate investment and drive and track focused execution of cross-functional tactics;
  • Share learnings and best practices across the Global Rare Business Unit.

The role will lead a team of  Field Business Leaders (FBL) across a group of geographies and be the primary interface with local Country Managers and International TTR BU shared services (eg Regional Commercial, Business Operations and and Market Access). They will appropriately partner with Medical and Regional Marketing to ensure optimal alignment, insight sharing and communication.  The Cluster Head will also build and execute the Cluster tactical plan (e.g.,Sales force and HCP target group prioritization,  congress activities, marketing materials) and participate in the regional tactics as appropriate (e.g., European congresses). 

The Cluster Head reports to the VP, International Rare Head.

Summary of Key Responsibilities

Manages the full Commercial Team for the specific geographies (Field Business Leaders and their KAMs)

  • Maximize the commercial potential of Alnylam’s assets through the development and implementation of strategic/operational plans in close collaboration with Global Rare marketing, Medical Affairs and Market Access teams.
  • Define, plan and set the commercial direction for the business within the Cluster, utilizing innovative techniques to drive increased customer value and market penetration
  • Lead the cross-functional team providing vision, motivation, and support and coaching infrastructure to drive the business and achieve portfolio objectives.
  • Partner with Market Access and Country Managers to identify, develop, propose and execute local reimbursement plans, including alignment with appropriate adaptation of European pricing, reimbursement and access strategies
  • Effectively lead and build a high performing commercial team by hiring top talent, addressing talent gaps, upskilling and providing career guidance
  • Take responsibility and accountability to deliver against the agreed commercial and strategic objectives, as well as Quality, Compliance and risk management in the countries of the cluster
  • Ensure that all business activities are in line with company policies, procedures and local guidelines
  • Builds sustainable relationships with local healthcare stakeholders, functions as main partner for local customers and local/ international KOLs
  • Ensure high quality revenue and volume forecasting and brand investment deployment for the cluster
  • Develops and implements innovative, multichannel marketing strategies and tactics in the cluster, including the planning and tracking of commercial spent investment
  • In close collaboration with the Global marketing teams, ensure deep local market and stakeholder insights to inform local tailoring of the strategy and tactics and to help inform the global/regional strategy
  • Contributes to the development of the Global strategic plan and annual tactical plans.
  • Ensure detailed pre-launch and post-launch tracking of agreed KPIs to allow early course correction and ensure execution of key tactics

Qualifications, Key Skills, and Competencies

  • Life Science degree or Business degree
  • Extensive knowledge / experience of working in a bio/pharmaceutical commercial (Sales & Marketing) team
  • Experience in collaboration in Cross-functional teams
  • Demonstrable commercial leadership experience in the biopharmaceutical industry such as a highly successful Sales Manager or Marketing Manager and a strong sales & marketing leader within the specialty therapeutics arena, orphan drugs is a plus.
  • Must have a track record of successful budget management with an understanding of revenue forecasting and expense budget planning and tracking
  • Must have the ability to build and drive a business, whilst possessing innate ‘market-making’ capabilities with natural self-starter, hands-on, entrepreneurial and innovative attitude
  • Strong leadership qualities such as having the ability to attract, motive and retain talent and drive a culture of collaboration, engagement and motivation
  • Ability to provide strategic input at Global level
  • Outstanding knowledge of the Rare Disease space, including Market Access key success factors.
  • Strong network/matrix stakeholder communications skills with both regional and in-country teams
  • Strong business and financial acumen
  • Relentless external customer and patient focus
  • Outstanding strategic thinking combined with strong execution leadership
  • Inspirational leader, able to energize and motivate cross-functional teams and Sales Force
  • Autonomous working style, pragmatic and operationally oriented, excellent planning and organizing skills
  • Sense of urgency, ethics and responsibility 
  • Excellent command of written and spoken English
  • Openness to travel approximately is required - 60% domestically and some internationally

About Alnylam: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: ALNY) has led the translation of RNA interference (RNAi) into a whole new class of innovative medicines with the potential to transform the lives of people afflicted with rare and more prevalent diseases. Based on Nobel Prize-winning science, RNAi therapeutics represent a powerful, clinically validated approach to treating diseases at their genetic source by “interfering” with mRNA that cause or contribute to disease. Since our founding in 2002, Alnylam has led the RNAi Revolution and continues to turn scientific possibility into reality.

Our culture: Our people-first culture is guided by our core values: fiercely innovative, open culture, purposeful urgency, passion for excellence, and commitment to people, and these values influence how we work and the business decisions we make. Thanks to feedback from our employees over the years, we’ve been fortunate to be named a top employer around the world. Alnylam is extremely proud to have been recognized as one of Science Magazine’s Top Biopharma Employers, one of America's Most Responsible Companies for 2024 by Newsweek, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in Canada, France, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, and UK – among others.

At Alnylam, we commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal employment opportunity. We are dedicated to building an environment where employees can feel that they belong, can bring their authentic selves to work, and achieve to their full potential. By empowering employees to embrace their unique differences at work, our business grows stronger with advanced and original thinking, allowing us to bring groundbreaking medicines to patients.

title: Account Manager - Physicals - Europe
description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

About the Role

As a Commercial Development Manager, you will play a pivotal role in accelerating Kpler's growth trajectory across France and Switzerland. Operating within our Mid-market EMEA Sales division, you will drive pipeline generation and spearhead territory expansion by delivering high-value market intelligence solutions to physical commodities clients. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams and our legal entities, your work will directly fuel our commercial expansion and empower industry leaders with transparent, actionable trade data.

Key Responsibilities

- Drive Territory Growth: Proactively manage and expand the France and Switzerland territory to consistently meet or exceed annual pipeline generation and revenue targets.

- Cultivate High-Value Pipeline: Identify, qualify, and develop new commercial opportunities across physical energy and commodities markets with a proactive "hunter" mindset.

- Lead Commercial Strategy & Discussions: Support pricing and commercial terms structure, collaborating with internal legal and contracting entities to streamline deal execution.

- Deliver Strategic Market Insights: Gather frontline client feedback and competitive intelligence to inform product strategy, demand planning, and multi-year forecasting.

- Maintain CRM & Forecasting Integrity: Keep Salesforce meticulously updated with key client interactions, pipeline metrics, and accurate updates to ensure reliable business forecasting.

- Champion the Kpler Brand: Act as a credible brand ambassador at industry events and client meetings, conveying Kpler’s value proposition with professionalism and technical authority.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with Sales Operations, Customer Success, Marketing, and Business Units to ensure seamless customer onboarding and long-term business success.

Experience & Background
What you'll need (Must-haves):

- Proven Commercial Experience: 5+ years of experience in a sales, account management, or commercial development role within technology, SaaS, data vendors, or commodity markets.

- Language Proficiency: Fluency in both English and French is required to effectively engage our core client base across France and Switzerland.

- Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of energy markets, trade dynamics, and broader commodity trends.

- Proactive Mindset: Self-motivated, disciplined hunter mentality with a track record of thriving in fast-paced, dynamic, and unstructured environments.

Nice-to-haves:

- Familiarity with the maritime industry or physical commodities trading ecosystem.

- Experience utilizing modern sales engagement tools such as Salesforce, ZoomInfo, Outreach, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

- Proven ability to support complex contract discussions and pricing negotiations.

We are a dynamic company dedicated to nurturing connections and innovating solutions to tackle market challenges head-on. If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us?

We make things happen

We act decisively and with purpose, going the extra mile.

We build together

We foster relationships and develop creative solutions to address market challenges.

We are here to help

We are accessible and supportive to colleagues and clients with a friendly approach.

Our People Pledge

Don’t meet every single requirement? Research shows that women and people of color are less likely than others to apply if they feel like they don’t match 100% of the job requirements. Don’t let the confidence gap stand in your way, we’d love to hear from you! We understand that experience comes in many different forms and are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.

Kpler is committed to providing a fair, inclusive and diverse work-environment. We believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, and better ideas allow us to better understand the needs and interests of our diverse, global community. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives and are an equal opportunity employer.

By applying, I confirm that I have read and accept the Staff Privacy Notice

You’ll drive complex, high-value deals and build long-term strategic partnerships with medium-sized and large customers. These are multi-stakeholder sales cycles that often span regions, business units, decision layers and require the ability to translate solutions into value

What you bring

  • 5+ years of B2B sales closing complex deals with several decision-makers, with consistent quota attainment.

  • A deep understanding of the Swiss market and local business landscape, with the credibility to engage senior buyers from day one.

  • Strong executive presence, plus value-based discovery and negotiation skills.
  • Fluent German and English; French and/or Italian are a plus.

What we offer

  • An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being part of a thriving multinational environment.

  • Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members.
  • Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your family in one of the most important times in life, the birth of a child. Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.

title: System Architect
description:
Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness.

As a System Architect, you will be responsible for our solid-state transformer as a complete system. You will connect the work of our power electronics, magnetics, and mechanical and thermal engineering teams into one coherent system, and ensure it meets the requirements of hyperscale data center customers.

Instead of specializing in a single subsystem, your mission is to keep the whole system in view: balancing efficiency, size, cost, reliability and manufacturability, guiding the key technical trade-offs, and taking our SST from prototype to a product ready for certification and series production.

This role is for you if…
you’ve owned a complex high-power system rather than one part of it. You enjoy keeping the whole picture in view, making the call on trade-offs between expert teams, and bringing just enough structure to a fast-moving team without slowing it down.

This role isn’t for you if…
you’ve spent your career going deep on a single component or subsystem, or you manage projects without making the technical decisions yourself. It’s also not a fit if you need a fixed specification and established processes before you can start.

Key Responsibilities

- Own the system architecture of the SST and its key performance metrics, including efficiency, power density, cost, thermal performance, reliability, manufacturability and control performance.

- Coordinate the subsystems of the SST (AC/DC, DC/DC, magnetics, mechanical and thermal) and their interfaces, ensuring the work of each team is compatible and consistent with the system design.

- Lead system-level trade-off decisions and set technical priorities across teams.

- Define and maintain system requirements, interface specifications and change management, ensuring design changes are assessed for their impact across the system.

- Translate the requirements of data center operators and hyperscalers into system specifications, and track how they evolve.

- Explore and compare different system architectures and their integration in the datacenter power supply chain

- Drive standardization and design for manufacturing across subsystems in preparation for series production.

- Work with the compliance and certification team to define a feasible certification path for the system.

- Identify technical risks at system level early and propose mitigations.

Qualifications

- MSc or a higher degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.

- 8+ years of industry experience in developing complex power electronic systems.

- Proven responsibility at system or platform level, e.g. as system engineer, system architect, technical lead or team lead.

- Track record of taking power electronic systems from development to series product.

- Experience with high-power systems such as EV charging, electric drivetrains, rail traction, industrial drives, renewable energy converters or robotics.

- Broad understanding of the electrical, magnetic, thermal, mechanical and control aspects of power electronic systems, and how they interact.

- Working knowledge of cooling concepts and the mechanical integration of high-power electronics.

- Experience with standards, norms and certification processes for power electronic products.

- Strong communication and decision-making skills; able to align experts across disciplines and drive decisions.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving requirements.

The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland.

Nice to Have

- Experience with medium-voltage converter systems or solid-state transformers.

- Knowledge of data center power architectures.

- Experience in design for manufacturing and cost engineering.

- Experience establishing systems engineering processes in a growing organization.

Benefits

- Equity + competitive salary.

- Unique technology and market opportunity – shape the architecture of a new product category for the energy transition.

- Hybrid work with flexible working times.

title: Senior Multiphysics R&D Engineer (Electro-mechanical)
description:
With over 140 years of Swiss engineering heritage, Sécheron Hasler Group is a global leader in high-power electrical and electronic equipment. Our solutions power railways, renewable energy, DC and AC networks, and industrial systems worldwide trusted for their precision, reliability, and innovation.

At the heart of modern rail infrastructure, our Traction Power Systems unit delivers cutting-edge DC and AC traction substations, protection systems, power conversion and digital monitoring solutions. Join us to shape the future of sustainable mobility with technology that keeps cities and countries moving. For the expansion of our team, we are seeking to hire in Geneva a dynamic and motivated Senior R&D Engineer.

As a Senior Multiphysics R&D Engineer, you will be involved with the R&D team in the development of cutting-edge high-speed switching devices such as high-speed DC circuit breakers, contributing to the full product lifecycle: from design to application.

You will work at the intersection of electrical and mechanical engineering, bringing expertise in power electronics, dielectrics and thermal advanced modeling, playing a key role in shaping the future of medium voltage switching technology.

Main Responsibilities:

- Contribute to innovative R&D projects focused on high-speed circuit breakers and related switching technologies.
- Design and simulate electrical switching systems using MATLAB/Simulink, COMSOL MultiPhysics including electromagnetic, thermal, material science and dielectric behavior.
- Define and execute test plans for prototypes, including dielectric, thermal, and mechanical validation.
- Interface with cross-functional teams including mechanical, electrical and electronics engineers.
- Collaborate with manufacturing teams to optimize material processing and industrialization.
- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical strategy and innovation roadmaps.
- Contribute to patent filings, technical documentation, and compliance with IEC/IEEE standards.
- Develop and validate electronic control boards for switching and protection systems.

Requirements

- Minimum 8 years of experience in R&D for low voltage and/or medium voltage electric equipment.
- Good understanding of Railway protection systems – Modern DC microgrids.
- English fluent mandatory, French strong plus.
- Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Applied Physics or similar.
- Strong understanding of electro-mechanical and magnetic systems.

Strong plus:

- Experience with testing and validation in high-voltage environments.
- Knowledge of High-speed DC circuit breakers.

Plus:

- Good knowledge in power electronics switching devices.
- Thermal and dielectric analysis.
- Modeling and simulation in MATLAB/Simulink - COMSOL.
- Material processing and manufacturing techniques.
- Electronic board design and integration.
- CAD 3D design tools (SolidWorks).
- Curious, attentive to detail, team player.

Benefits

We foster flat hierarchies and direct communication, enabling quick decisions and strong collaboration across all levels. You’ll be trusted with real responsibility and encouraged to take initiative, with plenty of opportunities to grow both personally and professionally.

title: (Senior) Deployment Strategist
description:
You take a signed customer and turn them into a flagship reference, owning the journey from first go-live to a full rollout across their plants.

Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We serve manufacturers from Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, and are backed by Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Palantir, McKinsey, Meta, Google, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity.

WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT?

You will take a signed logo and turn them into a flagship reference. That means getting onto the shopfloor fast, understanding what drives their KPIs, and deploying Ethon's agentic workflows where the impact is highest. You implement the first use case while already mapping the next. Once one is live, you find the next one. When the engineer is sold, you bring in the plant manager. Once the plant manager is convinced, you get to the COO. This is what you'll do:

- Own the deployment: You're the person who makes sure go-live happens on time and the customer's team knows how to use it. You handle the onboarding, the training, and the change management that gets a new platform embedded into daily operations.

- Turn shopfloor problems into business cases: An operator tells you yield drops on line 3 every Tuesday night. You figure out why, quantify what it costs, and build the case for the next deployment. You're as comfortable talking to a process engineer as you are presenting to a VP of Operations.

- Drive expansion: You know which teams in the account haven't seen Ethon yet, which problems are still unsolved, and what it takes to get the next use case signed.

- Be on-site: You're in factories. The insights that matter don't come from email chains and slides, they come from being on the floor.

- Feed the product: You're closest to what customers actually need. You bring that signal back to Engineering and Product and you help us build something better.

- Work with the team: GTM & Sales brings the logo with your help as a trustworthy industry expert, you take it from there. You work tightly with Engineering on delivery and with the commercial team on expansion opportunities.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING?

The best people in this seat combine strategic thinking with the willingness to get their hands dirty on a shopfloor. We can teach you our product. We can't teach you to care about how things get made, or to push hard when a deployment is stuck.

- You're technically sharp enough to understand a production process and commercially minded enough to turn a pain point into a business case

- You have 3-5 years of experience in something demanding: consulting, enterprise tech deployment, or a career on the shopfloor

- You know how to manage complex stakeholder environments, from shopfloor operators to C-suite sponsors

- You've run change management or adoption programs and know what it takes to get people to actually use new tools

- You have a builder mindset: when something isn't working, your instinct is to fix it rather than escalate it

- You're open to travel 30-50% of the time

This is how we'll set you up in your first six months:

- Months 1-2: Learn about product, customers, and how our best deployments get done. You shadow live accounts, learn the platform end-to-end, and expand your understanding of how manufacturers think. You start working on your first account.

- Months 3-4: You own delivery for one or more accounts, with support from the team.

- Months 5-6: Full ownership of one or more customers. You're running deployments, driving expansion conversations, and your first upsell is in motion.

Great fits tend to come from backgrounds like:

- Deployment, implementation, or customer success at high-growth industrial tech companies (e.g., Palantir, c3ai, Rockwell, Siemens Digital Industries) where you owned outcomes

- Top-tier consulting, ready to stop writing recommendations and start executing them

- Digital transformation or operational excellence roles inside manufacturing companies, where things were moving too slowly for you

- Manufacturing or process engineering, where you've lived the problems Ethon solves, you know what a plant manager actually cares about, and customers trust you the moment you walk onto their floor

- A technical degree in chemical, mechanical, electrical engineering, physics, or a related field

Bonus:

- Experience with MES, ERP, Historian, or quality systems in manufacturing environments

- Fluency in German, French, or another European language

WHY IS ETHON RIGHT FOR YOU?

We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person. Feedback loops are short, access to founders is direct. People who prove themselves here outgrow their title fast.

Additionally, we offer:

- Performance-based career & growth paths

- On-site work with significant scope for flexible schedules

- Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success

- Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation

- Flexible parental leave

- Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse world we live in. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, and we especially welcome voices traditionally underrepresented in tech.

title: Facharzt/Fachärztin Allgemeine Innere Medizin (Zürich)
description:
Bei Oviva und Ovivamed Clinic verfolgen wir die Mission, nachhaltige, personalisierte und klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu machen, während wir Europas führende KI-gestützte Plattform für die Behandlung chronischer Krankheiten aufbauen. Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen dabei, gewichtsbedingte Erkrankungen in den Griff zu bekommen. Dabei konzentrieren wir uns auf das, was am wichtigsten ist: die Gesundheit zu verbessern, das Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und die Lebensqualität zu steigern.

Bis heute haben wir über eine Million Menschen in Grossbritannien, der Schweiz und Deutschland unterstützt. Hinter unserer Mission steht ein engagiertes Team, das in vier Ländern tätig ist, einschliesslich unseres Hubs in Polen. Jedes Gespräch, jede Coaching-Session und jede Zeile Code bringt uns einer gesünderen Zukunft näher.

Unser ärztliches Team sucht ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung weitere Unterstützung für unsere Ovivamed Clinic für die Tätigkeit als:

Facharzt/Fachärztin für Allgemeine Innere Medizin in Zürich (anteilig Home Office)

Deine Aufgaben

- Betreuung und Beratung: Du führst Konsultationen durch, koordinierst die multimodale Therapie unserer Patienten und stellst eine hohe Behandlungsqualität sicher.

- Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit Ernährungsberater*innen, Psycholog*innen und anderen Fachkräften zusammen, um einen ganzheitlichen Behandlungsansatz zu gewährleisten.

- Beitrag zur medizinischen Qualitätssicherung: Du engagierst dich in der Weiterentwicklung unserer medizinischen Standards und Protokolle, um eine beständig hohe Qualität der Patientenversorgung sicherzustellen.

Dein Profil

- Abgeschlossenes Medizinstudium mit der Weiterbildung zur/zum Fachärztin/Facharzt im Bereich der allgemeinen inneren Medizin

- Vorhandene Berufsausübungsbewilligung oder Erfüllung der Kriterien, eine solche beantragen zu können

- Sprachkenntnisse: Sicherheit in der Kommunikation auf Deutsch, Französisch ist ein Plus

- Interesse am Thema Adipositas (Diagnose, Behandlung, Anwendung und Umgang mit GLP-1RAs)

- Fähigkeit, selbständig und im Team in einem stark digital getriebenem Arbeitsumfeld zu arbeiten

Was Ovivamed Dir bietet

- Wirkung mit Sinn: Du wirst Teil eines engagierten Teams, das die Gesundheitsversorgung für Menschen mit Adipositas und Typ-2-Diabetes revolutioniert.

- Dynamische Kultur: Ein Umfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Kreativität und Veränderung gefördert werden.

- Attraktive Benefits: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, flexible Arbeitsmodelle und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Es ist uns sehr wichtig, eine Kultur zu haben, in der die Menschen gerne arbeiten wollen. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir unsere Werte bei allem, was wir tun, in den Vordergrund stellen:

Patient*innen stehen bei uns an erster Stelle, Wir befähigen unsere Teams, Wir machen es möglich

Ovivamed engagiert sich leidenschaftlich dafür eine inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, die die unterschiedlichen Stimmen unserer Mitarbeiter*innen ermutigt, unterstützt und feiert. Wir sind ein wirklich inklusiver Arbeitsplatz, an dem man selbst sein kann und alle willkommen sind.

Bereit, etwas zu bewirken? Begleite uns bei der Transformation der digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung. Bewirb Dich noch heute!

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.

Position Description

As an Engineering Manager at Sonar, you will lead a squad of 8 developers to build, automate and operate software used by millions of Sonar customers worldwide. You will own the professional growth and development of your team, enabling them to build well-crafted software for our products, and promoting a high-performance engineering culture.

You will improve our products by leading the elaboration of the squad's annual and quarterly objectives in close collaboration with the AI team while contributing to and overseeing technical architecture and engineering direction.

You will help to bring consistency across Sonar’s engineering organization by collaborating closely with your engineering manager peers to foster and share engineering best practices.

What you will do

- Lead and manage a team of Engineers, providing guidance, support, and mentorship to help individuals grow in autonomy and contribute to the team's success.

- Hold yourself and your team accountable to a high engineering standard.

- Foster a safe culture of feedback, continuous improvement, and collaboration, encouraging team members to share their ideas and concerns openly.

- Align feedback with other teams to ensure things operate smoothly between teams.

- Partner with product managers, designers, and team leads to develop and communicate a clear vision for the squad that aligns with the company strategy and ensure that the team's work and focus align with this vision.

- Ensure the squad defines clear objectives that are aligned with team, department, and company goals.

- Be accountable for tracking sprint progress.

- Be accountable that processes and ceremonies align with company expectations to deliver the best product successfully.

- Ensure that the right level of collaboration happens with the squad stakeholders (Product Managers, developer squads, Marketing, Management, etc.).

- Partner with the Hiring team to recruit talented Engineers for the team. Participate in improving the hiring process for the team and ensuring we recruit enough to reach our goals.

- Be accountable that the onboarding of new team members is happening in the squad.

- Lead by example, modeling the behaviors and values that the company holds dear, including humility and servant leadership.

Experience and qualifications
The technical skills you will demonstrate

- 8+ years of software development or equivalent experience in the software development domain, with a strong understanding of software testing.

- Having a developer mindset: experience with coding lifecycle, ability to produce secure code, to do code reviews, and to jump into an unknown codebase, language, and framework.

- Advanced knowledge of the Java ecosystem

- Good knowledge of at least one programming language along with its development environment to understand end-user's context and expectations.

- Experience with Agile methodologies.

Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. description:
Für ein international tätiges Industrieunternehmen der Energieinfrastruktur steuerst du Angebote für Hochspannungsprojekte in globalen Märkten. Du führst das Bid-Team über alle Funktionen, bewertest Risiken und Chancen und bringst die Unterlagen termingerecht zur Abgabe. Gefragt ist echte Tender-Erfahrung aus der Branche, keine reine Vertragsassistenz.

Das zeichnet die Stelle aus

- Gesamtverantwortung für den Angebotsprozess, von Bid/No-Bid bis zur Abgabe
- Internationale Ausschreibungen von Netzbetreibern und Generalunternehmen

Deine Aufgaben

- Ausschreibungen sichten und gemeinsam mit der Verkaufsleitung fundierte Bid-/No-Bid-Empfehlungen erarbeiten
- Bid-Team aus Engineering, Projektmanagement, Einkauf, Produktion, Logistik, Finanzen und Recht führen
- Kostenkalkulationen, Preisofferten und Vertragsbedingungen erarbeiten, Risiken und Chancen strukturiert bewerten
- Angebotsunterlagen technisch, kommerziell und rechtlich zusammenstellen, prüfen und fristgerecht einreichen
- Präqualifikationen und Lieferantenregistrierungen bei Netzbetreibern und Generalunternehmen vorbereiten und abschliessen
- Ausschreibungs- und Pipelinedaten im ERP, zum Beispiel Microsoft Dynamics 365, pflegen und das Verkaufsreporting unterstützen
- Vertragsverhandlungen begleiten, Win/Loss-Analysen auswerten und Vorlagen sowie Abläufe im Bid-Management verbessern

Dein Profil

- Abschluss in Elektro- oder Energietechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Betriebswirtschaft, oder vergleichbare Ausbildung
- Mindestens fünf Jahre eigene Tender-Verantwortung in Energieinfrastruktur oder vergleichbarem internationalem Projektgeschäft
- Erfahrung mit Hochspannungssystemen oder Generalunternehmer-Projekten ist ein klarer Vorteil
- Sichere Kostenkalkulation, starke Analytik und gute Kenntnisse kommerzieller Vertragsbedingungen
- Nachweisbare Koordination funktionsübergreifender Teams, sicher in MS Office und ERP-Systemen
- Verhandlungssicheres Englisch ist Pflicht, Deutsch im Alltag von Vorteil

Arbeitsort: Raum Aarau, Schweiz (vor Ort). Pensum: 100%.

Du bewirbst dich bei CONCAPE GmbH, Personalvermittlung, Städtle 13, 9490 Vaduz, Liechtenstein. Den Namen des Unternehmens besprechen wir persönlich mit dir. Vorgestellt wirst du nur mit deinem OK.

Du hast bereits eigenständig Software entwickelt und kannst zeigen, wie du Anforderungen in lauffähige Prototypen und erste MVPs übersetzt. title: Software Engineer
description:
Construction is a multi-trillion-dollar industry used by every human across the planet. It needs your help: we need to invent new software systems so construction becomes as efficient, quick, automated and green as possible. The team at Benetics (60+ years of engineering experience, 2 founding engineers from Google, and a CEO with a successful exit in tech.) is laser-focused on a vision of understanding each building’s DNA: How are people on-site communicating? How was the building constructed compared to what the plan said? How can we automate planning, implementation, logistics, and maintenance into a seamless process flow?
Join the fastest-moving company in this space.

Tasks

- Build reliable, performant, and scalable software solutions.
- Follow data-driven experimentation to iterate on features.
- Bring machine learning models for construction process flows.
- Work closely and collaborate with engineers, product managers, designers, and other team members.
- Share expertise, hold tech talks, contribute to design meetings, and enrich our engineering culture.
- Tackle greenfield algorithmic, scaling, and performance challenges.
- Code using primarily TypeScript and Python

Requirements

- [required] 2+ years of software engineering experience
- [required] Master’s or bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in computer science, mathematics, or related fields (ETH Zurich or equivalent)
- Your A-Game: top-notch software engineering, a curious mind looking to learn constantly, and an empathic style that wants to teach others.

Benefits

- Experienced and powerful team; a start-up without the chaos.
- Quick pacing while paying attention to all the details: we build a delightful, bullet-proof product.
- Performance-driven compensation, including equity.
- A place to learn and develop yourself.
- A once-in-a-generation chance to reshape an industry of crucial importance for humanity and the planet.
- We are hiring the best people around the world and offer visa sponsorship.
