title: SAP Analytics Consultant
description:
We are seeking three experienced French-speaking SAP Analytics professionals to strengthen the internal SAP Finance/Analytics team of a public-sector client in Lausanne. The team supports the client’s financial reporting, budget planning, annual accounts and budget publication, all running on an SAP S/4HANA, BW / BW-IP, HANA and BusinessObjects landscape.

The three positions cover the full application lifecycle: one keeps the existing reporting and planning chains running, one builds enhancements and new developments, and one defines the target analytics architecture and guides the team through complex projects. All three work together within the same team, so you will have regular contact with colleagues across RUN, BUILD and architecture.

Location: Lausanne (minimum 3 days/week on-site during the first 3 months for onboarding and knowledge transfer, then remote. Remote work is possible only from Switzerland or the French border zone.

Contract: 01.01.2027 - 31.12.2029, renewable annually

Language: Fluent French

The Positions:

SAP Analytics Techno-Functional Consultant – Corrective & Adaptive Maintenance (RUN) | approx. 100%

Qualify and analyse incidents on BW/IP, BO/Lumira, SLT, CDS/HANA Views and output management, including impact analysis

Reproduce issues and analyse data, performance, SLT replication and XML generation

Deliver corrections and changes across BW/IP, BO, Lumira, CDS/HANA, SLT and the custom ABAP XML program, with regression testing

Provide daily support for financial and budget reporting, as well as the production of annual accounts and budget publication

Deploy changes, support go-lives, carry out root cause analysis, and drive optimisation and documentation

2. SAP Analytics Techno-Functional Consultant – Enhancements & New Developments | approx. 60%

Analyse financial, budget and social reporting needs and map CRM/S4, BW, SLT and output management flows

Design BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira and SLT solutions and estimate effort and risks

Run POCs on analytical models, SLT and XML output flows

Build BW/IP models, CDS/HANA Views, BO/Lumira reports, SLT flows and the ABAP XML program, including testing

Prepare environments, transports and go-lives, and hand over to the support team

3. SAP Analytics Expert – Evolutive Maintenance & New Developments (mini-projects) | approx. 45%

Define the target analytics architecture (BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira, SLT) in line with the SAP roadmap and cloud analytics solutions

Lead scoping and GAP analysis, and deliver documented recommendations backed by SAP references and SWOT analysis

Lead POCs and validate performance and reporting output

Conduct design reviews, performance analysis and optimisation

Support the team on complex developments and knowledge transfer

Your Profile (all positions):

Senior-level SAP Analytics / BI experience on S/4HANA (for the Expert position: expert level, with proven experience in leading analytics architecture and design)

Strong BW / BW-IP skills in design, modelling, data loading, financial reporting and budget planning

Hands-on experience with financial reporting tools: AfO, BEx Analyzer, BEx Query Designer, WAD and broadcasting

Experience in budget planning, including planning models, simulations, consolidation and reporting

Solid knowledge of SAP BusinessObjects, Lumira and migration to WebI (N4V for WebI is a plus)

Experience with SAP SLT (CRM → S/4HANA replication, monitoring and troubleshooting)

Experience designing, extending and optimising CDS Views and HANA Views

ABAP skills to maintain and enhance a custom program generating XML for output management

Understanding of integration across CRM, S/4HANA, BW, HANA and reporting tools, with a focus on data quality, performance, security and governance

Knowledge of management accounting (controlling) and project management

Familiarity with RUN processes: incident resolution, SPS/SP cycles, regression testing, transports and Basis validation

Experience with Jira, ChaRM, Solution Manager and Confluence

Knowledge of SAP cloud analytics solutions (and, for the Expert position, the SAP analytics roadmap)

SAP Analytics certifications (BW, BW-IP, CDS Views, SLT, BO, Lumira, SAP cloud analytics) are an advantage

Fluent French is essential

What We Offer:

A long-term engagement through 2029, renewable annually

Meaningful work supporting the financial and budget processes of a public-sector organisation

A broad and modern SAP Analytics landscape covering BW/IP, HANA, CDS, SLT, BO/Lumira and cloud analytics

A choice of focus (RUN, BUILD or architecture) to suit your expertise and availability

Collaboration within an experienced internal SAP Finance / Analytics team

Remote working after the onboarding phase

Opportunities to shape the client’s analytics architecture and future roadmap

title: Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor
description:
We are currently looking for an experienced Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor to join an international financial services environment and contribute to strengthening its technology, cybersecurity and risk management landscape.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise with a strong understanding of governance, risk and controls. You will take ownership of complex audit engagements, challenge existing practices and provide independent insights that support informed decision-making at senior management level.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically experienced professional who enjoys investigating complex IT environments, identifying potential vulnerabilities and making a meaningful impact on the organisation’s security and resilience.

Responsibilities & Tasks

Plan, lead and deliver comprehensive IT audit engagements based on a risk-oriented approach, including the development of audit strategies and testing procedures.

Review and evaluate technology-related risk areas, including cybersecurity, IT governance, infrastructure, network security, access management, data protection, operational resilience and emerging technologies.

Apply your technical background to analyse complex IT architectures, identify potential weaknesses and assess the effectiveness of existing security measures and internal controls.

Review findings from penetration tests, vulnerability scans, security assessments and monitoring activities, translating technical observations into relevant risk insights.

Assess emerging technologies, particularly Artificial Intelligence and AI-driven solutions, and evaluate their implications for cybersecurity, governance and technology risk.

Present audit findings, recommendations and risk assessments to relevant stakeholders, including senior management and executive-level decision-makers.

Prepare structured and impactful audit documentation, ensuring that identified issues are clearly communicated and actionable.

Track remediation activities and evaluate the effectiveness of implemented measures.

Work closely with colleagues across IT, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, Governance and Business functions to promote continuous improvement and strengthen the overall control environment.

Requirements & Qualifications

Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a comparable discipline, alternatively equivalent professional experience.

At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in IT, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Technology Risk or a related technical field.

Strong practical knowledge of several core technology and security domains, such as Network Security, Identity and Access Management, Vulnerability Management, Security Operations or IT Resilience.

Experience working with technical security assessments, penetration testing results, vulnerability scanning solutions or comparable security tools.

Previous exposure to IT Audit, Internal Audit, External Audit, Technology Risk or another assurance-related function is highly desirable.

Professional certifications such as CISA, CISM, CISSP or equivalent qualifications are considered an advantage.

Interest in Artificial Intelligence, machine learning and AI-driven technologies, particularly in relation to security, governance and risk management. Practical experience in AI governance or AI-based solutions is beneficial.

Strong analytical capabilities, a structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to assess complex technical information independently.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge established practices constructively and engage with senior decision-makers.

High professional integrity, sound judgement and a strong sense of responsibility.

Fluent English is required. German and/or French language skills are an additional advantage.

Willingness to undertake international business travel, approximately 20 days or more annually.

Benefits & Culture

Work in an international financial services environment where technology, security and risk management play a central role.

Take on a highly visible position with direct exposure to senior stakeholders and strategic decision-making.

Enjoy a broad and varied scope of responsibility across technology, cybersecurity and emerging risk areas.

Collaborate with experienced professionals from IT, Business, Risk and Governance in a supportive and knowledge-driven environment.

Benefit from opportunities for continuous professional development, specialist training and relevant industry certifications.

Contribute to meaningful initiatives that strengthen organisational security, resilience and governance.

Join a professional culture that values integrity, initiative, collaboration and individual expertise.

title: Collaborateur.trice d'analyse SIB – Spécialisation Alimentation et Santé
description:
Description des tâches à faire

GCBOAL02 Business Management & Développement

Bac+5 0-1 an Télétravail

Votre mission :

- Audit et Évaluation de terrain : Appliquer et tester sur le terrain les questionnaires d'enquête initiale pour déterminer l'empreinte chromatique des restaurants partenaires (sur les axes clés : santé, diététique, approvisionnement, gestion des déchets, etc.).

- Analyse et Amélioration continue : Analyser les premiers résultats des tests pratiques en con ditions réelles, identifier les limites des outils actuels et formuler des corrections/ajustements pour valider définitivement les questionnaires.

- Recherche et Modélisation : Effectuer des analyses d'impact (macro/micro) liant la nutrition à la santé publique (alignement avec le Programme national nutrition santé - PNNS, impact des choix alimentaires sur la baisse des maladies chroniques comme l'obésité ou le diabète).

- Développement et Promotion : Participer à la visibilité du projet par des actions de commu nication/publicité pour promouvoir le programme de green coaching et recruter de nouveaux restaurants dans le "Réseau Vert".

- Reporting et Coordination : Travailler en étroite synergie avec les autres membres de l’équipe gaea21 pour la vérification croisée des livrables, et reporter directement au Coordinateur de projet SIB.

Nous vous offrons

Ce que vous recevez :

- Expertise en économie circulaire et audit de terrain (ACV, empreinte chromatique) appliquée à la restauration et à la santé publique (normes PNNS).

- Méthodologie de projet de transition : participation active au processus de transition des entreprises ("Greening Your Restaurant").

- Développement d'un réseau professionnel : accès aux acteurs du "Réseau Vert" et au "Répertoire Vert", vous permettant de vous connecter avec des entreprises et organisations engagées dans l'économie durable.

- Coaching et encadrement : Un suivi régulier via au minimum deux réunions hebdomadaires pour vous accompagner dans la réussite de vos objectifs.

- Impact concret, contribution active à la réduction de l'impact environnemental des entreprises (objectif de -2% minimum par an) et à l'amélioration de la qualité de vie au travail.

- Autonomie et télétravail : Une expérience significative en gestion de projet à distance, développant votre capacité d'auto-organisation et de reporting.

Votre profil pour avancer ensemble

Profil recherché :

- Formation : niveau Master, issu de cursus spécialisés dans les domaines de la nutrition/santé publique, de l'environnement/développement durable, ou du management de la restaura tion/agroalimentaire.

- Compétences techniques : Connaissance des enjeux de l’alimentation durable (gaspillage, circuits courts, analyse de cycle de vie). Maîtrise des concepts de santé liés à la nutrition (PNNS, qualité nutritionnelle). Capacité à analyser des données issues de grilles d'évaluation ou d'audits (Empreinte chromatique).

- Soft Skills (Savoir-être) : Esprit d'analyse développé, rigueur scientifique, autonomie, aisance relationnelle pour les enquêtes sur le terrain auprès des professionnels.

- Maîtrise des outils bureautiques, Workspace Google et Pack Office et d’outils de prospection (templates d'emails et prospection réseaux sociaux professionnels).

- Esprit créatif, excellentes qualités rédactionnelles et bonnes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse

- Esprit d'équipe et transversalité : Collaborer efficacement avec d’autres pôles (par exemple, l'équipe statistique pour la modélisation des données ou l'équipe RH).

- Bonne communication écrite et orale (français B2/C1 minimum)

Modalités du poste

Modalités du poste :

- Début : immédiat ou à convenir

- Durée : 3 mois min. à 6 mois (temps plein ou partiel)

- Format : télétravail

- Statut : stage ou mission bénévole dans le cadre d’un parcours de formation, de profession nalisation ou d’insertion/reconversion (poste non rémunéré)

- Réunions hebdomadaires : 2 minimum obligatoires

title: Collaborateur.trice de Stratégie Marketing B2B & Développement RSE
description:
Description des tâches

Votre rôle consiste à transformer les succès de nos phases pilotes en une stratégie de conquête pour engager des entreprises (PME, TPE, administrations).

Votre mission :

- Réaliser un mapping concurrentiel de l’accompagnement RSE en Suisse romande.

- Affiner la proposition de valeur de gaea21 en fonction des 10 dimensions clés du programme (Gouvernance, Eco-mobilité, ACV, Lean Management, etc.).

- Segmenter les cibles pour distinguer les entreprises "sensibles" des entreprises "réceptives à l'argument économique" (ROI, réduction des coûts, productivité).

- Concevoir le Pitch Deck stratégique pour convaincre les dirigeants de PME de l’intérêt d’un "Green Audit" ou du pack "Greening Your Business".

- Transformer les données techniques (réduction d'impact, calcul d'empreinte) en cas d'usage (Business Cases) et infographies percutantes.

- Développer des supports marketing pour valoriser l'intégration des futurs clients au Réseau Vert et au Répertoire Vert.

- Bâtir une stratégie d’extension vers de nouveaux secteurs (écoles, bureaux, restaurants).

- Concevoir des templates de prospection multicanaux (LinkedIn, emails, scripts) basés sur la psychologie du changement de comportement et la gamification.

Nous vous offrons

Ce que vous recevez :

- Expertise en Consulting RSE (formation pratique sur l’application des 10 dimensions du Green Coaching)

- Maîtrise d'outils innovants : logiciel d'audit environnemental GCBO, programme "Sustainability in a Box" (SIB) et les méthodologies de calcul d'empreinte.

- Développement d'un réseau professionnel : accès aux acteurs du "Réseau Vert" et au "Répertoire Vert", vous permettant de vous connecter avec des entreprises et organisations engagées dans l'économie durable.

- Coaching et encadrement : Un suivi régulier via au minimum deux réunions hebdomadaires pour vous accompagner dans la réussite de vos objectifs.

- Impact concret, contribution active à la réduction de l'impact environnemental des entreprises (objectif de -2% minimum par an) et à l'amélioration de la qualité de vie au travail.

- Autonomie et télétravail : Une expérience significative en gestion de projet à distance, développant votre capacité d'auto-organisation et de reporting.

Votre profil pour avancer ensemble

Profil recherché :

- Formation : Étudiant(e) en Master 2 (fin d’études) en Marketing, Stratégie Commerciale, Communication Responsable ou Management de la RSE.

- Compétences Techniques & Marketing (Analyse de positionnement et Datamining, Copywriting B2B - capable de parler le langage de la durabilité autant que celui de la performance économique)

- Connaissances du cadre RSE et Reporting Extra-financier (calcul d'empreinte et indicateurs de suivi d'impact environnemental GES, énergie, déchets).

- Maîtrise des dimensions de la Durabilité et de l’Économie Verte et Circulaire (gestion responsable des ressources pour assurer la pérennité des entreprises).

title: CFO (Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung)
description:
Das Universitäre Zentrum für Zahnmedizin Basel (UZB) vereint Patientenbehandlung, akademische Lehre und Forschung unter einem Dach. Mit rund 300 Mitarbeitenden, rund 100'000 Behandlungen pro Jahr und einem Umsatz von ca. CHF 40 Mio. erbringt das UZB seine Leistungen unter anderem auf Basis von Leistungsaufträgen mit der Universität Basel und dem Kanton Basel-Stadt. Wir suchen eine oder einen CFO mit überzeugenden betriebswirtschaftlichen und finanziellen Kenntnissen. Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung ist neben dem Finanzwissen auch unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln gefragt, um das Unternehmen gesamtheitlich zu steuern und weiterzuentwickeln.

Ihre Verantwortung

- Sie verantworten die finanzielle Führung des UZB – von der Budget-, Liquiditäts- und Finanzplanung über das Rechnungswesen und die Rechnungslegung nach Swiss GAAP FER bis hin zum Controlling – und stellen ein aussagekräftiges, stufengerechtes Reporting an unsere Leitungserbringer, die Geschäftsleitung und den Verwaltungsrat sicher.

- Sie sichern die Finanzierung und Liquidität, entwickeln das Risikomanagement und das interne Kontrollsystem weiter und sind Ansprechperson für den Prüfungsausschuss des Verwaltungsrats und die Revisionsstelle.

- Sie führen und entwickeln die Bereiche Finanzen (rund 10 Mitarbeitende), IT (3), Technischer Dienst (3) und Einkauf mit vier direkt unterstellten Führungspersonen und fördern die Zusammenarbeit über Fachgrenzen hinweg.

- Sie bringen die Digitalisierung und Weiterentwicklung von Abläufen und Systemen voran und entscheiden bei der laufenden Evaluation einer neuen ERP-Lösung massgeblich mit.

- Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung tragen Sie auch die gesamtunternehmerische Verantwortung mit und bringen sich in Fragen der Unternehmensentwicklung aktiv ein.

- Sie beraten die CEO und die Geschäftsleitung als Sparringpartner in allen betriebswirtschaftlichen Fragen und erarbeiten Business Cases für neue Angebote und Projekte.

- Sie schaffen Entscheidungsgrundlagen für den Dialog mit internen und externen Anspruchsgruppen in einem öffentlich-rechtlich geprägten Umfeld und pflegen den Kontakt zu den relevanten Stakeholdern.

Ihr beruflicher Hintergrund

- Sie verfügen über substanzielles Know-how in Finanzen und Controlling sowie über Erfahrung in einer verantwortlichen Finanzführungsfunktion.

- Sie haben einen (Fach-) Hochschulstudium in Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen oder sind Expertin bzw. Experte in Rechnungslegung und Controlling; Erfahrung mit Swiss GAAP FER und SAP ist von Vorteil.

- Sie haben Führungserfahrung, sind es gewohnt bei Entscheidungsprozessen mitzuwirken und anschliessend die Entscheidungen in ihrem Verantwortungsbereich konsequent umzusetzen. Sie kommunizieren differenziert und transparent, arbeiten pragmatisch und verbinden finanzielle Sorgfalt mit Offenheit für neue Lösungen.

- Sie verfügen über stilsichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Sie interessieren sich für Digitalisierung und einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit Daten und neuen Technologien.

- Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen oder in einer öffentlich-rechtlichen Organisation sind willkommen, doch keine Voraussetzung.

Was die Aufgabe auszeichnet

Das UZB ist eine dynamische Institution: 2016 gegründet und seit 2021 um rund 30 % gewachsen. Unsere Strukturen, Prozesse und Systeme lassen sich aktiv mitprägen. Sie verbinden eine finanzielle Schlüsselrolle mit der Möglichkeit, die Weiterentwicklung einer Unternehmung mit gesellschaftlichem Auftrag aus Geschäftsleitungsperspektive mitzugestalten. Die Position verlangt Nähe zum Tagesgeschäft ebenso wie einen verlässlichen Blick auf das Ganze.

title: Technology Marketing Manager
description:
About the role

We are looking for a Technology Marketing Manager to turn Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and long-term vision into compelling stories for engineers and executives.

This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, marketing, and go-to-market.

You will develop a deep understanding of Neural Concept’s technology and work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to create and continuously improve how our platform is explained to enterprise audiences.

Your work will directly shape how global enterprises perceive Neural Concept: not as a point solution, but as an intelligence layer that brings AI into engineering workflows, helping Global 2000 engineering leaders design better products faster.

This is a high-impact role with significant autonomy, offering the opportunity to take ownership of complex topics, shape Neural Concept’s technical and market narrative, and potentially grow into leading a product marketing team as the company scales.

What you will do

Technology & Product Narrative

- Develop a deep, hands-on understanding of Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and roadmap.

- Act as a primary internal reference for market-facing technology and product narratives.

- Turn complex technical concepts into clear explanations, examples, and value stories for engineering and executive audiences.

- Work closely with leadership and Product to ensure alignment between vision, roadmap, and market messaging.

Messaging & Positioning Framework

- Structure and maintain the core messaging framework in collaboration with leadership and Sales Enablement.

- Define how Neural Concept’s technology is positioned across personas, industries, and use cases.

- Ensure consistency and clarity across all market-facing materials (website, flagship assets, campaigns).

- Clearly articulate technical differentiation and competitive positioning in a factual, grounded way.

Content Strategy & Creation

- Own and produce technology- and product-driven content across flagship assets (hero blogs, whitepapers, product pages, decks).

- Translate ongoing technical innovation into concrete, high-quality content that can be used externally by customers, partners, and sales teams.

- Partner with the Design team to shape and produce high-quality product and technology content, including diagrams, visual explanations, demos and videos.

Go-to-Market Foundations (in collaboration)

- Produce use-case content, value stories, and messaging inputs that Sales Enablement and Marketing actively use in customer conversations and campaigns.

- Collaborate with Sales Enablement to ensure product and technology narratives are translated into clear, consistent sales messaging.

- Support entry into new industries or use cases by clarifying positioning and value stories, without owning sales strategy or execution.

Cross-functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Product, Applied Engineering, Sales Enablement, Marketing, and Leadership.

- Act as a bridge between technical teams and market-facing functions.

- Contribute to strategic discussions on positioning, category evolution, and long-term narrative.

Who you are

Experience & Skills

- 5+ years of experience in technology marketing, technical product marketing, or market-facing technical roles within B2B or deep-tech companies.

- You combine technical depth with a strong sense for marketing and storytelling, whether you built it in a marketing role or on the technical side.

- Demonstrated ability to deeply understand complex technology platforms and systems, and reason about how they create value in real-world engineering workflows.

- Engineering background (e.g., mechanical, aerospace, or computational engineering) or hands-on familiarity with CAD, CAE, or simulation tools is a strong plus.

- Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to translate technical capabilities, constraints, and trade-offs into clear market positioning.

- Proven ability to structure and maintain coherent messaging and positioning frameworks grounded in technical reality.

- Track record of producing substantial, high-quality marketing content for complex technical products.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt the message to very different audiences, from engineers and technical experts to executives, decision-makers, and non-technical stakeholders.

- Comfortable engaging in technical discussions and asking the right questions to build accurate, credible market narratives.

- Fluent in English, written and spoken.

Ways of working

- Able to drive complex topics from exploration to execution.

- Able to operate with a high degree of autonomy while staying closely aligned with leadership and peers.

- Execution-oriented, pragmatic, and hands-on.

- Open, direct, and collaborative in working across functions.

- Energized by a fast-paced, ever-changing environment. You adapt quickly, stay ahead of change, and are willing to challenge your own choices and iterate on them.

- Genuine passion for technology, engineering, innovation, and AI. You naturally follow what’s happening in the field, enjoy exploring how new technologies change the way products are designed, and have a strong appetite for learning and continuous improvement.

- Proactive and eager to step in beyond the core scope when projects call for it, contributing to product-related communications such as events, press releases, website updates, or newsletters.

What you get

- Work with a world-class technology team – our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence.

- Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.

- Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized.

- Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another.

- Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

- Balance life and work with a hybrid model and flexible hours—we care about results, not rigid schedules.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

- capacità di analizzare le esigenze del business e tradurle in requisiti funzionali e soluzioni tecniche sostenibili, scalabili e semplici da utilizzare

- esperienza nella gestione del ciclo di vita di un’applicazione, dall’analisi dei requisiti allo sviluppo, test, rilascio, manutenzione e supporto agli utenti
- familiarità con Microsoft Power Platform, Azure, Git, SQL, servizi cloud, API REST e strumenti di versionamento del codice
- esperienza, anche maturata attraverso progetti personali, formativi o professionali, nello sviluppo di soluzioni AI, chatbot, assistenti digitali, sistemi di automazione o applicazioni basate su modelli linguistici
- approccio pragmatico e orientato alla soluzione, curiosità verso le nuove tecnologie e capacità di operare contemporaneamente su attività di sviluppo, integrazione e supporto applicativo
- capacità di lavorare in team e di collaborare in modo trasversale con le diverse funzioni aziendali, comprendendone obiettivi, priorità e processi

Cerchiamo una persona curiosa, concreta e orientata all’innovazione, capace di coniugare competenze tecniche e comprensione delle esigenze del business.

title: MSF International Managing Director
description:
Location: Based in Geneva or within approximately +/- two (2) hours from Geneva

Contract: Fixed term at 100% - It is a mandated role (currently 3+3 years)

Starting date: 01st of March 2027

Deadline to apply: 26th of November 2026 - We reserve the right to close this position once suitable candidates have been identified.

Compensation and Benefits: MSF practice is to offer the compensation and benefits package in line with the MSF entity offering the contract

*By default, the successful candidate will be offered a contract in the MSF office, able to issue a contract, of their country of residence at the time of application. If no MSF office exists in their country of residence, the successful candidate will be expected to relocate to a country where an MSF office can issue a contract, provided the local legislation allows for that.

At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. The successful candidate will be expected to comply with the organisation’s safeguarding policies and standards of professional behaviour.

We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process.

MSF International

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 26 sections, 28 associations and 16 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested.

I. CONTEXT

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent medical humanitarian organisation providing emergency assistance to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters, based solely on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation.

MSF International is the legal entity whose membership is composed of all MSF associations. It hosts the International Secretariat, supports the International Board, facilitates coordination across the MSF movement, and provides shared services and initiatives as mandated by the movement.

Within MSF International, the International Office acts as the Secretariat of the International Board (IB) and operates under the direct management of the International Secretary General (ISG). MSF International also provides administrative and operational support to movement-wide initiatives and services, including MSF Access.

II. PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The MSF International Managing Director is a senior executive role responsible for institutional leadership, stewardship of resources, and organizational performance of MSF International as a legal entity serving the MSF movement.

The role ensures that MSF International:

- Effectively implements -within the scope of MSF International - the MSF International Multiyear Plan and SPARC (MSF-wide Strategic Planning, Accountability and Resource Cycle) and supports the International Board and the International Secretary General in their governance roles and responsibilities.

- Provides high quality, well governed services to the MSF movement, as mandated by the Full ExCom (executive committee);

- Operates with strong systems of governance, accountability, risk management and duty of care;

- Has robust, transparent and efficient governance, financial, human, and knowledge systems;

- Operates as a coherent, inclusive, and accountable internationally distributed organization;

- Models MSF values in leadership, equity, duty of care, and ethical management;

- Ensures that the decisions taken by the Board of Directors of MSF International and its implementation is compliant with the Articles of Association, the internal regulations, as well as Swiss standards and Swiss laws, for as long as the registered office is in Geneva, Switzerland.

The MSF Management Director acts as a strategic partner to the International Secretary General, providing leadership on transversal and institutional topics with regards to the management of MSF International.

III. ACCOUNTABILITIES

1. Strategic Leadership and Implementation of MSF International (Multi‑year Plan & SPARC): Lead the translation of MSF International and movement strategic priorities into clear objectives, organisational plans, policies and resourcing within MSF International; support cross‑functional initiatives required by international platforms as needed to deliver the Multi‑Year Strategic Plan and SPARC commitments.

Expected result: MSF International delivers on agreed strategic priorities and SPARC commitments through coherent plans, measurable milestones and coordinated delivery across functions and movement partners.

a. Contribute to the development of MSF International Multi‑year Strategic Plan and SPARC within MSF International’s mandate and scope and translate strategic priorities into concrete organisational objectives, policies, systems and resource allocations, ensuring coherence across functions and services.

b. Supports cross‑functional and transversal initiatives required to deliver common strategic priorities and SPARC‑related commitments.

c. Contribute to movement-wide discussions on harmonization, efficiency and shared services.

d. Sets up and tracks implementation plans, including key milestones, indicators, and risks. Support the ISG in reporting to the International Board and relevant Standing Committees, and contribute to SPARC’s Monitoring & Evaluation Framework and Expense Steering Process for functions and services managed within MSF International’s scope.

e. Deputize for the ISG as required, within agreed scope and representation mandates.

f. Represent MSF International to key stakeholders, partners and external audiences as required, and build relationships that protect and advance MSF's institutional interests.

2. Governance, legal compliance, accountability and risk management for MSF-International: Ensure robust governance implementation, statutory compliance and effective risk management systems for MSF International as a Swiss legal entity and for services delivered on behalf of the movement; prepare governance-level advice and support Board decision-making.

Expected result: International Board and executive decisions are supported by timely, compliant and risk‑informed advice; MSF International statutory obligations and legal requirements are met and organisational risks are identified and mitigated.

a. Act as senior management liaison to the ISG, the International Board and Standing Committees on matters related to MSF International organisational governance, resources, risk, compliance and organisational performance.

b. Ensure robust systems of internal control, risk management and accountability, are in place and functioning for MSF International, in line with legal, fiduciary and associative obligations, including preparedness for critical incidents directly affecting MSF International.

c. Lead or support organizational responses to critical incidents directly affecting MSF International, including HR, legal, reputational, safeguarding or security‑related situations.

d. Ensure that MSF International fulfils its statutory responsibilities as a Swiss legal entity and that appropriate legal, administrative and governance support is obtained for decisions of the IB in light of the International Statutes, the Internal Regulations, and Swiss standards and law. Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations regarding daily management of MSF International.

e. Oversee compliance with GDPR and Swiss data protection law, promoting a culture of privacy and responsible data use.

f. Ensure appropriate legal review of all contracts and agreements directly involving MSF International and including those through which it delivers services to the movement, in accordance with MSF’s rules and policies, as well as Swiss law.

g. Design, implement and monitor the effectiveness of internal control systems and procedures; ensure that MSF International risks are identified and registered and ensure that mitigation measures are discussed and incorporated in the respective departments annual plans.

3. Services to MSF: Provide executive stewardship of movement-wide services mandated to MSF International, ensuring clear service governance, defined accountabilities and cost‑effective delivery.

Expected result: Movement services operate to agreed service charters and KPIs, with transparent costs and reliable delivery that meet sections' needs and contractual obligations.

a. Provide executive leadership and stewardship over services mandated to MSF International in support of the MSF movement, ensuring they are clearly governed, fit for purpose, cost‑effective and appropriately funded.

b. Ensure that roles, responsibilities, decision‑making authority and service boundaries between MSF International and MSF sections are clearly defined and communicated, balancing interoperability and mutualization objectives with the sections and ODs autonomy.

c. Establish and monitor service governance and performance frameworks, including service charters, KPIs, cost‑sharing arrangements and escalation mechanisms where relevant, and ensure transparency.

d. Facilitate structured dialogue with MSF sections to identify service needs, manage expectations and address risks or performance issues.

4. Financial stewardship and institutional integrity: Oversee budgeting, financial planning, statutory accounts, audits and financial controls; ensure alignment of resources with strategic priorities and manage institutional financial and insurance arrangements.

Expected result: MSF International maintains sound financial health, regulatory compliance and transparent resource allocation that supports strategic objectives.

a. Provide executive oversight of budgeting, forecasting and financial reporting for MSF International.

b. Ensure alignment between strategic priorities (including SPARC) and resource allocation.

c. Oversee statutory accounts, audits, financial policies and compliance with Swiss GAAP, tax and VAT requirements.

d. Oversee relationships with external auditors, financial advisors and legal counsel.

e. Oversee institutional insurance coverage and financial risk mitigation. Manage the full suite of institutional and corporate insurance coverage for MSF International.

f. Oversee legacies and donations earmarked for MSF International

5. People, culture and organisational development: Oversee people strategy, workforce planning, performance management, leadership development and organisational design to foster an inclusive, safe and high‑performing culture across a distributed workforce.

Expected result: A diverse, supported and capable organisation with clear succession pathways, strong performance management and a positive organisational culture.

a. Provide strategic leadership over human resources management, organizational design and workforce planning.

b. Ensure a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct.

c. Oversee performance management, leadership development and succession planning.

d. Ensure a lively MSF International culture despite the geographical spread, including through adequate internal communication.

e. Lead organisational development, when necessary, to ensure the organisational structure remains fit for purpose and appropriate for a well-functioning office.

f. Manage institutional relationships with MSF sections hosting MSF International staff and ensure coherent frameworks for hosting, contracting, payroll and staff integration.

g. Ensure appropriate information governance and that knowledge management systems support collaboration, institutional memory and organizational learning, including learning from strategy and SPARC implementation.

h. Liaise regularly with the Staff Committee of MSF International.

IV. AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY

The MSF International Managing Director operates with a high degree of autonomy to think, interpret and act within the strategic direction set by the International Secretary General, the International Board and the governance framework of MSF International.

The role is required to make independent judgements on organisational priorities, resource allocation, risk mitigation, service performance, people matters and operational responses, often in situations where issues are sensitive, cross-functional and without straightforward precedent.

The complexity of the environment is significant: the postholder works across a federated MSF movement with multiple stakeholders, distributed teams, hosted staff arrangements and diverse section interests, while also ensuring compliance with Swiss legal and regulatory requirements, internal governance rules, financial and HR procedures, safeguarding standards and data protection obligations. Success therefore depends on balancing institutional coherence, legal and procedural rigour, and service effectiveness with diplomacy, sound judgement and the ability to operate in ambiguity.

V. SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE

The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others.

- Ensure respectful management and communication at all levels.

- Ensure that staff and consultants under their supervision understand their responsibilities with respect to required behaviour and report abuse while working for MSF by reinforcing and regularly discussing expected standards of behaviour.

- Welcome complainants, understand how to guide colleagues to appropriate channels, promote and create an environment that does not tolerate abuse or inappropriate behaviour. Guide colleagues to the correct process without investigating.

- Ensure that staff know how to complain and keep staff updated on reporting mechanisms.

Education

- Master’s degree in management, humanitarian affairs, political sciences, or a related field, or equivalent senior-level professional experience

Experience

- Extensive senior leadership experience (General/Executive Director, Deputy Director or Director of a major organizational function) in a complex and large international and decentralised organisations

- MSF experience is a major asset

- Proven ability to operate at Board and executive level

- Strong people leadership, including conflict management and change leadership

- Solid expertise in financial oversight, governance and organisational systems

- Experience with equity, diversity and inclusion strategies

Knowledge

- Strong commitment to MSF’s humanitarian principles and associative values.

- High level of integrity and ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters.

- Knowledge of Swiss legal, institutional, employment, financial and data protection frameworks is an asset.

- Familiarity with governance of associations and federated movements is an asset.

- Proven ability to lead cross-functional and institutional change.

- Comfortable leading teams across different locations and liaising with stakeholders at all levels.

- Excellent written and verbal communication, able to communicate complex or sensitive matters clearly, concisely, and professionally.

- High level of discretion, judgement, and emotional intelligence, and the ability to build a strong network across an organisation.

- Confident decision‑making and the ability to act autonomously as appropriate.

- Flexible team player, willing to adapt to changes, and confident tackling unfamiliar challenges across multiple domains of knowledge/experience.

Languages

- Excellent English (written and spoken) is essential.

- French highly desirable, and other MSF languages are further assets.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms their understanding and acceptance of these recruitment procedures.

Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested.

I. CONTEXT

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent medical humanitarian organisation providing emergency assistance to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters, based solely on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation.

MSF International is the legal entity whose membership is composed of all MSF associations. It hosts the International Secretariat, supports the International Board, facilitates coordination across the MSF movement, and provides shared services and initiatives as mandated by the movement.

Within MSF International, the International Office acts as the Secretariat of the International Board (IB) and operates under the direct management of the International Secretary General (ISG). MSF International also provides administrative and operational support to movement-wide initiatives and services, including MSF Access.

II. PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The MSF International Managing Director is a senior executive role responsible for institutional leadership, stewardship of resources, and organizational performance of MSF International as a legal entity serving the MSF movement.

The role ensures that MSF International:

  • Effectively implements -within the scope of MSF International - the MSF International Multiyear Plan and SPARC (MSF-wide Strategic Planning, Accountability and Resource Cycle) and supports the International Board and the International Secretary General in their governance roles and responsibilities.

  • Provides high quality, well governed services to the MSF movement, as mandated by the Full ExCom (executive committee);

  • Operates with strong systems of governance, accountability, risk management and duty of care;

  • Has robust, transparent and efficient governance, financial, human, and knowledge systems;

  • Operates as a coherent, inclusive, and accountable internationally distributed organization;

  • Models MSF values in leadership, equity, duty of care, and ethical management;

  • Ensures that the decisions taken by the Board of Directors of MSF International and its implementation is compliant with the Articles of Association, the internal regulations, as well as Swiss standards and Swiss laws, for as long as the registered office is in Geneva, Switzerland.

The MSF Management Director acts as a strategic partner to the International Secretary General, providing leadership on transversal and institutional topics with regards to the management of MSF International.

III. ACCOUNTABILITIES

1. Strategic Leadership and Implementation of MSF International (Multi‑year Plan & SPARC): Lead the translation of MSF International and movement strategic priorities into clear objectives, organisational plans, policies and resourcing within MSF International; support cross‑functional initiatives required by international platforms as needed to deliver the Multi‑Year Strategic Plan and SPARC commitments.

Expected result: MSF International delivers on agreed strategic priorities and SPARC commitments through coherent plans, measurable milestones and coordinated delivery across functions and movement partners.

a. Contribute to the development of MSF International Multi‑year Strategic Plan and SPARC within MSF International’s mandate and scope and translate strategic priorities into concrete organisational objectives, policies, systems and resource allocations, ensuring coherence across functions and services.

b. Supports cross‑functional and transversal initiatives required to deliver common strategic priorities and SPARC‑related commitments.

c. Contribute to movement-wide discussions on harmonization, efficiency and shared services.

d. Sets up and tracks implementation plans, including key milestones, indicators, and risks. Support the ISG in reporting to the International Board and relevant Standing Committees, and contribute to SPARC’s Monitoring & Evaluation Framework and Expense Steering Process for functions and services managed within MSF International’s scope.

e. Deputize for the ISG as required, within agreed scope and representation mandates.

f. Represent MSF International to key stakeholders, partners and external audiences as required, and build relationships that protect and advance MSF's institutional interests.

2. Governance, legal compliance, accountability and risk management for MSF-International: Ensure robust governance implementation, statutory compliance and effective risk management systems for MSF International as a Swiss legal entity and for services delivered on behalf of the movement; prepare governance-level advice and support Board decision-making.

Expected result: International Board and executive decisions are supported by timely, compliant and risk‑informed advice; MSF International statutory obligations and legal requirements are met and organisational risks are identified and mitigated.

a. Act as senior management liaison to the ISG, the International Board and Standing Committees on matters related to MSF International organisational governance, resources, risk, compliance and organisational performance.

b. Ensure robust systems of internal control, risk management and accountability, are in place and functioning for MSF International, in line with legal, fiduciary and associative obligations, including preparedness for critical incidents directly affecting MSF International.

c. Lead or support organizational responses to critical incidents directly affecting MSF International, including HR, legal, reputational, safeguarding or security‑related situations.

d. Ensure that MSF International fulfils its statutory responsibilities as a Swiss legal entity and that appropriate legal, administrative and governance support is obtained for decisions of the IB in light of the International Statutes, the Internal Regulations, and Swiss standards and law. Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations regarding daily management of MSF International.

e. Oversee compliance with GDPR and Swiss data protection law, promoting a culture of privacy and responsible data use.

f. Ensure appropriate legal review of all contracts and agreements directly involving MSF International and including those through which it delivers services to the movement, in accordance with MSF’s rules and policies, as well as Swiss law.

g. Design, implement and monitor the effectiveness of internal control systems and procedures; ensure that MSF International risks are identified and registered and ensure that mitigation measures are discussed and incorporated in the respective departments annual plans.

3. Services to MSF: Provide executive stewardship of movement-wide services mandated to MSF International, ensuring clear service governance, defined accountabilities and cost‑effective delivery.

Expected result: Movement services operate to agreed service charters and KPIs, with transparent costs and reliable delivery that meet sections' needs and contractual obligations.

a. Provide executive leadership and stewardship over services mandated to MSF International in support of the MSF movement, ensuring they are clearly governed, fit for purpose, cost‑effective and appropriately funded.

b. Ensure that roles, responsibilities, decision‑making authority and service boundaries between MSF International and MSF sections are clearly defined and communicated, balancing interoperability and mutualization objectives with the sections and ODs autonomy.

c. Establish and monitor service governance and performance frameworks, including service charters, KPIs, cost‑sharing arrangements and escalation mechanisms where relevant, and ensure transparency.

d. Facilitate structured dialogue with MSF sections to identify service needs, manage expectations and address risks or performance issues.

4. Financial stewardship and institutional integrity: Oversee budgeting, financial planning, statutory accounts, audits and financial controls; ensure alignment of resources with strategic priorities and manage institutional financial and insurance arrangements.

Expected result: MSF International maintains sound financial health, regulatory compliance and transparent resource allocation that supports strategic objectives.

a. Provide executive oversight of budgeting, forecasting and financial reporting for MSF International.

b. Ensure alignment between strategic priorities (including SPARC) and resource allocation.

c. Oversee statutory accounts, audits, financial policies and compliance with Swiss GAAP, tax and VAT requirements.

d. Oversee relationships with external auditors, financial advisors and legal counsel.

e. Oversee institutional insurance coverage and financial risk mitigation. Manage the full suite of institutional and corporate insurance coverage for MSF International.

f. Oversee legacies and donations earmarked for MSF International

5. People, culture and organisational development: Oversee people strategy, workforce planning, performance management, leadership development and organisational design to foster an inclusive, safe and high‑performing culture across a distributed workforce.

Expected result: A diverse, supported and capable organisation with clear succession pathways, strong performance management and a positive organisational culture.

a. Provide strategic leadership over human resources management, organizational design and workforce planning.

b. Ensure a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct.

c. Oversee performance management, leadership development and succession planning.

d. Ensure a lively MSF International culture despite the geographical spread, including through adequate internal communication.

e. Lead organisational development, when necessary, to ensure the organisational structure remains fit for purpose and appropriate for a well-functioning office.

f. Manage institutional relationships with MSF sections hosting MSF International staff and ensure coherent frameworks for hosting, contracting, payroll and staff integration.

g. Ensure appropriate information governance and that knowledge management systems support collaboration, institutional memory and organizational learning, including learning from strategy and SPARC implementation.

h. Liaise regularly with the Staff Committee of MSF International.

IV. AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY

The MSF International Managing Director operates with a high degree of autonomy to think, interpret and act within the strategic direction set by the International Secretary General, the International Board and the governance framework of MSF International.

The role is required to make independent judgements on organisational priorities, resource allocation, risk mitigation, service performance, people matters and operational responses, often in situations where issues are sensitive, cross-functional and without straightforward precedent.

The complexity of the environment is significant: the postholder works across a federated MSF movement with multiple stakeholders, distributed teams, hosted staff arrangements and diverse section interests, while also ensuring compliance with Swiss legal and regulatory requirements, internal governance rules, financial and HR procedures, safeguarding standards and data protection obligations. Success therefore depends on balancing institutional coherence, legal and procedural rigour, and service effectiveness with diplomacy, sound judgement and the ability to operate in ambiguity.

V. SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE

The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others.

  • Ensure respectful management and communication at all levels.

  • Ensure that staff and consultants under their supervision understand their responsibilities with respect to required behaviour and report abuse while working for MSF by reinforcing and regularly discussing expected standards of behaviour.

  • Welcome complainants, understand how to guide colleagues to appropriate channels, promote and create an environment that does not tolerate abuse or inappropriate behaviour. Guide colleagues to the correct process without investigating.

  • Ensure that staff know how to complain and keep staff updated on reporting mechanisms.


Education

  • Master’s degree in management, humanitarian affairs, political sciences, or a related field, or equivalent senior-level professional experience

Experience

  • Extensive senior leadership experience (General/Executive Director, Deputy Director or Director of a major organizational function) in a complex and large international and decentralised organisations

  • MSF experience is a major asset

  • Proven ability to operate at Board and executive level

  • Strong people leadership, including conflict management and change leadership

  • Solid expertise in financial oversight, governance and organisational systems

  • Experience with equity, diversity and inclusion strategies

Knowledge

  • Strong commitment to MSF’s humanitarian principles and associative values.

  • High level of integrity and ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters.

  • Knowledge of Swiss legal, institutional, employment, financial and data protection frameworks is an asset.

  • Familiarity with governance of associations and federated movements is an asset.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional and institutional change.

  • Comfortable leading teams across different locations and liaising with stakeholders at all levels.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, able to communicate complex or sensitive matters clearly, concisely, and professionally.

  • High level of discretion, judgement, and emotional intelligence, and the ability to build a strong network across an organisation.

  • Confident decision‑making and the ability to act autonomously as appropriate.

  • Flexible team player, willing to adapt to changes, and confident tackling unfamiliar challenges across multiple domains of knowledge/experience.

Languages

  • Excellent English (written and spoken) is essential.

  • French highly desirable, and other MSF languages are further assets.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Mechanical Engineer, Jigs & Tools
description:
About the Role

The Destinus engineering team is looking for a highly motivated and hands-on mechanical engineer capable of delivering jigs and tooling solutions as part of the research and development in the rocket motor department. In this role, you will design and develop equipment and machines for testing and production of our products. The ideal candidate will have at least 3 years of experience as a mechanical engineer with experience in industrialization projects, mechanical design and DFM with a demonstrated ability to take ownership during development and drive technical solutions.

Responsibilities

- Take the technical lead for the Jigs and Tools development
- Review product designs from a production point of view
- Understand and evaluate the production steps and the needed tools
- Research existing off-the-shelf components and combine them to a production solution
- Generate 3D CAD models, drawings, bills of material, and other related documentation required for production.
- Deliver technical documentation including any engineering calculations, analysis and assumptions required to substantiate your design decisions and solutions.
- Manage suppliers and manufacturers by addressing any technical questions and resolving any issues which may arise during the manufacturing process.
- Select standard parts, fasteners, equipment, and consumables following best practices and industry standards.
- Coach junior engineers and interns in jigs and tooling design, manufacturing and CAD.
- Participate in design reviews and technical discussions during different development stages.
- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including mechanical, testing, and industrialization engineers, to ensure seamless integration and functionality of the components into the vehicle.

Requirements

Qualifications and Experience

- BSc. In Mechanical Engineering, Design Engineering or a related discipline.
- Ideally, technical training as a mechanical designer/drafter, Toolmaker or Mechanic
- Min. 3 years of experience in mechanical engineering with close ties to jigs & tools for production
- Knowledge of machining, sheet metal, composites and assembly processes, and of metrology and inspection methods.
- Lean manufacturing knowledge is desirable.
- Experience with 3D printing for tooling is a plus.
- Experience with design of automated solutions, special machines or test benches is a benefit
- Ideally, experience in several different phases: design, build, integration, test, and operation.
- Good communication skills, proactive attitude, and problem-solving skills.
- The ability to work to strict timescales as part of an integrated, multidisciplinary team and autonomously.
- The ability and willingness to thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly changing work environment.
- Willingness to travel to different Destinus sites in Switzerland (max. 20%)
- Fluency in English and German language is required.

title: Mechanical Engineer, Automation Projects
description:
About the Role

The Destinus engineering team is looking for a highly motivated and hands-on mechanical engineer capable of delivering engineering solutions as part of the research and development in the rocket motor department. In this role you will design and develop automated solutions for production. The ideal candidate will have at least 3 years of experience as a mechanical engineer with experience in automation projects, mechanical design and DFM with a demonstrated ability to take ownership during development and drive technical solutions.

Responsibilities

- Take the technical lead for the automation and special machines development
- Review product designs from a production point of view
- Understand and evaluate the production steps and automation possibilities
- Research existing off-the-shelf components and combine them to an automation solution
- Design and prototype special machines and automation solutions that replace manual production processes and plan their manufacturing.
- Create 3D CAD models, drawings, BOMs, and the documentation needed for manufacturing, integration, and testing.
- Document your design decisions with clear calculations, analyses, and assumptions.
- Work with suppliers and manufacturers to answer technical questions and resolve issues during production.
- Select standard parts, fasteners, equipment, and consumables according to best practices and industry standards.
- Commission finished machines and hand them over to our production team.
- Coach junior engineers and interns in mechanical design, manufacturing, and CAD.
- Take part in design reviews and technical discussions throughout development.
- Work closely with mechanical, automation and testing engineers to ensure the machines integrate and function reliably.

Requirements

Qualifications and Experience

- BSc in Mechanical Engineering, Design Engineering, or a related field.
- Technical training as a mechanical designer or drafter (preferred).
- At least 3 years of mechanical engineering experience with close ties to automation.
- Experience designing automated solutions, special machines, or test benches (an advantage).
- Experience across several project phases: design, build, integration, test, and operation (preferred).
- Strong communication skills, a proactive attitude, and a problem-solving mindset.
- Ability to meet tight deadlines, both independently and within a multidisciplinary team.
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, fast-changing environment.
- Willingness to travel to Destinus sites in Switzerland (up to 20%).
- Fluent English and German.

raw.description:
Wat ga je doen?

Als Social Media & Content Marketing Stagiair(e) bij Flagship Events ben je bezig met het bedenken en maken van creatieve content voor onze verschillende socialmediakanalen. Je laat zien wat Flagship Amsterdam allemaal te bieden heeft: van onze rondvaarten en evenementen tot onze verschillende activiteiten en ervaringen in de stad. Je houdt je vooral bezig met Instagram en TikTok en weet als geen ander wat er speelt op social media. Je bedenkt nieuwe concepten, gaat zelf op pad om video's te filmen en monteert deze tot aantrekkelijke content. Zo help je Flagship Events om op een creatieve en herkenbare manier zichtbaar te blijven bij verschillende doelgroepen.

Wat ga je leren?

  • Creatieve content bedenken en maken voor Instagram en TikTok;

  • Video's filmen, monteren en voorbereiden voor publicatie;

  • Een contentkalender opstellen en bijhouden;

  • Inspelen op actuele socialmediatrends en deze vertalen naar passende content;

  • Content maken rondom onze rondvaarten, evenementen en andere activiteiten;

  • Reviews en user-generated content verzamelen en verwerken;

  • De interactie met volgers onderhouden en reacties beantwoorden;

  • Meedenken over de online uitstraling en zichtbaarheid van Flagship Events;

  • Content voorbereiden en ter goedkeuring voorleggen voordat deze wordt gepubliceerd.

Praktisch

  • Startdatum: Vanaf februari 2027, of eerder in overleg;

  • Duur: 5 maanden;

  • Type stage: meewerkstage;

  • Stagevergoeding: € 350 per maand;

  • Locatie: kantoor in hartje Amsterdam en op verschillende evenementenlocaties.

Wat we aanbieden

  • Een creatieve meewerkstage waarin je veel ruimte krijgt voor eigen ideeën;

  • De mogelijkheid om zelf contentconcepten te bedenken, filmen en monteren;

  • De kans om jouw werk daadwerkelijk terug te zien op onze socialmediakanalen;

  • Veel ruimte om je kennis van contentmarketing en social media verder te ontwikkelen;

  • Een kijkje achter de schermen bij verschillende merken, activiteiten en evenementen binnen Flagship;

  • Legendarische vrijdagmiddagborrels, sportieve uitjes en bedrijfsfeesten;

  • Een heerlijke verzorgde lunch op kantoor;

  • 25% personeelskorting op rondvaarten en andere activiteiten binnen Flagship Holding.

Functievereisten

  • Een opleiding in de richting van Creative Business, Communicatie of CMD;

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met TikTok en Instagram, bijvoorbeeld via eigen kanalen;

  • Je kunt zelfstandig video's filmen en monteren;

  • Je hebt gevoel voor trends en weet wat werkt bij verschillende doelgroepen;

  • Een goede beheersing van het Engels;

  • Je bent creatief, zelfstandig en neemt graag initiatief;

  • Je gaat verantwoordelijk om met content en de uitstraling van een merk;

  • Ervaring met fotografie, copywriting of betaalde social media advertenties is een plus.


Over Flagship Amsterdam

Flagship Amsterdam is een snelgroeiende rederij in het hart van Amsterdam. Wat in 2017 begon met drie boten, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een vloot van meer dan 70 boten, en we groeien nog steeds elke dag verder! Jaarlijks verwelkomen we gasten uit meer dan 55 verschillende landen, en we varen het hele jaar door. Dit doen we met een gedreven en ambitieus team van meer dan 800 (seizoensgebonden) medewerkers.

Maar Flagship is meer dan alleen rondvaarten. Vanuit dezelfde energie bouwen we aan verschillende concepten die allemaal draaien om beleving, gastvrijheid en de stad Amsterdam. Zo ontdek je de stad op de fiets met Flagship Bike Tours, proef je de sfeer bij Flagship Waffle Experience Amsterdam, en werken we bij Shipyard aan creatieve projecten op en rond het water. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep. Samen vormen ze één organisatie, maar met verschillende manieren om mensen de stad te laten ervaren.

Je helpt bijvoorbeeld met de administratie rondom zakelijke reizen, het verwerken en controleren van reisgegevens en, waar mogelijk, het boeken van hotels en vluchten. title: Senior Manager Account Management
description:
About the Role

Account Management is where DataSnipper grows. Our EMEA Accounting AM team manages a book worth tens of millions in ARR across the region's leading audit and accounting firms, and we believe that book can double. The growth won't come from renewals that run themselves. It will come from moving customers onto our AI and Agents platform, defending against cheaper point solutions and free AI tools, and handling firms that keep acquiring each other.

As Senior Manager, Account Management – EMEA, you'll lead a team of 5 Account Managers, report to our EMEA Sales leader, and own retention, expansion and forecast accuracy for the region. This is a player-coach role in spirit. You'll be in the deals and in front of senior partners and executives, not managing from a dashboard.

Why DataSnipper

The best commercial opportunities don't come around every day. Selling technology that's transforming an entire industry is one of them.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers.

Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

For our commercial teams, this is where things get exciting.

Alwin has just launched, demand is growing, and we're expanding into new markets and segments. With a product customers already rely on, there's a huge opportunity to make your mark.

If you're commercially driven, ambitious, and excited to build something bigger, this is you chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and accelerate your own career along the way.

What You Will Do

Lead and Build the Team

- Lead, coach and develop a team of 5 AMs, with hands-on deal coaching on renewal strategy, negotiation and executive engagement

- Raise the talent bar: make the calls on the existing team and hire native speakers for under-covered markets (Dutch, German, French, Spanish)

- Rebalance books as account loads move from 200 per rep toward 110, so every AM has room to go deep

Own the Number

- Own gross and net revenue retention, expansion and multi-year commitments across the EMEA Accounting book

- Bring a strategic lens to renewals: move customers up-market on packaging and from legacy products onto our AI platform

- Lead high-stakes negotiations with senior partners and executives at Europe's leading accounting firms, including network and multi-entity agreements, price increases, multi-year commitments and competitive displacement threats

- Build and present business cases that tie DataSnipper to the outcomes partners care about: audit quality, capacity, margin and talent retention. Business conversations, not feature walkthroughs

Build Forecast Discipline
