title: IT-Support-Spezialist (m/w/d)
description:
Dein Einstieg bei Deeken Technology

Du hilfst gern, behältst auch bei kniffligen Problemen die Ruhe und erklärst Technik so, dass sie jeder versteht? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Deeken Technology ist ein etabliertes IT-Systemhaus aus dem Oldenburger Münsterland - seit über 10 Jahren am Markt, mit einem motivierten und engagierten Team. Wir betreuen mittelständische Unternehmen ganzheitlich: IT-Infrastruktur, IT-Sicherheit, Digitalisierung und Telekommunikation. Dabei verkaufen wir keine Einmal-Lösungen, sondern sind langfristiger IT-Partner unserer Kunden - wir kennen ihre Systeme, ihre Abläufe und ihre Ansprechpartner.

Für unser Team in unseren neuen Büros im ecopark Emstek suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Systemadministrator (m/w/d) als Support-Spezialist - unbefristet, in Vollzeit mit 39 Stunden und hybrid.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Support-Spezialist bist du die freundliche und kompetente Stimme von Deeken Technology für alle Anwender unserer Kunden. Du kümmerst dich um sämtliche IT-Support-Anliegen - und sorgst dafür, dass niemand mit seinem Problem allein bleibt.

- Du bist im First- und Second-Level-Support die erste Anlaufstelle: Du nimmst Anfragen telefonisch entgegen und löst sie nach Möglichkeit direkt im ersten Gespräch.

- Du bearbeitest schriftliche Anfragen per E-Mail über unsere Service-Plattform Hindeo.

- Du analysierst Probleme gemeinsam mit den Anwendern per Fernwartung und findest Lösungen.

- Bei Bedarf besprichst du Supportthemen in kurzen Teams-Meetings direkt mit unseren Kunden.

- Du gibst Anwendern Tipps, wie sie ihre Systeme besser und sicherer nutzen.

- Du stellst die Erreichbarkeit unseres Supports sicher, dokumentierst sauber in Hindeo und gibst komplexe Themen strukturiert an unsere Spezialisten weiter.

- Erkennst du beim Kunden Bedarf, übergibst du die Vertriebschance an unsere Kollegen im IT-Vertrieb.

Das bringst du mit

Verlässlichkeit ist uns extrem wichtig: Wenn du etwas zusagst, hältst du es ein. Dazu kommunizierst du klar und freundlich - am Telefon genauso wie schriftlich - und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Anliegen unserer Kunden.

- Eine abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung, z. B. als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

- Erfahrung im IT-Support oder Service Desk, idealerweise in einem Systemhaus

- Ein gutes Grundverständnis in einem möglichst breiten Spektrum: Microsoft 365, Nextcloud, Terminalserver, Drucker, Smartphones, Tablets und Thin Clients

- Sicherer Umgang mit Fernwartungs-Tools und Ticketsystemen

- Freude am Kontakt mit Menschen, Geduld und eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise - auch wenn es mal hektisch wird, behältst du den Überblick

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt zu 100 Prozent, aber passt menschlich und fachlich im Kern? Dann bewirb dich trotzdem - wir sprechen lieber einmal mehr miteinander.

Warum Deeken Technology

- Dein eigener Firmenwagen: Nach der Probezeit stellen wir dir einen Firmenwagen zur Verfügung.

- Dein Fitnessstudio-Abo: Für deinen Ausgleich zum Job bekommst du von uns ein Fitnessabo.

- Dein perfekter Support-Arbeitsplatz: Cloud-Telefonie-Arbeitsplatz, mehrere Monitore, Firmenlaptop, Firmenhandy und modernste Ausstattung - alles, was du für einen reibungslosen Support brauchst.

- Software, die wir selbst bauen: Wir arbeiten mit Hindeo, unserer eigenen IT-Service-Plattform. In den letzten zwölf Monaten komplett neu entwickelt, gehört sie zu den modernsten Lösungen für Systemhäuser - und dein Feedback aus dem Support fließt direkt in die Weiterentwicklung ein.

- Sicherheit mit Anspruch: Als eines der wenigen IT-Unternehmen der Region sind wir nach ISO 27001 zertifiziert. Du arbeitest nach Standards, auf die du stolz sein kannst.

- Deine Perspektive: Im Support lernst du die gesamte IT-Landschaft unserer Kunden kennen. Mit Weiterbildungen und Herstellerschulungen kannst du dich bei uns gezielt weiterentwickeln - bis hin zum Spezialisten in einem unserer Fachbereiche.

- Neues Büro im ecopark: Knapp 500 m² im OM-Medienhaus - hell, klimatisiert, mit kontrollierter Belüftung, barrierefrei und mit Mensa im Haus. Getränke, Snacks und ein frischer Obstkorb stehen für dich bereit.

- Ankommen ohne Stress: Kostenlose Parkplätze direkt am Haus. Für Elektrofahrzeuge stehen E-Ladesäulen bereit.

- Hybrid & flexibel: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Home-Office-Ausstattung und nach der Einarbeitung ein Tag mobiles Arbeiten pro Woche.

- Extras: Edenred und Mitarbeiterrabatte.

- Familie & Beruf: Über die Kita-Kooperation im ecopark stehen in einem benachbarten Kindergarten reservierte Plätze für Kinder von Beschäftigten im ecopark zur Verfügung.

- Sicherheit & Miteinander: Unbefristeter Vertrag, 28 Urlaubstage, flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege, lockerer Dresscode sowie gemeinsame Teamevents - vom Stoppelmarkt über das Cityfest bis zur Weihnachtsfeier.

Deine ersten Monate

- Ankommen: Du lernst dein Team, unsere Prozesse, Hindeo und unsere ISO-27001-Standards kennen und bearbeitest deine ersten Supportfälle an der Seite erfahrener Kollegen.

- Loslegen: Schritt für Schritt übernimmst du eigene Anfragen am Telefon und per E-Mail und lernst die Umgebungen unserer Kunden kennen.

- Verantwortung übernehmen: Nach der Einarbeitung bist du für die Anwender unserer Kunden die erste Anlaufstelle - und sorgst dafür, dass ihre Anliegen zuverlässig gelöst werden.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann bewirb dich über den Button - ein Lebenslauf reicht für den Anfang. Versprochen: Innerhalb von 3 Werktagen bekommst du eine persönliche Rückmeldung von uns. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

title: Senior Sales Engineer
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact
As a highly personable, technically curious and enthusiastic Axon Sales Engineer, you consistently strive to be the trusted customer advisor for the value and technical aspects of Axon’s globally leading solutions. You will use your experience with Software as a Service (SaaS), on-premise software, networking, installation, configuration plus excellence in supporting highly impactful PoC’s to support us in our mission to Protect Life and Accelerate Justice. As a member of the Axon EMEA Sales Engineering Team the Sales Engineer supports the sales campaign to communicate the value of and deploy and support evidence capture devices, digital evidence management solutions SaaS and on-premise solutions to Public Safety Agencies across Southern Europe region. The Sales Engineer is a quota carrying, customer-facing front line role that facilitates and influences product enhancements and the deployment of Axon Enterprise’s products and solutions.

Location: Germany - Remote with 70% travel in DACH region
Reports to: Sr Manager, Sales Engineering EU
Direct Reports: 0

  • Support the technical and value aspects of the sales effort across territory which will include: impactful and compelling technical presentations, architecture design discussions, competitive displacement, proof-of-concept engagements, leading RFP/RFI responses, solution demonstrations and technical workshops with customers and partners
  • Support the smooth transition of the sales opportunity into successful delivery by our Professional Services and/or Partner network.
  • Consistently research, network and ideate to become the regional “go to” resource for future solution opportunities, product roadmap development and thought leadership
  • Present and evangelise Axon technical & business value propositions at industry events
  • Develop in-depth technical knowledge of AXON and domain expertise within technology subject area
  • Document customer feature requests and issues, providing feedback to sales and product management
  • Provide support to product Test and Evaluations
  • Execute customer site assessments targeting technology infrastructure assessments
  • Transfer industry, technical and product knowledge to customers and colleagues
  • Proactively plan to prevent pre and post sales issues to shorten time to revenue

What You Bring

  • A natural and enthusiastic aptitude for technology plus the ability to communicate its value using compiling and contextualised stories to anyone from any background
  • Confidence to own and professionally drive customers to successful outcomes with Axon solutions.
  • A “self starter” - ability to identify what tasks need your ownership and when you should collaborate.
  • Bachelor's Degree (preferably in Computer Science or Engineering fields) or equivalent experience
  • Willing to travel significantly (70%), some travel internationally
  • Must have a valid Passport and Clean Driving License
  • 8+ years experience as a Sales Engineer, Systems Engineer, Network Engineer or similar related field
  • Knowledge and demonstrated operating experience in one or more of the following areas of specialisations: Digital Video, Mobile communications, IP Engineering, IP security, Embedded Systems, IAM, SAAS
  • Strong understanding of CCTV systems, VMS, network technologies and IP stack (for example Genetec, Milestone, Avigilon, Ocularis, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANS, firewalls, VPN gateways, proxies, etc.)
  • High degree of technical knowledge in computing infrastructure components, data centers, and system support
  • Experience in data integration and data analysis to support expanding product portfolio
  • Experience and understanding of large-scale infrastructure-as-a-service platforms (e.g. Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure, OpenStack)
  • Demonstrable experience of strong project management for successful PoC’s
  • Fluent Native German and excellent English language skills essential
  • Evidence of effectively adding value as a Global team member
  • Evidence of working effectively remotely and independently
  • Knowledge and experience implementing and managing relational database solutions, in-particular Microsoft/Azure SQL, an advantage
  • Practical knowledge of SAN technologies (EMC, HP 3Par, etc.) an advantage

Benefits that Benefit You

  • Competitive salary package
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Private healthcare allowance
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Fun and engaging team events

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.

 

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at Axon Privacy Web Form. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.

title: Key Account Executive
description:
About Sine Engineering

Sine Engineering builds the technology behind reliable drone autonomy, delivering communication, navigation, and control systems that enable coordinated multi-drone operations. More than 200 UAV manufacturers rely on our solutions, and our technology powers many of the interceptor operations active today.

Through our dual-use platform, we support civilian innovation while helping democratic nations strengthen their technological advantage.

Any drone. Any scale. Anywhere. Resilient communication, navigation, and coordination built for the age of autonomy. Our products have already proven their effectiveness in real combat conditions in Ukraine.

Responsibilities

- Build and expand Sine Engineering's customer and partner network across Germany.

- Identify, engage, and develop strategic accounts across the defense, aerospace, UAV manufacturing, systems integration, robotics, electronics, telecommunications, RF, autonomy, and other related technology sectors.

- Own the full sales cycle, including market mapping, prospecting, qualification, discovery, technical evaluation, proposal development, negotiation, closing, and long-term account growth.

- Develop relationships with OEMs, system integrators, defense primes, technology partners, and relevant government-affiliated stakeholders.

- Build direct relationships with senior executives and C-level decision-makers while developing strong engagement across engineering, program management, and procurement functions.

- Position Sine Engineering effectively before formal procurement and tender processes begin.

- Lead customer discussions related to communication modules, GNSS-denied navigation systems, video links, embedded autonomy software, and integration opportunities.

- Coordinate technical evaluations, pilot projects, demonstrations, and integration discussions in collaboration with product and engineering teams.

- Prepare commercial proposals, pricing structures, contract documentation, and partnership models.

- Lead commercial negotiations, including pricing, volume commitments, long-term agreements, and commercial frameworks.

- Maintain high standards of CRM management, pipeline tracking, revenue forecasting, and account planning in line with European business operations.

- Provide market intelligence regarding German defense procurement, competitors, customer requirements, funding priorities, and partnership opportunities.

- Represent Sine Engineering at industry events, trade shows, conferences, and customer meetings across Germany and Europe.

- Help establish scalable and repeatable sales processes for the German market and contribute to future team growth.

- Work closely with the Managing Director Germany to ensure commercial account ownership and local market representation remain aligned and complementary.

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in B2B sales, business development, strategic account management, or partnerships within a complex technical environment. Experience in the defense, aerospace, UAV, robotics, telecommunications, RF, or deep-tech sectors.

- Proven track record of managing full-cycle sales processes with enterprise, industrial, defense, aerospace, or technology customers.

- Strong understanding of long sales cycles, multi-stakeholder procurement processes, and complex commercial negotiations.

- Ability to understand technical products and translate customer needs into clear business and technical requirements.

- Experience collaborating closely with engineering, product, operations, legal, and executive leadership teams.

- Excellent commercial judgment, negotiation skills, and executive-level communication abilities.

- Ability to work independently, proactively creating opportunities rather than relying primarily on inbound leads.

- Strong sense of ownership and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, scale-up environment.

- Ability to work effectively in a matrix organization, collaborating with both a functional sales manager and a local managing director.

- Based in Munich or willing to travel there regularly.

- Willingness to travel frequently across Germany, Ukraine, and Europe.

Nice to Have

- Experience building a market presence, territory, or sales function from an early stage.

- Experience working with international teams, particularly across Germany and Eastern Europe.

title: Technical Account Manager - Senior Care (m/f/d)
description:
🎤 Why voize? Because we’re more than just a job!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

💡 Your Mission: Be the technical partner our largest care groups trust

As Technical Account Manager - Senior Care, you will own the technical relationship with 10 to 15 of our largest care groups. You will understand their systems, configurations, and stakeholders, and support them from go-live through releases and renewals; ensuring voize runs reliably across every facility. Your success will be measured by trust, retention, and long-term customer outcomes.

🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike

- Own the technical relationship with a portfolio of 12 to 15 care groups, building a deep understanding of their EHR setup, infrastructure, open topics, and key stakeholders

- Maintain a technical account plan for every customer, covering their integration landscape, planned changes, open risks, and requirements for upcoming rollout waves

- Lead release pre-briefings and technical reviews, helping customers understand the impact before changes affect their operations

- Stay close to every issue across your accounts: Technical Support manages the queue, while you manage the relationship and provide the account context needed to accelerate resolution

- Identify recurring themes across customers and turn them into actionable feedback for Product and Engineering

🤝 Your Skillset - What you bring to the table

- Several years of experience in technical account management, solutions engineering, technical support, or implementation, ideally in B2B SaaS or health tech

- Hands-on technical knowledge of integrations, APIs, logs, networks, and device or MDM setups, with the ability to isolate issues across interconnected systems

- Great communication skills across technical and executive audiences, from discussing an interface with an IT lead to aligning on a rollout with senior management

- A structured, calm approach to managing multiple customers and open topics simultaneously, supported by data that demonstrates progress and impact

- Professional German and comfortable English, based in Germany, and willingness to occasionally travel to customer sites when a rollout or escalation requires on-site support; experience with care documentation systems such is a plus

🌱 Growing together - what you can expect at voize

- We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving frontline workers more time for people

- We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely across Germany

- Become a co-creator of our success with stock options

- Generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible

- You decide when you work best, that means flexible working hours and a good hybrid set-up.

✨ Ready to talk? Apply now! 🚀

title: AIT MGSE Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

We want you as a talented AIT MGSE Engineer to help us in our mission by designing and delivering the MGSEs needed for the preparation of our next capsule.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as MAIT MGSE Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day duties will include:

- Work closely with Engineering and AIT colleagues to understand and refine the requirements/timelines for the different MGSEs that we will need for various assembly or testing activities.

- Conceptualise, design (CAD including manufacturing drawings), procure and commission the MGSEs.

- Confirm with mechanical analysis/hand calculations/proof tests that the design is compatible with the external loads.

- Discuss with suppliers the MGSE designs for ease of manufacturing and with the most adequate processes.

- Follow up the manufacturing/procurement with the suppliers (with the support of our supply chain team) and answer any technical questions/concerns ensuring timely delivery of all items.

- Provide necessary instructions and support the assembly/commissioning/ implementation of these MGSEs.

What we would love to see from you

In the role of MAIT MGSE Engineer ideally, you will have the following:

- Mechanical / Aerospace engineering degree or similar with focus on machine / structural design.

- Minimum 2 years of experience in CAD design + drafting (using Siemens NX or similar) and FE analysis (using Hypermesh or similar).

- Good understanding of machine design and different manufacturing processes (e.g. machining, welding, etc), design for manufacturing and GD&T.

- Familiarity with standard margin calculation methodologies for various applications like beams, bolted joints, welds, etc.

- Experience with design of test setups/jigs/fixtures and planning/execution of mechanical tests in-house would be a plus.

- Good at documentation including design descriptions, assembly instructions, test reports, etc.

- Creative with innovative ideas and technical problem solving/troubleshooting skills.

- Basic hands-on experience with mechanical assembly and simple machining tools like drilling machine.

- Previous experience in space AIT and MGSE design would be highly appreciated.

- Good English communication skills (German would be a plus).

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:

- We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind

- We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them

- We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.

All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. About the Role:

Join Camunda as the Manager of Account Development and be at the forefront of our hyper-growth journey into new markets. In this dynamic role, you will take charge of pipeline generation for one of our EMEA ADR teams, closely collaborating with cross-functional teams across Sales, Marketing, Partner Management, and Customer Success. You will use your superpower in coaching to build and empower a high-performance team, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous development. This role not only demands strong leadership and management skills but also a passion for inspiring and uplifting your team to achieve their full potential.

What you'll be doing:

- Lead and develop a high-performing Account Development team, focusing on attracting, onboarding, and coaching team members to excel in their roles and eventually promote into future GTM roles.

- Serve as a trusted partner to Sales Leadership on all sales activities, strategies, and forecasting, leveraging data-led insights to drive results.

- Analyze pipeline management and team productivity metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement actionable recommendations that lead to pipeline growth

- Champion a culture of continuous feedback and growth, building a team environment that encourages innovation and celebrates achievements.

What you bring:

- Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

- Proven experience in leading high-performing global account development teams within a SaaS environment.

- Strong analytical skills with experience in utilizing CRM for pipeline management and data analysis.

- Exceptional people management skills and a demonstrated commitment to employee development and career growth.

- A results-oriented mindset, with a track record of exceeding team pipeline generation and sales targets.

Nice-to-haves:

- Familiarity with remote working principles and experience in driving success in highly transparent environments.

  • Collaborate with Datadog’s product management, engineering and technical services teams to help identify and prioritize new features and capabilities;
  • Continuously help curate and evolve lead/best practices for Datadog platform adoption and success.

 

You Are:

  • Possess a solid technical grounding with hands-on experience of IT Development and/or Operations;
  • A demonstrable track-record and never-ending passion for learning;
  • A self-starter, tech-savvy professional with solid business acumen; ability to articulate Datadog value from server room to boardroom;
  • Confident presentation skills;
  • Must be a current EU resident
  • Desired hands-on experience in two or more of the following areas:
    • Observability: Datadog, Splunk, AppD, New Relic or Dynatrace
    • Public Cloud: AWS, Azure, GCP, or Alibaba
    • Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Cloud Foundry
    • Dev/Scripting: Python, Javascript, Ruby, Perl, PHP, Go
    • Config Mgmt: Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, Chef
    • CI / CD: Jenkins, Gitlab

 

Bonus Points:

  • Previous experience working in a technical role for or supporting channel partners (Systems Integrators, Managed Services Providers, e.g.);
  • Previous experience using Datadog and/or other cloud monitoring tools (APM, Infrastructure, Logs, Synthetics, NPM);
  • Previous experience with root-cause-analysis, troubleshooting, debugging

 

Why You Should Apply: 

  • Generous and competitive global and US benefits
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan
  • Continuous career development and pathing opportunities 
  • Product training to develop an in-depth understanding of our product and space
  • Best in breed onboarding
  • Internal mentor and buddy program cross-departmentally
  • Friendly and inclusive workplace culture

Datadog is the monitoring and security platform for cloud applications. Given the resilience of cloud technologies and importance placed today in digital operations and agility, Datadog continues to innovate and is well positioned for the long term.

title: Construction Project Manager, Germany
description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

We are looking for an experienced Development/Construction Lead to manage clinic development projects across Germany. This role will oversee the full lifecycle of projects, from concept and planning through to operational delivery, ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. The role requires strong knowledge of the German construction environment, particularly building permits and local project processes.

What You'll Delivery in the First 6-12 Months

- Lead clinic construction and development projects across Germany from concept through to operational handover.

- Manage contractors, architects, and consultants while ensuring quality and timeline delivery.

- Navigate German building permit processes and local regulatory requirements.

- Monitor project budgets and capital expenditure, ensuring cost control on projects typically ranging from €5M–€15M.

- Report project progress, risks, and issues to senior leadership and key stakeholders.

- Coordinate site preparation and oversee construction activities across multiple clinic locations.

Minimum Qualifications

- 10–15 years’ experience in construction, development, or project management.

- Fluent German speaker with strong understanding of local construction and permit processes.

- Background in commercial, retail, or real estate development environments (e.g., flexible office, commercial fit-outs, retail spaces).

- Proven experience delivering projects from concept through to operational launch.

title: Sr. Specialist Solutions Architect
description:
FEQ228R125

As a Senior Specialist Solutions Architect (Sr. SSA) for AI/ML, you will be the go-to technical expert for Databricks' AI platform across our customers. You will help them move from AI experiments to governed, cost-efficient agents and ML systems running on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.

You will work with Account Executives and Solutions Architects to win strategic opportunities. You will design architectures for advanced agent and ML use cases and lead hands-on proofs of concept and MVPs. You will act as a trusted advisor to customer technical leaders on AI strategy, governance and economics. You will also shape our AI go-to-market in the region, enable the wider field team, and feed what you learn from customers back to Product and Engineering.

This role reports to the Manager, Specialist Solutions Architects – Switzerland, Austria & Eastern Europe.

The impact you will have

  • Win the technical decision for AI on Databricks. Lead discovery, architecture design, demos, proofs of concept and MVPs for agent, GenAI and ML use cases in competitive evaluations.
  • Design production-grade agent systems. Architect agents and multi-agent applications using Agent Bricks, Databricks Apps, MCP tools, Lakebase, AI Search and the Foundation Model APIs. Govern assets under Unity Catalog
  • Make agent quality measurable. Help customers build evaluation and observability into everything they ship, using MLflow tracing, domain-specific LLM judges, labelled evaluation datasets, release gates and production monitoring.
  • Govern AI at enterprise scale. Position the AI Gateway as the central control point for model access, guardrails, PII protection, usage tracking and rate limiting.
  • Scale your expertise. Enable SAs and partners with workshops, reusable assets and reference architectures. 
  • Influence the product. Bring structured customer feedback and requirements specific to the market to Product Management and Engineering.
  • Be a visible voice. Represent Databricks at customer executive briefings, meetups, conferences and in written content.

What we look for

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in machine learning, AI engineering or data science, including customer-facing technical work (pre-sales, consulting or technical leadership).
  • A track record of shipping LLM and agent systems to production, not just prototypes, including evaluation, monitoring and cost management.
  • Deep knowledge of agent architecture: tool use and function calling, MCP, agent memory and state, orchestrating multiple agents, and retrieval and context design.
  • Strong practical experience evaluating GenAI systems: tracing, LLM-as-a-judge, building evaluation datasets, regression testing and observability in production.
  • Hands-on with at least one modern agent framework (e.g. LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, DSPy). You should be framework-agnostic in how you design.
  • Solid understanding of the foundation-model landscape (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, open-weight models) and the trade-offs between quality, latency, cost and data residency.
  • Strong grounding in classical ML and MLOps: model development, deployment, monitoring and lifecycle management at scale.
  • Strong software engineering skills in Python and SQL. You use AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) daily and can build a working demo application quickly.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP) and modern data platforms.
  • Proven ability to influence technical leaders up to CTO/CDO level and to explain complex AI topics in business terms.
  • Communication: Proven ability to communicate and teach complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

What we offer you:

  • Work-life-balance: Teamwork and personal collaboration in the office are central to us, but we also offer a regular remote work day for added flexibility. In addition, you can compensate for overtime.
  • Vacation mode on: You receive 26 days of paid leave plus an additional 4 compensation days.
  • Wellbeing first: Health benefits and dedicated Mental Health Awareness Days put your health and well-being front and center.
  • Practice makes perfect: Grow through our diverse training programs and leverage internal career initiatives for your personal development across the WPP network.
  • More than just a job: Look forward to unforgettable team events, exclusive employee discounts, and many more highlights.
  • Be yourself: Everyone is warmly welcome here – diversity and equal opportunities are at the core of who we are.

 

This is what you move:

As Senior Manager Client Media (m/f/d) on a fixed-term contract in Lausanne, you lead campaign strategy for a world-renowned luxury brand. You serve as the primary strategic advisor to the client, translating complex briefs into innovative, omnichannel media solutions. Working closely with our activation teams, you orchestrate tailored audience journeys and ensure strategic excellence from concept to execution.

  • Campaign Strategy Leadership: Driving high-level media and communication strategies tailored to the standards and nuances of a premier luxury brand.
  • Client Partnership & Advisory: Acting as the primary client sparring partner for strategic inquiries, crafting compelling presentations, and delivering innovative solutions for every campaign brief.
  • Audience Journey & Messaging Architecture: Defining comprehensive messaging journeys for priority target groups—orchestrating what to communicate, which narrative to use, optimal timing, and the most effective touchpoints.
  • Integrated Cross-Channel Planning: Collaborating with activation experts to design integrated strategies across all relevant media channels, including Digital, Social, Search, Print, and OOH.
  • Specialist Briefing & Implementation: Translating approved strategic concepts into actionable, high-quality briefs for specialist activation teams (Social, Search, Offline) to ensure seamless operational execution.
  • Measurement & KPI Frameworks: Defining performance measurement frameworks, establishing relevant luxury-tier KPIs and benchmarks, and evaluating campaign effectiveness to drive continuous improvement.

 

 

The following qualities distinguish you:

  • Strategic Agency Background: At least five years of proven experience in campaign strategy, media consulting, or account management, ideally gained within an established media agency.
  • Luxury & Global Client Expertise: Track record of driving strategic initiatives for multinational accounts, preferably with deep exposure to the luxury or prestige goods sector.
  • Omnichannel Media Acumen: Strong holistic understanding of the full media landscape, seamlessly connecting digital ecosystems (social, search, programmatic) with premium offline environments (print, OOH).
  • Storytelling & Presentation Skills: Proven ability to turn complex consumer insights and data into elegant, inspiring client narratives and high-impact presentations.
  • Relationship & Partner Management: Proactive mindset with a natural talent for engaging diverse stakeholders, fostering trust, and building strong collaborative bridges between client teams and internal units.
  • Language Proficiency: Business-fluent English skills (written and spoken) are essential; French and/or German language skills are a valuable asset.

Furthermore you are: #strategic-thinker #luxury-enthusiast #trusted-advisor

If this job sounds exciting to you, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don't have every qualification listed above.

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events.

In der Rolle als Marketing Manager (gn), übernimmst du die Entwicklung und Umsetzung unserer Markenstrategie für More Nutrition in der Schweiz.

More Nutrition macht bereits 8-stellige Umsätze in der Schweiz, die wir gemeinsam mit dir auf 9-stellige Umsätze ausweiten wollen. 

In dieser Rolle gestaltest du wirkungsvolle Kampagnen, treibst lokale Marketinginitiativen voran und stellst ein konsistentes Markenerlebnis über alle Touchpoints hinweg sicher. Du arbeitest eng mit crossfunktionalen Teams, Agenturen und lokalen Akteuren zusammen, um unsere Präsenz auf dem Schweizer Markt massiv auszubauen. 

 

Deine Mission bei uns 

  • Als Brand Guardian entwickelst und setzt du die Markenstrategie für die Schweiz um, indem du globale Leitlinien mit lokalen Consumer Insights verknüpfst
  • Du definierst den Marketing-Aktivierungskalender und leitest die Planung sowie Umsetzung von Omnichannel-Kampagnen (inkl. Massenmedien, Influencer Marketing, TikTok und Point of Sale)
  • Du gestaltest das lokale Produktportfolio basierend auf den Bedürfnissen und Potenzialen des Schweizer Marktes mit
  • Du briefst und steuerst Agenturen zur Erstellung markenkonformer, lokal relevanter Assets (in Deutsch und Französisch) und stellst eine termingerechte Kampagnenumsetzung sicher

title: Expansion Associate (H/F) - 100%
description:
Tu n'abandonnes pas au premier refus, ni au dixième. Tu traites une liste le vendredi après-midi avec le même soin que le lundi matin, et tu mènes à terme ce que tu as commencé, pour que rien ne reste en suspens et que rien ne vieillisse en silence dans un coin. Tu n'as besoin de personne derrière ton épaule pour tenir ton niveau d'exigence. Et quand un cas ne rentre pas dans le processus, tu le signales au lieu de bricoler une solution.

Si tu te reconnais dans ces lignes, tu es au bon endroit.

En tant qu'Expansion Associate, tu es le chasseur ou la chasseuse d'appartements de Room Estate en Suisse romande, avec un accent sur Genève. Tu es responsable de l'acquisition d'appartements de A à Z : tu passes le marché au crible, tu évalues chaque appartement sous l'angle du coliving, tu le visites sur place, tu postules en notre nom, tu relances et tu accompagnes le dossier jusqu'à la signature du bail. C'est un rôle pour les personnes qui passent à l'action, et c'est précisément sa force : fréquence, ténacité et sens des responsabilités dans un processus clairement défini. Notre principe directeur : la croissance naît d'un tri des annonces à haute fréquence, d'une évaluation rigoureuse et de relances systématiques, pas de coups de chance. Tu travailles en étroite collaboration avec notre responsable de l'équipe Acquisition, qui tranche les cas d'appréciation, et ton travail se mesure à ce qui compte au final : les chambres acquises, les baux signés et la qualité de ce que tu ramènes.

Tasks

- Tu passes les portails immobiliers au crible de manière systématique, chaque jour et avec un regard sûr pour ce qui convient.

- Tu évalues chaque appartement sous l'angle du coliving : plan, état, immeuble, et la question de savoir si la propriété est prête à jouer le jeu.

- Tu organises les visites et tu te rends sur place pour vérifier sur l'objet réel ce que promet l'annonce.

- Tu postules en notre nom et tu positionnes Room Estate comme le locataire que toute régie souhaite avoir.

- Tu relances jusqu'à ce qu'une décision soit prise. Aucun dossier ne s'enlise.

- Tu accompagnes le dossier jusqu'à la signature et tu contrôles le bail à l'aide de notre liste de contrôle : points critiques, clauses manquantes et écarts par rapport à l'annonce.

- Tu tiens le suivi des dossiers à jour : chaque objet saisi, chaque statut traçable.

Requirements

- Sens des responsabilités et autonomie. Tu fais avancer un processus de bout en bout à une fréquence élevée et à un rythme fiable, tu vas au bout de chaque suivi et tu ne laisses aucun dossier s'enliser. C'est le cœur de ce rôle.

- Maîtrise du français, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, dans les échanges avec les régies et les propriétaires.

- Ténacité et sens de la négociation, le marché locatif genevois dit souvent non, et cela ne te déstabilise pas.

- Un œil pour les plans, tu vois d'emblée si le coliving fonctionne dans un appartement et combien de chambres sont réalistes.

- Rigueur dans le travail avec des listes de contrôle, tu vas au bout de chaque point plutôt que de faire les choses à peu près, et tu repères les écarts. Aucune connaissance spécialisée en droit du bail n'est requise.

- Permis de conduire catégorie B et disponibilité pour des visites régulières à Genève, dans la région lémanique et dans le reste de la Suisse romande.

- Anglais courant, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, notre langue de travail interne.

BONUS

- Expérience dans le secteur immobilier suisse (formation en gérance immobilière, cours USPI, activité de courtage)

- Réseau existant auprès des régies et des propriétaires à Genève et dans la région lémanique

- Expérience dans l'univers du coliving ou des appartements meublés avec services

- Connaissances de base du droit du bail suisse

- Allemand

Benefits

- Salaire fixe plus bonus progressif pour chaque chambre acquise, sans plafond : plus tu acquiers de chambres, plus tu gagnes par chambre.

- Bureau à Lausanne, avec la possibilité de télétravailler certains jours

- Équipement de ton choix (ordinateur portable, écran, accessoires)

- Des processus et des listes de contrôle documentés, et un·e responsable d'équipe à qui reviennent les exceptions, pour que tu puisses faire ta part avec précision au lieu d'improviser

- Un rôle qui t'appartient : tu ne fais pas partie d'une équipe d'acquisition, tu es l'acquisition en Suisse romande

- Une équipe internationale et solidaire, avec une vraie culture de l'apprentissage

- Budget de formation continue (cours, livres, conférences)

- Une vraie évolution : ton ambition détermine jusqu'où tu iras, tes résultats à quelle vitesse. Ton périmètre de responsabilité grandit avec les deux.

Chez Room Estate, tu bénéficies de vraies responsabilités et d'un feedback direct, sans micromanagement ni langue de bois. On se tutoie, on se dit les choses, et nous sommes exigeants : tu as le droit de l'être tout autant avec nous.

Des séminaires d'équipe, une fête d'été annuelle et une collaboration étroite avec des collègues de différents pays font partie de l'aventure et élargissent ton réseau personnel et professionnel. Mais l'essentiel est simple : nous voulons progresser chaque jour et nous cherchons des personnes qui le veulent aussi. Ici, tu assumes un rôle qui compte, dans un environnement international, et tu contribues activement à façonner l'avenir du coliving en Europe.

Rejoins Room Estate et construis avec nous l'avenir du logement. 🚀

description:
Internationales E-Commerce-Unternehmen · Remote innerhalb der Schweiz · Eintritt nach Vereinbarung

Wir sind ein international tätiges E-Commerce-Unternehmen mit Sitz in der Schweiz und verkaufen hauptsächlich an Kundinnen und Kunden in den USA. In den letzten Jahren sind wir stark gewachsen. Zur Gruppe gehören mehrere Gesellschaften in der Schweiz und in den USA. Wir suchen eine erfahrene Person, die die Verantwortung für unsere Schweizer Finanzen und Compliance übernimmt, von der laufenden Buchhaltung bis zur Steuererklärung. Die US-Buchhaltung und das interne Reporting führen unser Team und externe Partner. Du arbeitest eng mit ihnen zusammen und berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsleitung.

Deine Aufgaben

- Führung der Buchhaltung der Schweizer Gesellschaften in Bexio, unterstützt durch KI und Automatisierung

- Monats- bzw. Quartalsabschlüsse und Zwischenabschlüsse als Grundlage für unterjährige Dividenden

- Jahresabschlüsse nach OR, inklusive Integration der Zahlen unserer US-Gesellschaft

- MWST-Abrechnungen und laufende MWST-Compliance

- Lohnbuchhaltung und Sozialversicherungen

- Steuererklärungen der Gesellschaften, Dividenden und Verrechnungssteuer sowie Kontakt mit der Steuerverwaltung und der ESTV

- Zusammenarbeit mit unseren US-Buchhaltern sowie unseren Steuer- und MWST-Beratern, mit klaren Terminen

- Aufbau sauberer, möglichst automatisierter Prozesse

Dein Profil

- Eidg. Fachausweis Finanz- und Rechnungswesen, eidg. Diplom Experte/Expertin in Rechnungslegung und Controlling oder gleichwertige Ausbildung

- Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der selbständigen Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen und Steuererklärungen, idealerweise aus einem Treuhandbüro

- Fundierte Kenntnisse im Schweizer Steuer- und MWST-Recht

- Erfahrung mit mehreren Gesellschaften und Auslandbezug, USA von Vorteil

- Du nutzt KI und moderne Tools gerne und willst Abläufe automatisieren

- Du übernimmst Verantwortung und hältst Termine ein, auch gegenüber externen Partnern

- Deutsch fliessend, Englisch verhandlungssicher in Wort und Schrift

- Wohnsitz in der Schweiz

Was wir bieten

- Eine Schlüsselrolle mit echter Verantwortung und kurzen Entscheidungswegen

- Ein schnell wachsendes, internationales Unternehmen

- Remote-Arbeit innerhalb der Schweiz und flexible Arbeitszeiten

- Marktgerechte Entlöhnung

- Pensum 50–60%, eine spätere Erhöhung ist möglich und kann je nach Gespräch auch von Beginn an höher sein

- Perspektive auf eine erweiterte Rolle in der Geschäftsführung der Schweizer Gesellschaften

Bewerbung

title: Senior RAM Engineer
description:
Destinus Engineering is looking for a highly motivated and experienced Senior Reliability Engineer to ensure that our defense systems and products perform dependably in demanding operational environments. You’ll lead reliability, availability and maintainability (RAM) efforts across Destinus systems and products covering the full product lifecycle, from early design trade studies through qualification, fielding, and sustainment. You will work closely with system design, test, and supply chain teams as well as customers. The ideal candidate is a strong team player with good social and leadership skills to continuously coordinate with the peers of the respective engineering disciplines and teams.

Key Responsibilities

· Develop and execute reliability program plans in line with contract requirements and applicable standards (e.g., MIL-STD-785, MIL-HDBK-217, MIL-STD-1629, IEC 60812, FIDES, ANSI/GEIA-STD-0009, ASD S3000L or customer-specific equivalents)

· Perform reliability predictions, FMEA/FMECA, fault tree analysis, derating and worst-case analyses, and reliability block diagram modeling

· Define and run reliability test programs, including HALT/HASS, environmental stress screening, accelerated life testing, and reliability growth testing

· Contribute to design reviews (PDR, CDR) and influence design for reliability and maintainability early in development

· Support sustainment engineering, including obsolescence and parts-quality assessments, and supplier reliability oversight

title: System Engineer – MFT, EDI & Email Security 80%-100%
description:
Wir sind ein spezialisiertes IT-Unternehmen mit weniger als 10 Mitarbeitenden und konzentrieren uns auf die Bereiche Managed File Transfer (MFT), Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) und Email Security.

Als IT-Reseller und Lösungsanbieter begleiten wir unsere Kunden über den gesamten Lifecycle – von der technischen Beratung und Konzeption über die Implementierung und Integration bis hin zum Betrieb und Support.

Unsere Lösungen sind häufig ein zentraler Bestandteil der IT- und Geschäftsprozesse unserer Kunden. Entsprechend wichtig sind uns technische Qualität, zuverlässige Umsetzung, saubere Kommunikation und ein professioneller Umgang mit Kunden und Partnern.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen System Engineer, der unsere Kundenprojekte technisch begleitet und gemeinsam mit unserem Team anspruchsvolle Integrations- und Infrastrukturaufgaben umsetzt.

Als System Engineer bist du Teil unseres technischen Teams und übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle bei der Implementierung, Integration und Betreuung unserer Lösungen.

Du arbeitest sowohl selbstständig als auch im Team und hast direkten Kontakt zu unseren Kunden. Dabei bewegst du dich an der Schnittstelle zwischen Applikationen, Infrastruktur, Netzwerken und Geschäftsprozessen.

Je nach Erfahrung und Interesse übernimmst du zunehmend Verantwortung für eigene Kundenumgebungen und Projekte.

Dein Aufgabenbereich

Engineering & Projektumsetzung

- Planung, Installation, Konfiguration und Inbetriebnahme unserer Softwarelösungen

- Integration unserer Lösungen in bestehende Enterprise-IT-Infrastrukturen

- Umsetzung von Schnittstellen und Systemintegrationen

- Konfiguration und Anbindung von Kommunikationspartnern, Applikationen und Umsystemen

- Begleitung von Migrationen, Upgrades und Systemerweiterungen

- Durchführung von technischen Tests und Abnahmen

- Analyse und Optimierung bestehender Systemarchitekturen

- Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentationen und Betriebskonzepte

Troubleshooting & Support

- Analyse und Behebung komplexer technischer Störungen

- Systematisches Troubleshooting auf Applikations-, Netzwerk- und Infrastruktur-Ebene

- Analyse von Logs, Systemmeldungen und Kommunikationsabläufen

- Unterstützung bei Incidents und Problem Management

- Zusammenarbeit mit Herstellern und deren 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Support

- Technische Unterstützung unserer Kunden im laufenden Betrieb

Kunden & Projekte

- Direkter technischer Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden

- Aufnahme und Analyse technischer Anforderungen

- Erarbeitung und Umsetzung von Lösungsansätzen

- Technische Beratung unserer Kunden und Unterstützung bei Architekturentscheidungen

- Mitarbeit bei der Planung und Durchführung von Kundenprojekten

- Koordination technischer Aufgaben mit Kunden, Partnern und Herstellern

Dein technischer Hintergrund

Du verfügst über eine solide technische Basis und hast Freude daran, dich auch in komplexe Systeme und neue Technologien einzuarbeiten.

Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung in mehreren der folgenden Bereiche mit:

Systeme & Infrastruktur

- Windows Server und/oder Linux

- Virtualisierung und grundlegende Kenntnisse moderner Infrastrukturplattformen

- Active Directory und grundlegende Identity-Konzepte

- Netzwerk- und Infrastrukturkomponenten

- Backup, Monitoring und Systemmanagement

Netzwerk & Kommunikation

- HTTP/HTTPS/AS2

- TLS/SSL und Zertifikatsmanagement

- Firewall- und Netzwerkgrundlagen

- SFTP/FTPS/SSH

- Verständnis für sichere System- und Datenkommunikation

Integration & Automation

- REST APIs und Web Services

- Sicherheit im Umgang mit XML, JSON, CSV und weiteren strukturierten Datenformaten

- Scripting und Automatisierung, beispielsweise mit PowerShell oder Bash

- Verständnis von Datenflüssen und Systemintegrationen

- Kenntnisse von EDI-Prozessen und gängigen EDI-Standards sind von Vorteil

Security

- Grundverständnis von IT-Security-Konzepten

- Verschlüsselung und Zertifikatsmanagement

- Grundverständnis von Security Best Practices

Das bringst du persönlich mit

Neben deinen technischen Fähigkeiten sind uns folgende Eigenschaften besonders wichtig:

- Analytische und strukturierte Denkweise

- Ausgeprägtes Interesse an technischen Zusammenhängen

- Selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

- Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Zuverlässigkeit

- Freude am Troubleshooting und an der Suche nach nachhaltigen Lösungen

- Professionelles Auftreten gegenüber Kunden

- Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit – auch bei komplexen technischen Themen

- Teamorientierung und Bereitschaft, Wissen zu teilen

- Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen und Aufgaben selbstständig zu organisieren

- Interesse an neuen Technologien und kontinuierlicher Weiterbildung

Was wir dir bieten

Bei uns arbeitest du nicht an beliebigen Standard-IT-Aufgaben, sondern an spezialisierten Lösungen mit direkter Relevanz für die Geschäftsprozesse unserer Kunden.

Du erhältst Einblick in unterschiedliche Kundenumgebungen und Technologien und kannst dein Know-how in den Bereichen Integration, Security, MFT und EDI kontinuierlich erweitern.

Kleines Team, grosse Verantwortung

Mit weniger als 10 Mitarbeitenden sind unsere Hierarchien kurz und die Kommunikationswege direkt.

Bei uns kannst du:

- Verantwortung für eigene Kunden und Projekte übernehmen

- technische Lösungen aktiv mitgestalten

- eigene Ideen einbringen

- direkt mit Entscheidern und technischen Ansprechpartnern unserer Kunden arbeiten

- dich fachlich und persönlich weiterentwickeln

- Wissen mit erfahrenen Kollegen austauschen

Unser Arbeitsumfeld

Als engagiertes Team legen wir grossen Wert auf ein offenes, kollegiales und respektvolles Arbeitsklima.

Wir arbeiten professionell und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch, ohne unnötige Hierarchien oder Konzernbürokratie. Gegenseitige Unterstützung und ein unkomplizierter Umgang miteinander gehören für uns genauso dazu wie eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten.

title: Medical Operations - Netherlands
description:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

We’re building the clinical co-pilot of the future - empowering clinicians, enhancing care delivery, and scaling impact. As part of our Global Medical Operations team, you’ll play a pivotal role in rolling out Tandem’s AI clinical operating system to some of the most influential healthcare organisations worldwide.

This is a highly visible, global role where you’ll engage directly with executives, medical leaders, and end-users. You’ll bring clinical insight into how our tools are implemented on the ground - from onboarding new organisations and refining workflows to shaping the product through continuous feedback. You’ll be at the forefront of transforming healthcare delivery, ensuring Tandem becomes an indispensable part of daily patient care for clinicians across the globe.

What You Will Do

- Lead live product demos for prospective clients and support global commercial efforts.

- Design and adapt workflows and templates for diverse markets and large-scale customers.

- Partner with product, engineering, and commercial teams to deliver smooth rollouts and seamless workflow integration.

- Represent Tandem at international conferences, workshops, and customer events.

- Guide clinicians through onboarding, training, and day-to-day support.

- Troubleshoot and solve problems to ensure clinicians get maximum value from Tandem.

- Build templates and prompts, contributing to the ongoing evolution of Tandem’s AI assistant.

- Manage clinical safety incidents and optimise internal operations for safe scaling.

What You Bring

- Clinical experience in healthcare (e.g. general practice, hospital, private practice).

- Exposure to consulting, corporate, or startup environments.

- A passion for technology, AI, and their potential to transform care.

- Strong communication skills - equally comfortable with executives, engineers, and frontline clinicians.

- Organisational strength and a process-driven mindset.

- Ownership, curiosity, and initiative in a fast-paced environment.

- Flexibility to travel up to 25% and step in during critical moments.

- Fluency in Dutch and English

Bonus Points

- Experience with prompting or large language models (LLMs).

- Background in healthtech or SaaS.

- Familiarity with EU clinical safety or digital health regulations.

- Track record in implementation projects or customer rollouts.

Location

We believe great ideas thrive when we connect in person. This is a full-time hybrid role based in Leiden with occasional travel to meet the core team in Stockholm and clinicians across the country as needed

How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

- Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

- First interview with our NL Country Director

- Follow up interview with of our NL Medical Operations team lead

- Working Day - Join us in the Leiden office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

This is a highly visible, global role where you’ll engage directly with executives, medical leaders, and end-users. You’ll bring clinical insight into how our tools are implemented on the ground - from onboarding new organisations and refining workflows to shaping the product through continuous feedback. You’ll be at the forefront of transforming healthcare delivery, ensuring Tandem becomes an indispensable part of daily patient care for clinicians across the globe.

What You Will Do

  • Lead live product demos for prospective clients and support global commercial efforts.

  • Design and adapt workflows and templates for diverse markets and large-scale customers.

  • Partner with product, engineering, and commercial teams to deliver smooth rollouts and seamless workflow integration.

  • Represent Tandem at international conferences, workshops, and customer events.

  • Guide clinicians through onboarding, training, and day-to-day support.

  • Troubleshoot and solve problems to ensure clinicians get maximum value from Tandem.

  • Build templates and prompts, contributing to the ongoing evolution of Tandem’s AI assistant.

  • Manage clinical safety incidents and optimise internal operations for safe scaling.


What You Bring

  • Clinical experience in healthcare (e.g. general practice, hospital, private practice).

  • Exposure to consulting, corporate, or startup environments.

  • A passion for technology, AI, and their potential to transform care.

  • Strong communication skills - equally comfortable with executives, engineers, and frontline clinicians.

  • Organisational strength and a process-driven mindset.

  • Ownership, curiosity, and initiative in a fast-paced environment.

  • Flexibility to travel up to 25% and step in during critical moments.

  • Fluency in Dutch and English

Bonus Points

  • Experience with prompting or large language models (LLMs).

  • Background in healthtech or SaaS.

  • Familiarity with EU clinical safety or digital health regulations.

  • Track record in implementation projects or customer rollouts.

Location

We believe great ideas thrive when we connect in person. This is a full-time hybrid role based in Leiden with occasional travel to meet the core team in Stockholm and clinicians across the country as needed

How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

  1. Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  2. First interview with our NL Country Director

  3. Follow up interview with of our NL Medical Operations team lead

  4. Working Day - Join us in the Leiden office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

Als Sales & Accountmanagement Stagiair(e) ondersteun je Flagship Events bij het binnenhalen van nieuwe zakelijke evenementen. Je helpt bij het vinden en benaderen van potentiële klanten, het opvolgen van aanvragen en het voorbereiden van offertes en voorstellen. Startdatum: Vanaf februari 2027, of eerder in overleg;

  • Goede beheersing van het Engels;

Flagship Amsterdam is een snelgroeiende rederij in het hart van Amsterdam. Jaarlijks verwelkomen we gasten uit meer dan 55 verschillende landen, en we varen het hele jaar door. Dit doen we met een gedreven en ambitieus team van meer dan 800 (seizoensgebonden) medewerkers.

Maar Flagship is meer dan alleen rondvaarten. Vanuit dezelfde energie bouwen we aan verschillende concepten die allemaal draaien om beleving, gastvrijheid en de stad Amsterdam. Zo ontdek je de stad op de fiets met Flagship Bike Tours, proef je de sfeer bij Flagship Waffle Experience Amsterdam, en werken we bij Shipyard aan creatieve projecten op en rond het water. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep. Samen vormen ze één organisatie, maar met verschillende manieren om mensen de stad te laten ervaren.

title: CTO (f/m/d)
description:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the product, roadmap, and development process that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard robotics questions become real product decisions: how do we turn customer needs into a highly capable robotic hand that is reliable, manufacturable, and ready to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

As a Chief Technology Officer, you will own TACTILIA's technology strategy, product architecture, and engineering execution. You will lead a multidisciplinary organization across project management, systems engineering, mechanics, electronics, sensorics, embedded and robotics software, AI, product management, applications and testing. Your responsibility is to turn a highly capable robotic hand into a reliable, manufacturable, serviceable and scalable industrial product.

This is a leadership role with substantial technical depth. You do not need to be the deepest specialist in every discipline, but you must have first-hand experience with both hardware and software development and the judgment to make sound system-level decisions across both.

What you will do:

Set the technology direction. Define TACTILIA’s technology strategy and product roadmap from the current platform to a scalable industrial product.

Lead the whole stack. Lead the teams across project management, systems, mechanics, electronics, sensorics, embedded and robotics software, AI, product, applications and testing.

Make the architecture work. Own the system architecture and the interfaces between hardware, software, AI and applications.

Turn R&D into product. Drive the transition from advanced prototypes to reliable, manufacturable, serviceable and customer-ready products.

Make the right trade-offs. Balance performance, reliability, cost, safety, manufacturability and speed of execution.

Build the organization. Recruit, develop and lead the engineering and product organization across Zurich and Munich.

Create clarity and accountability. Establish effective priorities, processes, decision-making structures and technical standards across the teams.

Own resources and execution. Manage engineering budgets, headcount and priorities in line with the company’s product and business goals.

Stay close to customers. Translate customer requirements and field experience into product decisions and future technology direction.

Represent TACTILIA externally. Act as the technical face of the company with customers, partners, SCHUNK, investors and the robotics community.

Stay close to the hard problems. Remain sufficiently hands-on to challenge important technical decisions and unblock the team when necessary.

What you bring:

You can lead across hardware and software. You have deep practical understanding of both disciplines and the credibility to guide experts across mechanics, electronics, sensors, embedded systems, controls, AI and applications.

You have led complex engineering organizations. You have successfully led multidisciplinary teams, ideally with responsibility for 20 or more people, multiple functions and a significant budget.

You have shipped physical products. You have taken complex robotics, mechatronics, medical or industrial hardware from development or prototype stage into customer use, production or product maturity.

You understand human-like robotic systems. Ideally, you have experience in humanoid or biomedical robotics, particularly with anthropomorphic mechanisms, sensor and actuator systems, robotic hands or tendon-driven devices.

You think in systems. You can connect mechanics, electronics, sensing, control, software, AI and customer applications into a coherent product architecture.

You build teams that execute. You have a track record of recruiting strong people, developing leaders and creating a culture of ownership and high standards.

You know how to scale engineering. You bring experience from a startup, scale-up or industrial technology company and understand how to combine speed with disciplined execution.

You make sound decisions under uncertainty. You are pragmatic, commercially aware and able to distinguish between the perfect solution and the right solution.

You communicate with every audience. You can engage credibly with engineers, customers, executives, investors and industrial partners.

You have a strong technical foundation. A degree in engineering, computer science, robotics, mechatronics or a related field is preferred.

You are ready to build internationally. You are fluent in English and comfortable working across the Zurich and Munich locations. German is an advantage.

Bonus:

- Dexterous manipulation, grasp planning, or robotic hands

- Tactile sensing and contact-rich manipulation

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that works reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Langfuse - Senior Product Engineer
description:
Why Product Engineering at Langfuse

Your work will have an outsized impact.

Everything you build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible. Langfuse has 35,000+ GitHub stars and our SDKs are downloaded more than a hundred million times per month. When you ship a new feature the community notices in GitHub issues, on X, and in our community channels.

Product engineers at Langfuse are the people who deliver new features end-to-end to our users. You own the product thinking from understanding the user problem to deciding what to build to shipping the solution.

You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM applications are built. The users you serve are some of the best and most ambitious software engineers leveraging Langfuse to improve their applications. Deeply understanding the problems they solve will help you design the best possible product and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself.

You will grow at Langfuse by

- Own features end-to-end: from talking to users, to writing the spec, to shipping the code and docs, to writing the changelog post with your name on it. To give you a sense: recent features a single engineer owned include the Langfuse for Agents release (new trace views, agent graphs, semantic span labels), the TypeScript SDK v4 rewrite on OpenTelemetry, and managing dashboards via API/CLI/MCP.

- Work across the full stack: and we mean full. Our surface area is wide: React frontend, Next.js backend, ClickHouse analytics, Python and TypeScript SDKs, public docs, Terraform modules, and more. You'll touch whatever the feature needs. One week you might be writing a new ClickHouse query for cost analytics, the next you're designing an SDK API, the next you're building a new rust worker for faster data processing.

- Talk to users constantly: jump on calls, respond in community channels, and route support requests. At Langfuse, support is how we build conviction about what to build next. Our handbook says it best: support by engineers is a core value proposition.

- Write public documentation about the features you own. At Langfuse, docs are product.

- Ship publicly during Launch Weeks: we've run four Launch Weeks so far, dropping a new feature every day for a week. Engineers present the features they built to the community.

What we’re looking for

- Someone who has built features or even entire products from scratch end-to-end

- Experience building and shipping user-facing products end-to-end, ideally in TypeScript/React and with exposure to data-intensive backends

- Someone who can manage projects themselves. You know how to develop strong conviction about what to build and how to ship it.

- Taste for great developer experience: you care about API design, UI details, and clear documentation

- Interest in open source software and genuine excitement about talking to developers about their problems

- Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters

- CS or quantitative degree preferred

Bonus points:

- Experience with ClickHouse, analytics databases, or building complex data visualizations

- Former founder or early startup experience

- Contributions to popular open source projects

- ML/AI background or familiarity with the LLM framework ecosystem

No candidate checks all boxes. If you feel you are a good fit for this role, please go ahead and apply.

Perks

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

- Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

- Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

- A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

- Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

Compensation: €90K – €160K • Offers Equity

  • Work across the full stack: and we mean full. Our surface area is wide: React frontend, Next.js backend, ClickHouse analytics, Python and TypeScript SDKs, public docs, Terraform modules, and more. You'll touch whatever the feature needs. One week you might be writing a new ClickHouse query for cost analytics, the next you're designing an SDK API, the next you're building a new rust worker for faster data processing.

  • Write public documentation about the features you own. At Langfuse, docs are product.

  • Ship publicly during Launch Weeks: we've run four Launch Weeks so far, dropping a new feature every day for a week. Engineers present the features they built to the community.

Your work will have an outsized impact.

Langfuse ingests terabytes of AI tracing data per day. When a Fortune 50 company instruments their application with Langfuse, they hit the infrastructure you built. Everything you ship is open source and immediately visible.

You will grow at Langfuse by

- Own and optimize our ingestion pipeline: Langfuse ingests massive volumes of tracing data through a pipeline that flows from our API to ClickHouse. You'll work on throughput, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency at every stage of this pipeline.

- Make ClickHouse fast: our tracing data lives in ClickHouse.
