title: Meeloopstage | IT Service Improvement & Klantbehoeften
description:
Wat jij doet

Gemeenten staan voor een uitdaging op IT-gebied, bijvoorbeeld de toenemende complexiteit van het landschap, strengere beveiligingseisen en een tekort aan specialistische kennis. Als Centric helpen wij gemeenten met deze vraagstukken. Bij deze stage ga je aan de slag bij het HPT-TAB team: High Performance Team - Technisch Applicatie beheer. Zij leveren dienstverlening aan gemeenten rondom Patches, Updates en Fixes en Technisch beheer.

Het team wil graag beter inzicht krijgen in hoe gemeenten de huidige dienstverlening ervaren en op welke klantenbehoeften wij nog beter kunnen inspelen. Je gaat dan ook echt bij gemeenten langs om in gesprek te gaan met de gebruikers en koppelt dit aan de services die wij als Centric leveren en kunnen leveren. Je spiegelt in het team welke behoeftes er zijn en hoe wij deze zouden kunnen leveren. Aan het eind lever je een concreet adviesrapport op over deze kansen.

Je gaat onder andere:

Een analyse maken van de bestaande procesen en documentatie.

Kijken wat de trends zijn binnen gemeentelijk IT-beheer.

Afnemen van interviews met interne en externe stakeholders.

Je uitkomsten analyseren op thema’s

Mogelijke verbeteringen en commerciele kansen uitwerken in een adviesrapport.

Dit krijg je

Een uitdagende opdracht met goede begeleiding in een informele werksfeer

De kans om te blijven na je stage en door te groeien in jouw vakgebied

Veel ruimte voor autonomie en het inbrengen van je eigen ideeën

Borrels en andere activiteiten

Toegang tot de Centric Academy om je ook al tijdens je stage verder te ontwikkelen

Een fijne stagevergoeding van €550,-

title: Afstudeerstage | Marketing & Propositieontwikkeling
description:
Hoe vertaal je marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften naar sterke proposities die zichtbaar zijn en commerciële kansen creëren? Tijdens deze hbo- of wo-afstudeerstage bij Risk Solutions, onderdeel van Centric, ga je aan de slag met een uitdagend vraagstuk waarin marketing, propositieontwikkeling, business development en procesoptimalisatie samenkomen.

Risk Solutions ondersteunt organisaties bij het beheersen van financiële, operationele en compliance-risico’s. Denk aan oplossingen en dienstverlening rondom kredietacceptatie, risicobeoordeling, Wwft, AML, KYC en fraudebeheersing. Er is veel kennis aanwezig over de markt, klanten, risico’s en wetgeving. De uitdaging is om deze kennis te vertalen naar duidelijke proposities en gerichte commerciële en marketingactiviteiten.

Jouw afstudeeropdracht

Tijdens je afstudeerstage onderzoek je hoe het huidige marketing- en propositieproces verloopt: van een eerste idee tot content, campagne, lead en commerciële opvolging. Je kijkt waar het proces beter of efficiënter kan en werkt daarbij samen met collega’s uit onder andere Marketing, Sales, Business Consultancy, Compliance en Risk Management.

De centrale vraag tijdens jouw afstudeerstage is: Hoe kan Risk Solutions het marketing- en propositieproces zo inrichten dat nieuwe proposities met beperkte capaciteit sneller en consistenter in de markt worden gezet en de zichtbaarheid, vindbaarheid en commerciële opvolging worden verbeterd?

Je onderzoekt ook wat er in de markt speelt en hoe andere aanbieders hun oplossingen presenteren. Daarbij verdiep je je onder andere in kredietacceptatie, financiële risico’s, AML, Wwft, KYC en fraudepreventie. Je onderzoekt welke financiële, commerciële en compliancevraagstukken bij klanten spelen, hoe organisaties daarmee omgaan en welke waarde verschillende oplossingen daarbij bieden. Ook kijk je naar wat belangrijk is voor bijvoorbeeld een Compliance Officer, Risk Manager, kredietmanager of directielid.

Daarnaast onderzoek je de zichtbaarheid van de verschillende proposities. Je kijkt hoe kanalen en middelen zoals de website, SEO, LinkedIn, klantcases, whitepapers, nieuwsbrieven, webinars en evenementen worden ingezet en waar verbeteringen mogelijk zijn. Ook onderzoek je welke werkzaamheden slimmer kunnen worden ingericht en waar AI kan ondersteunen.

Op basis van je onderzoek ontwikkel je een Marketing & Proposition Launch Framework. Hierin leg je een vaste werkwijze vast om een propositie van idee en positionering naar content, campagne, leadopvolging en evaluatie te brengen. Je maakt hiervoor praktische hulpmiddelen, zoals templates voor proposities en campagnes, afspraken over rollen en verantwoordelijkheden en KPI’s om resultaten te meten.

Tijdens je stage test je deze werkwijze op minimaal één concrete propositie. Samen met de betrokken collega’s doorloop je de verschillende stappen en maak je bijvoorbeeld een propositiecanvas, contentplan, campagne-opzet of salesmateriaal. Op basis van wat je in de praktijk tegenkomt, pas je de werkwijze aan. Zo ligt er aan het einde van je stage een aanpak die het team daarna zelf kan blijven gebruiken.

Wat ga je doen?

Je analyseert het huidige proces, van marktontwikkeling en propositie tot campagne, lead en commerciële opvolging.

Je onderzoekt de markt en concurrenten en verdiept je in de financiële, commerciële en compliancevraagstukken die bij klanten spelen.

Je onderzoekt hoe proposities het beste in de markt kunnen worden gezet en welke content en kanalen bijdragen aan meer zichtbaarheid en vindbaarheid.

Je kijkt hoe AI en automatisering kunnen helpen om werkzaamheden slimmer en efficiënter uit te voeren.

Je test de ontwikkelde werkwijze op minimaal één concrete propositie en gebruikt de resultaten om deze verder te verbeteren.

Je sluit je stage af met meer dan alleen een onderzoeksrapport. Je levert een geteste en praktische werkwijze op die het team daarna kan blijven gebruiken, inclusief hulpmiddelen, duidelijke afspraken over rollen en verantwoordelijkheden en KPI’s om de resultaten te volgen.

Dit krijg je

Een afstudeerstage waarin je niet alleen onderzoekt, maar ook ontwikkelt en test

Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ideeën

Een laptop van de zaak

Toegang tot de Centric Academy

Een stagevergoeding van €550 per maand op basis van 40 uur per week

Leuke activiteiten en borrels

Dit breng je mee

Voor deze afstudeerstage volg je een hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van Commerciële Economie, Marketing, Bedrijfskunde, International Business, Finance & Control, Finance, Communicatie, Business Innovation of een vergelijkbare studie. Volg je een wo-master en zoek je een meewerkstage waarin je onderzoek met praktijkervaring kunt combineren? Ook dan ben je van harte welkom om te solliciteren.

Daarnaast:

Heb je interesse in marketing, propositieontwikkeling, business development en commerciële vraagstukken

Ben je geïnteresseerd in financiële en compliancevraagstukken

Heb je enige ervaring met het uitvoeren en verwerken van onderzoek, bijvoorbeeld markt-, concurrentie- of doelgroepanalyse

Werk je zelfstandig, gestructureerd en resultaatgericht

Schakel je makkelijk tussen verschillende stakeholders en vakgebieden

Heb je interesse in digitale marketing, data, AI en automatisering

Ben je communicatief vaardig en beheers je de Nederlandse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk

Heb je ervaring met tools voor data-analyse, CRM, online marketing of AI, zoals Excel, Power BI, Google Analytics of Copilot? Dan is dat een pre.

Wij zijn Centric, een IT-software en services bedrijf dat verweven zit in de Nederlandse Maatschappij. Vaak zie je ons logo niet op onze producten, maar ze worden gebruikt door o.a. gemeenten, grote retailers, banken en ziekenhuizen. Door bij ons te werken omring je jezelf met kansen. title: [Interim] Strategy & Transformation Lead (CTO office)
description:
(Interim) Strategy & Transformation Lead (CTO office)

Freelance | Hybrid, Netherlands | Interim, immediate start

Riverflex is supporting technology leaders at major retailers through a number of strategic engagements, and we are looking for experienced strategy consultants to join our team on an interim basis. You work as part of a Riverflex team alongside our in-house consultants, reporting to a member of our leadership team. You help CTOs shape how their technology organisations run, decide and deliver.

Current and upcoming opportunities include:

Supporting a CTO following the merger of regional technology departments into one. The work covers how the leadership team should operate and how to set up a CTO office that delivers on their ambitions.

Partner with CTO-1 leadership to shape, document and drive the convergence plan following the merger of regional technology departments.

Establishing an AI-enabled CTO office. This means rethinking processes and ways of working, and using AI solutions to make the office more effective.

Acting as strategic thinking partner to a CTO. This means answering key technology questions and preparing updates for the C-suite.

Supporting CTO to drive improvements and modernization of security and disaster recovery strategy.

Support a large-scale, multi-country data transformation by setting up an EU-level DMO and governance model that aligns priorities, decision-making and delivery across regions.

You bring top-tier consulting training and sharp problem-solving skills. You structure ambiguous questions, build the analysis and craft the storyline. You do this as part of a tight team, not as a solo act.

About Riverflex

Riverflex was founded in Amsterdam and London in 2018, eventually growing into a global team of consultants united by a mission to help courageous leaders drive transformative change. Today, we offer an integrated service through three service pillars: strategy and transformation consulting that Creates Change, talent services that Build Teams, and business-accelerating products that Augment Intelligence. For more information, visit www.riverflex.com.

Responsibilities

title: Technical Integrations Manager
description:
At Vio we believe booking accommodation should feel smart, fair, and effortless — never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites — so they can find the perfect place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. We cut through the noise and complexity of hotel and vacation rental booking, surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays — booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology travelers can trust.

We are looking for an experienced Technical Integrations Manager to join our Supply Integrations team and help us onboard new hotel suppliers, keep 70+ live integrations healthy, and be the technical voice our partners talk to.

Vio connects to hotel suppliers through APIs: wholesalers, bed banks, hotel chains, and connectivity platforms. The Supply Integrations squad builds and runs those integrations. You will join a second Technical Integrations Manager and a team of backend engineers, reporting to the squad's Engineering Manager. This is a hands-on technical role, not a coordination role: you own each integration in your portfolio from the first look at a partner's API documentation through implementation, QA sign-off, launch, and live operations. You decide when an integration is good enough to go live, and you are the person a partner's representative emails when something looks wrong.

What you will do:

Assess new partner APIs: read the documentation critically, make test calls, find the gaps and limitations before our engineers hit them, and document what we need from the partner.

Run technical onboarding with partners: credentials, environments, communication channels, and everything an engineer needs to start on day one.

Act as the single technical point of contact for both partners and engineers during implementation, answering questions and unblocking issues fast.

Own pre-launch quality: test search, booking, cancellation, and modification flows end to end; verify prices, availability, and tax and fee breakdowns; and sign off on go-live. No integration launches without your approval.

Watch the live portfolio: use dashboards and alerts to catch throttling, error spikes, and data-quality drift early, investigate, fix what is in reach (configuration, CMS, small pull requests), and work with partners on the rest.

Keep a per-supplier incident history, spot recurring patterns, and drive the automation and process changes that remove manual work.

Maintain the integrations roadmap with the Engineering Manager, Product, and Partnerships, and keep stakeholders informed on progress and risks.

Continuously improve our integration lifecycle checklist based on what each launch teaches us.

Who you are:

You have 3+ years in a partner-facing technical role, such as technical integrations manager, integration or solutions engineer, technical account manager, or connectivity manager, and have owned a portfolio of live API integrations.

You are comfortable in Postman or similar software, not afraid of JSON and XML payloads, and can tell from a response what is wrong with it. Logs and dashboards are tools you reach for, not something you ask engineers to check.

You read API documentation critically and can assess technical viability.

You write clearly and briefly. A partner engineer can act on your email without a call.

You manage many parallel threads without dropping follow-ups and are resourceful when a partner is slow or the documentation is incomplete.

You improve processes rather than repeat them: you have built checklists, templates, or automation that made your previous team faster.

Hotel distribution experience (rate types, board codes, merchant vs agency models) is a strong plus; we will teach it to someone with the skills above.

Why join us now?

We are one of the most innovative and fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of over 100 million unique visitors worldwide each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of power features and managed to overcome the corona crisis remarkably fast;

The mobile applications (iOS and Android) we launched in 2023 are already a big success, reaching 5 million installs with great customer reviews, as we are beginning to build Vio as the brand for value-seeking travellers worldwide;

We are a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives with a commitment and focus on the traveler above all else - and it shows in our industry-leading TrustPilot score;

We place huge importance on rewarding our employees for the value they generate by giving Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees.

Do you want to know if Vio is the right place for you? Find out by reading about the attitude that thrives at Vio.

What we offer:

Plenty of chances to learn and grow within an open, diverse culture which promotes knowledge sharing, trust and transparency;

A great compensation package, perks and benefits (including significant stock appreciation rights);

Flexible time off (take as many holidays as you need) and a chance to work remotely;

You will be part of a highly international team that enjoys working, eating and playing together in one of the best office locations in Amsterdam;

We value good food and offer catered lunches from various cuisines, great coffee, and the occasional barbecue in our garden;

We enjoy getting together to celebrate our wins with company events in Amsterdam and abroad;

A budget for your dream home office;

Access to free mental health support via OpenUp.

title: Staff Data Scientist, Trust & Safety
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

You'll join Vinted's Trust & Safety domain, whose mission is to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. Across several detection, moderation and sanctioning teams, we run a growing set of machine learning models, rule engines, and LLM agents. They score every new listing, account and message at Vinted's scale, and many of them act on members automatically.

We're looking for a Staff Data Scientist to shape the architecture and effectiveness of our detection systems as a whole. You'll tackle problems that individual teams cannot solve independently: how to maximize detection coverage, combine different models into coherent risk decisions, and allocate computational resources where they reduce the most harm. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with scope across Trust & Safety and Security domains. You'll set technical direction, challenge existing approaches, prototype solutions and work with teams to bring them into production.

It's an opportunity to shape how a large-scale, increasingly AI-driven safety system is built, evaluated and improved.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Design the end-to-end ML architecture for detection, risk scoring, routing and decision-making.
  • Develop cost-efficient, layered inference strategies that combine broad, low-latency screening with deeper, more expensive analysis where it adds the most value.
  • Establish approaches to continuous risk assessment across the member lifecycle, from registration and listing creation to ongoing activity.
  • Define how we measure end-to-end detection effectiveness, including precision, coverage, missed harm and computational cost. Use these measurements to identify the highest-impact improvements.
  • Turn siloed, team-level models into a coherent, calibrated detection system by addressing the technical and organisational barriers that lead to local optimisation.
  • Identify and close detection coverage gaps, ensuring that relevant signals and outcomes are available for evaluation, diagnosis and continuous improvement.
  • Set shared technical standards and architectural direction across teams, working with engineering and data science leaders to translate them into production systems.
  • Prototype critical components, test architectural assumptions empirically and build reference implementations that teams can scale.
  • Explain complex ML trade-offs to senior technical and business leaders as clear choices about harm reduction, cost, and engineering investment.

About you 

  • Have 8+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or a similar role, including significant time owning production models or model evaluation at scale.
  • Have led cross-team technical work without formal authority, and you're comfortable setting standards that other teams adopt.
  • Have deep expertise in statistical inference and experimentation: A/B testing, measuring precision and recall under imperfect or biased labels, sampling for ground truth, and causal reasoning.
  • Understand the ML lifecycle in production: evaluation, threshold setting, retraining, drift, feature stores and monitoring.
  • Have hands-on experience evaluating LLM-based systems, or a strong interest in building rigorous methods for them.
  • Are highly proficient in SQL and Python and comfortable working in a modern data stack (e.g. BigQuery, dbt).
  • Can turn messy, cross-system problems into a clear plan, and can explain trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
  • Are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  • Nice to have: experience in Trust & Safety, fraud prevention, content moderation, or risk management.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:
€107.000—€144.800 EUR

title: Deployed Engineering Manager, Northern Europe & DACH
description:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

About The Role

As the Deployed Engineering Manager for Northern Europe, you will lead a team of deployed engineers from our hub in Amsterdam, working with our customers across DACH and Benelux. You'll help build and shape the team, grow the people in it and make sure our customers get the technical partnership they need to build and run great agents in production. This is an opportunity to have outsized impact at a company shaping the future of AI-powered software.

DEs work alongside our sales team to help our prospects and customers build reliable, scalable agents for their business using our suite of products: LangChain, LangGraph, Deep Agents and LangSmith. The team focuses on pre-sales efforts, but stays on accounts to not only close new business but also to make our customers wildly successful.

Your first job is your people. You will support great deployed engineers, ramp them quickly, coach them through live customer work and build a team where they do the best work of their careers. You'll stay close enough to the technology and to our customers to be credible with both: unblocking your team on hard engagements and stepping in on the region's most important opportunities.

You will report to the Director of Deployed Engineering, EMEA and partner closely with LangChain's sales leaders covering DACH and Benelux, with shared ownership of regional outcomes.

This role is mostly people leadership, with real customer engagement and revenue accountability alongside it. As part of the EMEA deployed engineering leadership team, you'll also bring what you learn back into the playbooks, processes and standards we use globally.

What You'll Do:

Grow the DACH/Benelux DE team: support recruiting, interviewing and closing candidates as the team grows and raise the bar with every hire.

Onboard and ramp new DEs quickly, with a clear definition of what "ramped" looks like and the support to get each person there.

Coach your team through live customer work: join calls, review architectures and proofs of value to provide direct, specific feedback that makes people better.

Own performance management: set clear expectations, recognise great work and address underperformance early and fairly.

Run the team's operating rhythm: account coverage, capacity and load balancing, deal and engagement reviews and the regional cadence with sales.

Partner with sales leadership in DACH and the Benelux on account strategy, coverage and technical win plans, with shared accountability for revenue outcomes and customer success.

Bring regional insight to the global DE team: what's working with customers in the region, product feedback and contributions to shared playbooks.

Develop future leaders, growing the senior DEs who will lead the next teams in the region.

How to be successful in the role:

7+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, engineering, or similar customer-facing technical roles at a dev tools, AI, or infrastructure company.

2+ years managing customer-facing engineers, including hiring, coaching and performance management.

A track record of developing people: engineers you hired and grew who went on to bigger scope or roles.

Technical credibility with your team and your customers: you're not a stranger to Python, and are well-versed in software engineering, platform engineering and solutions architecture. Hands-on experience building with LLMs or agents is a strong plus.

Experience working with or selling to developers and engineering-led buyers and an understanding of how enterprises in the region evaluate and buy (procurement, data protection, hosting and sovereignty requirements).

Exceptional communication and technical storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for customers and coach others to do the same.

A bias for action, comfort with ambiguity and a consistently high bar for excellence.

Fluent English; German strongly preferred.

Must be available to work in Amsterdam, with regular travel across the region.

Compensation Philosophy:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

description:
Your Role in Our Story: 

 

As a Senior Recruiter at ACT, you will attract and hire commercial talent, primarily -and not alone- for our Front Office teams. You will manage the recruitment process from intake to offer, working closely with hiring managers to understand their business, challenge requirements and turn hiring needs into effective recruitment strategies.

You understand our markets and what motivates people working in environmental commodities, energy and trading. You use this knowledge to identify talent, build relationships and give practical advice on how to attract the right candidates.

 

  • Own the full recruitment cycle, primarily for Front Office positions, including sales, trading and business development.

  • Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, agree on selection criteria and keep recruitment moving.

  • Proactively source and engage candidates, building talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.

  • Bring market knowledge into hiring discussions, advising on talent availability, competitor activity and candidate expectations.

  • Conduct thorough interviews and support objective, consistent hiring decisions.

  • Deliver a positive candidate experience through clear communication, timely feedback and careful follow-up.

  • Keep Greenhouse accurate and up to date, using recruitment data to identify bottlenecks and improve results.

  • Work closely with fellow recruiters, HR and Employer Branding, sharing knowledge and contributing to team priorities.

 

Your Expertise: 

To be successful in this role, we are looking for candidates with the following qualifications and attributes:

  • 3–5 years of recruitment experience, with a strong track record of hiring for commercial or Front Office positions.

  • Knowledge of environmental commodities, energy, trading or closely related financial and commodity markets.

  • Strong sourcing skills and experience engaging passive candidates in competitive international markets.

  • Confidence working with hiring managers, offering practical advice and respectfully challenging assumptions.

  • An eager, proactive approach: you take initiative, spot opportunities and follow through.

  • A collaborative mindset: you share insights, support colleagues and take responsibility for team results.

  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage several vacancies and changing priorities.

  • Experience using an ATS, preferably Greenhouse, and an interest in applying recruitment technology and AI effectively.

  • Excellent communication skills in English and the ability to connect with people across different cultures and backgrounds.

 

If you meet these criteria and are ready to contribute your expertise to a dynamic and challenging environment, we encourage you to apply.

title: HR Medewerker Senior (m/v/x)
description:
Een ervaren HR-professional die graag complexe HR-vraagstukken oppakt, kennis deelt, overzicht houdt en bijdraagt aan een goede HR-dienstverlening.

Voor onze volop in beweging zijnde HR administratie/HR-support team zoeken we een ervaren HR-professional die goed thuis is in HR operatie en graag meedenkt over uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor collega’s en steekt zelf graag de handen uit de mouwen. Met een proactieve blik kijk je verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk en zie je kansen om processen te verbeteren. Herken jij jezelf hierin en bouw je graag mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze afdeling? Solliciteer dan snel!

Wat ga je doen?

Jij zorgt er samen met je hr-collega’s voor dat de basis van onze HR-administratie op orde is, maar jouw meerwaarde zit vooral in het behandelen van complexere operationele HR-vraagstukken, het ondersteunen van HR collega’s en het samen met de teamleider verder ontwikkelen van onze dienstverlening. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor het HR-team en een vertrouwd aanspreekpunt voor NLR medewerkers en HR-adviseurs.

Als senior HR medewerker heb je een veelzijdige rol waarin HR-administratie, dienstverlening, inhoudelijke expertise en procesverbetering samenkomen. Jouw HR collega’s houden zich bezig met de dagelijkse HR-processen, waarbij jij je richt op vooral vraagstukken die meer ervaring, inzicht en zelfstandigheid vragen. Daarnaast deel je actief je kennis met collega's, denk je mee over een slimme verdeling van het werk en draag je bij aan de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening.

Jouw werkzaamheden in het kort:

Vraagbaak voor het HR-team: je behandelt tweedelijns HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR processen, detachering, inleen en deelt je kennis en ondersteunt collega’s.

Samenwerken met de teamleider HR: je werkt aan HR-projecten, verbetert processen en bewaakt de voortgang, met name bij piekmomenten.

Ondersteunen van de HR Adviseurs en managers: je helpt bij operationele HR-vraagstukken en zorgt voor een goede aansluiting tussen HR-processen en de praktijk.

Zorgen voor goede HR-dienstverlening: je bewaakt de kwaliteit van de HR-administratie en hebt contact met medewerkers. Je draagt bij aan een juiste en tijdige verwerking van personeelsgegevens en ondersteunt waar nodig bij eerstelijnsvragen.

Bouwen aan de HR-afdeling: je signaleert knelpunten, denkt mee over praktische/operationele verbeteringen, helpt werkprocessen te uniformeren en deelt je kennis met collega's.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die senioriteit laat zien in zowel gedrag als HR-kennis. Je hoeft niet alles te weten, maar je hebt een stevige basis, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en weet wanneer je zelfstandig kunt handelen en wanneer afstemming nodig is. First time right is het devies, kwalitatieve en zorgvuldige HR administratie en dienstverlening vinden wij belangrijk.

Verder breng je mee:

Afgeronde opleiding in HRM of een vergelijkbare richting met minimaal vijf jaar relevante ervaring binnen HR, bij voorkeur in een brede HR-administratieve functie en kennis van AFAS.

Je hebt gedegen kennis van HR administratie en support en ervaring met het zelfstandig behandelen van HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden en personeelsregelingen.

Je bent communicatief sterk, toegankelijk en klantgericht. Je maakt gemakkelijk contact met medewerkers en collega’s op verschillende niveaus.

Je werkt graag samen, durft je eigen perspectief in te brengen en staat open voor feedback en andere inzichten.

Je werkt nauwkeurig, hebt oog voor details en houdt overzicht en helpt collega’s om werkzaamheden goed en tijdig af te ronden.

Je bent gewend en krijgt er energie van om in een snel groeiende en veranderende organisatie te werken.

Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk op C1 niveau.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightechomgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. raw.title: HR Medewerker Senior (m/v/x)
raw.description:
Een ervaren HR-professional die graag complexe HR-vraagstukken oppakt, kennis deelt, overzicht houdt en bijdraagt aan een goede HR-dienstverlening.

Voor onze volop in beweging zijnde HR administratie/HR-support team zoeken we een ervaren HR-professional die goed thuis is in HR operatie en graag meedenkt over uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor collega’s en steekt zelf graag de handen uit de mouwen. Met een proactieve blik kijk je verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk en zie je kansen om processen te verbeteren. Herken jij jezelf hierin en bouw je graag mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze afdeling? Solliciteer dan snel!

Wat ga je doen?

Jij zorgt er samen met je hr-collega’s voor dat de basis van onze HR-administratie op orde is, maar jouw meerwaarde zit vooral in het behandelen van complexere operationele HR-vraagstukken, het ondersteunen van HR collega’s en het samen met de teamleider verder ontwikkelen van onze dienstverlening. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor het HR-team en een vertrouwd aanspreekpunt voor NLR medewerkers en HR-adviseurs.

Als senior HR medewerker heb je een veelzijdige rol waarin HR-administratie, dienstverlening, inhoudelijke expertise en procesverbetering samenkomen. Jouw HR collega’s houden zich bezig met de dagelijkse HR-processen, waarbij jij je richt op vooral vraagstukken die meer ervaring, inzicht en zelfstandigheid vragen. Daarnaast deel je actief je kennis met collega's, denk je mee over een slimme verdeling van het werk en draag je bij aan de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening.

Jouw werkzaamheden in het kort:

  • Vraagbaak voor het HR-team: je behandelt tweedelijns HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR processen, detachering, inleen en deelt je kennis en ondersteunt collega’s.

title: Marketing Communication Intern (Healthcare Analytics)
description:
Our mission

We are LOGEX, a company dedicated to improving healthcare through advanced data analytics. Our tools transform data into actionable insights that help decision-makers in healthcare navigate the sensitive balancing act of affordability, accessibility and quality of care. Trust and privacy are fundamental to our work, ensuring reliable and secure data for confident healthcare decisions. As Marketing Communication Intern, you will join LOGEX’s International Marketing team during an exciting scale-up phase. We are here to communicate our expertise in a proactive way to our European audiences and we need your enthusiasm and creativity to contribute to this goal.

Your impact and responsibilities

Content Creation & Copywriting: Support the development of blogs, website content, newsletters and social media posts. You will work alongside experienced marketing and communications professionals who will help define the brief, provide guidance during content creation and review all deliverables before publication. This is an ideal opportunity to develop professional writing and communication skills in a supportive environment.

Visual Content Development: Create and adapt visuals for social posts, presentations and marketing materials. While major designs are reviewed by senior colleagues, you have a good eye for layout, branding and visual communication.

Project Management: With your structured approach to tasks, you help keep content projects moving forward with punctuality and precision.

Analytics & Reporting: Use your analytical skills to monitor and report on the performance of social media, website and email campaigns.

Collaboration: Work closely with colleagues across Marketing, Sales and local market teams to support a wide range of communication initiatives.

Your team

Join a diverse team of field marketers, digital marketers and communication professionals, located in the Netherlands and Germany.

Your profile

Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Communication, Marketing or a related field.

A natural curiosity and are eager to learn.

Strong writing skills and an interest in content creation and social media.

Have an eye for design.

Have good communication and interpersonal skills and you enjoy collaborating with others.

Have a hands-on mentality and a proactive, solution-oriented approach.

Are fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch, German or other languages is a plus.

Are available for a minimum of 5 consecutive months.

Why LOGEX?

We offer an internship allowance of €500 per month.

An excellent compensation package (salary, holiday allowance, NS Business Card, phone and internet allowance)

25 vacation days (based on full-time employment) to recharge, with the option to purchase additional days

An informal working environment with motivated colleagues

The possibility to work in a hybrid setup

A laptop and everything you need to set up a comfortable and ergonomic home office

Personal and professional development opportunities through our LOGEX Academy

Access to our mental health partner, OpenUp

Regular after-work drinks and many more social events

Contact us!

You can apply via the button below and upload your CV. For more information, or in case you have any
questions, you can contact Wesley Schreuder at

Our company is dedicated to building a workplace that promotes equity, diversity, and inclusion, and we believe that a diverse workforce is essential to our success. As we strive to create a workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, regardless of their race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic, we encourage everyone to apply.

title: Product Designer
description:
Software is not just vital but a strategic cornerstone of our operations. We’re looking for a Product Designer to set the cross-application UX direction for our commercial software - from pharma cold-chain visibility that helps temperature-sensitive medicines move safely around the world, to ULD tracking for airlines. You’ll define a consistent, high-quality experience across our modules and applications and support our specialised designers in bringing that experience to life, while remaining hands-on in discovery, from the first user conversation through to the final UX.

📍 Location: We are open to candidates based anywhere within the UK, Spain, and the Netherlands, with remote working available within these countries. Hybrid option available in the Netherlands.

Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions.

Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide.

Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains.

Why SkyCell?

🌱 Purpose-Driven Work: Make a real difference by contributing to a more sustainable future in global logistics and healthcare.

🚀 Innovation at Heart: Work with cutting-edge technology and be at the forefront of supply chain innovation.

🌎 Stronger together: Join a supportive team of talented individuals from over 40 countries, where we work together every step of the way.

💡 Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in our people – continuous learning and development are key pillars of SkyCell.

🏆 Award-Winning Culture: Join a workplace recognized for its commitment to excellence with a ‘Great Place to work’ award, as well as a Platinum Ecovadis rating highlighting our sustainability and employee well-being.

What You'll Do:

A dedicated framework team owns our Design System and Design Guidelines, while embedded designers craft the screens and flows within each product module. Your role is to set the overall direction for the experience they design towards — including experience principles, end-to-end journeys and measurable outcomes that help multiple modules feel like one product.

You will:

Lead discovery end-to-end, including user research and interviews, journey mapping, jobs-to-be-done, pain points and opportunities, and translate research into a shared foundation for UX and product decisions

Create wireframes, mock-ups and prototypes hands-on using Figma and/or code to explore and test concepts during discovery, and run evaluative tests with users and engineers

Define the cross-application UX vision, design principles and success metrics together with Product and Marketing

Support and align our specialised designers - framework and embedded - around a consistent experience across modules and applications

Communicate UX principles and investment priorities to senior leadership, demonstrating the value and potential impact of UX-related roadmap items

Maintain the UX roadmap and prioritise pattern and design investments with the framework team

Produce high-level experience flows and service blueprints that connect journeys across applications and domains

Review Design System and module deliverables for alignment with experience strategy and brand

Support embedded designers from discovery through to delivery by co-framing problems, reviewing flows against the cross-application blueprint and ensuring continuity across user journeys

Set KPIs and use analytics, user research, A/B tests and competitive analysis to inform and refine design decisions

Promote a UX culture centred on user needs, inclusive design and accessibility standards such as WCAG across the organisation

Collaborate with Marketing on tone, terminology and brand consistency across products

What You'll Bring:

Degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Experience as a senior or lead product designer working on complex B2B software, ideally within supply chain, logistics, aviation/air cargo or pharma

Strong experience leading discovery, from understanding user needs through research and prototyping to defining and refining UX solutions

Advanced proficiency in Figma, with experience creating and iterating wireframes, mock-ups and prototypes

Experience bringing together multiple designers, including without formal reporting lines, to create a consistent experience across products or modules

Ability to communicate UX strategy, priorities and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders

Working knowledge of design systems and accessibility standards such as WCAG; experience partnering with design system teams is an advantage

Experience designing for multiple user groups, such as pharma quality/logistics teams and airline cargo operations, is beneficial

If you don’t meet every requirement but bring relevant experience and skills, we’d still like to hear from you.

What's In It For You?

⚡ Flexibility & Balance: Flexible working hours and work-life balance allow you to tailor work to fit your life.

🌟 Recognition & Growth: Opportunities for career advancement in a company that values your contributions.

🌍 Flexible ways of working: Our global teams work across our offices in Zurich, Zug, Hyderabad and Basel, with a mix of on-site, hybrid and remote working. Role-specific locations and working arrangements are detailed above.

🎉 Company-wide Events: Join us for company events to celebrate successes, build teams, and share our vision. Plus, new joiners experience SkyWeek, our immersive onboarding program.

👶 Generous Maternity & Paternity Leave: Support for new parents with competitive maternity and paternity leave.

🏖️ Annual Leave & Bank Holidays: Enjoy a generous annual leave package, plus local bank holidays to recharge and unwind.

Ready to Make an Impact?

We’re not just offering a job; we’re offering a chance to be part of something bigger. At SkyCell, you’ll help build a future where pharmaceutical delivery is efficient, sustainable, and transformative.

Stay Connected with SkyCell

Visit http://www.skycell.ch and explore #WeAreSkyCell on LinkedIn

How to Apply

Simply click ‘apply for this job’ below! We can’t wait to meet you and discuss how you can contribute to our mission! Please note, we are unable to consider applications sent to us via email.

If you have any questions, you can contact our Talent Team (

For this position, if you are not located in, or able to relocate (without sponsorship) to one of the advertised locations, your application cannot be considered.

description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a Mobile UI Designer to create elegant, intuitive and high-performing mobile experiences for BJAK's AI Neobank and financial products.

This role is for someone who loves designing mobile interfaces that feel effortless, responsive and visually refined. You'll work alongside engineers and product managers to create experiences used daily by millions of users.

What You'll Own

Design beautiful and intuitive interfaces for iOS and Android applications.

Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes and production-ready UI.

Design mobile experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and financial services.

Build and maintain mobile design systems and reusable components.

Work closely with developers to ensure pixel-perfect implementation.

Optimize interfaces for usability, accessibility and platform guidelines.

Iterate designs using analytics, usability findings and product feedback.

Ensure consistency across different devices, screen sizes and operating systems.

What We're Looking For

2+ years of experience designing mobile applications.

Strong portfolio showcasing high-quality mobile UI work.

Expert proficiency in Figma and interactive prototyping.

Deep understanding of iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Android Material Design.

Strong understanding of mobile usability, responsive layouts and interaction design.

Excellent attention to typography, spacing, colour and visual hierarchy.

Ability to simplify complex financial workflows into clean mobile experiences.

Portfolio is required.

Design Stack

Figma

FigJam

Design Systems

Auto Layout

Interactive Prototyping

iOS Human Interface Guidelines

Material Design

The Kind of Builder We Want

Thinks mobile-first.

Obsesses over visual polish and interaction quality.

Notices small UI inconsistencies before users do.

Cares about accessibility, responsiveness and performance.

Collaborates closely with engineers to deliver high-quality products.

Takes pride in shipping pixel-perfect interfaces.

This Role Is Not For

Designers whose experience is primarily marketing or branding.

People who design without considering real user behaviour.

Designers unfamiliar with mobile platform conventions.

Individuals who struggle to collaborate with engineers.

Candidates who cannot explain the rationale behind their design decisions.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Netherlands. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Netherlands.

Language

English is our primary working language across our global teams. Strong English communication skills are required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

Portfolio review

Practical design task (if applicable)

Role-specific interview

CEO / Final interview

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments promptly will be prioritized.

title: Senior Integration Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Integration Software Engineer to bring our algorithms and software backend together into reliable, operational solutions, and to take technical ownership of how our software is integrated.

Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with an Integration Software Engineer who enjoys building clean, reliable interfaces between components and working where software meets hardware, and who takes ownership of making complex systems work together end to end.

As a Senior Integration Software Engineer, you will support their integration into operational systems: connecting algorithms to the backend through robust APIs, building data connectors, health reporting and control software, and defining and verifying integrations with Command and Control (C2) systems.

You will work closely with domain experts in acoustics, signal processing and machine learning, and with the software engineering team, and hands-on with our monitoring systems at our headquarters and production facility. You will also take technical ownership of work delivered by internal and external engineers and set the standard for good engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

Lead software integration engineering for our underwater acoustic sensing systems, ensuring frontend and backend components, algorithms, and hardware systems work together reliably.

Integrate the algorithmic toolbox with our system backends, turning research code into maintainable, versioned and deployable software components.

Implement data interfaces for our real-time sonar processing pipeline, to ingest multiple sensors (acoustic, heading, temperature, pressure, etc.) from internal and external data acquisition systems. Implement health reporting, logging and monitoring, so that the status and performance of software and system components is visible and actionable.

Develop the software control layer for our sensing systems and their hardware components, including APIs for commanding, state handling, error handling and recovery.

Implement, align and verify software integrations with external partners and C2 systems, being directly involved in defining interfaces, maintaining interface specifications and running joint integration tests.

Testing & debugging: Develop system-level test suites and CI/CD pipelines, diagnose communication failures, and ensure secure, reliable data transfers as the toolbox and backends evolve.

Address performance, latency and scalability of the integrated pipeline, together with algorithm and backend developers.

Work hands-on with integrated software and hardware systems at our headquarters and production facility, with occasional on-site visits.

Review the work of junior engineers and external development partners in depth, promote good practices for packaging, versioning and release, and share integration knowledge across the team.

Why Join Us?

Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

Competitive salary and benefits package.

Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

Fresh team lunches provided 5 times/week.

Qualifications:

BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.

Significant professional experience in software engineering, with a focus on system integration, backend or platform development.

Extensive experience developing production software in Python, including packaging, testing, dependency management and writing maintainable, well-structured code.

Familiarity with systems programming in C++, or Rust, for the purpose of extending Python for more performance or hardware control.

Proven experience designing and implementing APIs and messaging interfaces (e.g. MQTT, WebSocket) and data serialization (e.g. protobuf).

Experience with realtime data pipelines, and handling high-throughput or streaming data.

Experience with Docker, CI/CD and automated testing in a Linux environment.

Experience working with software that interacts with physical systems, and comfort doing hands-on integration and troubleshooting in a lab or production environment.

Experience reviewing code and designs, mentoring junior engineers, and setting engineering standards.

An outcome-focused mindset, with the ability to own a problem end to end or break it down for others.

Ability to work with algorithm developers and translate research code into robust, maintainable software.

Flexible and proactive in taking on what needs to be addressed, and comfortable in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

Good communication skills in English and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external partners.

Willingness to work primarily from our Amsterdam headquarters, as parts of the role involve classified information and physical systems.

Nice to Have:

Knowledge of defense systems or defense standards (e.g. NATO STANAGs, MIL-STD), for example in naval, maritime security or surveillance systems.

Experience with the scientific Python stack (e.g. NumPy, SciPy) or integrating signal processing or ML models into production systems.

Experience developing software interfaces for controlling instruments or devices.

Experience with other messaging or streaming frameworks (e.g. Kafka, ZeroMQ, DDS).

Familiarity with observability tooling.

Security & Compliance:

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer to develop and deploy machine learning solutions for real-world underwater acoustic sensing systems.

Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing cutting-edge fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments, including underwater acoustics, offshore energy, and defense applications. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with a Senior AI/ML Engineer who combines strong mathematical foundations with applied machine learning expertise to enhance the next generation of intelligent acoustic sensing solutions.

Role Overview:

As a Senior AI/ML Engineer, you will apply machine learning to real-world underwater acoustic sensing challenges using Optics11’s fiber-optic technology platforms. You will work closely with acoustics engineers, signal-processing specialists, and embedded/software teams to develop robust ML components that integrate seamlessly into operational systems.

This role requires a strong foundation in signal processing, applied mathematics, and statistics, and the ability to combine physics-based acoustic algorithms with data-driven ML methods.

Responsibilities:

Develop and implement machine learning solutions for underwater acoustic sensing use cases, including detection, classification, localization and anomaly monitoring within fiber-optic sensing systems.

Select and adapt modelling approaches based on data availability, operational constraints and system requirements.

Apply strong foundations in applied mathematics, statistics and signal processing (e.g., beamforming, spectral analysis, detection pipelines) and integrate these with modern data-driven ML techniques.

Design, train, evaluate and benchmark AI/ML models, ensuring robustness, generalization and deployment readiness.

Validate models rigorously across laboratory experiments and offshore field datasets, with clear performance tracking and reproducible experimentation.

Analyze and interpret large-scale experimental and real-world fiber-optic sensing datasets, contributing to scalable workflows for data preparation, labelling and augmentation.

Support technical trade-offs between accuracy, interpretability, latency and real-time or embedded constraints.

Collaborate closely with acoustics engineers, signal processing specialists, software and embedded teams to integrate ML components into operational acoustic sensing pipelines.

Translate complex AI/ML results into clear technical insights that inform system-level engineering decisions.

Contribute to strong engineering practices, including version-controlled experiments, documentation, traceability, validation standards and continuous improvement of ML components.

Stay informed about advances in AI/ML for time-series analysis, sensor fusion and signal-informed learning, and prototype promising approaches that complement the broader technology stack.

What's in it for you?

Competitive salary .

Innovative high-tech, international organization .

The opportunity to work in a cross-functional and interdisciplinary environment .

A lot to learn and to develop, we stimulate personal development .

Lunches.

Required Qualifications

MSc in Machine Learning, Signal Processing, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, or a related field.

Strong foundation in linear algebra, probability, statistics, and signal processing.

Proven experience applying AI/ML methods to time-series or sensor data, including techniques such as: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) (e.g., LSTMs), Transformer-based architectures for time-series learning.

Supervised and unsupervised learning approaches for detection and classification.

Hands-on experience with model training, evaluation, and validation in applied settings.

Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX).

Ability to work in an applied R&D environment with experimental and field data, balancing model performance with real-world constraints.

Nice to Have

Experience with underwater acoustics, sonar, or beamforming-related applications.

Knowledge of embedded or real-time deployment constraints.

Experience with sensor fusion, self-supervised learning, or physics-informed ML.

Familiarity with offshore, defense, or industrial monitoring domains.

Familiarity with structured ML development processes such as CRISP-ML(Q) or similar lifecycle and quality frameworks.

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. title: Senior Customer Solutions Engineer
description:
Life at Plume

At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale.

We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data.

With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day.

Plume is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Customer Solutions Engineer to join our dynamic team. As a key technical advisor, you'll work directly with Internet Service Providers (ISPs), acting as the bridge between their business needs and our cutting-edge solutions. You'll play a crucial role in the sales process, from initial discovery to successful deployment, ensuring our partners achieve maximum value from our products.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a technically adept individual with a passion for networking, cloud, and AI who thrives in a customer-facing role.

Responsibilities

Technical Trusted Advisor: Engage with ISPs to deeply understand their technical and business requirements, and then effectively demonstrate how Plume's solutions can meet and exceed those needs.
Product Demos & Trials: Conduct compelling product demonstrations and manage complex proof-of-concept (PoC) and field trials, showcasing the tangible benefits of Plume's technology.
System Integration: Collaborate with our internal Customer Engineering, Product Management, and Operational teams to understand and deliver Plume's solutions within a customer's ecosystem. You'll work to integrate our solutions into their existing BSS/OSS, CRM, ticketing, and AI platforms using APIs and other integration methods.
Sales Enablement: Work closely with the sales organization to drive revenue, achieve sales quotas, and contribute to the overall growth of the business.
Presentations & Events: Prepare and deliver high-impact presentations, including Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and represent Plume at industry events and conferences.
Product Development Input: Provide valuable feedback to our product and engineering teams based on customer requirements and market trends, helping to inform the development of new features and solutions.
Technical Support: Offer prompt local and remote technical support for PoCs, lab trials, and deployment ramp-ups, ensuring a smooth and successful customer journey.
Industry Expertise: Continuously research and stay up-to-date on the latest industry standards and emerging technologies in networking, cloud architectures, and AI.

Experience & Qualifications

Hands-on Technical Experience: Strong hands-on experience in the configuration and deployment of software and hardware, including Wi-Fi, networking equipment, and cloud services. A fundamental understanding of cloud architectures and AI principles is essential. Deep understanding and knowledge of Residential and SMB Gateways is a big plus.
ISP SaaS Experience: Proven experience working with ISPs to deploy large-scale SaaS network solutions to millions of endpoints.
Communication & Collaboration: A track record of developing and maintaining professional, cooperative relationships with all levels of staff and customers.
Networking & Cloud Certifications: Relevant certifications such as CWNA, CCNA, or AWS Solutions Architect are highly preferred.
Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues in a fast-paced environment.

Qualification Requirements

Experience: 5+ years of related experience working with network, security, SaaS, and/or AI industries.
Education: A BS/BA degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience.
Industry Knowledge: In-depth industry knowledge and a strong understanding of SDN and wireless technologies, solutions, and product offerings are preferred.
Communication Skills: Advanced written and oral communication skills.
Travel: Ability to travel >70% of the time.

Location/Language: This is a remote position. Candidates must be based in United Kingdom or Netherlands and be fluent in English.

About Plume

As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM.

Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume's software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture.

Plume is an equal opportunity workplace that maintains a continuing policy of nondiscrimination in all employment practices and decisions, ensuring equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth or related individual conditions, medical conditions (as defined by state law), military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

title: HR Operations Specialist
description:
Your next mission

Power our growing crew from day one. Keep our people operations running sharp – so every colleague feels supported, valued, and ready to aim high.

As our HR Operations Specialist, you keep the operational heartbeat of Robin Radar steady and reliable. You guide colleagues and managers through everyday questions while managing key processes from onboarding to payroll and pensions. Working alongside the Head of HR, you turn complex regulations into clear, smooth procedures that support our international team. You play a vital part in making our workplace an environment where bright minds thrive[cite: 1, 3].

What you'll do

People operations and lifecycle management: Oversee essential lifecycle processes including contract management, visa and 30% ruling applications, leaves, and absenteeism. Ensure policies are followed while advising on necessary updates.

HR systems and digital tools: Maintain and control our core systems, including HiBob, Odoo, and Officevibe. Act as the primary go-to specialist for system knowledge and drive continuous platform improvements.

Onboarding and colleague support: Organise and host our monthly onboarding days to welcome new joiners. Deliver clear guidance to colleagues and managers on day-to-day queries with a customer-focused approach.

External partnerships and compliance: Act as the direct point of contact for external payroll, pension, occupational health, and legal partners. Track changes in labour law to keep our personnel policies and handbook up to date.

HR analytics and projects: Develop meaningful HR reports and analytics to inform people decisions. Lead and support projects, from implementing new systems to rolling out fresh policies.

What you bring

BA/MSc or HBO in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field

Over 5 years of experience, ideally in international/multicultural settings

Knowledge of Dutch employment law with a focus on migrant employment requirements

Familiarity with HR systems like HiBob is a plus

Fluent in both English and Dutch

Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

Team player with the ability to work independently

Assertive and hands-on approach

Proactive mindset with a focus on driving improvements

Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate across diverse cultures and backgrounds

What we offer

Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company;

Comprehensive pension plan;

Commuting allowance;

30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days);

Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications;

High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role

An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks!

Robin Radar is a defence technology leader in detecting, tracking and classifying drones and other small airborne objects. Our radars and software protect military sites, borders and critical infrastructure from drone threats, and also help prevent bird strikes in aviation and reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife. Our work shows up at defence and security sites, airports and wind farms around the world.

We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH.

Want to work on next-level radar tech, solve real problems, and never have to pretend your job has meaning? You'll fit right in – we're saving you a seat.

title: Junior Quantum Design Engineer
description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As a Junior Quantum Design Engineer, you will take on a vital, hands-on responsibility in creating our next-generation quantum processors. Your core focus will be centred on the layout, simulation, and verification of quantum processor components and superconducting circuits. Collaborating directly with other design engineers alongside cross-functional R&D teams spanning fabrication, measurement, and system integration, you will transform conceptual device architectures into production-ready designs while closing the feedback loop between theoretical design intent and empirical performance. Your work will be essential as we scale to increasingly complex systems and deliver on the promise of quantum computing.

What you'll be doing

Design and lay out superconducting circuit components and test structures, such as resonators, qubits, and control lines.

Perform electromagnetic and circuit simulations to predict device parameters and optimise designs.

Contribute to design verification, including design-rule checks and review of layouts against fabrication process constraints.

Compare simulation results with measurement data to validate design models and feed learnings back into future design iterations.

Help develop and maintain design tooling, automated layout scripts, and documentation to make our design flow faster and more robust.

Your Profile

MSc in Physics, Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a concentration in Quantum Computing or Quantum Technology (PhD is a plus).

Understanding of microwave engineering, circuit theory, or superconducting devices, gained through coursework, a thesis project, or an internship.

Experience with EM simulation tools (e.g. HFSS, Q3D, Sonnet) and layout tools (e.g. KLayout, Qiskit Metal).

Python skills for design automation, simulation workflows, or data analysis.

Detail-oriented mindset with a structured approach to design, verification, and documentation.

Eagerness to learn, take ownership, and grow within a fast-moving, multidisciplinary team.

Familiarity with superconducting qubits, circuit quantisation, or cleanroom fabrication processes is a plus.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.
