title: Product Manager
description:
Product Manager

Location: UK (remote)

Job Description

About Us

Reachdesk is the first truly end-to-end global SaaS gifting and swag platform, helping B2B companies create meaningful connections with prospects, customers, and employees, while driving measurable ROI.

We believe gifting is more than just a transaction: it’s about building genuine human connections that fuel business growth. Whether it’s engaging prospects, celebrating customers, or recognizing employees, our platform makes it easy to deliver personalized gifts, branded swag, and unforgettable event & brand experiences at scale through automated sourcing, storage, and global delivery.

Trusted by many of the most recognized names in technology and SaaS, Reachdesk integrates effortlessly with marketing, sales, and HRIS tech stacks and is powered by our world-class team across New York, London, and Lisbon.

We’re growing, and we’re currently looking for a Product Manager to join us.

 

About the Role

As a Product Manager at Reachdesk, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the Reachdesk Platform. You will be accountable for turning complex customer and business problems into software products that deliver measurable impact.

Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you’ll lead product initiatives end-to-end,  from identifying and deeply understanding the right problems to solve, through discovery and delivery, to launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy, proactively building context across customers, the market, internal stakeholders, data, and technology to understand what Reachdesk needs to achieve its goals. You’ll also make sound decisions when the path forward isn’t obvious.

You’ll partner closely with Engineering and Design and work across the wider business to create alignment, communicate decisions clearly, and ensure what we build is successfully launched, adopted, and delivers the outcomes we set out to achieve.

If you enjoy solving difficult problems, taking ownership, and moving comfortably between customer, technical, and business conversations, you’ll thrive in this role.

 

Responsibilities

  • Set product direction and priorities, bringing together company goals, internal stakeholder needs, customer insight, market context, data, and technical considerations to focus on the highest-impact opportunities.
  • Define problems and experiences before solutions, creating clear stories, journeys, and shared context so the Design and Engineering teams understand the problem and intended outcomes before determining the solution.
  • Lead product initiatives end-to-end, from discovery and solution definition through delivery, rollout, and iteration, partnering with Engineering to manage scope, make pragmatic trade-offs, and deliver valuable solutions at pace.
  • Make sound product decisions and trade-offs, balancing customer and business needs, commercial impact, user experience, and technical considerations while aligning the wider business on compromises, priorities, and expectations.
  • Develop product opportunities with external partners, building relationships with technology partners to uncover mutual opportunities, shape integrations, align roadmaps, and navigate the product and commercial considerations required to bring them to market.
  • Orchestrate successful launches and adoption, working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Services, Logistics, Finance, Legal, and other teams to ensure the business is ready and customers realise value from what we build.
  • Communicate with clarity throughout, ensuring leadership and teams across Reachdesk understand product decisions, progress, risks, changes, and results.

 

About you

  • You have a strong track record of owning B2B SaaS products end-to-end, from identifying the right problems through delivery, adoption, and measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • You’re a strong problem solver who gets to the root of complex problems, brings structure to ambiguity, and uses evidence and judgement to determine the right path forward.
  • You operate with independence and initiative: you seek out the customers, stakeholders, data, and context you need rather than waiting for direction, while staying anchored to Reachdesk’s goals and priorities.
  • You have strong business and commercial awareness and are curious about how the wider company operates, allowing you to understand competing needs and make pragmatic decisions beyond the boundaries of Product.
  • You’re technically fluent enough to work effectively with Engineering, understand systems, integrations, and constraints, ask the right questions, and contribute meaningfully to solution and scope decisions.
  • You’re an exceptional communicator, able to create clarity, influence decisions, surface difficult trade-offs, and adapt how you communicate across customers, engineers, leadership, and teams throughout the business.
  • You’re comfortable operating externally as well as internally, building productive relationships with technology partners, uncovering shared opportunities, influencing without authority, and navigating product, technical, and commercial conversations.
  • You have a strong sense of product and user experience, caring about the coherence and quality of the complete experience rather than whether individual requirements or features have simply been delivered.

 

The benefits

  • Competitive salary with generous stock options
  • Pension with employer contributions (NEST)
  • Affordable Private Medical Insurance, including mental health support and fast access to care
  • Flexible PTO that increases the longer you’re with us, plus extra flexibility for life’s unexpected moments
  • A genuinely collaborative culture with innovative, fun, and ambitious people

 

Reachdesk believes that a diverse team helps us achieve our mission faster, and so we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

We take this responsibility seriously!

What You'll Do:

  • Build, operate, and maintain the continually growing global network footprint of Fastly’s Edge Cloud Platform.

  • Response to significant traffic incidents and lead network incidents, resolving edge cases and failure scenarios with your expertise in IP routing, particularly BGP.

  • Write code that is performant, maintainable, clear, and concise and contribute to code reviews, improving the codebase and other team processes

  • Partner in the development and iteration of tools and automation systems that improve how we operate and build the network.

  • Innovate new methods for monitoring network performance, focusing on the end-user experience, and proactively address potential issues.

  • Continual deep-dive of performance-based analytics and close involvement with partner teams to maintain a performant global network.

  • Advocate for the operational stability of the network by identifying opportunities and partnering with engineering teams to shape their roadmaps and software solutions.

  • Mentor team members on the complexities of global routing, especially in an anycast-heavy environment.

What We're Looking For:

  • Experience in Automation and coding using languages like Python, or similar.

  • Proficiency in Tier 1 Internet service providers, Internet exchanges and cloud providers.

  • Ability to analyze internet traffic patterns across multiple dimensions using flow-based tools.

  • Experience working with alerting, monitoring and visibility tools (such as Graphite/Grafana, Prometheus, or Splunk).

  • Knowledge across cloud hosting solutions (i.e., GCP, AWS and Azure).

  • Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI / CD pipelines (ie. Git, Jenkins, Ansible).

  • Understanding of Linux/Unix systems administration and network stack optimisation.

  • Adept at knowledge sharing and creating comprehensive documentation to empower teams.

  • Able to collaborate with cross-functional teams to shape the technical roadmap, prioritizing initiatives to optimize automation tooling and the network.

We’ll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these:

  • Experience writing production-level code using VCL or GO

  • Experience in network telemetry including instrumenting infrastructure and collecting, processing, storing and analyzing data

Fastly currently embraces a largely hybrid model for most roles which allows employees flexibility to split their time between the office and home. This position may require travel as required by your role or requested by your manager.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

So, what’s the role all about?

 We are looking for a Senior  software engineer who is passionate about solving infrastructure challenges through software engineering and automation. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks that streamline cloud infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and operational processes.

You will build programmatic infrastructure solutions using Python, Jinja2, and Terraform, generating and managing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) at scale. You will also leverage Puppet for configuration management and develop PowerShell-based automation to support and optimize Windows environments.

This is a highly technical, coding-focused position. The ideal candidate is a software-minded engineer who writes clean, maintainable, and testable code every day—not just ad hoc scripts. You should be comfortable designing reusable automation components, applying software development best practices, and driving operational excellence through automation across complex cloud and hybrid environments.

How Will You Make an Impact?

  • Drive infrastructure standardization and operational excellence by designing and developing scalable automation frameworks in Python that enable consistent and repeatable deployments across cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Accelerate infrastructure provisioning by building and enhancing Terraform code-generation platforms using Python and Jinja2, enabling teams to produce validated, environment-specific infrastructure code from reusable templates.
  • Improve system reliability and compliance by developing and maintaining Puppet modules, manifests, and Hiera configurations that manage Linux and Windows environments at scale.
  • Increase operational efficiency across Windows platforms by creating robust PowerShell automation solutions for server management, Active Directory administration, and hybrid cloud integrations.
  • Simplify complex infrastructure workflows by developing internal automation tools, command-line utilities, and APIs that empower engineering teams to self-service common operational tasks.
  • Enhance the speed and safety of infrastructure delivery by integrating automation frameworks with CI/CD pipelines, enabling automated validation, testing, and deployment of infrastructure changes.
  • Improve software quality and reduce deployment risk by implementing comprehensive testing strategies for infrastructure code, including unit testing, linting, and integration testing.
  • Partner closely with cloud, platform, and application teams to identify manual processes, eliminate operational toil, and drive automation-first solutions across the organization.
  • Enable long-term scalability and maintainability by creating clear documentation, standards, and runbooks for automation frameworks and infrastructure templates.
  • Contribute to a strong engineering culture by participating in code reviews, sharing best practices, and continuously improving the quality, security, and maintainability of automation solutions.

Have you got what it takes? 

Python & Automation Development

  • 5+ years of Python development experience — not scripting, but structured, testable application code
  • Strong understanding of Python packaging, virtual environments, dependency management (pip, Poetry), and code quality tooling (pylint, black, mypy)
  • Experience building CLI tools and automation frameworks using Python (Click, Typer, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience with Jinja2 templating — building reusable, parameterised templates for configuration and infrastructure code generation
  • Experience with pytest for unit and integration testing of automation code

Terraform & IaC Code Generation

  • Strong Terraform proficiency: module design, state management, remote backends, workspaces, and dependency graphs
  • Proven experience generating Terraform HCL programmatically using Python and Jinja2 — building template-driven pipelines that produce valid, linted, plan-ready infrastructure code
  • Familiarity with Terraform tooling: tflint, tfsec, terraform-docs, Terragrunt, or Atlantis
  • Understanding of Terraform provider internals and resource lifecycle management

Puppet & Configuration Management

  • Hands-on Puppet experience: writing manifests and modules, Hiera data hierarchies, node classification, and r10k / Code Manager workflows
  • Experience managing mixed Linux and Windows environments with Puppet at scale
  • Familiarity with puppet-lint, rspec-puppet, and automated Puppet module testing pipelines
  • Understanding of Puppet Enterprise or open-source Puppet Server administration

PowerShell Scripting

  • Proficient PowerShell scripting for Windows Server administration, task automation, and hybrid cloud integrations (AWS Tools for PowerShell, Azure PowerShell)
  • Experience writing reusable PowerShell modules, functions, and error-handling patterns
  • Familiarity with Pester for PowerShell unit testing
  • Experience automating Active Directory, Group Policy, or Windows networking tasks via PowerShell

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Solid AWS experience: EC2, EKS/ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch — understanding of services as automation targets
  • Familiarity with CI/CD platforms and integrating infrastructure code pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI)
  • Comfortable working with Linux  and Windows Server in production environments

What’s in it for you?

Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NICE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NICEr!

 Enjoy NICE-FLEX! 

At NICE, we work according to the NICE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

Requisition ID: 11294
Reporting into: Director, Cloud Operations CXone, EMEA

Role Type: Individual Contributor

 

About NiCE

NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.

Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.

NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.

description:
Harbor is looking for a Senior Intapp Implementation Engineer to lead the design, configuration and delivery of Intapp solutions for legal-sector clients. You will work with client stakeholders across IT, Risk and Compliance, Finance and legal teams to turn business needs into secure, practical solutions across the matter lifecycle.

This is a hands-on role for someone with substantial experience implementing and enhancing Intapp products in a law-firm environment. You will take ownership of complex workstreams, guide technical decisions and support other members of the delivery team.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead end-to-end Intapp implementation work, from discovery and requirements through solution design, configuration, testing, deployment and post-go-live support.
  • Design and enhance workflows, forms, rules and application configurations for client and matter intake, conflicts, risk and compliance, time recording or related processes.
  • Advise clients on solution options, product capabilities, design trade-offs and implementation approach.
  • Configure and support relevant Intapp products, such as Intapp Intake, Conflicts, Open, Time, Walls, Flow and Integrate.
  • Plan and oversee integrations with legal finance, document management and other business systems, including integration testing and defect resolution.
  • Lead workshops with business and technical stakeholders; document requirements, process flows, functional designs and technical specifications.
  • Plan and coordinate system testing, user acceptance testing, data validation, training, deployment and business readiness.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues and work with client teams and Intapp support to resolve product or implementation problems.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, controls, data quality and user experience.
  • Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and contribute to delivery standards, documentation and estimates.
  • Support upgrades, migration planning and cloud readiness where required.

What we’re looking for:

  • At least five years of hands-on experience implementing, configuring or significantly enhancing Intapp products.
  • Experience delivering Intapp solutions in a law firm or comparable professional-services environment.
  • Proven participation in multiple implementation or major enhancement projects, with responsibility for solution design and delivery.
  • Strong working knowledge of one or more Intapp products, such as Intake, Conflicts, Open, Time, Walls, Flow or Integrate. Depth in a core product is essential; experience across several products is an advantage.
  • Experience designing workflows and translating Risk, Compliance, Finance or legal business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience with integrations between Intapp and other enterprise or legal-sector systems.
  • Confidence leading workshops, managing stakeholders and explaining technical choices clearly.
  • Experience planning or carrying out testing, deployments, upgrades and post-go-live support.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation and analytical skills.

Desirable experience:

  • Intapp cloud migration or cloud readiness work.
  • Legal finance or document management platforms such as Aderant or iManage.
  • SQL, APIs, reporting tools or integration platforms.
  • Conflicts management, ethical walls, information barriers, client due diligence or AML workflows.
  • Agile delivery, project governance or mentoring other engineers.

How success will be measured:

You will deliver reliable Intapp solutions that meet agreed business and control requirements, communicate risks and decisions clearly, and leave clients with supportable configurations and useful documentation.

About Us:

Harbor is the preeminent provider of expert services across strategy, legal technology, operations, and intelligence. description:
About the team:

As an iOS Engineer on the Design System team, you'll translate SumUp's design language into a reusable, easy-to-use library of UI components and experience patterns, empowering product teams to build cohesive, accessible user experiences at scale.

The Design System team works hand-in-hand with the Mobile Platform team to set standards and provide guidance across all product teams at SumUp. As we expand our ecosystem of merchant and consumer-facing products, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape the foundation that helps developers build faster and ship higher-quality experiences to millions of users worldwide.

What you'll do:

Shape the core experience for both users and developers interacting with SumUp's iOS ecosystem
Collaborate closely with product and design teams to build components that are maintainable, consistent, and beautiful
Embed accessibility best practices into every component — from content descriptions and touch target sizing to color contrast and dynamic type
Provide hands-on technical guidance to product teams to deliver on company priorities, including the upcoming support for landscape orientation
Review code contributions, enforce design system conventions, and mentor engineers on best practices for reusable UI development
Lead the migration of legacy UIKit-based components to SwiftUI while maintaining system stability
Proactively identify and address technical debt to uphold a high bar for engineering excellence and codebase health

You'll be a great fit for this role if you:

Bring 3+ years of professional iOS development experience, ideally on large-scale or consumer-facing applications
Are fluent in Swift, with deep hands-on knowledge of both SwiftUI and UIKit — and a clear view on when and how to use each
Bring experience building or contributing to a design system, component library, or shared UI framework, and understand what it takes to make components truly reusable and scalable
Take pride in crafting accessible user experiences — you know your way around VoiceOver, dynamic type, color contrast, and touch target standards, and treat accessibility as a first-class concern, not an afterthought
Bring a strong grasp of testing best practices for UI components, including unit tests, snapshot tests, and UI automation
Are comfortable reviewing code and mentoring peers — you enjoy sharing knowledge, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team
Are self-motivated and structured in your working style — you manage your own priorities, communicate clearly in English, and thrive in a cross-functional, collaborative environment
Stay genuinely curious about the iOS ecosystem — you follow Apple's releases closely, experiment with new APIs, and are excited to bring fresh ideas back to the team

Why you should join SumUp:

🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our Paris location. This involves an office-first setup
🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced
🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success
📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education
💼 Financial security: corporate pension contributions that support your long-term future

title: Social Media Senior Manager
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're looking for a Senior Manager of Social Media who will own the shaping and execution of our UK social media strategy and lead social media managers across all European markets where Wellhub operates. As the most senior Social Media professional in Europe, you'll be the regional lead for the team and the primary social media partner for senior stakeholders.In this role, you'll partner closely with our Senior Director of Global Social Media to bring the UK strategy to life—creating platform-specific content, developing cultural relevance, supporting local influencer and ambassador programs, and elevating Wellhub's presence across key platforms like Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and emerging channels.You're someone who lives and breathes social. You understand UK culture deeply. You know how to move fast, test fearlessly, and capture moments in real time. You have a video-first mindset and love being behind—and occasionally in front of—the camera.You'll combine hands-on UK ownership with European team management, stakeholder leadership, and accountability for regional alignment and performance. Your creativity, agility, and understanding of UK social trends will shape how consumers, partners, and companies experience Wellhub.

YOUR IMPACT

Shape and Execute the UK Social Media Strategy.
Shape, localize, and operationalize Wellhub's social media strategy for the UK market.
Build regionally relevant content plans tailored for B2C, B2B, and B2P audiences.
Support Wellhub's GEO efforts through content strategy, partnering with relevant teams and European social media managers to align content priorities and strengthen brand authority and discoverability across the region.
Manage the editorial calendar for the UK and ensure seamless alignment with global priorities, launches, campaigns, and cultural moments.
Lead Social Media Managers Across Europe.
Manage, coach, and develop social media managers across all European markets where Wellhub operates, setting clear objectives, supporting professional growth, and enabling local ownership.
Set regional priorities with the Senior Director of Global Social Media, align local plans with global strategy, and establish regular planning and performance reviews.
Share insights and successful formats across countries, resolve competing priorities, and represent the European social team in global discussions.
Create High Impact Video First Content Concept, script, shoot, and edit content optimized for Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn.
Capture spontaneous, social-worthy moments at local events, content shoots, and partner activations.
Work with creative and production colleagues to bring fresh ideas to life.
Drive Cultural Relevance.
Identify UK cultural trends, memes, humor, and moments that Wellhub can authentically participate in.Adapt global narratives to fit the UK social landscape and audience expectations.
Monitor competitor activity and industry trends to keep Wellhub culturally and creatively ahead.
Lead Local Ambassador and Influencer Execution.
Support the development and execution of influencer and ambassador programs in the UK
Partner with creators and wellness influencers who authentically represent the Wellhub brand.
Manage briefings, content feedback, deliverables, and performance tracking.
Lead Stakeholder Relationships Across Europe
Act as the most senior Social Media representative in Europe and the primary partner for regional leadership, country leaders, and senior marketing, sales, people, PR, and partner stakeholders.
Build alignment on social strategy, priorities, and expectations across European markets.
Guide decisions, constructively challenge requests, and resolve escalations while protecting local relevance and global brand consistency.
Collaborate with UK marketing, sales, people, PR, and partner teams to amplify locally relevant moments.Work closely with the global creative team to align content quality, storytelling, sonic identity, and brand voice.
Support country leaders and internal spokespeople with social content, thought leadership, and engagement guidance.
Own Measurement Optimisation and Insights.
Track and report on performance metrics across awareness, engagement, growth, and sentiment.Test new formats, creative variations, and posting strategies to continuously improve results.
Conduct social listening to understand audience behavior and guide content direction.
Review performance across European markets with local social managers and turn shared learnings into regional recommendations and improvements.
Community Engagement and Brand Advocacy
Oversee proactive community management across the UK channels—engaging in conversations, responding to comments, and cultivating brand advocates.
Ensure alignment with global crisis and response protocols.

WHO YOU ARE

You have 7+ years of experience in social media, content creation, or digital marketing—ideally in fast-moving B2C or lifestyle brands.
You're fluent in UK social culture, humor, trends, and how different audiences behave online.
You have excellent English writing and editorial skills.
You're a video-first creator who is comfortable planning, shooting, editing—and occasionally stepping in front of the camera.
You're obsessed with social platforms: their algorithms, nuances, and emerging formats.
You understand how to speak to diverse audiences—consumers, HR leaders, corporate buyers, wellness partners.
You're highly creative, but also organized and able to manage calendars, workflows, approvals, and reporting.
You have experience managing and developing social media teams across markets, with the judgement and autonomy to serve as the senior regional lead.
You can influence senior stakeholders, explain your recommendations, manage difficult conversations, and align regional priorities with local needs.
You excel in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and aren't afraid to test new ideas.
You're a collaborative team player who values feedback, teamwork, and cross-functional partnership.
You're proactive, curious, and passionate about wellbeing and digital storytelling.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

HEALTHCARE: Health and dental insurance.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it's really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We're proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

title: Head of Product Operations (Core)
description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets.

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Head of Product Operations (m/f/d) to join our Product team in Munich, Madrid, London or Paris with a hybrid work setup. In this role, you will lead and improve the operations that are directly linked to our products. Your work will directly impact our operational integrity notably by enhancing fraud detection, streamlining customer support processes, or managing cash projections. All of which are critical to delivering a trustworthy and seamless experience for our users.

This dedicated product operations position was triggered by the launch of new offer types within our product, and the scope of the role will expand as we innovate with our product.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

Drive end-to-end fraud management and detection strategies across all product types and payment flows.
Streamline customer support workflows to improve resolution speed, operational efficiency, and user trust.
Oversee the operational maintenance and reliability of coupon auto-apply and app-to-app features.
Partner with Finance to forecast and manage cash allocations and liquidity across provider accounts.
Work cross-functionally with Product and key teams to translate business needs into scalable operational solutions.
Champion AI and automation initiatives to generate operational insights and drive continuous process improvements.

Your Profile:

We're looking for someone with

3 - 5 years of experience in strategy consulting, mergers and acquisitions, or operations in tech
Strategic & Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities, with the ability to break down complex business problems, identify opportunities, and develop scalable solutions.
Operational Excellence: Proven ability to design, standardize, and optimize processes across complex or rapidly evolving products and organizations.
Leadership & Collaboration: A strong leadership track record
Mindset: A proactive and persistent mindset, adaptability in a dynamic environment, and a strong interest in leveraging AI and automation to improve operational efficiency and decision-making.
Language requirements: Fluent in English and any other European languages is a plus.

Our hiring process:

TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.
*Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role.

#LI-Hybrid

At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged.

As part of our recruitment process at Atolls, we use AI tools for interview recording and transcription. These tools are designed to assist our teams and are never used independently to make hiring decisions. Every assessment and hiring decision is made by our hiring panel and team through human judgment.

title: Senior CRM Executive - Lifecycle
description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the team

This position will be part of the central CRM & Ops team, composed of 18+ specialists, dedicated to driving and executing global strategic initiatives to grow and retain our New Customer base. Collectively, the team is targeted on growing orders, expanding our subscriber base, improving engagement metrics to retain Deliveroo customers. Serving as the voice of the customer, the CRM & Ops team does this by enhancing personalised user experiences, activating best-in-class campaigns, and putting relevancy at the heart of everything.

The Role

As a Marketing Manager within the Lifecycle CRM & Ops team you are the voice of Deliveroo when speaking with our customers across the globe. You'll operate under a hybrid work model, spending a minimum of three days a week at our London HQ.

Reporting into the Senior Marketing Manager on the New Customer squad, and working closely with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Global CRM, Marketing Promotions, and Data Science, You'll be a technical, commercially minded CRM marketer who is hands-on in the tooling: building Lifecycle journeys, setting up experiments and audiences, and configuring promotions and in-app merchandising. You'll have end-to-end ownership of the New Customer Lifecycle, from journey design and build through to measurement and ROI. You'll also use personalisation and AI to make journeys more relevant. Your primary focus will be on creating customer-centric journeys that are highly relevant, using the right channels at the right time to deliver meaningful business impact, while working with local markets as you scale your initiatives internationally.

What you'll be doing

Collaborate with multiple stakeholders to support growing the new customer base by combining data-driven insights with CRM best practice to initiate and deliver programs internationally
Build and configure multi-channel journeys (email, push, in-app), including audience logic, triggers, testing and QA
Design and build multi-variant Lifecycle experiments
Create promotions for new customer acquisition and retention, ensuring accurate setup, targeting and tracking
Manage in-app merchandising placements, working with Product and Marketing Promotions
Deliver personalisation at scale, and test where AI can improve content and efficiency
Own operational delivery, optimisation, reporting of campaigns and weekly trading
Proactively monitor and report on campaigns to stakeholders & propose/manage changes and optimisations where necessary
Collaborate with the New Customer Lifecycle Manager and Marketing Promotions teams to develop the global CRM new customers lifecycle strategy
Collaborate with stakeholders on key projects to create and implement test strategies that optimises performance of new & existing campaigns
Be comfortable with data targeting, segmentation & analysis - pulling it, manipulating it and interpreting it, whilst using marketing technology to help achieve customer touchpoints faster and more efficiently than ever before
Drive innovative ideas and solutions in response to business and customer needs
Provide regular communication with stakeholders, such as the central marketing team, product and engineering teams and local markets, to ensure workloads & deadlines are managed efficiently (we love Slack channels for everything)
Conduct post campaign reporting, pulling out the most interesting lessons and using these to guide your future ideas

Requirements

Bachelor's Degree (Marketing or Business preferred) or strong relevant experience
A minimum of 3+ years CRM experience
Can work in a fast-paced environment and prioritise workload
Attention to detail and campaign deadlines are adhered to, maintaining high standards of accuracy
Highly computer literate with:
HTML familiarity (ability to understand where changes need to be made)
Liquid logic

Technical knowledge in CRM automation development
Good communication skills and ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders groups
Data visualisation tools & reporting experience (Looker preferred)
CRM deployment experience (Braze or similar is a plus!)

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Senior Staff Product Engineer
description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Engineering team

At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology.

Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users.

How we work

We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder, and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.

We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods, usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.

We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.

Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.

A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.

The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 5, that looks like this.

What you'll be doing

Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion.

Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced.

Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve.

Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting.

Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you.

Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating.

What you'll need to have done

Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered.

Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve.

Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps.

Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to.

Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce.

Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity.

Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them.

At Level 5 we'll also look for

Set technical direction on a hard problem other engineers built on, and been judged on whether you made them faster and safer rather than on the size of your team.

Held a quality bar across other people's work without becoming the gate they wait on.

Led cross-cutting or decoupling work that teams adopted because it was the best path, not because it was mandated.

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

Initial chat with our Talent team

Lead Hirer Interview

Live AI Skills Assessment

Values Interview with the CPTO

Meet the CEO

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

title: Product Engineer
description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

How we work

We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder, and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.

We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods, usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.

We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.

Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.

A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.

The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 2, that looks like this:

What you'll be doing

Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion.

Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced.

Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve.

Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting.

Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you.

Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating.

What you'll need to have done

Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered.

Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve.

Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps.

Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to.

Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce.

Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity.

Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them.

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

Initial chat with our Talent team

Lead Hirer Interview

Live AI Skills Assessment

Values Interview with the CPTO

Meet the CEO

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

title: Sales Manager, UK - SMB/MM/Enterprise
description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

The Role

We’re hiring a hands-on sales leader for the UK. You’ll build, lead, and coach the regional Sales team, deliver against ARR and pipeline goals, and build a repeatable local growth engine.

You'll act as the business lead for your market, with accountability for revenue. As a sales leader, you'll lead and coach the sales team, stay close to customers and deals, and build a repeatable sales approach that fits your market. As an orchestrator, you'll coordinate the local pipeline generation activities that feed your number, including marketing and pre-sales. You'll work closely with leaders across BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Solutions Engineering, Deployment, and Customer Success, and influence how they support your market's priorities.

What you’ll do

Own the region’s ARR plan, forecast, and qualified pipeline. Work with the CRO to set priorities, understand capacity needs, and support the team to deliver against the plan.

Build and lead the regional Sales team. Hire, onboard, coach, and develop sellers, while staying hands-on in priority opportunities from prospecting and discovery through qualification, evaluation, negotiation, and close.

Make clear, evidence-based recommendations to Product based on regional customer conversations, deal patterns, and market needs. Build and refine a repeatable regional sales approach using pipeline, win/loss learning, and customer outcomes.

Drive the plan in partnership with field marketing to set priorities for events, campaigns, customer advocacy and community programs, and direct how field marketing resources are used to support your pipeline and ARR goals.

Partner with the marketing leadership, who own field marketing standards, methods and team management, to make sure regional programs are well executed, measured and consistent with Dust's broader marketing approach

Partner with BDR and Growth leaders to build a qualified pipeline through a deliberate mix of outbound and other locally effective channels.

Set direction for how Partnerships can support regional priorities. Work with the Partnerships lead to identify opportunities for sourcing, co-selling, or delivery.

Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, Deployment, Professional Services, and Customer Success to support credible evaluations, successful implementations, customer outcomes, and expansion.

Represent regional customer needs internally and share market learning with the CRO and functional leaders, contributing to consistent GTM practices across Dust.

Market-specific focus

United Kingdom

Build on early customer and partner traction. Use customer referrals, targeted events, and focused market experiments to build qualified pipeline and strengthen local customer proof.

What we’re looking for

A proven sales professional who has grown from individual contributor into people leadership, with 5+ years leading B2B software sales and coaching regional sales teams and a hands-on understanding of how to help reps succeed in-market.

You've owned a market or segment revenue number end to end, not just a team's quota. You've built pipeline through functions you didn't manage, such as marketing, partners and pre-sales, and you've made real calls about where capacity and budget go, including between direct sales and partners

Ability to lead by example in priority opportunities, from discovery through close.

Experience building pipeline and customer relationships in a market where the brand or sales motion is still developing.

A disciplined approach to forecasting and performance feedback, paired with high EQ and a genuinely supportive leadership style.

An appetite for building, testing, and refining a market over multiple quarters while balancing near-term results with durable growth.

What success looks like

The region delivers against its ARR and pipeline goals while developing a repeatable sales approach suited to local customers. The team builds customer trust and referenceable outcomes, cross-functional support is focused on regional priorities, and market learning informs Dust’s broader GTM approach.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

Our product constitution, a story about our mission

Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

Compensation: £240K – £270K • Offers Equity

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
About Us:

At Sitecore, our mission is to simplify how brands reach, engage, and serve people by delivering intelligent, personalised digital experiences that connect the world. We empower the world’s most iconic brands to build lifelong relationships with their customers—seamlessly, smartly, and at scale.

As the leading provider of agentic digital experience software, Sitecore brings together content, commerce, and data into one composable platform that enables brands to deliver millions of meaningful, adaptive experiences every day. Trusted by global leaders such as American Express, Porsche, Starbucks, and L’Oréal, Sitecore helps brands transform engagement through experiences that are not only personalised but predictive and dynamic.

Our foundation is our people—a diverse, passionate, and collaborative global team spanning over 25 countries. We believe that every experience matters, and that belief starts with how we work together. Our values guide how we lead, innovate, and connect. They are the behaviours that bring our mission and vision to life, every day, in every interaction.

As we continue to evolve, we are actively cultivating AI skills across our teams to unlock new levels of creativity, efficiency, and insight. From engineering to customer experience, AI capabilities are becoming integral to how we design, build, and deliver the next generation of digital experiences.

Learn more at Sitecore.com.

About the Role:

The Sales Development Representative (SDR) role at Sitecore is a key role within our sales organisation that will give you the knowledge, skills, and foundation for a long, successful career in technology.

In this role, you will be responsible for supporting Sitecore's growth strategy. It is a chance to use your skills to help shape our future as the leaders in the Digital Experience Marketing space.

You will play an essential role in creating market awareness, identifying prospective customers, qualifying leads and generating new business for the company. You are an ambitious, results driven team player.

What You Will Do:

Execute targeted outbound campaigns to identify new contacts, establish need and fit, and arrange a product introduction

Manage inbound lead flow

Partner with the Sales team to build quality pipeline

Stay engaged with prospects and nurture your deals

Act as an ambassador and advocate for Sitecore, sharing your passion and knowledge with customers and prospects

Arranging discovery calls and well-qualified product demonstrations for the Field Sales and Pre-Sales teams

What You Need to Succeed:

Positive and energetic communication skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing skills

Genuinely curious, self-motivated, creative, results-driven, solution-oriented, direct, and driven to succeed

Comfortable making cold calls

Thrive in a metrics-driven organisation

Ability to analyse industry trends and craft relevant messaging

Curious personality with a desire to grow a long-term career in enterprise sales

Additional European langauges highly advantageous

Additional Skills That Could Set You Apart:

title: Sales Associate
description:
Powering Great Work

We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists:

🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business

🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time

🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country

As our next Account Executive, you'll help bring more trades onto Checkatrade across different regions and categories. It's a new business role: you find high-potential trade businesses and guide them from the first conversation to a signed deal. You'll sit in our Strategic Growth team, at the heart of how we grow the trade network that homeowners rely on.

The job, unfiltered:

Win new trade businesses by finding high-potential small and medium trades, building proposals that make sense for them and negotiating terms.

Hand each new trade over smoothly to our vetting team, so the start of their Checkatrade journey goes well.

Spot opportunities in the market, using data and insights to see where Checkatrade is strong and where we can grow.

Work with Account Management, Vetting, Product and Operations to find the regions and categories that would benefit most from Checkatrade.

Learn our product suite inside out, so every business case is tailored to the prospect in front of you.

Own the outbound sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through to proposals, negotiation and closing.

The fit:

Solid experience in commercial or new business sales, ideally in similar markets, with a strong focus on outbound acquisition.

A track record of finding new clients, building tailored proposals and hitting revenue targets.

The knack for building strong relationships with tradespeople, and working closely with colleagues across teams.

Confidence juggling multiple priorities and improving how things get done.

Experience building customer relationships, whether through digital outreach or face-to-face conversations.

Tenacity and resilience. This is a test-and-learn environment where persistence matters.

Nice to have: familiarity with CRM systems (Salesforce) and outbound tools, and an understanding of AI-powered optimisation tools.

(Don't self-select out because you don't tick every box. We'd rather meet you.)

What you get

💰 Competitive salary, annual bonus & equity scheme

🩺 Health, wellbeing and learning support

🚲 Gym membership, Smart Tech Scheme, Cycle Scheme

🎂 Birthday/special day leave, buy & sell holiday scheme

❤️ 1 week's paid charity leave, and more

How this goes

1st stage interview with our Head of Sales SMB via video call

2nd stage interview with our Head of Sales SMB and Sales Operations Manager in person at our HQ

3rd stage interview with our VP of Sales via video call

Not this one? Stay close anyway. Join the Talent Community and we'll ping you the second something better fits.

At the moment, this role isn’t open to visa sponsorship applications.

About us

We’re Checkatrade – the UK’s leading platform for finding a tradesperson. With more than 50,000 trades listed and over 6 million reviews, we help homeowners get jobs done right and help tradespeople grow their business.

We’re growing fast, with big plans to become the go-to brand for home improvements. If you care about great work, take pride in the details, and want to make an impact, you’ll fit right in.
