title: Director of People Operations
description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The role
This role owns how it works to be an employee at Legora on the backend. You will operationalise every stage of the employee journey, making sure every moment is supported by clean systems, accurate data, and processes that scale. If an employee interacts with a Legora program or system, from their first day in the HRIS to a salary change three years in, your team is accountable for making it accurate, timely, and smooth.

You will lead a distributed People Operations team across Stockholm and New York, reporting to the VP, People Operations. As we enter new markets, you will also build and manage local specialisms to handle day-to-day employee and manager questions and run structured, lower-complexity casework, with a clean handoff to Employee Relations for anything that becomes formal, contested, or carries legal weight.

What you'll own

The full employee lifecycle, operationally. Every touchpoint from offer to exit, mapped, documented, and supported end to end.

HRIS and data integrity. Onboarding new hires into the HRIS, data entry, and data QA. You keep employee data accurate, complete, and audit-ready as the single source of truth.

Contracts and changes. Addendums, employee transfers, salary and reporting-line changes, and the workflows and documentation behind each one, working in close partnership with Payroll so every change flows through accurately and on time.

Benefits and leave administration. Run the day-to-day administration of benefits and leave across our markets. Total Rewards owns the policies, plan design, and philosophy; your team makes sure they are executed cleanly for every employee. Anything contested, discriminatory, or medically complex is escalated to Employee Relations.

Local HR Generalist build-out. As Legora enters new markets, hire, ramp, and manage the local HR Generalist / People Advisor-Ops layer: the in-market presence for day-to-day employee and manager questions, and for structured, lower-complexity casework such as absence management, recurring capability concerns, and restructuring conversations. These roles report into People Operations for management and delivery, with a dotted line to the regional Employee Relations Director for sign-off on jurisdictional readiness and casework quality.

Systems and tooling. Run the People tech stack (HiBob, Ashby, Ironclad), drive adoption, and take manual work out of the process.

Process and SOPs. Design scalable, well-documented processes for every program employees touch, and keep reducing friction and cycle time.

Compliance and controls. Partner with Legal and Finance to keep operations compliant across our markets, including working time, leave, and entity or EOR transitions, with a clean escalation path to Employee Relations for anything that becomes formal or carries legal weight.

Reporting. Own people data quality and the reporting backbone that powers People analytics for the business.

What you'll bring

8+ years in People Operations or HR Operations, including leading a team and building out local, in-market HR capability as a company scales into new geographies, ideally in a high-growth or global company.

Deep HRIS expertise across complex, multidisciplinary system landscapes, with a strong interest in data quality, integrations, AI and tools.

A track record of building and scaling lifecycle processes and SOPs internationally, and of moving work from manual to automated.

Strong grasp of multi-jurisdiction employment compliance across EMEA, AMER, and APAC.

Comfort operating in a tiered People model, with clear judgment on what your team owns directly and what belongs with Employee Relations, Legal, or Total Rewards.

An operator's mindset: detail-obsessed, systems-thinking, and a high bar for accuracy.

Comfort partnering across Finance, Legal, and IT, and communicating clearly with employees and leaders alike.

Fluency in English, which is our working language.

Why this role
People Operations is the infrastructure that lets the rest of the People team, and the business, move fast without breaking things. That now includes building the in-market HR Generalist presence that gives every employee fast, consistent support close to home, wherever they are, with a clean handoff to Employee Relations the moment something becomes formal. You will build that infrastructure for one of the most exciting companies in tech, and set the standard for what operational excellence looks like as we scale.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Sourcing Specialist
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

About the Role

This isn't a typical sourcing job. You won't be handed a list of open roles and asked to find candidates for each one. Sourcing role by role means every hire starts from nothing; we want strong people already in conversation with us before a role opens.

You'll run a sourcing function of one that combines AI agents, market intelligence and an engaged talent community. That means owning three things: talent pools that are already warm, market maps that are current, and an employee referral scheme that works as a real hiring channel.

You'll report to the Director of Talent and have a high level of ownership and autonomy. How you get there is for you to decide. We expect you to try new approaches, learn from what works and drop what doesn't.

What You'll Do

Run AI-powered sourcing: manage our sourcing agents end to end — write the briefs, review the output, tune the criteria — and judge where an agent is the right approach and where a personal one works better. Pass strong, qualified pipelines to recruiters and engage candidates directly where that adds value.

Own market intelligence: build and maintain market maps and competitor intelligence for our priority hiring areas, in a form recruiters and hiring managers can use straight away.

Build the talent community: grow and engage pools of people we want to hire now or in future. Run events and webinars, write a regular newsletter, and work with colleagues across Relay on blogs, vlogs and video that show what it's like to work here.

Turn referrals into a real channel: drive the employee referral scheme — where it's promoted, how referrers are recognised beyond the bonus, and how fast referrals are followed up. Sit down with new joiners early to market-map the best people at their previous companies, then turn those maps into targeted outreach.

Measure and adapt: track which activities lead to hires and conversations with strong candidates, and change course when something isn't working.

Get ahead of problems: spot hiring problems before they're raised, propose a fix and run it. Decide which AI sourcing tools we try and adopt, and report back to the wider TA team.

Who Will Thrive in This Role

Proven sourcer. You've built pipelines in hard-to-hire markets, in-house or agency.

AI-native in how you source. You've used AI tools hands-on in sourcing, or you pick up new tools quickly and judge their output critically.

Self-starter. You can point to things you started without being asked, and what came of them.

Strong writer and persuader. You write things people choose to read, and you can get a busy colleague to record a video or write a post.

Equally at ease with new joiners and senior stakeholders. You build trust quickly at every level.

Organised without a req list. You run several workstreams at once and set your own priorities.

Measured on results, not activity. You want to define how sourcing works, not follow a fixed process.

It would help if you've run events, webinars or online communities, produced market maps or competitor intelligence, or used Ashby, Metaview, Juicebox or similar tools.

Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay's success

Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you'd need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it

25 days of holidays

Enhanced parental leave

Hardware of your choice

Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more)

Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.

Who Thrives at Relay?

Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

Create awareness spikes. A track record of viral campaigns. You have created campaigns that broke through nationally and drove measurable spikes in public attention, online and offline. Fast paced. You are skilled in fast and excellent execution with rapid pivots and changing contexts.

An active network. You have active and trusted networks into UK politics (including key decision makers), civil society and civic tech, across the whole democratic political spectrum, including on the left, in the centre and on the right. AI-first, curious about civic tech. You use AI tools every day and have built or improved workflows and automations with them. 3+ years leading people, at Senior Manager level. We're also open to candidates at Manager level who have experience mentoring others and the ambition to lead a team.

A proven track record of national campaigns in the UK that created significant public attention and media coverage.

Hands-on experience using AI in communications or campaigning work.

description:
Job title: Senior SAP AMS Consultant (SAP PP)

Employment: Permanent

Location: UK based

Salary: Excellent basic salary

Benefits: 24 days holiday, paid birthday day off, paid volunteer day, holiday buy & sell, Bupa private healthcare, 5% employer matched pension contribution, life insurance 4x annual salary, electric car lease scheme, funded social events, investment in personal development, you chose the charity we make the financial contribution, CSR initiatives, and much more!

The Company

At The Config Team, we’re not a typical corporate consultancy, and we’re not a generic SAP/IT Consultancy. We are experts in SAP supply chain, and we do it exceptionally well. With 30+ years of experience and our own suite of products (like PreBilt™ for EWM), we help global brands create smarter, faster, more resilient supply chains.

Each project we deliver is different from the next. We can offer an environment that brings a variety of projects at the forefront of modern supply chain solutions.

What You’ll Do

To delight our customers by exceeding their expectations in all aspects of support and service. The Config Team is an experienced and trusted SAP AMS partner.

This is a senior, customer-facing role with responsibility for managing and delivering day-to-day client requirements, including Service Requests, Incident Resolution and Problem Management, in line with ITIL methodology and Service Level Agreements.

The successful candidate will also lead complex changes, contribute to project delivery, resolve challenging issues and improve SAP-related processes.

As a subject-matter expert, the Senior AMS Consultant will work closely with customers and colleagues across our delivery teams. The role also includes supporting the development of less-experienced team members through coaching, mentoring and knowledge sharing.

To ensure the above is fully achievable for our clients you will need to have a strong knowledge and understanding of SAP PP.

Required Skills

Functional experience within SAP PP.

Good knowledge on processes and best practice principles within specialist area of SAP.

Background in an SAP support or SAP AMS environment.

To be able to demonstrate problem solving abilities in SAP.

Ability to deal with internal and external stakeholders in a support environment.

A full valid UK driving licence.

Right to work in the UK.

Desired Skills

Functional and/or configuration experience within SAP SD and SAP MM.

Experience of using or implementing mobile solutions either in SAP ITS or using a Third Party Product with SAP.

Able to investigate issues and bugs.

The Config Team

A leading SAP Supply Chain Software Consultancy, with a people-centric and collaborative culture focused on employee well-being, learning and development and creating an excellent place to work for our people. We aim to delight customers with the exceptional delivery of SAP projects.

Why apply for this position with The Config Team?

Work with globally recognised brands.

Join a software business with an exceptional 98% customer retention rate.

Work Where Works approach.

Opportunity to build and shape our partner strategy.

Work with innovative SAP software products and solutions.

Excellent career progression and learning & development opportunities.

Be part of a collaborative, supportive and people-focused culture.

Find out more about Life At The Config Team on Glassdoor where we our proud to say employees rate us 4.9 / 5 stars! https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-The-Config-Team-EI_IE1831019.11,26.htm

At The Config Team, our people are our greatest asset. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment built on trust, respect, and integrity, where everyone has the opportunity to succeed. We strive to create a workplace where all individuals feel welcome, safe, valued, and supported.

﻿

We are committed to preventing discrimination of any kind and actively encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including those from underrepresented groups. To ensure you can perform at your best during the hiring process, we are happy to accommodate any reasonable adjustments you may need.

To find out more information, a full job description or if you have any questions, please submit your CV.

﻿We look forward to hearing from you.

description:

At Acturis, innovation isn’t just part of our culture - it’s in our DNA.

Our story began in 2000 in the garage of our co‑founder, Theo Duchen, who, alongside fellow former McKinsey partner David McDonald, set out to reinvent insurance technology. What started as a bold start‑up idea has grown into a global SaaS leader trusted by the industry.

Today, over 100,000 users across 40+ countries rely on the Acturis platform. By working closely with brokers, insurers, and MGAs, we continue to shape the market and drive new standards across both personal and commercial lines.

Acturis is proud to be recognised as a Great Place to Work® 2026 and to maintain a collaborative, innovative, start‑up‑style culture, even as we scale globally. With over 90% of our hires coming from graduate backgrounds, this is a place built for early‑career talent to thrive. And as an EcoVadis Committed‑rated organisation, we focus on creating long‑term value by operating in a sustainable and responsible way.

Day to day you will:

Develop and enhance Acturis’ web platform using C#, ASP.NET, ASP.NET MVC and modern JavaScript frameworks to build complex, dynamic front-end experiences.

Design and implement innovative tools and solutions while applying best development practices, including unit testing and code reviews.

Optimise, refactor and improve existing code to ensure performance, maintainability and long-term platform quality.

We offer mentorship from day one, a clear progression path, and real responsibility early on, because we’ve built an environment where graduates grow fast and make meaningful impact.

You can expect:

A transparent career structure, regular feedback, and 3 formal performance reviews annually

Opportunities to lead projects, manage resources, and mentor junior team members.

Intensive onboarding, industry-recognised training, and funded specialist courses as you progress.

You'll thrive here if you:

Have (or expect) a 2:1+ in a STEM degree with strong A‑levels (AAB minimum, including an A in Maths), plus in‑depth experience with at least one major programming language and exposure to object‑oriented programming (e.g., C#, Java or C++).

Be logical, analytical, organised and quick to learn new technical concepts.

Communicate confidently and enjoy collaborating in a supportive, team‑focused environment.

Ready to apply your technical mind to real‑world challenges?
Join Acturis and build a career where you’ll grow quickly, innovate boldly, and work alongside some of the brightest people in the industry.

Please note Acturis is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, transgender status, religion or belief, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity. For further information, visit www.acturis.com.

Successful candidates will usually be contacted within 14 days of applying. Due to the high-volume of applications we receive, we are unfortunately unable to inform unsuccessful applicants.

title: Chief Operating Officer / Directeur des Opérations (H/F)
description:
TA MISSION

Tu soulages les deux fondateurs des décisions opérationnelles et tu fais le tampon entre eux et l'équipe.

Tu portes deux casquettes : celle du dirigeant qui construit le système de pilotage et la roadmap, et celle de l'opérationnel qui met les mains dans le cambouis. Objectif à 12 mois : rendre JOLT moins dépendante de ses fondateurs, et construire l'organisation capable d'absorber la croissance et l'ouverture de nouveaux marchés.

TES RESPONSABILITÉS

Mettre en place le système de pilotage de JOLT : tableaux de bord, KPIs, rentabilité, prévisions

Structurer l'organisation : équipes, responsabilités, process documentés, outils automatisés

Piloter la machine opérationnelle : supply chain, logistique, service client, planification

Construire et exécuter la roadmap d'expansion européenne : marchés prioritaires, modèles de distribution, premiers relais locaux

Faire monter le niveau d'exécution d'une équipe d'une vingtaine de personnes

LE PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

5 ans et plus d'expérience, dont une expérience concrète de scale-up e-commerce, DNVB ou consumer

Profil opérationnel avec une forte culture business et P&L

Leadership démontré : tu as déjà construit et embarqué des équipes

Une expérience internationale, ou l'envie réelle d'ouvrir de nouveaux marchés

Français et anglais courants

L'ÉTAT D'ESPRIT

Exécution avant tout : tu descends dans le détail, tu ne restes pas au niveau du plan

Esprit entrepreneurial : tu es à l'aise dans l'ambiguïté et tu construis ce qui n'existe pas encore

Ownership : tu prends les sujets de bout en bout et tu challenges les fondateurs quand il le faut

POURQUOI CE POSTE ?

Un rôle central, avec un impact immédiat et une carte blanche large

Une entreprise à faire changer d'échelle, pas simplement à gérer

Un terrain de jeu entrepreneurial : ops, international, pilotage, structuration

LES CONDITIONS

Contrat : CDI
Rémunération : 80 à 120 K€ fixe selon profil, + variable sur KPIs
Localisation : Toulouse
Langage : Français et anglais courants requis
Démarrage : Q4 2026 - Q1 2027, selon profil et opportunité

LE PROCESS

01 Entretien RH (humatter)
02 Entretien avec JOLT
03 Case study
04 Entretien final avec les deux fondateurs

title: Accountmanager in Auction Business - Hauts de France (gn)
description:
For this position we source for our sister company Troostwijk.

About us Troostwijk & the TBAuctions group are part of one of Europe’s leading networks for digital B2B auctions. We market machines, vehicles, equipment and other commercial assets, bringing sellers and buyers together through digital processes and personal support.

What your day-to-day work will involve As an Account Manager, you will develop the French seller market and act as the main point of contact for new and existing sellers. You will build a profitable portfolio, develop long-term relationships based on trust and guide opportunities from the first conversation through to active auction business.

The role combines remote work with regular travel and gives you direct influence on the development of our French market.

You will receive professional support from our teams and work with modern tools that help you structure your pipeline, follow-ups and seller relationships.

What this means in practice

Identify, approach and acquire new sellers in the French market.
Develop a profitable seller portfolio and build long-term relationships based on trust.
Research companies and market opportunities and turn them into relevant conversations.
Present our activities and value proposition clearly to business owners and potential sellers.
Prepare meetings, understand seller needs and agree on clear next steps.
Own negotiations and follow opportunities through to conversion.
Keep pipeline, follow-ups and seller information structured with modern tools.
Represent our company image and values in the market and coordinate closely with internal teams.

What matters in this role We are looking for someone who enjoys building a market rather than only maintaining an existing portfolio. You should be comfortable creating your own pipeline, speaking confidently with business owners, handling rejection and staying focused until opportunities move forward.

What you should bring

Proven experience in sales, business development or new-business acquisition.
Experience in a technical, industrial or B2B environment with measurable commercial results.
Strong communication, negotiation, closing and relationship-building skills.
Autonomy, commercial drive, persistence and a results-oriented approach.
Willingness to travel regularly and a valid Category B driving licence.
French as a native language and the ability to work in English.

A perfect CV is less important than your ability to create relationships, develop a territory and turn commercial opportunities into long-term seller business.

What we offer

Autonomy with professional support

You will own your territory and your seller relationships while working closely with internal teams that support you with expertise, coordination and operational follow-through. You will not be left alone with complex opportunities or process questions.

Build something with visible impact

The role gives you the opportunity to help establish the French market, shape long-term seller relationships and contribute directly to recurring auction activity. Your work combines commercial ownership with professional development.

Performance that pays off

You can expect an attractive compensation package with a competitive fixed salary and a bonus model that recognises your individual performance.

Your benefits

Company car, computer, phone and meal tickets support you in your day-to-day work.

Do you have a track record in B2B sales and want to help build the French seller market? We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Senior Account Executive, Hotels - France & Netherlands (12M FTC)
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Airbnb Hotels team is a fun, fast-growing group leading Airbnb’s expansion into the hotel sector. Operating with an entrepreneurial spirit, this team combines the simplicity, product excellence, and guest-centered ethos that define Airbnb. This team’s mission is to deliver the smoothest, most intuitive hotel booking experience for guests, while helping independent, boutique hotels easily drive incremental bookings so they can focus on delivering the best hospitality. The ultimate aim is to help more people discover high-quality hotels, creating value for guests and our hotel partners.

The Difference You Will Make

As a Senior Account Executive, you will be responsible for converting leads into net‑new supply to support new-market launches and at pace to hit quarterly goals. Working the full sales funnel, you will proactively turn cold leads into warm sales opportunities helping to build the Hotels category’s market presence in the process through collaboration with other teams. This includes partnering, strategizing, and running daily operations directly with independent, boutique hotels , and ensuring that Airbnb sources  the best hotel inventory available to our guests.

This role is based in Paris (hybrid, 2 days a week in the office).  It will start off as a 12-month FTC with the potential for conversion depending on individual performance. 

A Typical Day

  • Meet and exceed KPIs by owning the performance and success of assigned region
  • Prospect new potential hotels through external research, networking, and use of Airbnb tools.
  • Securing new hotels involves targeted sales strategies and negotiating and closing the deals
  • Develops acquisition strategies and scalable, localised supply strategies for established and emerging markets
  • Expertly position and communicate Airbnb’s value proposition to new partners via phone, email, and in-person
  • Add net new hotels by qualifying and moving leads through the funnel as quickly as possible, achieving defined quarterly goals
  • Find supply in and launch new markets: Own market launches including supporting lead generation and coordinating cross functionally
  • Support hotel onboarding as needed from won sales opportunities
  • Effectively promote and build strong relationships with hotels by demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of our platforms and confidently pitching their value

Your Expertise

  • 8+ years of professional experience, preferably in a fast growing startup tech or hospitality company working in sales and/or account management
  • Previous hospitality experience is a plus
  • Proficiency in both English and French.
  • CRM required; Proficiency in Salesforce, Gong and other scalable AI Sales prospecting tools is a plus.
  • The ability to get things done with constantly changing priorities, projects and deadlines

title: Senior Talent Partner, Tech
description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Why this role exists

We are about to hire the people who will define the next phase of this company. Not backfill a plan someone else wrote — define it. The quality of who joins Dust over the next eighteen months is the single highest-leverage variable in whether we build the category or watch someone else do it.

That work needs a recruiter who treats hiring as a craft rather than a queue. Someone who can hold a real point of view on what "great" looks like for a role, defend it with a hiring manager who disagrees, and then go find that person themselves — from a cold start, without a lead gen team, a sourcing pod, or a playbook waiting for them.

You'll be an early member of a small Talent team. That means you own roles end to end, and you also help build the thing itself: the assessment design, the interview loops, the calibration, the data we use to know whether any of it is working.

We're looking for someone who cares about the candidate experience for all parties internal and external. And prioritizes protecting Dust's culture by being thoughtful, thorough and leading by example in being a true team player.

What you'll own

Full-cycle hiring, end to end. You run your own searches from role kickoff to close. Sourcing, outreach, screening, interviewing, offer strategy, negotiation. You are the owner of the outcome, not a coordinator of other people's opinions.

Assessment design, not just assessment delivery. For every role you open, you help define what evidence would actually predict success — then you build the loop that surfaces it. You'll push back on interview stages that exist out of habit and replace them with ones that test something real.

Hiring manager partnership with a spine. You'll spend as much time calibrating hiring managers as you do talking to candidates. When a manager says "not quite the right feel," you'll ask what they mean until there's a defensible answer, and you'll say so when there isn't one.

Market intelligence. You'll know your talent market better than anyone else in the building — who's good, where they are, what moves them, what compensation actually looks like right now — and you'll bring that back into how we scope roles and design offers.

The candidate experience. Our hiring process is the first honest sample of what working here feels like. You'll make it expedient, direct, well-communicated, and worth a candidate's time whether or not they get an offer.

Building the function. Process, tooling, structured scorecards, funnel data, quality-of-hire signal. You'll leave the system better than you found it, and you'll be trusted to change it without asking permission first.

Two tracks — tell us which one is yours

We're hiring for depth in one of two areas. You should have a genuine centre of gravity in one; interest in the other is a bonus, not a requirement.

GTM. Account Executives, Sales Engineers, Customer Success, Marketing, and the leaders above them, across Europe and the US. You know how to assess commercial talent on evidence rather than swagger, and you can tell the difference between a rep who carried a territory and a rep who inherited one.

Technical. Software engineers, infrastructure, product, and design, in a market where the best people are not looking and the second-best are drowning in outreach. You can hold a credible conversation about what someone actually built, and you know why that matters more than where they built it.

How we think about hiring

We're telling you this up front because if you disagree with it, this will be a frustrating job.

We don't hire based on pedigree. Logos and school names are weak evidence. What someone has actually done, and what they can demonstrate now, is strong evidence. We design our loops accordingly.

We hire for evidence, not affinity. "Culture fit" that means "reminds me of me" is how companies get homogeneous and slow. We assess against explicit behaviours tied to how we work, and we write down what we saw.

Speed and rigour are not in tension. Slow processes are usually a symptom of unclear thinking about the role, not of high standards.

A no should be as clear as a yes. To the candidate, and internally.

Some of us came from well-known companies. That's context, not criteria. It isn't why we're here and it won't be why you are. We celebrate everyone's achievements and want to create an environment where diversity of thought and experience of a collective whole makes this place exceptional and lasting.

Recruiters are operators, not order-takers. If you think a role is wrongly scoped, badly levelled, or shouldn't be open at all, you're expected to say so.

What we're looking for

5+ years in full-cycle recruiting, with meaningful time in-house at a high-growth company. You've hired in an environment with real ambiguity, not just real volume.

Demonstrable depth in either GTM or technical hiring — you can talk through searches you've run, what made them hard, and what you'd do differently.

Genuinely strong sourcing. Not "I partner with a sourcing team." You find people yourself, and you write outreach that people reply to because it's obviously written by a human who read something.

Comfort operating without infrastructure. No playbook, no SDR equivalent, limited tooling to start.

The judgement and directness to challenge senior stakeholders, and the credibility to be listened to when you do.

A bias to start. You see the gap and close it before anyone asks you to.

Excellent written English and a real feel for language. Everything you write is a piece of our employer brand.

Low ego, high ownership. No job is too big or too small — you'll design an assessment framework in the morning and chase a scheduling conflict in the afternoon.

Based in Paris, London or New York.

Ideal, but not required: experience hiring in AI or developer-facing companies; experience building or improving a hiring process rather than inheriting one; multi-market hiring across Europe and the US.

You'll be using AI to do this job — properly

We build the AI operating system that companies use to rewire their work. We expect our own team to be the sharpest possible example of that.

You'll build and run your own Dust agents: market maps, candidate research, interview debrief synthesis, competitive intelligence on where talent is moving. Not as a side project — as how the job gets done. You don't need to have done this before, but you do need to be the kind of person who is genuinely excited to, rather than politely tolerant of it.

You'll also be one of our most credible internal sources of feedback on the product, because you'll be a heavy user of it every day.

Location

This role is based in Paris, London or New York, and we'd love you to spend real time in the office with the team. A lot of the best things about building at Dust happen because people are in the same room: the energy, the fast decisions, the unexpected conversation that unlocks a hard problem.

We hire people with strong judgement and extend that trust to how they manage their time.

Our process

We'll tell you the full loop up front, keep it to a small number of stages, and give you a decision quickly. You'll meet the people you'd work with, not a panel of proxies. Expect at least one stage where you work through a real hiring problem with us rather than describing a past one.

If you don't check every box, apply anyway. We're more interested in your potential and how you think than a perfect match to a checklist.

Please send your application and resume in English.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

Our product constitution, a story about our mission

Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

title: Marketing Operations
description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Marketing Ops is one of Alan's highest-leverage functions.

It sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, data, and technology — turning systems into growth engines and ensuring every touchpoint with prospects and members is timely, relevant, and scalable.

Alan is growing fast across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. But today we're leaving value on the table. On the prospect side, we drive more traffic but can't convert it properly: no scoring, no intelligent routing, no nurturing that adapts to buying intent. On the member side, messaging is one of our primary touchpoints for engagement, retention, and trust — yet nobody operates it strategically. Personalization stays shallow, communication pressure goes unmonitored, and shipping a message often means filing an engineering ticket.

We need Marketing Ops leaders who can architect scalable systems, operate them strategically, and progressively embed AI into workflows — to raise quality, reduce manual execution, and unlock growth without scaling headcount linearly.

⭐️ The Marketing Ops job ⭐️

We are hiring two Marketing Operations Managers, each embedded in a different crew:

Growth Infrastructure — focused on prospect acquisition: building a unified lead engine that captures, scores, routes, and nurtures across all channels

Product Platform — focused on member lifecycle messaging: operating Alan's messaging stack as a scalable service across 1.7M+ profiles

Both roles share the same DNA: strong marketing ops fundamentals, data fluency, a product mindset, and the ability to be both hands-on and strategic. Crew placement will be determined based on the candidate's experience, interests, and fit during the hiring process.

Why is this role interesting?

Speed: marketing, product, and sales teams ship campaigns and messages confidently — Marketing Ops turns bottlenecks into force multipliers across every crew

Trust: clean data, governed attributes, proper segmentation, and enforced rules mean the right person gets the right message at the right time

Scale: as we grow to millions of members across multiple countries, we need operators who keep our platforms clean and the user experience protected — without scaling headcount linearly

AI at the frontier: this isn't a maintenance role — you'll identify high-priority use cases for AI agents, train and refine them to a senior marketer's quality bar, and drive real adoption

What will you do with us?

You'll be a partnership with marketers — not a service desk. You'll partner closely with engineers, data, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders (PMMs, sales, growth, product) within a PM-Tech duo crew model.

Regardless of crew, you will own a core set of capabilities:

Marketing Automation & CRM: own and optimize our marketing stack (Customer.io, CRM integrations); build automations that enable marketers to launch campaigns independently, at scale, across all geos

title: Assistant(e) social(e)
description:
🐼 Pourquoi Prévenir

Prévenir est un nouveau Service de Prévention et de Santé au Travail Interentreprises (SPSTI) en Île-de-France.

Notre ambition est de repenser la santé au travail pour améliorer l'impact sur la vie des salariés et l'expérience des professionnels de santé, en s'appuyant sur les moyens technologiques d'Alan.

Notre premier centre médical a ouvert ses portes au 117 Quai de Valmy (Paris 10ᵉ) et ce n'est que le début !

👉 Pour en savoir plus sur le quotidien chez Prévenir, c'est ici

💉 Le poste, concrètement

Vous êtes Assistant(e) Social(e) au sein d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire (médecins du travail, ASST, IPRP) avec laquelle vous co-construisez la pratique de Prévenir. Votre temps se répartit entre :

Accompagnement des salarié(es) dans leurs démarches sociales : retour d'arrêt, difficultés budgétaires, aidants, addictions, orientation vers les dispositifs

Participation aux cellules pluridisciplinaires de prévention de la désinsertion professionnelle (PDP) et construction des solutions de maintien dans l'emploi

Mobilisation du réseau institutionnel : MDPH, RQTH, Cap Emploi, Sameth, CAF, CPAM, Carsat

Conduite des actions collectives et des sensibilisations (aidants, retraite, budget, RPS)

Utilisation et enrichissement de nos outils numériques et d'IA, contribution à la construction du métier chez Prévenir

Ce qui change vs. un SPSTI classique :

Une équipe pluridisciplinaire à co-construire. Vous ne rejoignez pas un service figé : vous participez à dessiner la place du Psychologue du Travail chez Prévenir, les protocoles de délégation avec les médecins, et les passerelles avec Assistant Sociaux et IPRP

Des outils numériques co-construits avec vous. Une équipe d'ingénieurs et de designers Alan développe avec les soignants les outils dont ils ont besoin, DMST, parcours de prévention, supports de webinaires, expérimentations IA

Le mix présentiel / distanciel pensé comme un atout métier. Vous voyez les salariés et les entreprises sur le terrain quand c'est utile, et vous gardez le temps et les outils pour faire de la prévention de qualité à distance le reste du temps

👤 Le profil recherché

DEASS (diplôme d'État d'assistant·e de service social, Bac+3) : obligatoire

3 ans d'expérience, idéalement en santé au travail

Connaissance des dispositifs de maintien dans l'emploi, du handicap et de l'invalidité

Écoute, sang-froid, indépendance et sens de l'équipe pluridisciplinaire

Basé·e en Île-de-France ; à l'aise avec un fonctionnement hybride et les outils numériques

💚 Ce qu'on offre

Lieu : 117 quai de Valmy (Paris 10ᵉ) - dans un centre tout neuf, pensé pour la qualité de l'exercice médical

Rémunération de 38 390 € à 48 180 € par an, selon profil

Plan d'intéressement

Télétravail partiel possible

RTT

Prise en charge du transport quotidien

Restaurant d'entreprise

Formation linguistique offerte

Événements d'équipe réguliers

Pour en savoir plus sur notre politique salariale, c'est ici !

title: Senior Revenue Ops
description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

Why is this role interesting?

High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

Real ownership: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery.

Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.

What will you do with us?

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

Learn more about the exciting challenges tackled by the team by reading this article about Carlos Targhetta's role at Alan 👀

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you:

Have at least 5 years of experience in RevOps / Sales Ops / Sales Effectiveness, several of them spent hands-on building the sales machine. You own initiatives end-to-end (scope, design, build, measure);

Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives;

Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

Can write and own SQL queries yourself (joins, basic data modeling), not just read them.

Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

Have configured Salesforce yourself (objects, fields, flows) and can say what you personally built vs. what an integrator or another team did.

Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

Have at least an advanced level in English.

Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Madrid, Barcelona or Brussels.

For this role we are looking to hire within the C1-E level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Madrid, Barcelona or Brussels

All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

Transport. Generous transit benefit

Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

We're opening Sales Team Lead roles in France to lead some of our growing crews of Sales:

Mid-market teams, covering companies with 30–300 employees.

A very small businesses team, covering companies with fewer than 10 employees, run fully inbound.

In this role, you will own acquisition on one of the Small / Mid-Market segments in France and run the business end-to-end. You'll be hands-on in the field while coaching and scaling a crew of Sales to win the associated market.

This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition. We have just passed the one million member milestone, and this is only the beginning. We're accelerating acquisition in France, and Mid-Market is one of the core pillars of that plan.

Why mid-market is exciting at Alan:

A large market with real momentum. You'll lead growth on a big B2B segment where our offer is already winning. We have strong references to build on.

Faster cycles, real stakes. Deals typically involve HR, Finance and the CEO, and sometimes a broker. Cycles are shorter than in Enterprise, so you see the results of your decisions quickly.

A strong product story. Companies in this range want a modern, digital health experience with fair pricing. They also want simple HR administration. This is where Alan stands out against traditional insurers and brokers.

Attractive economics. The segment has solid margins and is a key pillar of Alan's path to profitability in France.

⭐ What you will do ⭐

You will be the Sales leader of one of the Small / Mid-Market crews in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and building the machine. More precisely, you will:

Own the associated Mid-Market acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go-to-market strategy for 30–300 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets.

Lead a team of Sales:

Drive hiring, onboarding and career development as we scale the crew.

Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations, rigorous follow-up, and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution and pipeline management.

Be in the field with the team: joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates.

Empower every member of the crew. Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals: a strong feedback culture, clear ownership and autonomy.

Ensure market fit and remove blockers. Surface customer expectations, patterns and blockers. Make sure they're addressed through the right plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.).

⭐ Is it what you are looking for? You may be a great fit at Alan if you... ⭐

Have at least 6 years of experience in B2B sales, with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader

Have experience leading and coaching sales teams, with the ability to set a high bar, give clear direction and help people grow

Have full working proficiency in French, and an advanced level of English for internal communication

Have a very hands-on mentality: you love being in the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations and sharing what works

Have experience selling to small or mid-market companies (30–300 employees) in multi-stakeholder deals

Are comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and can prioritize ruthlessly

Are data-driven and analytical: you know how to use KPIs to drive performance, run analyses and make decisions

Have strong cross-functional collaboration skills and an appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.)

Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Nantes, Biarritz or Annecy

Nice-to-have:

Experience selling to HR, Finance and C-level stakeholders

Having already opened or scaled a new segment or market in a fast-growing company

Experience selling insurance, benefits, HR tech or SaaS

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only.

Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

title: Psychologue du travail
description:
🐼 Pourquoi Prévenir

Prévenir est un nouveau Service de Prévention et de Santé au Travail Interentreprises (SPSTI) en Île-de-France.

Notre ambition est de repenser la santé au travail pour améliorer l'impact sur la vie des salariés et l'expérience des professionnels de santé, en s'appuyant sur les moyens technologiques d'Alan.

Notre premier centre médical a ouvert ses portes au 117 Quai de Valmy (Paris 10ᵉ) et ce n'est que le début !

👉 Pour en savoir plus sur le quotidien chez Prévenir, c'est ici

💉 Le poste, concrètement

Vous êtes Psychologue du Travail au sein d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire (médecins du travail, ASST, IPRP) avec laquelle vous co-construisez la pratique de Prévenir. Votre temps se répartit entre :

Analyses RPS (dans le cadre de la PDP) individuels et entretiens, dans le respect de la déontologie des psychologues et du secret professionnel

Accompagnement des situations de travail dégradées et participation aux cellules de prévention de la désinsertion professionnelle (PDP)

Conception et animation des ateliers collectifs et des formations auprès des salariés et des employeurs

Conduite des interventions collectives complexes (crises, réorganisations), contribution au projet Prévenir, tutorat et construction des outils et programmes RPS / QVCT

Restitution d'analyses de façon claire et neutre aux entreprises et à l'équipe pluridisciplinaire (IDEST, Médecins, IPRP, Assistants Sociaux)

Utilisation et enrichissement de nos outils numériques et d'IA, contribution à la construction du métier chez Prévenir

Ce qui change vs. un SPSTI classique :

Une équipe pluridisciplinaire à co-construire. Vous ne rejoignez pas un service figé : vous participez à dessiner la place du Psychologue du Travail chez Prévenir, les protocoles de délégation avec les médecins, et les passerelles avec Assistant Sociaux et IPRP

Des outils numériques co-construits avec vous. Une équipe d'ingénieurs et de designers Alan développe avec les soignants les outils dont ils ont besoin, DMST, parcours de prévention, supports de webinaires, expérimentations IA

Le mix présentiel / distanciel pensé comme un atout métier. Vous voyez les salariés et les entreprises sur le terrain quand c'est utile, et vous gardez le temps et les outils pour faire de la prévention de qualité à distance le reste du temps

Master 2 de psychologie, idéalement psychologie du travail et des organisations

Aisance sur l'individuel, le collectif et l'organisationnel ; posture indépendante face aux employeurs

Sang-froid dans les situations dégradées, pédagogie, esprit d'équipe

Basé·e en Île-de-France, à l'aise avec un fonctionnement hybride

💚 Ce qu'on offre

Lieu : 117 quai de Valmy (Paris 10ᵉ) - dans un centre tout neuf, pensé pour la qualité de l'exercice médical

Rémunération de 47 300 € à 57 200 € par an, selon profil

Télétravail partiel possible

RTT

Prise en charge du transport quotidien

title: Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT
description:
The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT owns the DeepHealth Acute Care CT Suite end to end, with primary accountability for what to build and shared accountability for getting it shipped. DeepHealth is building the Acute Care CT Suite from the ground up to cover detection, care coordination, and reporting for emergency CT, starting with head CT and expanding to chest and abdomen, where minutes saved in stroke, bleeds, and trauma directly affect patient outcomes. The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT shapes the suite from day one: owning the roadmap, translating clinical needs into ML and product work, and driving cross-functional delivery on a subset of the suite from data through customer activation. The role does not write code or own technical software design.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Product Strategy and Roadmap

Own the Acute Care CT Suite roadmap and define what to build, defer, or stop based on evidence.

Define suite scope across pathology detection modules, software capabilities such as alerting and care coordination, and comprehensive draft reporting.

Work with emergency radiologists and neuro/stroke teams to distinguish stated requests from real clinical needs, including time-to-treatment, triage, missed findings, and care coordination.

Translate clinical problems into ML work and set model metrics that reflect clinical value, including sensitivity versus false-positive burden.

Track the acute care market (including Aidoc, Viz.ai, RapidAI, Nicolab, and peers) and position products with Sales and Marketing.

Delivery and Cross-Functional Execution

Own delivery end to end on a subset of the Suite, from data to customer activation, including planning, coordination across data, ML, software, QARA, and Support, tracking, and escalation.

Run squads for new devices (typically 3 to 9 months), such as ASPECTS detection.

Coordinate with QARA on the regulatory impact of each release, including EU MDR and FDA 510(k).

Cut scope or move dates when needed, and escalate further as required.

Partner with engineering and technical leads without writing code or carrying technical software design.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.

Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree in a technical, scientific, clinical, business, or related field, or equivalent experience (required).

8+ years in product or delivery for medical devices or medical imaging software, with products shipped end to end (required).

Knowledge of radiology and emergency department workflows (required).

Knowledge of machine learning in Clinical AI (required).

Experience running cross-functional delivery across data, ML, software, and QA/RA to fixed dates (required).

Fluent English (required).

Hands-on use of AI tools (Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar) in current work (required).

Preferred: French language skills.

Preferred: Acute care, stroke, or emergency imaging background.

Preferred: Experience with SaMD and regulated environments (EU MDR, FDA 510(k)).

Quality Standards

Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.

Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.

Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.

Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.

Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.

Practices universal safety precautions.

Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.

Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.

Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.

Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

Travel

This position requires domestic / international travel up to 10%.

  • Own delivery end to end on a subset of the Suite, from data to customer activation, including planning, coordination across data, ML, software, QARA, and Support, tracking, and escalation.

  • Coordinate with QARA on the regulatory impact of each release, including EU MDR and FDA 510(k).

  • Cut scope or move dates when needed, and escalate further as required.

  • Partner with engineering and technical leads without writing code or carrying technical software design.

title: Payload Systems Test Engineer
description:
About The Company

Our client is an international leader in satellite communications, delivering connectivity solutions to customers around the world. To strengthen its R&D team in Switzerland, it is looking for a Payload Systems Test Engineer who thinks big, acts with confidence and enjoys working in an inclusive, multidisciplinary environment.

The role As a Payload Systems Test Engineer, you will focus on cutting-edge technology for innovative satcom architectures. You understand complex systems which include communication chains, HW/SW as well as optomechanical subsystems, lasers, control loops, mechatronics and the related challenges when targeting the space environment.

You enjoy the R&D framework, ranging from (1) the meticulous system integration to (2) the execution of extensive test campaigns in the cleanroom for calibration and optimization, and (3) the consolidation of space-qualified third-party software to drive the overall system. You are passionate about continuous improvement and you feel at ease in a multidisciplinary and international environment, being the one with first hands on the core of the system.

Responsabilities

- Technical responsible for both core system and cleanroom throughout the test campaigns

- Technical lead on tests and experiments (test plans, test executions and test reports, from requirements to the compliance matrix)

- Point of contact for the high-level SW architecture and responsible for limited SW implementations

- Support on both formal and informal reviews

- Support on proof-of-concepts

- Assist on both system integration and maintenance in the cleanroom

Requirements

- MS/PhD in Engineering (Mechatronics, Microtechnology, Photonics, Electronics, Optoelectronics, Optomechanics, Automation, etc.)

- Experience in or interest for the following areas: - Satcom and payload architectures - Lasers and optomechanics - Mechatronics, HW, SW - Python - Test activities in cleanroom - Instrumentation and automation - Low-noise and low-vibration environments

- Prior working experience in industry is a plus

- Swiss or EU (27) citizenship

- Fluent English

description:
Unsere Mission

Photovoltaik wirtschaftlich, einfach und sorglos machen. Wir bringen die Energiewende ins Gebäude – mit intelligenten Lösungen für Eigenverbrauch & Elektromobilität, die sich für alle lohnen: Investor:innen, Nutzer:innen und unsere Zukunft.

Als ZEV-Pionierin ist Smart Energy Link (SEL) heute die führende Schweizer B2B-Plattform für Abrechnung und intelligente Steuerung dezentraler Energieinfrastruktur. Mit einem Team von rund 35 Mitarbeitenden haben wir bereits über 700 Projekte erfolgreich realisiert und betreuen mehr als 20'000 Wohneinheiten im Bereich ZEV und Metering.

Deine Rolle

SEL wächst vom Start-up zum Scale-up. Du sorgst dafür, dass man uns sieht, versteht und vertraut. Du schreibst gerne und erklärst komplexe Themen wie ZEV, vZEV, LEG und Energiemanagement verständlich, in Texten und Geschichten, die man mit Freude liest.

Der CEO gibt die Leitplanken für Marke und Kommunikation vor, du setzt sie eigenverantwortlich um. KI nutzt du selbstverständlich als Werkzeug. Bei uns erwarten dich kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen und viel Raum für eigene Ideen.

Deine Aufgaben

Markenauftritt: Du achtest darauf, dass SEL in allen Texten, Bildern und Kanälen einheitlich und wiedererkennbar auftritt.

Medien: Du schreibst Medienmitteilungen, bereitest Referenzprojekte und Produktneuheiten für Fachmedien auf und pflegst den Kontakt zu Redaktionen.

Kund:innen und Partner:innen: Du informierst klar und verständlich über neue Funktionen, Änderungen oder Anlässe.

Employer Branding: Du vermittelst unsere Mission und unsere einzigartige Kultur glaubwürdig an zukünftige Mitarbeitende.

Content & Kanäle

Content Marketing: Du planst und erstellst Inhalte, von Referenzstorys über News bis zu Fachwissen, als Text, Bild und Video, und spielst sie kanalspezifisch auf Website, LinkedIn und Newsletter aus

Kanäle betreuen: Du bespielst die Website (CMS), LinkedIn und Newsletter und führst den Redaktionsplan.

Wissensbeiträge: Du baust unseren Content Hub laufend aus und schreibst so, dass man uns in Suchmaschinen und KI-Assistenten findet.

Wirkung: Du wertest Reichweite und Klicks aus und leitest daraus Verbesserungen ab.

Unterstützung & Anlässe

Unterlagen: Du aktualisierst Kundenunterlagen, die Unternehmenspräsentation und Kampagnenmaterial für unsere Fachbereiche.

Anlässe: Du unterstützt Messeauftritte, Partneranlässe und Webinare mit Unterlagen und Beiträgen, vor, während und nach dem Anlass.

Das bringst du mit

Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung in Kommunikation oder Marketing und bringst idealerweise Erfahrung mit im B2B-Marketing.

Du schreibst gerne, formulierst überzeugend, einfach und elegant.

Im Online-Marketing bist du zu Hause: CMS, SEO/GEO, Paid Ads, E-Mail-Marketing und Analytics.

Du arbeitest gerne selbständig, bist neugierig und probierst gerne Neues aus.

Du bist Optimist:in und willst etwas für eine erneuerbare Energiezukunft bewegen.

Erfahrung mit Bewegtbild, etwa kurzen Social-Media-Videos, ist ein Plus.

Was wir bieten

Bei SEL arbeitest du an etwas, das zählt: Du prägst die Zukunft des Schweizer Energiesektors mit. Tag für Tag.

Wir nehmen uns Zeit für deinen Start: Du wirst sorgfältig eingearbeitet und übernimmst die Stelle mit einer persönlichen Übergabe.

Du bringst dich ein und gestaltest SEL aktiv mit, inklusive Mitarbeitendenbeteiligung.

Wir fördern dein Lernen & Wachstum und beteiligen uns an Kursen, Aus- und Weiterbildungen.

Wir leben Flexibilität: Du gestaltest deinen Arbeitsalltag weitgehend selbst.

Wir arbeiten mit Jahresarbeitszeit und einer 40-Stunden-Woche.

plus: NIKIN-Hoodie, Füürabe-Aareschwumm und Glace im Gfrüürfach

title: AI-ready Solutions Architect - Workplace & Security
description:
Alle wollen Copilot und AI-Agents. Aber ist das Fundament überhaupt bereit dafür?

Wer Copilot auf einem chaotischen Tenant ausrollt, liefert seinen Mitarbeitenden einen sehr schnellen Weg zu Daten, die sie nie sehen sollten. Plötzlich findet jemand die Lohnliste der Geschäftsleitung oder den Entwurf zur Reorganisation. Du sorgst dafür, dass das nicht passiert: Du machst Workplace- und Cloud-Umgebungen von Schweizer Unternehmen bereit für AI, sicher und sauber aufgesetzt, hands-on und mit eigener Handschrift.

Wir bei Epic Fusion sind ein AI-native Team: unkompliziert, kurze Wege, viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Wir probieren Neues aus, ganz im Sinne von «Learn it over Know it», und bauen es direkt in unsere Prozesse ein. Nicht alles funktioniert auf Anhieb, aber wir lernen schnell und bauen auf dem auf, was sich bewährt. Ein fertiges Prozesshandbuch für jede Situation gibt es bei uns nicht. Wenn du das brauchst, sind wir nicht die Richtigen. Wenn du es lieber selbst schreibst, schon.

Das gestaltest du bei uns:

Fundament legen: Du entwirfst Zielarchitekturen für Modern Workplaces mit Intune, Entra ID, Defender, Windows 365 und Azure Virtual Desktop.

AI-ready machen: Du räumst Identitäten, Berechtigungen und Datenklassifizierung auf, damit Copilot und Agents nur sehen, was sie sehen dürfen.

Absichern: Du entwickelst Security- und Governance-Konzepte mit Defender, Purview und Agent 365.

Automatisieren: Was zweimal von Hand passiert, löst du mit Graph API, PowerShell oder Infrastructure as Code.

Richtung geben: Du analysierst Kundenumgebungen, setzt klare Prioritäten und erklärst sie so, dass Technik und Management wissen, was als Nächstes passiert. Neue Microsoft- und AI-Features testest du, bevor sie beim Kunden ankommen.

Du passt zu uns, wenn …

du Intune, Entra ID und M365 konfigurieren kannst und auch erklären kannst, warum etwas so sein muss. Azure und Defender sind dir nicht fremd.

du mehrere Jahre im Microsoft-Cloud- oder Security-Umfeld gearbeitet hast und weisst, wie Tenants in der Realität aussehen.

du ein Studium an einer FH oder HF abgeschlossen hast oder auf anderem Weg ein Niveau erreicht hast, das sich damit messen kann.

du einem CIO in fünf Minuten erklären kannst, warum sein Copilot-Rollout noch warten muss, und er sich danach bei dir bedankt.

du Copilot, Agents oder Purview schon ausprobiert hast, weil es dich interessiert hat und nicht weil es jemand verlangt hat.

du auf Deutsch und Englisch souverän kommunizierst.

.. und dich diese Benefits ansprechen:

AI ohne Limit: Auf unserer eigenen Frontier Engine arbeitest du mit den 30 führenden Frontier-Modellen (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Mistral, Moonshot), dazu kommt Microsoft Copilot inklusive Cowork. Ein Token-Budget gibt es nicht.

Weiterbildung: Du bildest dich gezielt weiter und besuchst internationale Konferenzen, um früh zu sehen, was als Nächstes kommt.

Arbeiten, wo es passt: in unseren Office-Hubs in Zürich oder Bern oder remote aus der ganzen Schweiz.

6 Wochen Ferien, geschäftliche Fahrten SBB 1. Klasse und eine exzellente Pensionskassenlösung.

Alles ist irgendwie dringend und nicht alles ist gleich wichtig. Du bringst Ordnung hinein: Du erkennst, was brennt, löst selbst, was du lösen kannst, und gibst den Rest gezielt an die richtigen Specialist Engineers weiter. Unsere Kunden merken davon vor allem eines, nämlich dass es funktioniert.

Wir bei Epic Fusion sind ein AI-native Team: unkompliziert, kurze Wege, viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Wir probieren Neues aus, ganz im Sinne von «Learn it over Know it», und bauen es direkt in unsere Prozesse ein. Unseren Helpdesk verstehen wir als intelligente, agentengestützte Serviceplattform und nicht als Ticketsystem. Nicht alles funktioniert auf Anhieb, aber wir lernen schnell und bauen auf dem auf, was sich bewährt. Ein fertiges Prozesshandbuch für jede Situation gibt es bei uns nicht. Wenn du das brauchst, sind wir nicht die Richtigen. Wenn du es lieber selbst schreibst, schon.

Das gestaltest du bei uns:

Den Überblick behalten: Du übernimmst die Ticket-Triage im B2B-Helpdesk, setzt Prioritäten und sorgst dafür, dass jeder Case beim richtigen Menschen landet.

Selbst lösen: Second-Level-Anfragen rund um Microsoft 365 bearbeitest du eigenständig, vom Troubleshooting über die Konfiguration bis zur Wurzelursachenanalyse. Du willst wissen, warum etwas kaputt war, und nicht nur, dass es wieder läuft.

SLAs im Griff haben: Du überwachst SLAs und offene Cases und greifst ein, bevor etwas eskaliert.

Kunden auf Augenhöhe begleiten: Du pflegst die Kundenbeziehung proaktiv. Unsere Kunden wissen, wen sie anrufen können, und vertrauen dir.

Im Team spielen: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Operations- und Workplace-Specialists zusammen und gibst Fälle so weiter, dass niemand nachfragen muss.

Den Helpdesk smarter machen: Was zweimal von Hand passiert, schaust du dir genauer an. Du gestaltest mit, wie AI-Agents und automatisierte Workflows Triage, Analyse und Kommunikation im Helpdesk übernehmen.

Du passt zu uns, wenn …

du Microsoft 365 aus der Praxis kennst und Intune, Entra ID, Exchange, Teams oder SharePoint für dich keine Fremdwörter sind. Erfahrung mit Software-Paketierung, Printix oder Azure ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

du bereits in einem Helpdesk oder IT-Operations-Umfeld gearbeitet hast und weisst, wie sich ein voller Montagmorgen anfühlt.

du AI-Tools schon ausprobiert hast, weil es dich interessiert hat und nicht weil es jemand verlangt hat.

du auf Deutsch und Englisch souverän kommunizierst.
