description:
Über uns

Als junge Wirtschaftskanzlei in Passau beraten wir Unternehmen verschiedener Größen – von jungen Startups bis zu etablierten Familienbetrieben. Direkt, unternehmerisch und ohne juristische Floskeln.

Um unser Wachstum weiter voranzutreiben, suchen wir eine engagierte Person für die Stelle als People & Operations Associate (m/w/d). Hier hast du die Möglichkeit, den Aufbau eines jungen Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten. Du unterstützt im Recruiting und Onboarding, erarbeitest Berichte und Auswertungen für unsere Führungskräfte und sorgst dafür, dass unsere bestehenden Prozesse sorgfältig dokumentiert und stetig verbessert werden.

Wenn du neugierig bist und dich in unserem Team einbringen willst, dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Werde Teil von Holegal und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft des Rechtswesens im digitalen Zeitalter!

Deine Aufgaben

Recruiting und Onboarding koordinieren: Du vereinbarst Termine, führst Vorgespräche mit Bewerber:innen, holst Unterlagen ein und begleitest das Onboarding.

Berichte und Auswertungen erstellen: Du baust und pflegst Reportings und bereitest Ergebnisse für Entscheidungen auf.

Prozesse dokumentieren und verbessern: Du hältst fest, wie Abläufe heute funktionieren, findest Schwachstellen und setzt Verbesserungen mit um.

Stabsstellen mit aufbauen: Du unterstützt beim Aufbau der künftigen Bereiche, von der Struktur bis zur Umsetzung.

Deine Qualifikationen

Ein Studium mit wirtschaftlichem Schwerpunkt, eine kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office, vor allem Excel, Word und Outlook

Fließendes Deutsch und gutes Englisch

Eigeninitiative: Du siehst, was zu tun ist, und packst es an

Eine strukturierte, gut organisierte Arbeitsweise, auch wenn mehrere Themen parallel laufen

Vorausschauendes Denken: Du erkennst Engpässe, bevor sie entstehen

Den Anspruch, Dinge stetig besser zu machen, statt sie nur zu verwalten

Gewünscht aber kein Muss: Erfahrung mit KI-Tools und ein sicherer Umgang damit im Arbeitsalltag, sowie erste Erfahrungen in HR, Recruiting oder Operations

Benefits

Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust eine Kanzlei mit auf. Deine Ideen werden umgesetzt, nicht abgelegt.

Kurze Wege: Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Manager People & Operations und eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen.

Entwicklung: Mit den Stabsstellen wachsen auch die Möglichkeiten, dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Flexibilität: Homeoffice-Regelung, Arbeitszeitmodell

Extras: kostenfreie Getränke, Teamevents, Tischtennis in den Pausen.

Vergütung

Wir bieten ein Gehalt von 36.000 € – 48.000 €/Jahr.

title: Werkstudent:in Sachbearbeitung Erneuerbare Energien (m/w/d)
description:
Hi!

Wie schön, dass du hier gelandet bist und überlegst, als Werkstudent:in Teil unseres tollen Teams in Hamburg zu werden.

Hast du Lust, gemeinsam mit unserem Team die Energiewende voranzutreiben? Dann herzlich willkommen bei der KlimaInvest Green Concepts GmbH! Seit 2009 setzen wir uns für eine klimafreundliche Zukunft durch regenerative Energien ein. Mit unserem Wissen und unserer Erfahrung unterstützen wir unsere Kund:innen und zählen zu den führenden Dienstleistern im Bereich der erneuerbaren Energiewirtschaft für Stadtwerke und Energieversorger in Deutschland.

Somit haben wir nicht nur das Glück, in einem wirklich großartigen Team, sondern auch noch an einem sinnhaften und wichtigen Thema dieser Zeit zu arbeiten: Erneuerbare Energien und Klimaschutz.

Willst du mitmachen?

Werkstudent:in Service Management

Das erwartet dich:

Du unterstützt in erster Linie unser Servicemanagement beim Alltagsgeschäft und nach Bedarf auch andere Teams bei administrativen Aufgaben.
Du erstellst Dokumente für unsere Kund:innen, die bei uns Klimapartner heißen, und kümmerst dich um ihre Belange, die per E-Mail oder telefonisch eingehen.
Du lernst unser CRM-System Sugar sowie andere Programme kennen und hilfst uns dabei, Daten zu erfassen, aufzubereiten und so für eine gute Qualitätssicherung zu sorgen.
Du pflegst unser internes Informationssystem.

Was solltest du mitbringen:

Du bist noch mindestens für ein Jahr als Student:in eingeschrieben, Fachrichtung egal – Vielfältigkeit macht unser Team aus!
Du arbeitest sorgfältig, strukturiert und gewissenhaft.
Du bist äußerst zuverlässig und hast keine Angst, auch mal ans Telefon zu gehen.
Du bist digital-affin, kennst dich mit Office 365 aus und hast Spaß daran, neue Programme kennenzulernen.
Du bringst neben sehr guten Deutschkenntnissen auch noch ein gutes Zahlenverständnis mit.
Teamfähigkeit und Aufgeschlossenheit runden dein Profil ab.

Was bieten wir dir?

Eine sinnstiftende Arbeit in einem zukunftsrelevanten Thema mit der Möglichkeit, verschiedene Bereiche bei uns kennenzulernen.
Flexible Arbeitszeiten zwischen 15-20 Stunden, gerne an 2-3 Tagen pro Woche.
Einen mobilen Arbeitstag pro Woche nach deiner Einarbeitung.
15 € Stundenlohn in den ersten sechs Monaten, dann 16 € und nach einem Jahr 17 € sowie bezahlte Urlaubstage.
Eine vergünstigte und von uns darüber hinaus bezuschusste Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft.
Natürlich Kaffee, Tee – alles in Bio-Qualität – sprudelndes Wasser aus dem Wasserhahn, Bio-Obst- und Gemüse, Nüsschen und auch Süßigkeiten finden ihren Weg zu uns.
Teamevents wie der Tag im Grünen und After Work Sit-ins und das alles mit dem sympathischsten und tollsten Team, das du dir vorstellen kannst!

Klingt gut bis hierhin? Dann freuen wir uns jetzt auf deine Bewerbung.

Wie geht es jetzt weiter?
Hast du dich beworben, gibt es eine kurze Eingangsbestätigung. Wenn deine Bewerbungsunterlagen grundsätzlich passen, folgt ein erstes digitales Kennenlerngespräch mit uns via Teams, in dem wir gucken, ob wir auf einer Wellenlänge schwimmen und uns eine Zusammenarbeit vorstellen können. Falls wir das beide mit Ja beantworten, gibt es ein zweites Gespräch hier vor Ort mit unserer Service-Management-Leitung und einem unserer Geschäftsführer. Sollten wir alle weiterhin das Gefühl haben, dass es sehr gut passt, folgt ein Vertragsangebot.

In der Regel sind wir sehr fix, dauert es doch mal länger, liegt es an anderen Terminen oder Urlaubszeiten. Wir melden uns aber auf jeden Fall und du kannst es natürlich auch tun.

Jetzt freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

  • Du lernst unser CRM-System Sugar sowie andere Programme kennen und hilfst uns dabei, Daten zu erfassen, aufzubereiten und so für eine gute Qualitätssicherung zu sorgen.
  • Du pflegst unser internes Informationssystem.


Was solltest du mitbringen:

  • Du bist noch mindestens für ein Jahr als Student:in eingeschrieben, Fachrichtung egal – Vielfältigkeit macht unser Team aus!
  • Du arbeitest sorgfältig, strukturiert und gewissenhaft.
  • Du bist äußerst zuverlässig und hast keine Angst, auch mal ans Telefon zu gehen.
  • Du bist digital-affin, kennst dich mit Office 365 aus und hast Spaß daran, neue Programme kennenzulernen.
  • Du bringst neben sehr guten Deutschkenntnissen auch noch ein gutes Zahlenverständnis mit.
  • Teamfähigkeit und Aufgeschlossenheit runden dein Profil ab.


Was bieten wir dir?

  • Eine sinnstiftende Arbeit in einem zukunftsrelevanten Thema mit der Möglichkeit, verschiedene Bereiche bei uns kennenzulernen.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten zwischen 15-20 Stunden, gerne an 2-3 Tagen pro Woche.
  • Einen mobilen Arbeitstag pro Woche nach deiner Einarbeitung.
  • 15 € Stundenlohn in den ersten sechs Monaten, dann 16 € und nach einem Jahr 17 € sowie bezahlte Urlaubstage.
  • Eine vergünstigte und von uns darüber hinaus bezuschusste Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft.
  • Natürlich Kaffee, Tee – alles in Bio-Qualität – sprudelndes Wasser aus dem Wasserhahn, Bio-Obst- und Gemüse, Nüsschen und auch Süßigkeiten finden ihren Weg zu uns.
  • Teamevents wie der Tag im Grünen und After Work Sit-ins und das alles mit dem sympathischsten und tollsten Team, das du dir vorstellen kannst!

Hast du dich beworben, gibt es eine kurze Eingangsbestätigung. Falls wir das beide mit Ja beantworten, gibt es ein zweites Gespräch hier vor Ort mit unserer Service-Management-Leitung und einem unserer Geschäftsführer. Sollten wir alle weiterhin das Gefühl haben, dass es sehr gut passt, folgt ein Vertragsangebot.

In der Regel sind wir sehr fix, dauert es doch mal länger, liegt es an anderen Terminen oder Urlaubszeiten. Wir melden uns aber auf jeden Fall und du kannst es natürlich auch tun.

Jetzt freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Deine Andrea Hupe

title: Service Delivery & Projektmanager (m/w/d) - 1450
description:
Bei ITconfig/all betreuen Sie Kunden unterschiedlicher Größen – von kleinen und mittelständischen Unternehmen bis zu großen Enterprise-Organisationen. Entsprechend vielseitig ist Ihre Rolle: Im KMU-Umfeld koordinieren Sie die vereinbarten IT-Services im direkten Austausch mit den Ansprechpartnern unserer Kunden.

Im Enterprise-Umfeld steuern Sie definierte Servicebereiche und Projekte mit mehreren beteiligten Teams, klaren Schnittstellen und verbindlichen Service Levels. Dabei verbinden Sie Kundennähe mit strukturiertem Service- und Projektmanagement.

Aufgaben

Sie verantworten die operative Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung unserer IT-Services und stellen eine hohe Servicequalität und Kundenzufriedenheit sicher.

Sie steuern die Service Delivery entlang der vereinbarten Leistungsumfänge und Service Level Agreements (SLAs) – von der Ressourcen- und Einsatzplanung über die Abstimmung mit internen Fachbereichen und externen Partnern bis zur Überwachung der Service- und Qualitätsziele.

Sie planen und steuern IT-Projekte und Service-Transitions – von der Aufnahme der Kundenanforderungen über die Termin-, Ressourcen- und Budgetplanung bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung und Übergabe in den Regelbetrieb.

Sie sind zentraler Ansprechpartner für operative Service- und Projektthemen. Sie führen regelmäßige Service Reviews durch, vereinbaren Maßnahmen und unterstützen gemeinsam mit dem Account Management bei Vertrags- und Serviceanpassungen.

Sie übernehmen das operative Eskalationsmanagement und koordinieren die beteiligten Teams, um Störungen, Serviceabweichungen und Projektprobleme nachhaltig zu lösen.

Sie erstellen und analysieren Service- und Projektberichte. Mit relevanten Kennzahlen schaffen Sie Transparenz über Leistung, Qualität, Kosten und Projektfortschritt.

Sie identifizieren Verbesserungspotenziale und setzen Maßnahmen zur Standardisierung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Service- und Projektmanagementprozesse um.

Qualifikation

Erfahrung im Service Delivery Management, IT-Service-Management oder in der Steuerung von IT-Projekten – idealerweise bei einem IT-Dienstleister oder im Managed-Service-Umfeld.

Erfahrung in der Koordination interner Teams und externer Dienstleister sowie in der Betreuung von Kunden und der Steuerung vereinbarter Leistungen.

Die Fähigkeit, sich auf unterschiedliche Kundenstrukturen einzustellen – vom direkten Austausch mit Geschäftsführung und IT-Verantwortlichen im Mittelstand bis zur Zusammenarbeit mit spezialisierten Ansprechpartnern und mehreren Dienstleistern im Enterprise-Umfeld.

Verständnis für IT-Service-Prozesse, SLAs und relevante Servicekennzahlen sowie für die wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhänge der Service- und Projektabwicklung.

Erfahrung mit ITSM-, Ticket- und Projektmanagementsystemen sowie einen sicheren Umgang mit gängigen Office- und Kollaborationswerkzeugen.

Kenntnisse gängiger Service- und Projektmanagementmethoden. Eine ITIL- oder Projektmanagementzertifizierung ist von Vorteil.

Ausgeprägte Kunden- und Serviceorientierung, Kommunikationsstärke und ein souveränes Auftreten – auch in anspruchsvollen Abstimmungs- und Eskalationssituationen.

Analytische Fähigkeiten, eine strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie Organisationstalent, Verlässlichkeit und Teamfähigkeit

Sehr gute Deutsch- und mindestens gute Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

Persönliche Zusatzleistungen, flexibel auf deine Bedürfnisse
zugeschnitten – z. B. Jobticket, JobRad, Gympass oder andere
Zusatzleistungen, die individuell vereinbart werden können

Sehr gutes und angenehmes Betriebsklima in einem dynamischen und internationalen Arbeitsumfeld

Onsite, Hybrid, Workation – Flexibilität bei der Wahl des Arbeitsplatzes

Eine offene Kommunikationskultur mit flachen Hierarchien und schnellen Entscheidungsprozessen

Unterstützung bei der beruflichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung

title: Projekt-/Finanzcontroller (m/w/d)
description:
Das Unternehmen

Unser Auftraggeber ist eine erfolgreiche, wachsende Wohnungsbaugesellschaft im Eigentum eines Landkreises. Das Unternehmen entwickelt und realisiert moderne Wohnungsbauprojekte in der Region und verbindet unternehmerisches Handeln mit einem gesellschaftlich wichtigen Auftrag.

Zur Weiterentwicklung des Unternehmenscontrollings suchen wir einen erfahrenen

Projekt-/Finanzcontroller (m/w/d)

Wohnungsbau | Eigenverantwortung | Sicherer Arbeitsplatz

der seinen Verantwortungsbereich eigenständig gestaltet und als kompetenter Ansprechpartner der Geschäftsführung agiert.

Gestalte das Controlling eines kommunalen Wohnungsbauunternehmens!

Du möchtest nicht nur Zahlen analysieren, sondern mit Deinen Auswertungen und Empfehlungen unternehmerische Entscheidungen aktiv mitgestalten? Du schätzt eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten, kurze Entscheidungswege und die Sicherheit eines kommunalen Unternehmens?

Dann bietet Dir diese Position eine interessante berufliche Perspektive.

In dieser verantwortungsvollen Position übernimmst Du das gesamte Unternehmens- und Projektcontrolling und entwickelst die bestehenden Strukturen und Instrumente kontinuierlich weiter.

Deine Aufgaben – Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum

Unternehmens- und Finanzcontrolling

Du verantwortest eigenständig das Unternehmens- und Immobiliencontrolling und entwickelst dessen Strukturen und Instrumente weiter.
Du erstellst Wirtschafts-, Finanz- und Liquiditätsplanungen sowie regelmäßige Forecasts.
Du analysierst die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung anhand relevanter Kennzahlen, Soll-Ist-Vergleiche und Abweichungsanalysen.
Du bereitest aussagekräftige Reports und Entscheidungsvorlagen für die Geschäftsführung auf und leitest konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

Projekt- und Investitionscontrolling

Du begleitest Neubau- und Investitionsprojekte aus kaufmännischer Sicht und überwachst deren Budgets, Kosten und Wirtschaftlichkeit.
Du erstellst Investitionsrechnungen, Wirtschaftlichkeitsanalysen sowie Szenario- und Sensitivitätsberechnungen.
Du erkennst wirtschaftliche Risiken und Abweichungen frühzeitig und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Projektverantwortlichen geeignete Steuerungsmaßnahmen.

Prozesse und Zusammenarbeit

Du optimierst Controllingprozesse, Reportingstrukturen und digitale Auswertungsmöglichkeiten.
Du unterstützt bei Jahresabschlussarbeiten und arbeitest mit dem Rechnungswesen sowie externen Wirtschaftsprüfern zusammen.
Du stehst in engem Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und den Bereichen Technik, Rechnungswesen und Bestandsmanagement.

Das Besondere: Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für sämtliche Controllingthemen im Unternehmen. Dabei genießt Du ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung und hast die Möglichkeit, Deinen Verantwortungsbereich nachhaltig zu gestalten.

Dein Profil – analytisch, strukturiert und unternehmerisch denkend

Du hast ein Studium der Betriebswirtschaft, Immobilienwirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit Schwerpunkt Controlling, Finanzen oder Rechnungswesen erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
Du verfügst über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Controlling, idealerweise in der Wohnungs- oder Immobilienwirtschaft.
Du bist sicher in der Unternehmens- und Finanzplanung, im Reporting sowie in der Investitions- und Wirtschaftlichkeitsrechnung.
Erfahrungen im Projektcontrolling von Bau- oder Investitionsvorhaben sind willkommen.
Du beherrschst MS Excel sehr gut und hast idealerweise bereits mit ERP- oder BI-Systemen gearbeitet, beispielsweise Aareon oder DOMUS.

Was Dich persönlich auszeichnet:

Du denkst analytisch, arbeitest strukturiert und behältst auch bei komplexen Sachverhalten den Überblick. Mit Eigeninitiative, Beharrlichkeit und einem ausgeprägten Verständnis für wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge gehst Du den Dingen auf den Grund.
Du kommunizierst Deine Ergebnisse verständlich, vertrittst Deine Einschätzungen überzeugend und verstehst Dich als konstruktiver Partner der Geschäftsführung und Deiner Kollegen.
Dabei verbindest Du selbstständiges, lösungsorientiertes Arbeiten mit Teamgeist, Zuverlässigkeit und dem Anspruch, Dinge kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

Deine Vorteile – Sicherheit trifft Gestaltungsspielraum

Ein Arbeitsplatz mit langfristiger Perspektive

Unbefristete Festanstellung in einer erfolgreichen kommunalen Wohnungsbaugesellschaft
Hohe Arbeitsplatzsicherheit durch die öffentliche Trägerschaft
Verantwortungsvolle Position mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum und direkter Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung

Attraktive Rahmenbedingungen

Attraktives Gehaltspaket
Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Urlaubstage
Zusätzliche Altersversorgung (ZVK)
Betriebliche Berufsunfähigkeits- und Krankenversicherung
Vermögenswirksame Leistungen

Ein Umfeld, in dem Du etwas bewegen kannst

Modernes, zeitgemäßes digitales Arbeitsumfeld
Gezielte Förderung Deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterbildung
Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben rund um anspruchsvolle Wohnungsbau- und Investitionsprojekte
Die Möglichkeit, einen gesellschaftlich wichtigen Auftrag aktiv mitzugestalten
Unterstützung bei der Wohnungssuche

Interessiert?

Du suchst eine Position, in der Du Dein Controlling-Know-how eigenverantwortlich einsetzen, Strukturen weiterentwickeln und zugleich von der Sicherheit eines kommunalen Unternehmens profitieren kannst?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen!

Bewirb Dich und erfahre mehr über diese interessante berufliche Perspektive.

Bewerbung / Kontakt

Hallo, gerne geben wir Dir nähere Infos zu Job und Unternehmen zu bekommen? Rufe mich einfach jederzeit an, auch außerhalb üblicher Arbeitszeiten, unter 0201 18504-0. Du wirst ggf. auch auf mein Handy weitergeleitet. Gerne kannst Du mir auch eine Nachricht senden.

title: Senior Game Producer (Live Games) - Fully Remote
description:
At SOFTGAMES, we’re looking for a Senior Game Producer to lead one of our most exciting casual games on Facebook Instant. You’ll be at the heart of a small, agile team, defining the product vision, shaping the creative direction, and driving the roadmap for a game with significant growth potential.

We’re looking for someone who combines strong product thinking with excellent game design instincts. You understand what makes casual games engaging, know how to turn player insights into compelling features, and use data to continuously improve the player experience. From gameplay and progression to LiveOps and monetization, you’ll help shape every aspect of the game.

Your role:

Own and drive the game’s vision, strategy, and roadmap

Design and evolve engaging gameplay, progression, LiveOps, and monetization features that improve player engagement and business performance

Prioritize the roadmap based on player impact, business value, and development effort

Analyze player behavior, market trends, and A/B test results to make data driven product decisions

Lead and mentor a small team while fostering a strong product culture

Collaborate closely with Game Designers, Artists, Engineers, BI, and UA to deliver high quality features from concept to launch

Balance the game economy and continuously optimize retention, engagement, and monetization KPIs

Apply agile and lean development practices while identifying risks, removing blockers, and driving execution

Stay on top of market trends, player expectations, and competitor games to identify new opportunities

Partner closely with the Head of Studio to define product strategy and priorities

Your profile:

5+ years of experience in Game Production, Product Management, or Game Design for free-to-play mobile games

Proven track record of owning and growing successful live casual games

Strong game design skills with a deep understanding of player motivation, progression, game economy, and feature design

Strong product thinking with the ability to turn player insights and business goals into engaging game features

Highly analytical and comfortable using data to validate hypotheses and drive product decisions

Solid understanding of free-to-play monetization, LiveOps, retention, and UA fundamentals

Strong leadership, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills

Comfortable working with cross-functional and distributed teams

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Based within CET ±2 hours

Benefits:

SOFTGAMES offers a competitive package, including:

Remote-first, your way — Work fully remote from wherever you do your best work, or drop into our modern Berlin office whenever you like. You choose

Flexible hours — Structure your working hours to your needs. No crunch culture. No overtime

Generous vacation — Time to recharge, wherever in the world you are

Home office budget — We fund your setup so your home office actually works for you

Learning & development — Training budget for everyone, whether you're deepening expertise or picking up something entirely new

Top-tier equipment — A high-spec laptop, ready to get your best work done

Meal allowance — A monthly budget dedicated to your lunches

Home office utility grant — We cover a monthly contribution toward your electricity and internet costs

Company swag — Hoodies, bags, mugs — the good stuff

Annual company retreat — At least once a year, the whole company comes together to connect, align, and celebrate. Our events in general are epic but our off-site Retreat is one of a kind.

At SOFTGAMES, we value a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone's ideas are heard and valued. Join our dynamic team and be part of the exciting world of mobile gaming. Apply now and let your expertise shine!

SOFTGAMES is the global powerhouse in Instant Gaming. We believe that great games should be accessible to everyone, everywhere, instantly. Our mission is to create high-quality, social-first gaming experiences that run seamlessly across all devices, breaking down the barriers between players and their next favorite game.

Our vision is simple: to become the daily habit of casual gamers worldwide. We don't just build games; we create long-lasting digital worlds where millions of people connect, compete, and play every single day. By partnering closely with giants like Meta, Microsoft and Samsung, we are shaping the future of play, delivering rich, engaging content to a global audience of billions.

SOFTGAMES is a remote-first studio and home to over 135 passionate experts from all over the world. We thrive on proactive, independent teams with the freedom to take initiative and challenge the status quo. If you want to build the next generation of frictionless, everlasting games, you’ve found your home.

Have we caught your interest? Then we look forward to your detailed application together with your salary expectations and earliest possible start date.

title: Senior Product Manager - Productization (m/w/d)
description:
Die Rolle

Wir haben in den letzten Jahren gezeigt, dass wir echte Kundenprobleme lösen können. Jetzt geht es darum, aus bewährten Lösungen wiederholbare Produkte zu machen, die sich skalierbar verkaufen und liefern lassen. Genau dafür suchen wir Dich!

Du machst aus validierten Kundenlösungen skalierbare Produkte. Unser Product-Modell folgt drei Phasen: 0→1 (Kundenproblem verstehen, Lösung im Kundenfall beweisen), 1→n (daraus ein wiederholbares Produkt machen) und n (skalierbar verkaufen, liefern, weiterentwickeln).

Dein Fokus liegt auf 1→ n1→n: Du klärst, was das Produkt ist, für wen, welchen messbaren Mehrwert es liefert und wie es als Standardangebot verkauft und geliefert wird. Du verantwortest Produkt und Produktisierung – Engineering, Delivery, Sales und Product Marketing bleiben für Umsetzung, Kundenprojekt, Opportunity und Vermarktung zuständig. Darüber hinaus verantwortest Du den Lifecycle bestehender Produkte: Du sicherst ihre Stärken und Standards und entwickelst sie gezielt weiter.

Deine Aufgaben:

Validierte Lösungen konsequent in wiederholbare, standardisierte Angebote überführen
Zielkunden, Pain, Business Value und Value Proposition schärfen
Klaren Standardumfang und klare Produktgrenzen definieren – inklusive dessen, was bewusst nicht dazugehört
Gemeinsam mit Engineering die notwendige Produktreife herstellen
Kundenfeedback pragmatisch in Produktentscheidungen übersetzen
Product Marketing die fachliche Grundlage für Positionierung, Messaging und Content geben
Sales und Presales befähigen, das Produkt ohne permanente Product-Unterstützung zu erklären und zu verkaufen
Delivery befähigen, Einführung und Betrieb mit kalkulierbarem Aufwand umzusetzen
Lifecycle, Weiterentwicklung und Priorisierung verantworten, für neu produktisierte ebenso wie für bestehende Produkte, deren Stärken und Standards es zu sichern gilt

Was Du mitbringst

5+ Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Product Management im komplexen B2B- bzw. Enterprise-Software-Umfeld
Nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, aus individuellen Kundenanforderungen, Piloten oder Prototypen ein standardisiertes, wiederholbares Produkt zu machen
Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis für komplexe Software-, Daten- und AI-Produkte: Du arbeitest mit Engineering auf Augenhöhe und verbindest Business, Kunde, Produkt und Technologie – ohne selbst Engineer sein zu müssen
Pragmatische Arbeitsweise mit starkem 80/20-Schnitt und schneller Entscheidungsfähigkeit auch bei unvollständigen Informationen, getragen von fundierter methodischer Product-Erfahrung
Hohe Ownership: Risiken früh erkennen und mit einer klaren Empfehlung kommen statt mit der Bitte um mehr Zeit oder Ressourcen
Klarer Fokus auf Business Value und Ergebnisse statt auf Prozesse, mit dem Talent, Komplexität zu reduzieren
Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Industriekunden oder Enterprise-Lösungen wie Manufacturing, PLM, ERP, SCM oder Data
Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine vor Ort
Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift

Was die Rolle nicht ist

Damit Du einschätzen kannst, ob die Rolle zu Dir passt: Wir suchen bewusst nicht

einen klassischen Product Owner mit Schwerpunkt Backlog und Tickets,
einen reinen Projektmanager,
einen weiteren 0→1-Innovator,
einen Presales-Spezialisten,
einen reinen Strategen,
einen technischen Product Manager, der primär in Features und Architektur denkt.

Benefits:

Echte Gestaltungsverantwortung: Du prägst eine neu definierte Rolle und unser Product-Betriebsmodell für 2027 und darüber hinaus
Kurze Wege: direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Engineering, Sales und Delivery
Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeiten, flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub
Modernes Umfeld: Büro im Münchner Werksviertel (House of Communication), moderne Ausstattung und internationale, diverse Teams
Entwicklung & Kultur: Regelmäßiges Feedback, flache Hierarchien und kollaborative Zusammenarbeit
Plus: Spendit Card, Urban Sports Club oder EGYM Wellpass, kostenlose Getränke, Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Kaffee & Obst sowie Team- und Office-Events

Mission Brief 

Isar Aerospace is building Spectrum, a European launch vehicle. As an Intern in Data Engineering, you help bring engineering, manufacturing, business and operations data into one place, connecting sources to our emerging warehouse, building reliable data models and delivering dashboards that support company decisions. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission:

  • Build dashboards. Develop and maintain Metabase and Power BI dashboards for company KPIs.

  • Education: Enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s in computer science, data engineering or information systems; available for at least six months. 
  • Experience: Initial hands-on experience with pipelines, data ingestion or analytics through an internship, working student role or personal projects. 
  • Technical skills: Solid Python fundamentals and confident SQL, including joins, aggregations and relational schema basics. 
  • Tools and learning: Basic REST API, JSON, authentication and Git knowledge; comfortable learning new tools and data sources from documentation. 
  • Working style: Structured and detail-oriented, with a focus on accurate results and turning unclear requests into precise questions. 
  • Languages: Fluent English and clear communication; German is an advantage. 

Bonus Skills

We are Isar Aerospace and we are at the forefront of New Space building a modern space business to enable faster, better and cheaper access to space.

Our mission is to help democratise space and use it for good in order to improve life on Earth now and for the future generations.

We are a fast-growing company aiming to provide sustainable and environmentally friendly launch solutions for small and medium-sized satellites and constellations into Low Earth Orbit. title: Senior EW Direction Finding & Estimation Engineer (All Genders)
description:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

YOUR MISSION

You will turn our directional mesh network into a sensor. Using the same aperture that carries traffic, you will build direction finding, spectrum sensing, and GNSS-free position estimation, and prove their accuracy in the field against surveyed references. You own the error budget and the evidence, from IQ samples up to a validated position.

 

ABOUT THE TEAM

STARK's Electronic Warfare team is a systems-focussed engineering group delivering software-defined, mass-scalable RF solutions for autonomous systems. Combining deep domain expertise in hardware board design, thermal/ structural packaging, real-time C++ signal processing, and resilient directional mesh networking, we rapidly build field advanced EW capabilities designed to survive and operate in contested spectrum environments. 

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Build position estimation from the mesh itself under GNSS denial: TDOA/TOA ranging, multilateration, geometry and GDOP, the clock-synchronisation error budget, and fusion with platform navigation.
  • Develop the DF and baseline spectrum-sensing chain on the directional aperture that carries traffic, running concurrently with communications.
  • Own antenna calibration together with the antenna team, and keep it valid in the field.
  • Own the error budget, design validation campaigns against surveyed references, and produce the evidence packs for programme milestones.

 

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • You have measured DF accuracy against real signals and done localisation with an explicit geometry and error budget. Practical experience is what counts here, not GNSS integration or theory alone.
  • You have run measurement campaigns validated against a surveyed reference.
  • You have calibrated an antenna array yourself.
  • You work comfortably from IQ data and channel-level observables upward.

 

NICE TO HAVE

  • A background in direction finding, radar, or SIGINT, whether from industry, a research institute, or space-based SIGINT.
  • Publications with a real measurement section.
  • Kalman filter or factor-graph estimation.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

 

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

No RF background is required. We are looking for a strong embedded and networking engineer who has put software on physical systems.

STARK's Electronic Warfare team is a systems-focussed engineering group delivering software-defined, mass-scalable RF solutions for autonomous systems. Combining deep domain expertise in hardware board design, thermal/ structural packaging, real-time C++ signal processing, and resilient directional mesh networking, we rapidly build field advanced EW capabilities designed to survive and operate in contested spectrum environments.

  • Integrate the datalink onto platform compute: embedded Linux bring-up, drivers, deployment images, OTA updates, and secure boot.
  • Build network management: node identity, configuration and key distribution, health monitoring, and remote diagnostics of fielded nodes.
  • Own automated logging as a deliverable in its own right: time-aligned at both ends of the link and detailed enough to serve as evidence for programme milestones.
  • Implement telemetry and video transport (UDP/TCP, RTP) and the interfaces to ground control stations and our C2 software.

  • Embedded Linux experience beyond the application level: bring-up, drivers, and product deployment.
  • Networking at packet level, including how UDP and TCP behave under loss.
  • You have integrated software onto a physical system (vehicle, robot, or aircraft) and you treat the log as a design object, not an afterthought.
  • C/C++, Python, and Yocto or a comparable build system.

 

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with the PX4, ArduPilot, or MAVLink ecosystem, ideally from a UAS manufacturer.
  • Video transport over constrained or lossy links.

title: Internship - Strategy & BizOps
description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

mission

As the Strategy & BizOps Intern at telli, you'll work right alongside the founding team across finance, legal, ops, and special projects. You'll have a front-row seat to how an early-stage AI company operates and a very hands-on role in keeping things running and moving fast.

what you’ll do:

help us build the operational backbone behind telli's growth

take on special projects, driving initiatives forward by coordinating stakeholders and keeping everything on track

support with finance operations by maintaining reports, chasing invoices, and managing payment flow

help the growth team close new customers by managing legal and compliance processes

support with our hiring pipeline, from screening candidates to scheduling interviews

help plan and execute internal and external events and keep the office running smoothly

work closely with Ennie and Philipp

what makes you a great fit:

you are hands-on and not afraid of doing unglamorous work

you're tech- & automation savvy and can learn new tools fast

you love solving problems and figuring things out on your own

you’re a strong communicator in both English and German

you’ve have initial (internship) experience and/or worked on side hustles or projects

you're done or at the end of university and could imagine starting full-time after the internship

you may not make a good fit if:

you have never touched automation/AI tools or don’t have basic technical understanding

you only want to do high-level “strategic” work

you aren’t comfortable juggling multiple tasks at once

you don’t enjoy working directly with customers or in dynamic environments

you’re only looking for a typical 9–5 internship

Compensation: €3K – €5K per month

• €3K – €5K per month

your mission:

You will be pivotal to telli’s growth. Your mission is to drive revenue by building trusted relationships with enterprise customers and closing complex, high-value deals (€100k+ land deal size). As one of the first Sr. Enterprise AEs at telli, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we win, navigate, and scale our enterprise sales motion.

what you'll do:

Own complex enterprise deals end-to-end: Lead €100k+ deals from first discovery through signature, including demos, business cases, security reviews, procurement, legal, contract negotiations, and executive alignment. You uncover where telli creates measurable value and build the case to make it a priority.

Build and own your pipeline: Our SDR team supports you, but you can generate own Enterprise pipeline. You identify the right accounts, develop account strategies, write outbound, make the calls, and create opportunities where none existed before.

Navigate complex buying committees: Build relationships across Sales, Operations, CX, IT, Security, Legal, Procurement, Finance, and the C-Suite at large organizations. You identify champions, understand internal politics, and create consensus across multiple stakeholders.

Run strategic, multi-threaded sales processes: You don't rely on a single champion. You map the organization, understand who influences the decision, and build relationships at multiple levels long before procurement enters the process.

Own a quota and close €100k+ deals: Drive meaningful new ARR and take full accountability for your forecast, pipeline coverage, and revenue target.

Build compelling business cases: Translate telli's product into measurable commercial impact for the customer and make the ROI clear enough to win internal budget and executive sponsorship.

Bring the customer into the company: Feed structured insights back into product, marketing, and strategy. You sit closest to some of our most important prospects and customers, and your signal helps shape what we build next.

what makes you a great fit:

You have 3+ years of experience closing enterprise deals: You have proven experience owning complex €100k+ sales cycles and selling to senior and C-Suite economic buyers.

You know how to navigate complexity: You've worked through long sales cycles involving multiple departments, procurement, security, legal, and competing internal priorities, without losing control of the deal.

You're an elite relationship builder: You know the difference between a contact, a champion, and an economic buyer. You build trust quickly and have won deals because of the relationships you created across an organization.

You're a hunter: You know how to manufacture pipeline without relying on a warm inbound stream. You're comfortable breaking into large accounts and creating urgency from scratch.

You have executive presence: You can hold your own with C-Suite stakeholders from the first interaction. You communicate clearly, challenge thoughtfully, and earn credibility quickly.

You think strategically about accounts: You don't just run meetings, you map stakeholders, identify blockers, understand incentives, and continuously think about what needs to happen for the deal to move forward.

You're commercially sharp: You understand how to build a business case, quantify value, negotiate confidently, and protect deal quality while getting complex agreements across the line.

You're obsessively prepared: You know more about the prospect's business, priorities, and challenges than they expect you to. Every interaction has a purpose.

You're low ego and high accountability: You're not above doing the grunt work. You take ownership when things go wrong, act on feedback quickly, and share credit when things go right.

You speak business-level German and English

You want to work on-site 5 days a week in Berlin

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As Harvey scales its pre-sales function across EMEA, we are hiring a Legal Engineer Manager to lead and grow the team in Munich. This role exists to provide senior leadership and strategic direction to a team of Legal Engineers who sit at the heart of Harvey's commercial motion - bringing legal credibility, product expertise, and consultative support to law firm and in-house prospects.

Harvey’s Legal Engineers are skilled lawyers from top-tier law firms who apply their legal experience to ensure that current and prospective customers understand how Harvey’s solutions enhance specific day-to-day workflows, working alongside Harvey’s Account Executives to support all aspects of our sales strategy. Legal Engineers build consultative relationships with law firm partners and associates and in-house attorneys at private equity firms and Fortune 500 companies, becoming trusted advisors on how Harvey’s AI solutions can make them more effective.

Similar to the way Solutions Architects secure the “technical win” in the sales process, Legal Engineers secure the “legal win” by performing in-depth customer discovery and education on Harvey’s solutions through targeted meetings and demos that resonate with the customer’s day-to-day workflows specific to their legal practice area.

Legal Engineers utilize their experience practicing law and their legal mindset to ask thoughtful questions to understand the needs of law firm and in-house attorneys, develop credibility, and then partner with Account Executives to educate them on Harvey’s value via large and small group sessions as well as one-to-one conversations.

What You'll Do

Lead, coach, and develop a team of Legal Engineers, setting clear performance expectations and building a high-trust, high-output team culture

Own the quality and consistency of Harvey's pre-sales legal engineering function, ensuring demos, discovery conversations, and deal support are delivered to the highest standard

Partner closely with Account Executives and GTM leadership to prioritise pipeline, develop deal strategy, and support conversion on complex or strategic opportunities

Engage with lawyers at prospective customers to understand and address their workflow challenges

Collaborate with Product and Marketing to ensure the team's field insights are feeding into positioning, roadmap, and go-to-market strategy

Lead product demonstrations tailored to the context of various law firm practice groups and in-house legal teams, asking questions to validate how Harvey can add value and then showcasing Harvey’s features and benefits relevant to each prospective client’s potential use cases.

Act as the “Voice of the Customer,” using your legal perspective to help the broader sales team to develop and implement more effective strategies and synthesize customer feedback for the product team through a legal lens.

Travel may be required from time to time, including visits to customer office locations and company offices.

What You Have

Qualified lawyer with 7+ PQE, with experience in a law firm or in-house legal environment

Must have prior experience managing a team, with a track record of developing talent and driving performance

Deep familiarity with legal technology and AI tools, with an ability to quickly develop and demonstrate platform expertise

Strong commercial instincts and the ability to engage credibly with senior stakeholders at law firms and in-house legal teams

Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience running training, workshops, or client-facing product sessions

Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a pragmatic, solutions-oriented approach

title: QA Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Transforming 50M+ daily events into real-time actionable dashboard insights

The Dashboards team is responsible for the systems and interfaces that define our partners' daily operations. We build the campaign management APIs, analytics engines, and high-throughput tools that allow advertisers and publishers to configure, monitor, and optimize their activity on our platform.

This is not about simple CRUD interfaces, it is about building high-performance data surfaces that drive massive business decisions. Using Go, Kafka, and Druid, we process and render real-time analytics across 50+ million daily events, ensuring accuracy and complex campaign performance reporting at scale. On the frontend, we tackle genuine engineering constraints: utilizing TypeScript and React, we have moved beyond standard library limitations to build highly optimized graph-rendering with Recharts capable of visualizing datasets that would overload conventional solutions.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

QA with 3 years+ hands on automation experience, alongside a strong manual testing foundation. You design and execute structured and exploratory test cases, validate complex user journeys across frontend and backend, and perform regression testing before releases. You identify edge cases and risk areas early and document clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira.

You contribute to UI and API test automation using Playwright, identify critical regression flows worth automating, and maintain existing test suites. CI/CD integration experience is a plus.

API and data testing is part of your toolkit. You test APIs and data-driven dashboard features, and have basic SQL knowledge for backend data validation. You understand what correct looks like at the data layer, not just the UI.

Quality ownership from day one. You participate in refinement and sprint planning from a QA perspective, help define acceptance criteria and test strategies, and proactively flag quality risks before they reach release.

Plus: Experience in SaaS, AdTech, or performance marketing environments.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

title: Principal Engineer - Facades / External Walls
description:
Company Overview

Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more.

Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.

At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization. 

Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.

Job Overview

Role can be based in any of our UK offices

Jensen Hughes is a company fiercely committed to our purpose, our clients, and each other. Every single member of our team is essential to our success. Due to the continued growth and success of our External Walls and Facades team, we have an exciting opportunity for a Principal Engineer to join our market leading UK team.

As a Principal Engineer, you will provide advanced technical delivery and project leadership across façade engineering and external wall fire consultancy services, you will be responsible for exercising independent engineering judgement on complex projects, leading technical workstreams, and ensuring that deliverables are technically robust, proportionate, and defensible. You will be a senior technical contributor within project teams, support quality assurance and peer review processes, mentor developing engineers, and contribute to maintaining Jensen Hughes’ reputation for high-quality, risk-based advice.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical delivery on façade and external wall projects of moderate to high complexity.
  • Exercise independent engineering judgement in relation to façade systems, fire performance, remediation strategies, and compliance pathways.
  • Prepare and oversee the preparation of external wall fire assessment reports (e.g. PAS 9980 appraisals), façade engineering reports, and technical notes.
  • Review façade build-ups, materials, fire stopping provisions, cavity barriers, and remediation proposals.
  • Assess test evidence, classification reports, product certifications, and desktop studies.
  • Identify technical risks and develop proportionate mitigation strategies.
  • Act as day-to-day technical lead on allocated projects.
  • Lead technical discussions with clients, architects, contractors, and multidisciplinary design teams.
  • Provide clear, structured technical advice aligned with legislation, statutory guidance, and industry standards.

If successful, here is what we will expect from you:

  • Operate with increasing independence in technical judgement.
  • Demonstrate commercial awareness in project delivery.
  • Show readiness to transition toward Associate-level leadership responsibilities.
  • Build recognised technical credibility internally and externally.
  • Contribute to strengthening Jensen Hughes’ façade and external wall capability.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Degree qualified in Engineering, Architecture, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent demonstrable experience).
  • Chartered or actively working towards chartership (strongly preferred).
  • Significant experience in façade engineering and/or external wall fire consultancy.
  • Strong understanding of façade systems, construction methods, and performance requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical workstreams independently.
  • Experience in preparing and reviewing PAS 9980 appraisals or similar risk-based assessments.
  • Strong report writing capability and structured technical reasoning.
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers.
  • Clear communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 

Our People Are Our Greatest Asset

At Jensen Hughes, we know that our people are the foundation of our success. To attract and retain the best talent, we offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, work-life balance, and professional growth.

Our UK and Ireland Benefits Include:

  • Private medical insurance
  • 33 days paid time off with an additional day after 3 years
  • Industry-leading contributory pension scheme
  • 4 x life assurance
  • Income protection scheme
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Employee assistance programme
  • Enhanced parental-related pay
  • Recognition and reward programmes to celebrate team efforts
  • Access to extensive technical training and resources

Supporting Your Work-Life Balance

We understand the importance of flexibility and balance. We're happy to discuss hybrid, part-time, and flexible working arrangements to suit both you and the business. We also offer:

  • Flexible working hours and patterns including early Friday finish
  • Flexible holiday use over Christmas/New Year
  • Enhanced holiday entitlement after three years
  • The option to carry over up to five unused holiday days into the next year

A Commitment to Continuous Improvement

Our benefits represent a meaningful investment in both our people and the future of Jensen Hughes. We regularly review our benefits programme to ensure it aligns with statutory requirements, market trends, and the needs of our team. Any modifications will be carefully considered to support our employees and the company’s long-term goals.

 

#LI-SG1

 

Jensen Hughes is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

 

At Jensen Hughes, we embrace innovation and understand that people are increasingly using artificial intelligence (AI) tools like ChatGPT and other generative platforms to learn, prepare and communicate.  We have provided some guidelines regarding the responsible use of AI in the recruitment process.  Please click here to review.


The security of your personal data is important to us. Jensen Hughes has implemented reasonable physical, technical, and administrative security standards to protect personal data from loss, misuse, alteration, or destruction. We protect your personal data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, using security technologies and procedures, such as encryption and limited access. Only authorized individuals may access your personal data for the purpose for which it was collected, and these individuals receive training about the importance of protecting personal data.  Jensen Hughes is committed to compliance with all relevant data privacy laws in all areas where we do business, including, but not limited to, the GDPR and the CCPA.  Additionally, our service providers are contractually bound to maintain the confidentiality of personal data and may not use the information for any unauthorized purpose.

Jensen Hughes will not accept resumes, inquiries or proposals from recruiting agencies as an acceptable method to consider a candidate. 3rd party recruiting agencies must sign a standard Jensen Hughes agreement after being evaluated and accepted by a Human Resources or Talent Acquisition manager, or member of the talent acquisition team. title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
description:
Working at CreateFuture

CreateFuture is an AI-native consulting partner where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference  while always putting people first.

We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.

CreateFuture is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.

Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

About the role and team:

CreateFuture is looking for a collaborative, technically grounded Senior Business Analyst to join our team.

Our Senior Business Analysts drive high-impact change across a broad spectrum of client engagements. While we deliver end-to-end digital products, this role is tailored for a BA who is as comfortable driving complex back-end environments (such as API integrations, platform migrations, data architecture, and system integration logic) as they are crafting front-end user experiences and feature specifications.

You’ll leverage your proficiency in business analysis, system architecture, and product strategy to guide project development, acting as the crucial bridge between technical and non-technical stakeholders. Your responsibilities span meticulous requirements analysis, data flow mapping, estimation, and championing delivery best practices within your team.

Your exceptional communication skills are pivotal for translating complex client objectives into clear, developer-ready specifications and data flows, ensuring what we build is both valuable for users and technically robust under the hood.

Does this sound like you? Do you have a passion for the craft of Business Analysis, a natural curiosity for how complex backend systems work, and an interest in how modern tools are changing how we work? If so, we’d love to talk to you.

What you'll be doing:

  • Evaluate current and emerging business procedures, collaborating with clients and internal teams to propose impactful system solutions and process improvements.
  • Proactively bring cross-functional teams together to shape user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and technical specifications (including API contracts, payload logic, and data mappings).
  • Facilitate data analysis, query system data to uncover edge cases, and map complex integration dependencies across backend architecture.
  • Manage project backlogs during discovery, build, and run phases, balancing business priorities against technical constraints, non-functional requirements (NFRs), and engineering effort.
  • Support and lead client discovery conversations, driving estimation efforts, facilitating workshops, and championing best practices across your project team.

We'd love to talk to you if you have: 

  • Proven experience delivering both product-led user initiatives and complex technical projects (e.g., API integrations, platform migrations, data architecture).
  • Experience working for a Consultancy or Client facing environment
  • Strong experience as a Technical Business Analyst working closely with engineering, architecture and product teams.
  • Experience working with data, including data mapping, data models, databases and ideally SQL.
  • A strong track record of working alongside engineering teams to analyse data flows, system logic, and technical dependencies.
  • A user-centric mindset that ensures backend architectural choices directly support a seamless end-user experience.
  • Proven ability to bridge the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders, gaining a deep understanding of business context and translating complex goals into clear. specifications.
  • Bring meticulous requirements analysis, lead estimation efforts, and champion best practices across your project team.

    Bonus points if you have:

    • Experimented with AI tools to accelerate research, draft baseline specifications, map data fields, or red-team edge cases in system flows.
    • Exposure to or curiosity about how modern AI capabilities, LLMs, or agentic workflows integrate into backend system architectures.
    • A proactive approach to exploring new tools and techniques that improve the speed and quality of business analysis, with a desire to share those learnings with colleagues.

    You don’t need to arrive as an AI expert. If you haven’t yet had much opportunity to put AI into practice in your BA work, that shouldn’t stop you from applying. What matters to us is curiosity, a willingness to experiment, and a commitment to high-quality analysis. Everyone at CreateFuture undertakes AI-native training, and we’ll support you to build these capabilities and put them into practice.

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

  • Call with our Talent Acquisition Team 
  • Role specific capability interview 

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

We look forward to your application!

Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

About the role and team: 

Our Client Partners are at the heart of our client relationships, and our focus is on growing them, not just maintaining them. As Principal Client Partner, you'll own some of CreateFuture's most strategically important client relationships and lead a team of Lead Client Partners and Client Partners. This is a senior commercial leadership role: you'll set the growth agenda across a portfolio of accounts, build trusted relationships at C-suite level, and turn those relationships into significant, sustained revenue.

You'll be the person our clients call when they're thinking about what's next, and the person our team looks to for how growth gets done. You'll shape how CreateFuture grows its client base, from account strategy and multi-competitor bids through to commercial planning, and lead by example in the behaviours that drive it: qualifying with rigour, following through with intent, and seeing commercial conversations through to an outcome.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Owning the commercial performance of a portfolio of our largest or most strategically important accounts, from opportunity identification through to close, with clear accountability for revenue, margin and growth targets.
  • Building and sustaining C-suite relationships (CEO, CTO, CDO), expanding the stakeholder map, identifying whitespace and needs before clients articulate them, and turning those conversations into multi-workstream programmes.
  • Leading, coaching and developing a team of Lead Client Partners and Client Partners, raising the whole team's capability in consultative selling, stakeholder strategy and commercial qualification.

title: Senior Director, Reporting & Analytics Engineering
description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a Senior Director to lead our Enterprise Reporting and Analytics Engineering organization, a team of analytics engineers, report developers, visualization specialists, and people leaders. This organization focuses on the last mile of the enterprise data supply chain: the semantic models, curated data products, metric definitions, and consumption experiences that turn engineered data into decisions.

This is not a traditional reporting leadership role; the classic notion of “reporting” in the form of a myriad of dashboards and filters is racing towards obsolescence. But the need for data and insights, and the need to deliver it in a way that is digestible and actionable, is timeless. Yes, governed dashboards and trusted reporting remain the foundation, and this leader must be excellent at that foundation. But the mandate is to move the organization decisively beyond static reporting toward a proactive, intelligent analytics capability: partnering with Data Science to productize and visualize their models, enabling generative AI and LLM-based access to our data, building exception-based systems that alert users when outcomes deviate from expectation in a statistically meaningful way, and designing agents that monitor data continuously and deliver insight without being asked.

Analytics engineering shares much of its DNA with data engineering — modeling, transformation, testing, version control, CI/CD, performance and cost discipline — but is oriented toward business enablement rather than platform and pipeline. Success in this role therefore depends as much on partnership as on technical depth. This leader will work shoulder to shoulder with Data Engineering on the boundary between platform and consumption, with Product Management on roadmap and requirements, with Data Science on advanced analytic products, and with Analytics Operations on a disciplined intake and prioritization process that makes the best possible use of finite capacity.

The ideal candidate has spent years building the traditional foundations — governance, metadata, lineage, dimensional modeling, engaging with enterprise BI platforms— and is now looking to apply that rigor to a fundamentally different generation of analytic products in new and innovative ways.

What you'll be doing:

Organizational Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop an organization of approximately 30 people, including managing through frontline managers; own hiring, role clarity, career pathing, performance management, and succession planning.
  • Define a multi-year vision and roadmap for enterprise reporting and analytics engineering, and translate it into quarterly outcomes the team and its partners can measure. Partner closely with Product Management to jointly shape the multi-year enterprise end-to-end data strategy.
  • Own the organization's budget, vendor relationships, and contractor or offshore capacity.
  • Establish and sustain an engineering culture within an analytics function: peer review, automated testing, documentation standards, source control, CI/CD, etc.

Analytics Engineering and Data Architecture

  • Drive maturity of the last-mile architecture in partnership with Data Engineering: curated marts, semantic layers, reusable data products, and certified datasets that serve reporting, ai enablement, data science, and downstream applications.
  • Define and enforce dimensional modeling standards, transformation frameworks, and modular, tested, version-controlled analytics code.
  • Own the enterprise metric layer so that key business measures carry a single, governed definition regardless of where they are consumed.
  • Partner with Data Engineering to define clear contracts and handoffs between pipeline and platform work and last-mile modeling, including shared tooling, standards, and escalation paths.
  • Manage query performance, warehouse consumption, and platform cost as first-class engineering concerns.

Data Governance, Metadata, and Lineage

  • Own cataloging, business glossary, data certification, and stewardship workflows, leveraging tools such as Atlan as the primary metadata platform.
  • Maintain column-level lineage across the analytics estate to support impact analysis, change management, audit, and root-cause investigation.
  • Leverage data access provisioning and entitlement models, including row- and column-level security, in partnership with Security, Privacy, and Compliance.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to drive data quality monitoring, freshness and availability SLAs, observability, and incident response for analytic assets.

Enterprise Reporting and Data Visualization

  • Drive analytics engagement by leveraging enterprise visualization and provisioning platforms, including Domo and Tableau, in partnership with Data Engineering. Ensure best practices are followed in data architecture, governance, adoption, performance, and total cost management.
  • Set visualization and information design standards that make reports readable, consistent, accessible, and decision-oriented.
  • Rationalize the existing reporting portfolio: retire redundant and unused assets, consolidate overlapping content, drive down tech debt and drive consumption toward certified sources.
  • Build a durable self-service capability through training, templates, community, office hours, and clear guardrails on what belongs in self-service versus centrally managed content.

Advanced, Proactive, and AI-Enabled Analytics

  • Partner with Data Science to productize their work: build the visualization, interaction, monitoring, and feedback loops that turn models and research into products the business actually uses.
  • Partner with Product Management and Data Engineering to enable generative AI and LLM access to enterprise data. This includes preparing the semantic and metadata foundation that makes data legible to models, delivering conversational analytics, text-to-SQL, and retrieval-augmented experiences on governed sources, and establishing guardrails, evaluation, and accuracy monitoring so that answers can be trusted.
  • Build exception-based analytics that detect when an outcome deviates from its expected value in a statistically significant way, using seasonality-aware baselines, forecast residuals, control limits, and anomaly detection rather than static thresholds.
  • Route those exceptions to accountable owners with context, likely drivers, and a recommended next action; actively tune sensitivity and volume to prevent alert fatigue and preserve signal.
  • Design and deploy analytic agents that proactively monitor data, investigate variances, assemble narrative explanations, and deliver insight into the tools where people already work.
  • Shift the organization's consumption model from pull to push: the measure of success is not how many people opened a dashboard, but whether the right person was told the right thing at the right time.

Cross-Functional Partnership, Intake, and Prioritization

  • Operate as a true partner to Product Management: contribute to roadmap, requirements, user research, and release planning, and run analytics with a product mindset covering personas, adoption metrics, and asset lifecycle management.
  • Partner with Analytics Operations to run a transparent intake, triage, sizing, and prioritization process, with published capacity, explicit tradeoffs, and reliable delivery commitments.
  • Make capacity constraints visible to stakeholders and executives, drive reuse over one-off builds, and decline or defer work with evidence rather than friction.
  • Serve as a senior, executive-facing partner to business functions, translating ambiguous business questions into well-scoped analytic solutions.

What we're looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related quantitative field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in data, analytics, or business intelligence, including 8+ years leading teams and 4+ years managing managers.
  • Demonstrated experience leading an organization of 25 or more people in a large, matrixed enterprise.
  • Strong hands-on foundation in SQL, dimensional modeling, and ELT/ETL design, with production experience on a modern cloud data warehouse or lakehouse (for example Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, or Synapse) and a transformation framework such as dbt.
  • Experience applying software engineering practices to analytics work, including Git-based workflows, automated testing, and CI/CD.
  • Enterprise-scale leveraging of BI and data visualization platforms such as Domo, Tableau, Power BI, or Looker, including governance, provisioning, adoption, and cost management.
  • Demonstrated ability to participate in driving data governance program covering catalog, lineage, glossary, stewardship, quality, and access, using platforms such as Atlan, Collibra, Alation, or Informatica.
  • Proven track record of delivering jointly with Data Engineering and Product Management, with clear ownership boundaries and shared accountability.
  • Direct experience partnering with Data Science, including operationalizing, visualizing, and monitoring model output for business consumption.
  • Working command of the statistical concepts underlying exception detection, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, variance and control limits, seasonality, and forecasting.
  • Experience running a formal intake, prioritization, and capacity planning process for a shared services or platform organization.
  • Excellent executive communication and influence skills, with the ability to operate effectively amid ambiguity and competing priorities.
  • Experience managing budget, vendor contracts, and platform licensing.

Preferred Skills:

  • Master's degree or MBA in a related field.
  • Production experience delivering LLM-based analytics: retrieval-augmented generation over governed data, text-to-SQL or conversational BI, semantic layers designed for model consumption, and prompt, evaluation, and cost monitoring frameworks.
  • Experience designing agentic workflows and orchestration for monitoring, investigation, and notification use cases.
  • Hands-on experience with Atlan, Domo, and Tableau specifically.
  • Proficiency in Python or R for prototyping, and familiarity with common statistical and ML libraries and MLOps concepts.
  • Experience deploying anomaly detection at scale, including alert routing, suppression, and fatigue management.
  • Familiarity with data product and data mesh operating models, domain-aligned ownership, and data contracts.
  • Experience operating in an Agile or product operating model at scale, including portfolio, OKR, and roadmap management. Deep experience with the “Silicon Valley” school of Product Management, as exemplified by the “Marty Kagan”-style academic approach a significant plus.
  • Experience leading global or matrixed teams, including offshore or vendor-partnered delivery models.
  • Track record leading a major platform migration, consolidation, or reporting rationalization effort.
  • Demonstrated success attracting, developing, and retaining senior technical talent in a competitive market.
