description:
Overview 

We have an opportunity for a Principal Engineer in our AI & Algorithms department, working with a particular focus on our defence and security clients. You’ll join a team of talented engineers and scientists designing, building and testing intelligent systems that require cutting edge algorithms.

As one of the senior technical voices in the team, you’ll be architecting the algorithmic approach on our projects, setting the technical bar for others, and helping shape the work we deliver. As well as hands-on engineering, you’ll spend time with clients, using your expertise to win new projects as well as deliver them. You’ll work in multidisciplinary teams that use our labs and computing resources to enable us to deliver ambitious projects.

Much of our defence and security work requires security clearance, so we ask for it up front. You won’t work exclusively in that sector, but a genuine interest in it matters to us. 

We offer a flexible approach to hybrid working, although some of the projects you will be working on will require full-time working in the office.

What you’ll be doing: 

  • Applying data-driven software development in machine learning/AI, applied statistics, and sensor processing, alongside mathematical computing techniques such as digital signal processing, simulation, and numerical optimisation. 
  • Acting as technical lead and architect on our larger, more complex projects, owning the technical solution and the value it delivers to the client. 
  • Setting technical direction and acting as technical reviewer across the department, with your opinion sought by colleagues. 
  • Leading the development of proposals and costed work programmes, turning client problems into work we can win and deliver. 
  • Driving internal capability and demonstrators that keep us at the leading edge and open up new conversations with clients. 
  • Mentoring engineers and conducting technical interviews to help us recruit and grow strong people. 
  • Contributing to how the department works, improving our processes and technical standards. 

What you need to succeed:

  • 5+ years’ experience designing and delivering cutting edge algorithms for intelligent systems, including working on defence or security projects. 
  • Technical skills in one or more of: transformer models, diffusion models, reinforcement learning, machine vision and perception. 
  • A strong undergraduate degree in a relevant technical subject, such as AI/machine learning, computer science, mathematics or, physics. A PhD in a relevant subject is welcome but not required; deep, demonstrable industrial expertise is what matters. 
  • Strong Python and software engineering judgement.
  • The ability to architect the technical approach on complex projects and to review the work of others, including working autonomously as the technical authority. 
  • Experience mentoring and developing engineers. 
  • Experience working with non-technical stakeholders for your work. 
  • Interest in working directly with clients and contributing to proposals and sales conversations. 
  • A genuine affinity for working in the defence and security sector.  

While not essential requirements, we would also be very interested if you have experience with any of the following: 

  • Technical experience with any of: signal processing, edge computing, statistical modelling, numerical optimisation, or simulation. 
  • A track record of building client relationships and leading the technical side of sales campaigns and proposals. 

Some projects at Cambridge Consultants are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to obtain a Security Check (SC) level security clearance  ( United Kingdom Security Vetting: Applicant ). You must be able to work in the UK without restrictions in accordance with UK National Law and be prepared to successfully undertake an appropriate level of UK National Security Vetting according to UK Government National Security Vetting criteria.

Please be aware that, for roles requiring Security Check clearance, applicants will typically need to have been a continuous resident in the UK for a minimum of 5 years immediately prior to applying for this role in order to meet the requirements for Security Check (SC) clearance.

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Onboard Services)
description:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

The Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Onboard Services) will design, build, and operate the software services that run on UFORCE’s uncrewed vehicles — spanning video streaming, telemetry, autonomy integration, vehicle control, health monitoring, navigation, and device integrations.

You will turn independently evolved services into one secure, testable, and maintainable onboard platform. This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on production Python services, service architecture, messaging, and reliable operation on constrained Linux hardware, including Raspberry Pi, x86, and NVIDIA Jetson.

You will also own the boundary between the vehicle and the backend: clear, versioned contracts with cloud services, deployment systems, video infrastructure, and operator interfaces that work over intermittent, low-bandwidth links. Working with backend, autonomy, hardware, QA, and field teams, you will make releases predictable and catch failures on the bench, not in the field.

What you’ll do

Define and evolve a unified onboard service architecture: service boundaries, messaging, configuration, startup ordering, readiness, watchdogs, and graceful degradation when dependencies or devices are unavailable.

Build and migrate production services to shared patterns, using reusable libraries and a reference service template covering project structure, packaging, logging, health reporting, and lifecycle management.

Standardise local service communication around NATS, with clear rules for integrating MAVLink, ZMQ IPC, and HTTP where appropriate.

Design stable, versioned vehicle-to-backend contracts for telemetry, commands and acknowledgements, video metadata and control, configuration, health, and logs.

Engineer for unreliable connectivity: buffering and store-and-forward, idempotent commands, explicit acknowledgements and timeouts, reconnection, back-off, and safe behaviour when the backend is unreachable.

Implement secure-by-default services: least-privilege identities and messaging permissions, mutually authenticated and encrypted backend links, secure credential provisioning and rotation, sandboxed runtimes, and audit events for safety-critical commands.

Strengthen automated testing across unit, contract, integration, simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop tests, with CI gates that catch regressions before release.

Build safer release workflows with signed packages, dependency scanning, bench smoke and soak tests, staged fleet rollouts, and reliable rollback.

Profile services and enforce practical CPU, memory, and latency budgets on target hardware.

Improve field diagnostics through structured logs, metrics, standardised health reporting, post-mission log capture, and actionable runbooks.

Document architectural decisions and service interfaces, communicate trade-offs clearly, and use AI coding tools to accelerate delivery without compromising quality.

What success looks like

Actively developed onboard services converge on a shared architecture, supported Python runtime, messaging model, and service template.

Engineers can take a new service from an empty repository to running on a bench vehicle in a day or less, with less duplicated infrastructure code.

Vehicle-to-backend contracts remain compatible as cloud and vehicle software evolve at different speeds, preventing integration failures in the field.

Authentication, least privilege, secret handling, runtime hardening, and supply-chain checks are consistently applied across the onboard stack.

Automated tests and bench validation catch defects before deployment, reducing issues discovered in the field.

Releases move predictably from bench validation to pilot vehicles and the wider fleet, with clear readiness gates and rollback procedures.

Services stay within resource budgets and remain diagnosable under hardware constraints and degraded connectivity.

Architecture documentation and runbooks help engineering, QA, and field teams integrate changes and resolve failures faster.

Required Qualifications

7+ years of professional software engineering, delivering and operating production services.

Strong Python — experience designing and shipping production services, including asyncio, packaging, testing, and profiling; Node.js experience is a plus.

Web development and API experience — experience building and evolving HTTP/WebSocket APIs and message-based integrations with versioned contracts.

Development with AI tools — uses AI coding assistants/agents daily and can demonstrate how they apply these tools to design, implementation, review, and testing while maintaining high quality.

Security-first engineering — has applied authentication/authorisation, secrets management, least privilege, and secure update practices in a real system.

Testing and release discipline — has built test suites and CI gates for unit, integration, and contract testing, and shipped software through staged releases with rollback. Experience with simulators or hardware-in-the-loop testing is a plus.

C++, Rust, or Go experience is a plus.

UxV, robotics, or embedded/edge Linux experience is a plus (e.g., MAVLink, GStreamer, serial/CAN devices, or systemd services on constrained hardware).

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

Are You?

title: EMEA | Senior Data Business Analyst / Product Owner (Contractor)
description:
Role Overview

The Senior Data Business Analyst / Product Owner is a senior, client-facing member of the Data Products function who leads projects or individual domains within Data Transformation engagements, from the earliest Discovery and Scoping conversations through to Agile delivery and sign-off.

Alongside hands-on requirements, backlog and data analysis work, the Senior Consultant owns the Discovery and Design phase on their projects or domains within Data Transformation engagements, producing a clear scope baseline that enables Programme Management to run change control and enables Account Management to identify growth opportunities. The role brings a consulting mindset: structured problem framing, confident facilitation with senior business stakeholders, and a consistent focus on measurable client value.

Anticipated start date: January 2027

Location: EMEA - UK, Hungary, Bulgaria, Slovakia, Italy, Spain, Portugal

Daily rate: up to 420 GBP

Contract duration: 6 months

Project duration: December 2026 - June 2027

Daily Requirement: 8 hours per day, Monday to Friday

Key Responsibilities

Discovery & Design

Lead pre-project Discovery and Scoping for projects or individual domains within client Data Transformation engagements, applying Infinite Lambda's Discovery & Design framework, standards and artefacts

Define project objectives, preliminary requirements and scope boundaries with sufficient clarity to significantly de-risk the subsequent programme or project execution

Define data products end to end, including consumers, data contracts and ownership

Engage client product managers and senior business stakeholders to frame the business problem, explore the problem space and articulate the business value of the proposed solution

Frame the value of each data product with client stakeholders and track benefit against the case made

Partner with Account Managers on pre-sales activities to define the initial solution scope, articulate a product-based delivery approach and translate high-level client needs into tangible delivery Epics

Produce a clearly defined scope baseline for Programme Management and Account Management, enabling the change control process and the identification of opportunities that fall outside the agreed scope

Stakeholder Engagement

Act as the liaison between client stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring clear communication of needs and priorities

Support stakeholder alignment and facilitate sign-offs at key delivery stages, from Discovery outputs through to sprint deliverables

On Data Transformation engagements without a dedicated Programme Manager, act as the primary governance interface with the Account Manager, covering scope control, change requests and proactive communication on delivery health

Negotiate trade-offs on scope, timeline and resourcing with client stakeholders without escalating

Requirements Management

Own requirements for a data product end to end, breaking down Epics into user stories and acceptance criteria for integration and reporting use cases

Lead feature / data product kickoffs to ensure business context and delivery alignment

Facilitate estimation across the teams building a data product to support sprint planning

Collaborate closely with developers and testers to validate "done" stories and ensure Client sign-off

Partner with technical leads and client SMEs to ensure requirements are accurate, complete and technically feasible

Maintain traceability from Statement of Work (SOW) and Discovery outputs through Epics, Features and stories so that changes in scope are visible and controllable

Create and review target-to-source field mappings for individual data products

Establish reconciliation and data quality rules for each data product within the medallion architecture

Backlog Management

Own the product backlog and roadmap for a data product, prioritising with the client on business value

Conduct backlog refinement sessions with the team to clarify requirements, dependencies and priorities

Set the team's definition of ready and ensure stories meet it before sprint planning

Manage dependencies across epics, features and stories

Identify and escalate risks or blockers impacting backlog items or delivery flow

Agile Ceremonies & Reporting

Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint planning, retrospectives and show & tell sessions

Communicate the roadmap and delivery progress through Jira or similar tools

Track and report team health metrics through retrospectives and delivery KPIs

Produce end-of-sprint reports summarising story progress, carried-over items and upcoming priorities

Account Growth Support

Collaborate with account and delivery leadership (PO, Programme/Project Manager, Account Manager, Tech Lead) as part of the Account Leadership Team (CAT)

Spot opportunities within the engagement and shape them into proposals Account Managers can take to the client

Contribute to the SOW before signature, making sure assumptions, risks and exclusions are captured

Skills and Experience

10+ years of experience in Agile delivery environments (Scrum or Kanban), with significant experience in a senior capacity within a technology consultancy or Data Transformation programmes

Proven experience leading Discovery and Scoping phases (pre-sales or pre-contract) for data and analytics projects, including defining objectives, scope boundaries and preliminary requirements

Confident engaging and facilitating with senior business stakeholders to frame problems and articulate business value

Proficient in SQL

Strong experience in data and analytics projects, including data lineage, transformation, quality and data protection (GDPR) requirements

Understanding of the medallion data architecture and modern data platforms (e.g. Databricks, Snowflake), including how a migration is sequenced from source estate to target

Experience defining metrics for a semantic layer

Proficiency with Jira, Confluence and Agile reporting tools

Travel requirements for this role are mandated by the needs of the client, and depending on the client some travel is required

Excellent knowledge of SQL

Exposure to BI/reporting and DWH integration use cases

Understanding of the medallion data architecture and / or modern data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake).

Experience working in technology consultancy or data transformation programs.

Interview Process

Introductory call with TABP: 30 minutes

Technical interview with Head of Data Products + Senior Data Product Owner: 75 minutes

Client Fit Screening with Account Manager: 30 minutes

description:
Who is Atominvest

Atominvest is the operating system for modern private markets asset managers. Our modular, flexible SaaS technology underpins key investor- and portfolio-management workflows.

Our customers are sophisticated private equity, growth equity, and private credit firms managing billions in assets globally. We aim to deliver ongoing high-quality outcomes for them through a long-term partnership mindset.

At Atominvest, you’ll be working on something very exciting: the future of work, investments and sustainability/ ethical investing for the world’s best investors and delivering a positive impact through this. Based on the growth we are experiencing, we think we’re on to something big.

It won’t be easy. Joining a scale up business is an amazing and rewarding challenge, pushing well beyond the boundaries of natural growth cycles. You’ll move quicker than feels comfortable and be brilliant at continually re-prioritizing what must get done to keep Atominvest growing year over year at the pace of the best SaaS companies on the planet.

We’ve gone from zero to ten, now we’re looking to go from ten to one hundred!

What you'll do

Supporting the Account Management Lead (about 50% time)

• Build and maintain the renewals and expansion forecast across the client book, and flag risks early.

• Produce regular reporting on renewals, client health, product utilisation and expansion pipeline.

• Prepare the data and talking points for commercial QBRs, alongside the CSM.

• Help write the playbook, metrics and cadences the team will scale on.

• Keep HubSpot accurate: renewal dates, contacts and opportunities.

Running your own book (about 50% time)

• Own a defined set of accounts: track contract dates and sequence renewals well ahead of expiry.

• Monitor account health, starting in HubSpot and backed by usage and engagement data. Flag at-risk accounts early.

• Run regular reviews with your clients and record outcomes and next steps.

• Spot expansion across new funds, modules and users, and pass qualified opportunities on.

• Flag out-of-scope requests so they become expansion. CS/Implementation owns delivery.

• Work with Sales, CS/Implementation and Product, and feed client feedback back to Product.

What you'll bring

Must have

• 1-4 years in a commercial, client-facing, analyst or operations role.

• Strong Microsoft Office/G-Suite skills

• Proficiency in AI and AI-forward workflows (Claude, Chat GPT, Co-Pilot)

• Clear written and spoken communication, including with senior, numerate clients.

• Ownership: you stay organised and detail-focused while juggling a book of accounts and ad hoc requests.

Strongly preferred

• Exposure to B2B SaaS, fintech or financial services.

• Interest in private equity, venture capital or fund reporting.

• CRM experience (we run on HubSpot).

What we offer

• Competitive salary.

• 25 days holiday plus bank holidays.

• Hybrid working: 3 days a week in our central London office, near Oxford Circus.

• Cycle2Work and an Employee Assistance Programme.

• Real ownership, a meritocratic culture and room to grow as we scale.

• Company socials and events.

How to apply

Apply via the link below with your CV. Hiring stages: intro call → hiring manager → case interview → final conversation.

It won’t be easy. Joining a scale up business is an amazing and rewarding challenge, pushing well beyond the boundaries of natural growth cycles. You’ll move quicker than feels comfortable and be brilliant at continually re-prioritizing what must get done to keep Atominvest growing year over year at the pace of the best SaaS companies on the planet.

We’ve gone from zero to ten, now we’re looking to go from ten to one hundred!

The role:

Are you curious about how technology works and motivated by turning complex problems into practical product improvements?

We’re looking for a proactive and technically minded Graduate Technical Product Analyst to support Atominvest’s enterprise-grade API, SSO, MCP and SFTP capabilities and our Microsoft Outlook, Excel and Word plugins.

Working with the Technical Product Manager and Engineering, you will help understand customer needs, scope improvements, investigate issues, test functionality and support implementations. AI fluency will be central to your work, with tools such as Claude, Claude Code and OpenAI used across research, prototyping, testing, triage, infrastructure R&D and defect resolution.

We don’t expect you to know every technology from day one. What matters is that you bring strong technical foundations, intellectual curiosity and the drive to learn quickly. With support, you’ll deepen your product knowledge and take increasing ownership of investigations and defined technical-product initiatives—combining a focus on outcomes with rigorous testing and thoughtful, consistent delivery.

What you’ll be doing:

Supporting the development and improvement of Atominvest’s technical products, primarily its enterprise-grade API, SSO, MCP and SFTP capabilities and Microsoft Outlook, Excel and Word plugins.

Using AI tools—including Claude, Claude Code and OpenAI—critically and responsibly across product scoping, research, prototyping, testing, triage, infrastructure R&D and defect resolution.

Supporting technical-product discovery by researching customer needs, mapping workflows and data flows, exploring approaches and identifying dependencies, risks and edge cases.

Working with the Technical Product Manager to translate customer and technical needs into requirements, acceptance criteria and delivery plans, progressively owning defined workstreams.

Building practical knowledge of Atominvest’s technical products, including their architecture, use cases, configuration, security considerations, integration patterns and limitations.

Performing first-line triage of product and integration issues, using AI alongside Postman, JSON payloads, configuration data and logs to reproduce errors, test hypotheses and prepare evidence for escalation.

Supporting defect investigation and bug fixing by using AI coding tools to understand code, explore root causes, prototype fixes and validate changes within established Engineering processes.

Planning and executing functional, integration, regression and defect-fix testing, using AI to develop scenarios, identify edge cases and analyse results while independently validating its outputs.

Contributing to technical and infrastructure R&D through research and proofs of concept, while supporting customer implementations alongside the Technical Solutions Manager.

Maintaining technical documentation and troubleshooting resources, analysing usage and support themes, and progressively owning routine investigations and initiatives from scoping through release support.

If this sounds like what you’d love to be doing, we can’t wait to hear from you!

Your skills:

At least one year of relevant experience, including an internship, industrial placement or graduate role in product, technology, software or technical consulting.

A STEM degree or another background demonstrating strong technical, analytical and problem-solving ability.

Fluency with AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code and OpenAI, using them critically and responsibly for research, analysis, coding, prototyping, testing and technical problem-solving.

Familiarity with APIs, JSON, Postman, software development or similar technical tooling—or clear evidence that you can learn these areas quickly.

A structured and curious approach to unfamiliar systems, including testing hypotheses, identifying root causes and drawing clear conclusions from evidence.

The ability to understand customer needs, translate them into practical product requirements and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues.

Strong attention to detail, self-motivation and a willingness to take ownership, ask questions and adapt quickly in a fast-paced scale-up.

A positive attitude, humility, a sense of humour and a collaborative mindset.

The process

Meeting with our Product Managers to have a quick discussion, hear about you, talk about our story and where we’re heading and dig a bit deeper into your CV

Complete a short case study and discuss it with members of our product & engineering teams

Meet with Head of Product

Join Atominvest

description:

Atominvest is the operating system for modern private markets asset managers. Our modular, flexible SaaS technology underpins key investor- and portfolio-management workflows.

You’ll also contribute to the practical application of AI and MCP across our technical products. It’s a role for someone who enjoys solving complex technical problems, taking ownership of delivery and continually expanding what they can do.

Technical solutioning & implementation (~60%)

Lead enterprise customer implementations across APIs, SSO, SFTP and other integration methods, from initial discovery and solution definition through to successful launch.

Act as the principal technical contact during implementations, leading kick-off meetings, progress calls and troubleshooting with customers and third parties.

Support technical pre-sales discussions by explaining Atominvest's integration capabilities, assessing solution fit and identifying implementation constraints.

Design integration approaches using established product capabilities and technical patterns, partnering with Product and Engineering where new development is required.

Investigate complex API, SSO and SFTP issues using tools such as Postman, JSON payloads, configuration data and logs, escalating confirmed defects with clear supporting evidence.

Building the future of our technical products (~40%)

Work with the Senior Technical Product Manager to inform the integration and API roadmap, bringing insight from recurring customer needs and implementation experience.

Lead agreed integration features from requirements and solution design through testing and delivery, within the product direction set by the Technical Product Manager.

Identify recurring implementation challenges and work with Product and Engineering to turn them into reusable platform capabilities.

Contribute to the development of AI and MCP capabilities by identifying practical use cases, supporting prototyping and helping deliver agreed improvements.

Improve integration tooling, documentation and implementation patterns to reduce repeat work and make customer delivery more consistent and scalable.

What we're looking for

4+ years’ relevant experience leading enterprise SaaS implementations, ideally within solutions engineering, technical consulting or integrations.

Strong practical technical ability across APIs, SSO, SFTP, data flows and system integrations, with the credibility to act as a trusted technical lead in customer conversations.

A solutioner at heart: someone energised by complex and sometimes ambiguous technical problems who can investigate them methodically and exercise good judgement about when to involve Product or Engineering.

A reusable-solutions mindset—you recognise patterns across implementations and work with Product and Engineering to turn recurring needs into scalable capabilities.

Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills across technical, commercial and customer audiences.

Curiosity about emerging technologies and an appetite to develop practical knowledge of AI, MCP and modern integration approaches.

A proactive, accountable and collaborative approach, with the ability to lead delivery while working within the wider product and technical direction.

The process

Meeting with our Product Managers to have a quick discussion, hear about you, talk about our story and where we’re heading and dig a bit deeper into your CV

Complete a short case study and discuss it with members of our product & engineering teams

Meet with other Department Senior Team Members, including the Head of Product.

Join Atominvest

title: Customer Success Associate
description:
About Aphex

We're the construction coordination platform that's replacing outdated spreadsheets with multiplayer tools that delivery teams love. Major contractors like BAM, Balfour Beatty, SKANSKA, Kier, MACE, and Murphy use Aphex to deliver their projects ranging from £50 million to multi-billion pound mega projects.

Since launching in 2019, we've grown to become the market-leading solution in the UK and Australia, with aspirations to be where every major project in the world is planned and delivered.

We're tackling an industry that drives 10% of global GDP yet has seen productivity decline for 20 years. It's time for change.

The Role

As a Customer Success Associate at Aphex, you'll learn our Land & Expand Engine inside one of the highest-paced teams at the company: the UK Customer Success Hub.

Your job is to help major contractors get genuine value out of Aphex on their live projects. You'll be in the room and on site with planners, engineers, construction managers, and project directors, helping them embed weekly planning routines, daily coordination, and the reporting that makes their projects run better.

This is a fast progression role. You'll start in apprentice mode alongside the UK CS team, learning the playbook by doing it. Within 6 to 9 months, most CSAs are running their own portfolio of projects as full Customer Success Managers. We hire people who are hungry for that progression and ready to earn it from day one, not waiting until month nine.

The team you're joining is in the middle of a step change: scaling the UK book and expanding into new geographical markets. The CSAs we hire now are part of how the UK CS function holds together and grows through that period.

AI is part of how the team works at Aphex. We expect everyone to use it to think, write, plan, and analyse better. Genuine curiosity about how AI can multiply your output is part of the job.

At Aphex we challenge the status quo as a default. As you grow in this role, you'll be expected to propose better ways of working and make them real, not wait for someone to ask.

What you'll learn and do

Run project deployments. Shadow experienced CSMs through kickoffs, setups, and training, then take the lead on your own.

Embed planning routines. Help major contractor teams establish the weekly planning cycle that becomes their project's operating rhythm.

Drive daily coordination. Move teams from weekly planning into the daily routines that make site coordination genuinely better.

Build trusted relationships across the project. Engineers, supervisors, planners, project managers, construction managers. Hold real credibility at every level.

Monitor project health and act on it. Track signals, spot risks early, run plays to fix issues before they escalate.

The team you'll join

You'll be part of the UK Customer Success Hub, working directly alongside four Customer Success Managers who collectively support projects worth billions in construction value across the UK's largest contractors. You'll learn by working live deployments with them, not from a training course.

You'll also work closely with our UK sales team to understand how project success translates into account growth, and collaborate with our APAC hub on shared accounts, knowledge sharing, and the global playbook we run across regions.

Why this matters

Every project you help succeed means a real project gets delivered better. Less waste, less delay, less rework, less pressure on the people doing the work. You're not just supporting software adoption, you're helping the UK's biggest contractors deliver the infrastructure and buildings the country actually needs.

About You

At Aphex, we believe our team should reflect the variety of perspectives in the world we build for. We've noticed that qualified candidates from underrepresented groups sometimes hesitate to apply unless they meet 100% of the listed requirements, while others might apply when meeting just 60%. If you're excited about Aphex and believe you have the core skills to succeed in this role, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't check every box. Your unique perspective might be exactly what we need.

What we're looking for:

You build trust quickly with people across all kinds of roles and seniority. You've held real relationships beyond the transaction. People you've worked with before still take your call.

You've been thrown in over your head and figured it out. At least one specific story (probably more) of taking on something you weren't qualified for and getting up to speed fast.

You don't wait to be asked. When you spot something that isn't working (a broken process, a missing resource, an awkward workflow), you take it on yourself to fix it.

Nice to have:

A second European language relevant to our growth into new markets

Previous experience in customer success, SaaS, or a fast-moving B2B environment

Some construction or infrastructure background or curiosity (deep industry knowledge isn't required; curiosity for the work matters)

Evidence of using AI tools to improve how you work, with a clear view of where AI helps and where it doesn't

Benefits

What we offer:

25 days holiday plus UK bank holidays

Bupa Health & Dental Care

Pension contribution

Parental leave

Remote-first working with access to a WeWork office for in-person collaboration

The right tools. MacBook Pro setup, modern tech stack, and AI tooling across the team

Genuine development. Personal training allowance plus ongoing coaching and learning support

A team that takes the work seriously. Collaborative, ambitious people who care about doing the work well

Interview & Application Process

Our interview process is typically 2-3 rounds, focused on mutual fit and long-term alignment. As a remote-first business with teams across the UK, Europe, and APAC, parts of the process may run asynchronously.

title: Scientist
description:
Location: Oxford or London (Hybrid)

The Mission: Why We Exist

Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer healthier lives, using the power of genomics.

Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores - giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time.

A Day in the Life

title: Head of Design
description:
Isometric is the AI-native environmental certification company.

Fortune 100 companies need to be certified against regulatory, safety, and sustainability standards.

Until now, certification involved a tradeoff: do it fast, or do it right. Never both.

Isometric eliminates the tradeoff. We deploy AI agents to make the certification process accurate, instant and invisible—unleashing the potential of the industrial economy.

Things you’ll do in this role:

Lead Design at Isometric at a pivotal stage of growth – build the team, set the direction and quality bar, and stay hands-on as we scale.

Design a complex product that reverses climate change. Certify accelerates the certification of physical infrastructure 50x using agentic workflows and UX that turns dense audit work into something people actually want to use.

Shape how Isometric shows up beyond the product – from company brand to swag, sales decks and social media.

Things we’re looking for:

Deep, end-to-end product craft. You're likely 10 or more years into your career, but we care more about what you've shipped than the number. You've taken complex products from prototype to shipped and iterated – UX, UI, the lot – and you think in systems and services, not just screens. You use AI to design faster and better, and raise everyone around you to do the same. Bonus points for B2B SaaS or technical products.

A track record building and leading small, fast design teams along with the delivery and quality processes that hold the bar as they grow.

Proactive ownership, pragmatism, and desire to get stuck into whatever is required to move the company forward.

This role isn’t for you if:

You want a remote job. We value in-person collaboration and spend three days a week in the office.

You prefer staying within your area of expertise and operating in structured environments. We navigate ambiguity at extreme pace and everyone is a generalist.

You’re looking for a short term gig. We’re building for the long term and looking for people ready to grow with us for 5-10 years.

Compensation: £120K – £140K • Offers Equity

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Attio is the CRM for agentic revenue. Designed for the most ambitious go-to-market teams, it gives companies the power to understand every customer, automate at scale, and build their go-to-market motion exactly as they need. We've raised $116M from some of the world's best investors: GV (Google Ventures), Redpoint, Balderton, Point Nine, and 01A.

We hire builders who thrive on complex technical challenges, hold themselves to a high bar, and genuinely care about delighting the people who use what they build. The team here brings sharp judgement, real craft, and the drive to do exceptional work. We're obsessed about the details and energized by the frontier.

If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place.

About the role

Our Engineering team tackles the toughest challenges, so our users never have to. Real-time infrastructure, AI-native architecture, and a frontend that feels effortless - all powered by a team that moves fast, thinks rigorously, and holds an exceptionally high bar for quality.

We're looking for Platform Engineers who treat the platform as a product, with every engineer at Attio as its customer. You'll own the infrastructure, tooling and pipelines that let the rest of engineering ship quickly and safely, and you'll be accountable for keeping all of it reliable, fast and cost-effective as we scale.

What you'll do

Build and evolve our platform infrastructure as code (Terraform, Kubernetes, GCP), so every environment is reproducible, version-controlled and auditable.

Own our CI/CD pipelines end-to-end, making builds, tests and deploys fast, reliable and secure for every engineer at Attio.

Own our observability stack - metrics, logging and distributed tracing - as the foundation of an exceptional reliability culture.

Define and hold SLOs for latency, availability and error rates, and manage capacity to stay comfortably inside them.

Lead incident response: triage and resolve complex production issues, then run blameless post-mortems and ship the fixes as code.

Partner with product engineering teams to remove manual toil and shorten the path from writing code to running it in production.

What you'll bring

Hands-on experience operating production systems with an SRE mindset: SLOs, error budgets, toil reduction and blameless post-mortems.

Excellent knowledge of modern cloud architectures (either GCP or AWS), including networking, IAM and managed services.

Demonstrable deep expertise with Docker and Kubernetes at scale, covering cluster design, networking, storage and security.

Proficiency in a modern language such as Typescript, Go, Python or Rust, and a track record of writing well-tested automation.

Experience owning mission-critical operational tooling, including centralised logging or APM (e.g. Datadog, Splunk).

Ability to communicate technical ideas to the wider team and influence how other engineers build and operate their services.

What we offer

Competitive salary of £105,000 to £125,000

Equity in an early-stage tech company on an incredible trajectory

25 days holiday plus local public holidays

Apple hardware

Private medical insurance through AXA

Pension contribution through Hargreaves Lansdown

Enhanced family leave

Team off-site in fun places! (We've been to Barcelona, Lisbon, Malta, and Split so far)

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

Shape the future of agentic automation: UiPath is evolving from RPA to the worldʼs first Agentic Orchestration platform, enabling enterprises to deploy autonomous AI agents at scale. As part of this transformation, Peak (a UiPath company) is building new B2B agentic solutions that deliver immediate, measurable business value. Youʼll play a pivotal role in shaping and growing one of these solutions.

As a Principal Product Manager for one of our supply chain and/or manufacturing agentic solution areas, youʼll define how applied AI and automation combine to create measurable value in complex B2B domains such as supply planning, commercial operations and inventory optimization. Youʼll join a high-performing, cross-functional team building next-generation products in a rapidly evolving space where innovation, learning, and impact are daily drivers. Youʼll identify and prioritize the most valuable product opportunities, lead discovery and delivery, and work across Peak and UiPath teams to bring transformative solutions to life. From influencing go-to-market strategy to driving customer adoption, youʼll own the product vision for your area that excites and motivates our teams and delivers significant commercial impact.

What you'll do at UiPath

Define and drive an inspiring vision for one of Peakʼs agentic solution areas in supply chain or manufacturing, aligning to UiPathʼs broader strategic aims and the evolving agentic landscape

Bring deep credibility and domain expertise to customer and commercial conversations, steering sales, roadmap and design partnerships to maximise customer value

Own the roadmap for your area, making challenging tradeoff decisions for complex, ambiguous problems

Engage with our customers and the market to understand their needs, validate strategy and use cases, and ultimately drive amazing outcomes for our customers

Deeply understand the technical reality of our solution, anchoring our go-to-market motions to product truth

Lead product launches, enable sales teams to sell your solution and drive revenue growth in your areas of responsibility

Collaborate with and elevate the broader product team through knowledge sharing, thought leadership and mentoring

What you'll bring to the team

Typically 8+ years in product management, including significant experience leading strategic initiatives in a SaaS product business

Strong domain expertise in supply chain and/or manufacturing.

Deep experience with AI/ML/agentic products, and the ability to effectively navigate the technical complexity and rapidly evolving landscape characteristic of these products

Proven track record of working closely with cross-functional colleagues, including sales, marketing, professional services and engineering teams

Excellent stakeholder management across all levels of seniority, both within our business and within our customerʼs businesses

A highly effective strategic thinker, able to solve strategic problems creatively and pragmatically and drive disciplined execution across relevant teams off the back of it

Proven experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise software. Particularly desirable: experience in supply chain, pricing, procurement, ERP, or adjacent enterprise software domains.

Youʼll join a team that values clarity, autonomy, and experimentation — where weʼre building the future of agentic automation, together.

Peak is a business unit of UiPath headquartered in Manchester, UK. This position is either Manchester- or London-based. London-based candidates will be expected to visit Manchester on a weekly basis. You will report directly to the Director of Product Management. This is an Individual Contributor (IC) role, with the possibility of future people management responsibilities.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

title: VP Sales, Europe
description:
VP Sales Europe

Based out of the UK.

About Teton

Teton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care, using real-time, multimodal AI to generate a digital twin of the patient and care environment. Our product alleviates administrative inefficiencies and observational tasks that overburden healthcare professionals, enabling them to provide better patient care.

Through a combination of in-room hardware, AI, and desktop and mobile applications, Teton helps create a seamless healthcare experience for both patients and providers. Our solution provides unprecedented access to real-time data insights, creating a digital twin of resident states and care delivery that empowers healthcare providers with actionable intelligence for optimal decision-making.

With strong demand and clear product-market fit, Teton is focused on scaling its presence across Europe. We operate through a Country Director model across three established territories - the Nordics (Copenhagen), UK&I (London), and the DACH region (Zurich) - selling into both public hospital systems and care home operators. This is a rare opportunity to lead an established multi-country commercial organisation, bring consistency and governance across territories, and open Teton’s next European markets.

Key Responsibilities

Lead, coach, and develop Teton’s European sales organisation in the Nordics, UK&I, and DACH, holding each territory accountable to its new business targets.

Own and optimise Teton’s European commercial operating cadence across pipeline generation, tender and bid qualification, deal progression, forecasting, CRM governance, performance management, and team accountability - creating a consistent governance structure across territories while respecting local market differences.

Act as a hands-on deal leader on Europe's largest opportunities, across both public tenders and complex private enterprise deals - joining critical customer meetings, site visits, and executive presentations to bring deals over the line.

Optimise go-to-market in each territory: segmentation, coverage model, territory design, resourcing, and partner strategy across public hospital systems and private and public care home operators.

Evaluate and open new core European markets, such as the Benelux region - building the market-entry case, the operating model, and the initial commercial footprint.

Recruit, onboard, and develop commercial leadership and talent as Europe scales, while raising the effectiveness of the existing teams.

Represent Teton at major European industry conferences, national associations, while helping refine go-to-market strategy, messaging, pricing, and commercial execution across the region.

What We’re Looking For

Significant experience selling and leading teams that sell large and complex contracts won through public sector tenders and RFPs - a genuine command of the public procurement motion is essential for this role.

Equivalent enterprise experience closing large, complex contracts with private organisations, as both motions exist across Teton’s European territories.

A demonstrated track record as a highly successful individual contributor, consistently exceeding significant new business quotas and closing complex, high six-figure ACV opportunities across long sales cycles.

Proven sales leadership experience managing, coaching, and developing sales leaders and net-new business teams carrying significant new business quotas, ideally across multiple European countries or territories.

The ability to operate as a true player-coach: strategic enough to optimise the sales organisation and operating model, but hands-on enough to actively influence and close critical deals.

Deep experience managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving executive buyers, procurement, legal, and ownership groups.

A rigorous, data-driven approach to pipeline management, forecasting, CRM accuracy, qualification, performance management, and sales governance.

Experience building or scaling sales teams, segmentation models, territories, processes, methodologies, and repeatable go-to-market motions, including entering new markets.

Exposure to healthcare, hospital systems or senior living is a strong bonus, but not a requirement.

12+ years in enterprise sales, with at least 5 of those spent leading sales teams.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with a willingness to travel regularly across Europe.

What We Offer

Competitive salary and participation in our warrant program.

Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

A high-impact leadership position with significant influence over Teton’s European go-to-market strategy, territory structure, and commercial execution.

A vibrant, learning-focused work environment

title: Staff/Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js)
description:
What we are building

Mimica is an AI-powered process intelligence platform enabling enterprises and individuals to reclaim their most precious resource: time. We've all seen repetitive tasks and redundant processes quietly drain productivity and creativity. Not because companies don’t want to become more efficient, but because they don’t know where to start.

Mimica automatically analyzes your team’s work, then generates the AI agents to execute it. Our software turns everyday work into data-backed decisions, helping companies remove process bottlenecks, automate the right tasks, and upskill teams with precision and confidence.

We’ve raised $26 million in Series B financing and are scaling fast. Backed by investors including Khosla Ventures and Paladin Capital, our proprietary AI technology is trusted by Fortune 500 companies to accelerate transformation. Mimica is recognized as a Top 100 AI Start-up by Accel and an industry Leader by the Everest Group.

Our team

Behind our platform is a team of exceptionally talented people, remote-first and globally distributed across 16+ countries. We're looking for curious, collaborative people excited to solve complex problems. You'll join a fast-paced environment built on high ownership, bottom-up thinking, and transparent, open communication – helping some of the world's leading organizations transform the way work gets done with AI.

Our approach to engineering

We prioritize customer needs first

We work in small, project-based teams

We have flexibility in terms of the problems we work on

We own the full lifecycle of our projects

We avoid silos and encourage taking up tasks in new areas

We balance quality and velocity

We have a shared responsibility for our production code

We each set our own routine to maximize our productivity

Your mission

In this role, your mission will be to enhance and scale the backend systems powering the Mimica platform (MERN stack). This means designing and implementing a scalable architecture, developing and optimizing backend services and APIs, improving the performance and reliability of existing components, and taking operational responsibility for what you build. As a member of our early engineering team, you‘ll have the opportunity to shape our technical direction, processes and culture.

Part of your day-to-day

Contributing to architectural decisions and collaborating across teams to identify and implement product improvements.

Developing and optimizing a real-time backend service that enables multiple users to edit graph data and re-train AI models through their input.

Creating libraries and building APIs in our Node.js backend to interact with the various ML components of the system.

Diagnozing fault-tolerance and availability issues, as well as performance bottlenecks, and resolving them.

Refactoring our components and services and producing documentation for your implementations.

Providing feedback to peers through pair programming and code reviews and helping those around you to level up.

Participating in hiring and onboarding new team members; taking on end-to-end project management responsibilities as we grow.

What you will bring

Background in backend engineering, focusing on developing high-performance production software and scalable architectures.

Minimum 8 years of experience as a Software Engineer.

Proficiency in TypeScript, and experience using modern frameworks and technologies (e.g., Docker, K8s) to build high-throughput, low-latency systems.

Practical experience in designing APIs and managing databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB), with a keen eye for query optimization and efficient data storage & handling.

Firm grasp of distributed systems concepts and techniques – microservices, load balancing, caching, horizontal/vertical scaling and stateless architectures.

Commitment to upholding high engineering standards, prioritizing code quality, maintainability, reliability, and security.

Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills – methodically decomposing systems to identify bottlenecks, determine root causes, and implement effective solutions.

Drive to continually develop your skills, improve team processes and reduce debt.

Fluency in English, with effective communication skills – articulating complex ideas, concepts, and trade-offs clearly.

Bonus

Experience and fluency with Python.

Experience working within an international high-impact Startup/Scale-up environment – delivering value quickly and iteratively.

Active interest in AI, automation, or related fields.

We’d love to hear from you, even if you feel you don’t quite have all of the above.

Location

This is a fully remote position. You can be based anywhere in the UK, Americas, or Europe within a UTC-6 to UTC+1 timezone.

What we offer

💰 Generous compensation + stock options - aligned with our internal framework, market data, and individual skills.

🏢 Distributed work: Work from anywhere - fully remote, in our hubs, or a mix.

💻 Company-issued laptop, remote setup stipend, and co-working budget

📍 Flexible schedules and location

☀️ Ample paid time off, in addition to local public holidays

🍼 Enhanced parental leave

🧘‍♀️ Health & retirement benefits

📖 Annual learning & development budget

🌴 Annual workaways and regular virtual & in-person socials

🌍 Opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that shape the future of work

Note: Some benefits may vary depending on location and role

title: Senior AI Specialist
description:
Hi 👋 we’re Genio. We create beautifully simple learning tools that boost knowledge, skills, and confidence.

 

  • We’re a SaaS scale up - there’s 90+ of us around the UK with our HQ in Leeds.
  • Our software is award-winning and used by 100,000s of students at over 1,000 universities & colleges worldwide.
  • We’re driven achieve our mission to support 1 million students to become better learners by 2030.

 

🚀 About the role

Career track: IC4

Unit: Shared Services

 

Genio has given everyone access to Claude, but most of what makes AI work across a company doesn’t exist here yet: connections to our business systems, a shared skills library, people in each team who can help their colleagues, and the checks that keep it safe. This role designs and builds that system, then gets every team using it.

 

It’s a hands-on building role. We buy and configure leading platforms rather than build our own agent infrastructure, and you’ll write code and build custom integrations wherever configuration isn’t enough. Success is measured by how well other teams build and run their own workflows.

 

You will be responsible for:

  • Design. You design how our AI platforms, connectors, skills and agents fit together. You track what’s changing in AI tools, recommend platform and model choices to the Head of BizOps, and judge new tools on measured performance, reliability, security and cost.
  • Build and run. You build and maintain the integrations and agents that connect our AI platforms to business systems such as our CRM and our documentation, communication and finance tools. You’re responsible for the health of the whole system: spotting failures and out-of-date skills, and tracking use and cost by team so they can be recharged and reported. Champions answer first-line questions and IT handles access, while you handle escalations and fix root causes so problems don’t come back.
  • Knowledge. You build and look after the skills library and the shared knowledge our AI tools draw on: where it lives, how it’s organised, and how it’s kept current and correctly permissioned. You spot good workflows in one team, refine them and make them available to everyone, and decide which become company standards. The teams that own content keep it up to date.
  • Adoption. You train people at every level of technical skill and build a network of champions, nominated by their function heads, so every team has someone nearby to ask. You work alongside teams as they redesign processes, bringing the options for what can be automated, and share practice with engineering in both directions. You also report, team by team, where use is growing, where it’s slow and which uses are producing value.
  • Guardrails. You keep the inventory of AI tools and what each can access, run a fast track for low-risk trials using criteria from our AI policy, and coordinate security, data protection and legal reviews for everything else. Every trial starts with agreed success criteria and ends with a decision to adopt, scale or stop. You configure and check guardrails, such as human review before AI output reaches customers or students, and limits on what agents can do on Genio’s behalf.

 

👥 Meet the team

You will be reporting directly into the Head of BizOps (Business Operations) and working most closely with:

  • Division leaders and SME champions

  • VP Finance, on cost and recharging
  • IT and InfoSec, RevOps and Data in BizOps
  • Legal and data protection

 

👤 About you

Essential:

  • Professional experience rolling out AI tools or automation that teams other than your own use day to day, including redesigning the processes around them.
  • Hands-on experience connecting systems through APIs and automation platforms such as Zapier, Make or n8n, and enough Python or JavaScript to write, read and debug integrations, with AI assistance.
  • A track record of teaching technical things to non-technical people, and a way of knowing it worked.
  • Examples of persuading senior people when you disagreed with their priorities, and of setting your own direction against a wider goal.
  • Sound judgement about data and access, including knowing when a connection needs a security review before it goes live.

Desirable:

  • HubSpot administration or development
  • Organising shared knowledge, such as documentation or knowledge bases
  • Setting up or running a champions or super-user network

  • An engineering background

description:
The role

HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognized as the go-to expert on cost across the team.

What you’ll do

  • Develop a harmonized cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.
  • Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.
  • Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalization and consolidation opportunities.
  • Report progress against the group's ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.

 

You are...

  • An analytical professional who builds models that hold up to scrutiny from Finance and senior leadership.
  • Commercially minded: you look at total value, not just unit price, and you understand what drives cost in food and packaging.
  • A clear communicator who turns complex analysis into a simple story that regional teams can act on.
  • Collaborative: you build alignment with Finance, procurement, and market teams through influence rather than authority.
  • Self-directed: you manage several analyses at once and take ownership from the question through to the recommendation.

 

You have...

  • 5+ years in procurement, cost analysis, or consulting in a global food, retail, or consumer goods business.
  • Hands-on experience building should-cost models or total cost of ownership frameworks, and using them to influence real commercial decisions.
  • Experience measuring cost and savings across multiple markets, including the common pitfalls such as inconsistent methods, inflation effects, and volume mix.
  • Experience with food, ingredient, or packaging categories, including origin, certification, and specification considerations.
  • Fluent in English. Bonus if fluent in French, German, or Dutch. Comfortable working across time zones, with the ability to travel up to 20%.

 

Nice to have...

  • Familiarity with sustainability certification schemes and their cost implications.
  • Experience with commodity price risk or hedging frameworks.

title: AI Reliability Engineering Manager
description:
The role

Run the day-to-day operation of an AI Reliability Engineering team of eight to ten engineers across EMEA. You own the people, the queue, the rota, and the escalations. You report to the AIR Senior Manager for EMEA, who holds strategy, budget, and the senior customer relationships, so your time goes on running a world-class operation and growing the engineers in it.

The estate is about 29,000 GPUs today, with a planning target of one million by the end of 2027. You are the first manager hired under the Senior Manager, and as the region grows you take ownership of a full pillar with its own queue and SOPs. It is a hands-on role: close enough to GPUs, Linux, and high-performance fabrics to lead an incident and challenge a diagnosis, while leading the team most of the week.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead a team of eight to ten AI Reliability Engineers: 1:1s, objectives, reviews, probation, development, and hiring
  • Own the queue: prioritization, SLA adherence, MTTR, and backlog, with a named owner on every near-breach ticket and clean handoffs to Engineering and vendors
  • Run the rota and on-call for the team within the EMEA coverage model and the global follow-the-sun handover
  • Be the first management escalation point on P1s and customer escalations, lead post-incident reviews, and turn repeat incidents into problem records and durable fixes
  • Own the SOPs for your pillar and drive them into Nscale's automation so that repeatable remediation needs less human time
  • Work the day-to-day relationships with DC Operations, Network Operations, Engineering, and the fleet tooling and automation teams
  • Report your team's numbers weekly and accurately, and explain what moved and why

About you

  • Experience: 6+ years in infrastructure, operations, or support engineering in production environments, including 2+ years around GPU, HPC, or large data center estates
  • Leadership: 3+ years managing engineers in an operational support function, owning reviews, development plans, and performance management through to outcome
  • Operational ownership: you have run a queue against SLAs and are comfortable being accountable for the numbers
  • Communication: clear, specific, and concise, in writing and in person
  • Decisiveness and pragmatism: you make calls with incomplete information, improve process without slowing delivery, and commit once the decision is made
  • Technical foundation: solid production Linux and networking, working knowledge of how GPU fleets fail and get repaired, ITIL and SRE habits, and enough scripting to review an engineer's work
  • Adaptability: comfortable with out-of-hours escalations, on-call, and travel to data centers and customer sites

Nice to have

  • NVIDIA GPU platform depth: nvidia-smi, DCGM, and XID interpretation through to RMA (AMD Instinct beneficial)
  • InfiniBand or RoCE diagnostics, NCCL, NVLink and NVSwitch, and Slurm with Pyxis and Enroot
  • Rack-scale systems such as GB200 and GB300 NVL72
  • BMC and Redfish, MAAS, NetBox, OpenStack, Kubernetes, and Ansible or Terraform
  • High-performance storage such as VAST, Ceph, or NFS at scale
  • Follow-the-sun operations, and ITIL, Linux, networking, Kubernetes, or NVIDIA certifications

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

What will I be doing?

You’ll play a pivotal role in building and evolving our internal developer platform in order to empower our software teams. What will I be doing?

Own the People service desk queue day-to-day: triaging, responding to, and resolving employee queries, and keeping response times and queue health on track.

Continuously improve our Jira Service Desk itself - refining triage, workflows, and automations - and feed recurring ticket themes back into our People Bot's knowledge base, so the answers people get before they ever need a human just keep getting better.

Be the main point of contact for new joiners between offer and day one, partnering with Talent Acquisition to make pre-boarding seamless and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

Own and continuously improve the onboarding experience end-to-end - from offer acceptance to day one and beyond - so every new hire feels genuinely welcomed and set up for success.

Support payroll inputs, benefits administration, and compliance activities, making sure our processes hold up against internal policy and employment law requirements.

As you grow into the role: help audit and redesign People processes, identifying where automation, AI, or self-service can reduce manual effort and put information directly in employees' hands.

Roll up your sleeves on cross-functional People projects as they come up - whether that's a Reward cycle, a hiring initiative, or an experience improvement.

About You

Ideally, you'll have/be:

Some experience in a People Operations or HR administrative role, with a genuine interest in how operational rigour underpins the employee lifecycle.

Hands-on comfort with a HRIS, ideally Workday - confident entering and updating records accurately as part of onboarding and lifecycle admin, even if deeper reporting and analysis isn't your focus.

A naturally curious, detail-oriented approach to data - happy to flag something that looks off, even while you're still building the experience to know exactly why.

Some exposure to payroll input processes, or strong eagerness to learn them, with the attention to detail accurate processing demands.

Some experience administering employee benefits (enrolment, changes, queries), and comfortable being a point of contact when something needs sorting.

A habit of noticing when a process is clunky and saying so - you don't need to have led a full redesign yet, but you think about why something works the way it does.

Experience using a service desk tool (Jira or similar) to manage and triage a queue, with a good instinct for keeping things moving and knowing what needs escalating.

Awareness of compliance and employment law basics, and the judgment to flag rather than guess when something feels off.

Clear, warm communication - equally comfortable writing to a nervous new joiner as flagging something to a manager.

You're curious about what AI and automation can do for People Operations, and you're already poking at tools and forming opinions rather than waiting to be told to explore what's next.

You hold yourself to a high bar, and you'll say so if you think something could be better - even if you're not yet the one leading the fix.

What you’ll bring
Ideally you’ll have/be

Deep experience designing, building, and evolving a design system at scale, tokens, component APIs, documentation, and governance

Strong design and UX judgement, starting from the user, with genuine comfort challenging and being challenged by engineers and other designers

Practical knowledge of WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards, with real empathy for designing for users with accessibility needs, not just compliance

Confidence working in code, using AI-assisted tools to take a component from design intent through to shipped reality

Experience running a contribution or change process across multiple teams or apps, from proposal to full migration

A track record setting and delivering technical and design strategy jointly with engineering, iteratively, through genuine ambiguity, not from a finished plan

Strong communication skills, able to hold your opinions loosely, and to raise what matters even when it’s inconvenient, across engineering, product, and the wider business

Experience mentoring, coaching, and developing other designers

A bias to action, comfortable building momentum in the face of real uncertainty

Where you'll work

We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Our Values

Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

title: Fleet Charger (Night)
description:
About HIVED 📦

At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing.

Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.

A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.

Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

Role Overview 📝

The Night Charger is responsible for ensuring all vehicles correctly charged and ready for next-day operations (incl HGV). They must operate fairly independently, and so needs to be self-motivated and to work efficiently to a plan.

The role owns should escalate vehicle or charging issues quickly, and must operate with exceptional care to avoid damage or accidents.

The Night Charger also supports basic depot tasks during downtime.

This is a safety-critical night role with direct impact on fleet readiness and morning dispatch.

What you’ll be doing 🚀

Charge all vehicles overnight according to plan.

Safely move vehicles between yard, charging points, and parking locations.

Ensure all vehicle and charging issues are logged and escalated using standard inspection processes.

Drive vehicles carefully and defensively at all times; zero tolerance for accidents.

Plan charging sequences to accommodate longer charging times for HGVs

Monitor charging sessions to ensure vehicles are charging correctly

Use external charging infrastructure when required to maintain fleet
readiness.

Safely move vehicles within the depot yard to and from charging
points.

Assist with organising depot activity during overnight operations.

Support team coordination when acting in a supervisory capacity.

Support basic depot tasks (e.g. sortation, handling) when charging activity is complete.

Assist with moving equipment, organising cages, or general depot tasks.

Maintain safe working practices across all activities.

Support warehouse or depot teams during quieter periods if operationally required.

Maintain a clean, safe charging and yard environment.

Carry out minor overnight fixes where appropriate, such as:

Jump starting vehicles

Replacing or reconnecting 12V batteries

Inflating or replacing tyres (if trained)

What we’re looking for 🔎

1-3 years’ experience operating in operational roles or vehicle-related roles.

Valid van driving licence is required - >21 years’ old, licence held for >1 year, 0 points on licence.

Experienced, confident and safe vehicle handling, especially at night.

Comfortable working independently and following clear instructions.

High attention to detail and safety awareness.

Flexible, willing to support general depot tasks when required.

Reliable, punctual, and able to work night shifts.

Able to communicate effectively & build relationships.

Valid HGV licens may be required.

Understanding of electric vehicle charging processes.

Basic vehicle troubleshooting ability.

Our Values

😊 We Are Kind - Kind to the planet, our team and our partners. We listen with purpose, leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - it requires us to be fair, consistent, honest, thoughtful and compassionate.

🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence.

💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started. We never fight the urge to be inquisitive, to understand the world around us and to explore where others might not.

🌍 We Are Resourceful - Our planet's resources are scarce and our future depends on our ability to use them wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have.

How we reward our team 🎁

Dynamic working environment with a diverse and driven team

Huge opportunity for learning in a high growth environment, with progression opportunities based on success in the role

25 days of holiday allowance plus public holidays

if you're on a 4 days on - 4 days off shift pattern, you are entitled to the equivalent of 18 days paid holiday plus public holidays

similarly on 4 days on - 3 days off shift pattern, you are entitled to the equivalent of 20 days paid holiday plus public holidays

1 Birthday Day Off + 2 Tenure-Based Additional Days Off

Subsidised Private Medical Insurance including dental, vision & mental health therapy

Bi-annual performance reviews and tailored development plans

Annual compensation review

Team lunch provided once a week

Quarterly team socials and annual sports day (HIVED Olympics)

Enhanced maternity/paternity/adoption policy as day 1 right

Community volunteer days

Cycle to work scheme

Dog friendly office and depots

MacBook Air or Windows Laptop (depending on your preference)

🔍 Want to learn more?

HIVED is B Corporation certified

HIVED is #7 on The Sunday Times Tech 100

Read how HIVED raised $42M to transform parcel delivery with AI and all-electric logistics network

Check the Impact Reports for 2024 and 2025

Keep up with HIVED ✨ here ✨
