title: AI Engineer - Full time
description:
TLDR; Davis is hiring an AI Engineer to work on the multi-agent pipeline turning raw, fragmented data into expert-grade real estate deliverables. You will make it more reliable, fast, and indistinguishable from the best human teams, then push it past what any human team could do, owning the stack end to end, from context engineering and orchestration to verification, storage and evaluation.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

Where We Operate

Early-stage development starts with a chain of high-stakes decisions, each requiring different data, different expertise, and different deliverables. Today, we deliver AI-powered outputs across the full spectrum - site sourcing, feasibility studies, architectural design, investment analysis, financial modeling, dataroom analysis, and more.

The Role

You will work on one of the core systems behind what Davis delivers. Our agents take raw, fragmented data and turn it into deliverables that real estate professionals use to make high-stakes decisions. Your job is to make that pipeline reliable, fast, and indistinguishable from work done by the best human teams - then push it beyond what any human team could do.

You can expect to:

Build and operate multi-agent systems that turn heterogeneous data into expert-grade deliverables across real estate development workflows.

Own the system end to end: infra, orchestration, context engineering, how the system selects, structures, and injects the right information so agents behave reliably at scale.

Ensure production-grade quality, performance, and reliability across every output we deliver to clients.

Sit with clients and domain experts regularly to understand their constraints, challenge your own assumptions, and make sure every output meets and even exceeds clients' expectations.

Beyond the technical depth, this role will expose you to how real estate decisions are made, how clients think, and what it takes to deliver outputs they trust. You'll develop a sharp business intuition alongside your engineering skills.

Key Responsibilities

Harness engineering: design and build the system layer around the model - context assembly, tool orchestration, verification, and report generation - to deliver consistent, high-quality outputs at scale.

Data ingestion & context assembly: handle messy, unstructured project data from heterogeneous sources and ensure agents have the right context at all times.

Storage & traceability: persist sources, extracted facts, intermediate results, report versions, and expert edits.

Expert-in-the-loop UX: design and build the review experience (annotations, edits, approvals, diffs/version history, provenance display).

Evaluation & benchmarking: build an internal eval harness (datasets, rubrics, regression tests, monitoring) to track agents performance over time.

What We're Looking For

1.5+ years building and deploying production software at scale (APIs, reliability, testing, performance).

Experience building and evaluating LLM agents / multi-step workflows in real systems.

Proven context engineering experience: you've built systems where reliability depends on assembling the right context (RAG over heterogeneous sources, summarization, conversation state, tool outputs).

Deep Python expertise (clean architecture, typing, async/concurrency, strong testing culture).

Strong experience with databases + data modeling (structured storage, document storage, versioning).

Full-stack experience (you can ship a real UI), with a clear backend emphasis.

Comfortable building from first principles: we don't want heavy agent frameworks — we prefer a lightweight, well-engineered codebase.

Nice to Have

Experience operating LLM systems with observability and quality monitoring in production.

GIS familiarity (parcels, zoning layers, geocoding).

Multi-country product experience (heterogeneous sources, localization, varying rules).

NLP background

Why Join Us

You're joining a team of 9 at the very beginning - where every decision you make shapes the product, the culture, and the trajectory of the company. What you build here will be yours.

Direct impact on growth: your work doesn't sit behind three layers of review. You ship, clients use it, and you see the results. Every output you improve translates directly into revenue and reputation.

Real-world impact: your work supports investment decisions, accelerates development timelines, and helps redefine how cities are imagined, designed, and built.

High ownership: own the full feasibility stack end to end, as the CEO of that part.

Competitive salary and meaningful equity in an early-stage company.

A small team with high standards - we ship fast and love working together.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:

Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

Why We'll Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design Yet

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability; parametric tools only check constraints after generation, leading to designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but doesn't yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. As a result, floorplans may “look” plausible but break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they're usable.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

description:
TLDR; Davis is hiring an AI Researcher to push the frontier of floorplan generation. Working directly with architects, you'll own research directions end-to-end, from diffusion and flow matching models (continuous and discrete) to deployment in a product used by real estate professionals.

About Davis

We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

Our Mission

We build a foundation model for architectural design that generates compliant, editable building layouts from scratch. By leveraging discrete diffusion models (operating on structured representations rather than pixels), we aim to produce floorplans and site plans that respect real-world constraints (zoning laws, space requirements, etc.) and can be iteratively refined like a human-designed plan.

The Role

We are looking for a AI Researcher to lead this effort in our Paris office. If you’re excited about improving our current state-of-the-art floorplan generative model and applying it to a high-impact domain, this role offers a unique opportunity to define a new class of AI-driven design tools. You will work within a focused team of 3–4 engineers and researchers, collaborating daily with architects to turn foundational research into deployable tools.

What you'll own:

Model Architecture & Design Space: Design the core model architecture and work on a discrete design space for architectural layouts. You will choose how to represent floorplans (e.g. as graphs of rooms/connections or token grids) such that the diffusion model’s outputs are editable and code-compliant by construction. This involves ensuring the model can enforce architectural rules (e.g. room sizes, adjacency constraints) within its generation process.

Large-Scale Model Training: Lead the training of a foundation diffusion model from scratch on GPU clusters. You’ll set up distributed training across multiple nodes, optimize data loading and checkpointing, and manage experiments at scale. The role requires hands-on engineering for efficient training of large models on high-performance computing infrastructure.

Benchmarking & Iteration: Evaluate the model’s performance and establish benchmarks to measure success. Using these evaluations, you’ll iterate on the model to push performance beyond existing methods. Our goal is to surpass the latest research results and produce genuinely useful architectural designs.

What We’re Looking For

Applied Research Excellence: PhD or Master’s in Maths, Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Strong foundations in ML and a track record of innovative research, publications, or high-impact projects.

Diffusion Model Expertise: Deep understanding of diffusion models (discrete or continuous), guided generation techniques, and the latest advances in generative modeling.

Large-Scale Model Training: Proven experience training large-scale deep learning models on GPU clusters. Comfortable with distributed training, multi-node jobs, experiment management, and handling large datasets.

Technical Engineering Skills: Proficiency in Python with experience in PyTorch or similar frameworks. Ability to write efficient, maintainable code and optimize training pipelines. Familiarity with distributed training libraries (e.g., PyTorch Lightning) is a plus.

Research Literacy: Ability to read, evaluate, and implement advanced ML research. You stay current with state-of-the-art generative modeling work and can adapt cutting-edge methods to domain-specific problems.

Collaboration & Communication: Strong teamwork skills. Able to articulate complex concepts clearly and work closely with AI engineers, researchers, and domain experts to integrate technical solutions into the architectural design workflow.

Nice to Have

Industry Experience: Background in a top AI research organization or cutting-edge startup, especially working on foundation models or generative AI tools.

Publications/Open Source: Research publications in generative modeling (diffusion, VAEs, flows, GANs) or significant open-source contributions demonstrating ability to push state-of-the-art systems.

Domain Knowledge: While not required, an interest in architecture or design will help.

Reinforcement Learning & Optimization: Experience with RL, reward modeling, or constrained optimization (particularly MCTS, GRPO and RLHF) relevant to guiding generative models under complex constraints.

Multimodal Generation: Experience with graph-based, sequence-based, or discrete structured generative models (e.g., molecule generation, layout generation, program synthesis) or with graph neural networks.

You're joining a team of 12 at the very beginning - where every decision you make shapes the product, the culture, and the trajectory of the company. What you build here will be yours.

Build what no one has before: the foundation model that automates architectural design and redefines how cities are imagined, designed, and built.

Work on meaningful challenges: from constraint-aware generative models to real-world deployment in major construction projects.

Competitive salary and meaningful equity in an early-stage company.

Ship fast, iterate boldly: go from research to prototype to production in weeks, not years.

Join a world-class team: a mix of AI researchers, engineers, and architects backed by world-class VCs.

Project phases, a solid grasp of the phases from feasibility to schematic design, and what each one implies in level of detail.

Graphic production, images and diagrams that explain the project and make it legible.

  • Planning documents and how they apply: building envelope, height, setbacks, spacing rules, footprint, planted open ground, parking, permitted uses.

  • Rigor and a sense of synthesis, especially on ambiguous cases.

title: Finance Ops
description:
About Inbolt

Deploying an industrial robot still takes months of integration and programming, and the moment a part, a process, or a position changes, it starts over. Inbolt makes it take minutes.

Our generalist vision model gives robots the ability to see, think, and adapt in real time, so any robot can master any process, part, or station. Set up from a CAD model in minutes and compatible with FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa, Comau, and Universal Robots, Inbolt runs in production at Stellantis, Toyota, Ford, GM, Bosch and more, with 200+ systems live across 100+ factories on three continents.

We're a team based in Paris, Detroit and Japan, and we're growing fast. Here's the role:

You'll join the finance team as Finance Ops, reporting to Jean-François, our VP Finance. It's the right seat for someone who wants to see the whole finance function of a scaling industrial company.

🎯 Responsibilities

Controlling & reporting

Own the month-end close: accuracy of cost allocations, accruals, prepaids and intercompany across our French, US and Japanese entities

Analyze financial performance against budget and targets; explain variances to the VP Finance and leadership

Prepare the monthly reporting package (P&L, cash, KPIs) for management, the board and investors

Contribute to budgeting and forecasting cycles

Operations & cash

Invoice customers and monitor collections; follow up on overdue payments with Sales and Deployment

Prepare supplier and payroll-related bank payments

Track down and collect missing supporting documents (invoices, POs, expense receipts) and drive the team to keep them clean

Building the function

Improve internal finance processes and tooling, including using AI tools to automate collection, matching and reconciliation work

Take over bookkeeping (AP, AR, bank, accruals, prepaids) from our external accountant over the next 12–18 months

Support audit, tax and grant-related requests (CIR, BPI, etc.)

🔎 Preferred experience

3–4 years of experience in controlling, accounting or audit: ideally a mix (e.g. audit or expertise-comptable followed by an in-house role)

Experience in a startup/fast-paced environment

Degree in Finance, Accounting or Business (DCG, DSCG, Master CCA or equivalent)

Solid understanding of French GAAP, financial statements and month-end mechanics

Comfortable with financial analysis and budget tracking

Advanced Excel / Google Sheets

Familiarity with accounting or ERP software (Pennylane, Sage, NetSuite or similar)

Fluent in French and English: both required, as you'll work with our US and Japanese teams

Experience in leveraging or implementing AI solutions to improve and streamline financial processes

✍️ Position details

Team: Finance

Contract: CDI, full-time

Location: Paris (12 Rue Vivienne, 75002)

Work mode: 3 days minimum on site per week

Start date: ASAP

Package: 📈 stock options and 🩺 health coverage, on top of the benefits below

Why join Inbolt

Real impact, on real factory floors: your work runs in production at Stellantis, Toyota, Ford, GM and Bosch, across 200+ factories on three continents.

Ownership from day one: we value end-to-end ownership, high rigor and hands-on curiosity, and we move fast while staying precise.

An international team: Paris, Detroit and Japan, working closely with world-class robotics and automation partners.

A seat at the start of something big: we're building the default intelligence layer for every industrial robot, on every brand.

Benefits

We're building our benefits location by location, so they fit local needs and practices in each country where we operate.

📍 Prime office locations in Paris and Detroit

🤝 Team-building events & off-sites

🐶 Bring-your-dog-to-work policy

🍽️ Lunch expenses covered

✈️ Customer site visits in real factories

and more....

Benefits may vary by location and contract type.

Our hiring process

Introduction call (30 min) with our Talent team, to get to know you and answer your questions.

Interview with your future manager, including a case study or technical exercise depending on the role.

Meet the team: a conversation with the people you will work with every day.

Final round with our founders.

Reference checks.

The exact steps can vary slightly by role. We keep the process short and transparent, and we'll keep you posted at every step.

Ready to give robots sight?

Inbolt is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from everyone, whatever their background, and a real person reads every application. Even if you don't tick every box, if this role excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

Nous accélérons pour accompagner de nouveaux cabinets partout en France, tout en maintenant une exigence forte sur la qualité du produit et de l'accompagnement.

🎯 Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant

Pour un gestionnaire de paie, une question sans réponse un jour de clôture, c'est une paie en retard. La qualité du Support est un élément clé de l'accompagnement qu'Alassio propose à ses cabinets partenaires, et l'arrivée de nouveaux cabinets nous amène à constituer une équipe dédiée.

🚀 Ton rôle

Tu es le premier contact de nos cabinets partenaires quand ils ont une question. Ta réactivité et la clarté de tes réponses conditionnent leur confiance dans Alassio dès leurs premières semaines en production. En accompagnant les gestionnaires de paie dans leur pratique quotidienne du logiciel, tu contribues directement à la qualité du produit, et tu montes en compétences sur toute la paie et sur notre outil.

🧭 Ton parcours et tes missions

Tu te formes sur le produit, sur la paie telle qu'Alassio la calcule et sur les process de l'équipe

Tu prends le relais d'Alassio Intelligence, notre agent IA qui apporte la première réponse, quand un gestionnaire de paie a besoin d'un humain : tu réponds sur Intercom aux questions d'utilisation de l'outil, de paramétrage de dossier et de paie courante

Tu gagnes en autonomie et tiens nos standards de service : première réponse en moins de 5 minutes, satisfaction des cabinets supérieure à 98 %

Tu qualifies chaque demande et tu l'escalades quand il le faut, avec tous les éléments utiles : aux Consultant(e)s Support Paie & DSN pour les cas complexes de paie et de DSN, à l'équipe Tech pour les bugs

Tu contribues aux contenus d'aide et à la base de connaissances d'Alassio Intelligence, pour rendre les cabinets plus autonomes

Tu portes la voix des utilisateurs en remontant au Product des retours structurés

Tu testes les nouvelles fonctionnalités avant leur mise en production

🤝 Ton environnement

Rattachement : notre Lead Support Paie & DSN et Huy Anh (Resp. Métier)

Tu travailles au quotidien avec nos Consultant(e)s Support Paie & DSN, notre Expert(e) Métier Paie & DSN et notre Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie

À 1 mois : tu connais le produit et nos process, et tu réponds aux demandes simples avec relecture du Lead Support Paie & DSN

À 3 mois : tu es autonome sur le niveau 1, tu tiens nos standards et tes escalades sont complètes et bien qualifiées

À 6 mois : tu prends en charge tes premières demandes de niveau 2 et tu contribues régulièrement à la documentation

Profil recherché

🌱 Expérience

Indispensable :

Formation en paie (BTS, licence pro, master ou titre professionnel Gestionnaire de paie)

1 à 2 ans d'expérience en paie, alternance comprise (cabinet, entreprise ou éditeur)

De bonnes bases : établissement du bulletin, cotisations, absences, congés payés

Une vraie appétence pour le numérique et de l'aisance à l'écrit

Un plus :

Bonnes notions de DSN

Pratique d'un logiciel de paie du marché

Expérience en relation client ou en support

Un parcours ou un intérêt pour la tech (formation, projets personnels)

La curiosité et l'envie d'apprendre

La capacité à garder le cap lors des pics d'activité (clôtures de paie mensuelles, mois de janvier)

👊 Une mission unique

Développer tes compétences au contact d'experts et d'une équipe tech ambitieuse, dans une startup qui change le quotidien des gestionnaires de paie, et contribuer chaque jour aux améliorations du produit.

💰 Rémunération fixe de 40 à 45K€ selon le profil

🍽️ Carte Swile (titres-restaurant)

💻 Matériel informatique haut de gamme (MacOS, écran incurvé)

🎯 Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant

Quand un écart de calcul ou un rejet DSN bloque une paie, le cabinet a besoin d'un expert qui comprend vite et explique clairement. Ta réponse évite une paie en retard et renforce la confiance du cabinet dans Alassio.

Notre support est hybride : Alassio Intelligence, notre agent IA, apporte la première réponse ; nos Spécialistes Support Paie prennent le relais sur les questions courantes, et tu interviens sur les cas qui demandent une expertise approfondie.

🚀 Ton rôle

Tu prends en charge les demandes de paie et de DSN qui demandent une vraie expertise : tu analyses, tu expliques, et tu donnes vite au cabinet la bonne réponse. Tu es l'expert vers qui le cabinet se tourne quand une paie est bloquée.

🧭 Tes missions

Traiter les demandes de niveau 2 escaladées par les Spécialistes Support Paie : écarts de calcul, absences et maintien de salaire, entrées et sorties, régularisations

Expliquer les retours DSN (anomalies, rejets, comptes rendus métier) et guider le cabinet dans leur correction

Qualifier les bugs et les erreurs de paramétrage : reproduire, documenter et transmettre à l'équipe Tech ou à l'Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie

Escalader avec discernement les sujets d'analyse produit à l'Expert(e) Métier Paie & DSN et les questions d'interprétation juridique à l'équipe Juridique

Faire monter en compétences les Spécialistes Support Paie : relectures, partage de cas, réponses types

Capitaliser : fiches pratiques dans notre documentation et dans la base de connaissances d'Alassio Intelligence

Remonter au Product les irritants récurrents des cabinets

🤝 Ton environnement

Rattachement : notre Lead Support Paie & DSN et Huy Anh (Resp. Métier)

Tu travailles au quotidien avec nos Spécialistes Support Paie, notre Expert(e) Métier Paie & DSN, notre Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie et l'équipe Juridique

Outils : Alassio, Alassio Intelligence, Intercom, Linear, Notion, Mintlify

🗓️ Tes 6 premiers mois

À 1 mois : tu maîtrises le produit, le moteur de calcul et nos circuits d'escalade, et tu traites tes premières demandes de niveau 2 avec relecture

À 3 mois : tu es autonome sur le niveau 2, tes escalades vers le Métier et le Juridique sont complètes et justes, et tu partages ton rapport d'étonnement

À 6 mois : tu es la référence DSN de l'équipe Support, et tes contenus font baisser le volume des demandes récurrentes

Profil recherché

🌱 Expérience

Indispensable :

Formation en paie (BTS, licence pro, master ou titre professionnel Gestionnaire de paie)

3 à 5 ans d'expérience en paie : gestionnaire de paie confirmé(e) en cabinet, ou support et conseil chez un éditeur de paie

Maîtrise de la DSN : anomalies, rejets, comptes rendus métier, régularisations

Solide pratique des règles de paie en environnement multi-conventions

Une écriture claire et pédagogue

Un plus :

Pratique d'un logiciel de paie du marché

Expérience de support ou de hotline chez un éditeur

Connaissance d'un régime particulier : MSA, BTP (caisses de congés payés) ou Outre-mer

💎 Qualités

Le réflexe d'aller au fond d'un cas avant de répondre

La pédagogie : tu sais rendre une règle complexe compréhensible pour un gestionnaire de paie

Le calme et la réactivité lors des pics d'activité (clôtures de paie mensuelles, mois de janvier)

1️⃣ Appel d'introduction avec Hector (COO) : 30 min

Mettre ton expertise paie et DSN au service d'un logiciel qui change le quotidien des gestionnaires de paie, et voir tes retours transformés en améliorations du produit.

description:

En un coup d'œil

Lieu : Paris ou Aix-en-Provence ; hybride

Équipe : Métier

Expérience : 5 à 8 ans en paie, dont une expérience chez un éditeur de paie ou en MOA paie

Missions

🏗️ Alassio, en quelques mots

Le marché de la paie en cabinet d'expertise comptable est dominé depuis des décennies par des solutions historiques. Chez Alassio, notre ambition est de rénover le métier au bénéfice des gestionnaires de paie, avec un logiciel moderne, évolutif et pensé pour les réalités du terrain.

Lancé en juillet 2025 et déployé en clientèle depuis mars 2026, Alassio a levé 2,6 M€ en pre-seed auprès de Partech et de business angels de référence. Nous accélérons pour accompagner de nouveaux cabinets partout en France, tout en maintenant une exigence forte sur la qualité du produit et de l'accompagnement.

🎯 Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant

Un logiciel de paie ne vaut que par la justesse de ses règles métier. Qu'il vienne de la roadmap ou d'un cabinet, chaque sujet doit être analysé finement avant d'être développé : règles applicables, cas limites, impacts sur les bulletins et sur la DSN. Avec l'arrivée de nouveaux cabinets et l'extension d'Alassio à de nouveaux régimes, ces sujets se multiplient.

🚀 Ton rôle

Tu es l'analyste métier de référence de la paie chez Alassio : tu décortiques les sujets complexes et tu transformes un besoin métier en solution fiable, puis tu t'assures que ce qui est livré fonctionne vraiment pour nos cabinets. Tes sujets d'analyse viennent de deux sources : la roadmap du produit paie, et les cas les plus complexes que nous remontent nos cabinets.

🧭 Tes missions

Analyser les sujets métier de la roadmap : règles applicables, cas limites, impacts sur les bulletins et la DSN, notamment pour l'extension d'Alassio à de nouveaux régimes

Investiguer les cas les plus complexes escaladés par le support : écarts de calcul, anomalies et rejets DSN, régularisations ; identifier la cause et la bonne réponse (bug, évolution ou paramétrage, ce dernier étant pris en charge par l'Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie)

Formaliser tes analyses en spécifications fonctionnelles pour l'équipe Tech

Construire les cas de test avant chaque mise en production

Porter des sujets de bout en bout, du cadrage à la mise en production, avec l'équipe Tech

Prototyper si besoin avec des outils d'IA pour valider une approche

Faire de chaque analyse une source d'amélioration : transformer les irritants récurrents en sujets produit, priorisés avec Huy Anh (Resp. Métier), et enrichir la documentation fonctionnelle et la base de connaissances

🔁 Tes rituels

Les kickoffs des sujets que tu portes ou sur lesquels tu interviens

Un triage hebdomadaire avec Huy Anh, l'Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie et le support : remontées des cabinets, corrections, priorités produit

Le demo day de toute l'équipe, chaque vendredi midi

🤝 Ton environnement

Tu travailles au quotidien avec Huy Anh (Resp. Métier), l'Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie, le support, l'équipe Tech et Ludivine (Resp. Juridique)

Outils : Alassio, Linear, Notion, Intercom, outils d'IA

🗓️ Tes 6 premiers mois

À 1 mois : tu maîtrises le produit, le moteur de calcul et le circuit du support ; tu analyses tes premiers cas remontés par les cabinets et ta première spécification est relue avec Huy Anh

À 3 mois : tu portes un sujet de la roadmap de bout en bout (spécification, cas de test, recette), l'analyse des remontées des cabinets est systématisée et tu partages ton rapport d'étonnement

À 6 mois : tu es la référence métier de la squad Prod ; les sujets arrivent mieux spécifiés aux développeurs, avec moins d'allers-retours, et les irritants des cabinets se résolvent plus vite

Profil recherché

🌱 Expérience

Indispensable :

5 à 8 ans d'expérience en paie, dont une expérience de consultant(e) chez un éditeur de paie ou en maîtrise d'ouvrage (MOA) paie

Une pratique avancée de l'analyse fonctionnelle : spécifications, cas de test

Maîtrise de la DSN : structure, contrôles, anomalies et rejets, régularisations

Solide culture des règles de paie en environnement multi-conventions

Une écriture claire et structurée, compréhensible par un développeur comme par un gestionnaire de paie

Un plus :

Pratique d'un logiciel de paie du marché

Expérience d'un outil de gestion de projet produit (Linear, Jira ou équivalent)

Aisance avec les outils d'IA ou de prototypage

💎 Qualités

Le réflexe d'aller au fond d'un sujet avant d'écrire une ligne de spécification

L'autonomie pour porter un sujet de bout en bout

La capacité à faire dialoguer le métier et la tech

Processus de sélection

1️⃣ Appel d'introduction avec Hector (COO) : 30 min

2️⃣ Entretien métier avec Huy Anh (Resp. Métier) et Hector : 45 min

3️⃣ Cas pratique en direct avec Huy Anh et un développeur : à partir d'une remontée réelle d'un cabinet, qualifier le besoin et poser les grandes lignes d'une spécification et de ses cas de test : 1 h

4️⃣ Rencontre avec l'équipe : 1 h

👉 Le processus se termine par des prises de référence.

Ce que nous offrons

👊 Une mission unique

Être au cœur du produit paie d'un logiciel nouvelle génération, voir tes analyses devenir des fonctionnalités et rester au contact direct des cabinets.

🎁 Rémunération et avantages

💰 Rémunération fixe de 60 à 75K€ selon l'expérience + BSPCE

🏥 Mutuelle Alan

🍽️ Carte Swile (titres-restaurant)

💻 Matériel informatique haut de gamme (MacOS, écran incurvé)

🏡 Télétravail régulier possible

🤓 Offsites d'équipe réguliers (un par trimestre en moyenne)

Nous étendons en continu la couverture d'Alassio à de nouvelles conventions collectives et à de nouveaux dispositifs réglementaires. Chaque paramétrage se retrouve sur des milliers de bulletins : ta rigueur garantit la justesse des paies de nos cabinets, et ta réactivité leur permet d'obtenir vite les ajustements dont ils ont besoin.

🚀 Ton rôle

Tu fais évoluer le moteur de paie d'Alassio : c'est toi qui traduis les règles de paie (conventions collectives, dispositifs réglementaires, cas particuliers) en paramétrage fiable, utilisé par tous nos cabinets. Tu travailles avec les équipes Métier et Juridique à l'extension réglementaire d'Alassio, en t'appuyant sur les workflows IA d'intégration et de mise à jour des paramètres légaux et conventionnels que nous avons développés.

🧭 Tes missions

Réaliser et maintenir le paramétrage du moteur : rubriques, cotisations, profils de paie et conventions collectives

Traiter les demandes de paramétrage de bout en bout : diagnostic, analyse, paramétrage et livraison, en lien avec notre équipe Juridique

Requalifier les cas limites : distinguer ce qui relève du moteur, du paramétrage propre au dossier du cabinet ou d'une évolution produit

Mettre en œuvre les évolutions réglementaires : analyser, paramétrer et tester les changements de taux, de plafonds et de règles

Traiter les corrections issues du support : vérifier et ajuster les modifications analysées, puis les valider et les implémenter

Tester chaque paramétrage livré : tests de conformité et de non-régression, construction et entretien des jeux de tests

Fiabiliser le workflow IA d'intégration des CCN : contrôler, tester et corriger ce qu'il produit

Gérer la file des demandes : prioriser, suivre et accompagner la validation des livrables

Documenter les paramétrages réalisés

Analyser des cas clients pour identifier l'origine d'un écart de calcul

Remonter au Product les anomalies et les besoins d'évolution du produit

Notions de code (Python) ou de logique de formules avancées

title: Change and Transformation Manager - Client Delivery (Fluency in French & English required)
description:
Change and Transformation Manager – Client Delivery (French/english)

Location: Paris, France (hybrid, three days a week in the office; occasional travel to Brussels and London)
Level: Programme Manager senior
Team: Client Delivery
Contract: Permanent
Reporting To: Operating Model Design Lead

Please note: This role is based in France, so you need to live here or be open to relocating, and it requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential, and we kindly ask you to submit your CV in English.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

Own change and transformation support for go-live readiness for ENGIE France’s migration onto Kaluza as the hands-on lead, from planning through cutover, hypercare and transition towards scaling, so ENGIE’s teams are ready and confident to adopt the platform from day one.

Decide the change approach for the programme: stakeholder analysis, change impact assessment, training design and business readiness engagement, shaped to ENGIE France’s operating context and owned by their teams.

Operate Kaluza’s business readiness governance: stage gates, readiness evidence, risk and dependency tracking and weekly reporting.

Partner with the Learning and Adoption Specialist in France to coordinate training, Train the Trainer and knowledge content, so enablement lands throughout each programme increment as we build out and release features via Agile delivery.

Be the day-to-day point of contact for ENGIE France on business readiness, change and adoption, giving practical change advice to their transformation leads.

Track adoption and operational stability through hypercare, root-cause any shortfall against acceptance criteria, and agree interventions with ENGIE.

Improve Kaluza’s readiness playbook: evolve what worked on ENGIE Belgium, test fixes where it falls short in France, and share what you learn with colleagues across Client Delivery to shape the platform’s operational foundations and improvements and to set our global standards.

Day to day, the activities you’ll lead or support include:

Change impact and readiness planning: diagnosing the full scope of impacts across roles, workflows, systems and customer experience, then turning them into a prioritised readiness plan sequenced against delivery, migration and release cadence.

Stakeholders, sponsors and change networks: mapping stakeholders and influence at workstream level, helping sponsors stay visible and engaged, and shaping the champion, superuser and people-manager networks that carry change into ENGIE’s business.

Communications and resistance: supporting ENGIE France’s own communications and engagement strategy, so their teams and customers hear a consistent, positive story about the programme. You’ll help leaders and champions advocate for the change, internally and with customers, and anticipate where resistance may form so you can intervene before it becomes entrenched.

Migration and go-live readiness: building the business and operational readiness evidence that enables a smooth transfer to service, measured against the agreed acceptance criteria, and supporting the go-live command centre.

Hypercare and stabilisation: agreeing hypercare entry and exit criteria, monitoring stability and adoption signals, and handing over cleanly to ENGIE’s business-as-usual teams.

Early releases and workarounds: planning for known limitations in early releases, and reflecting them in training, knowledge and communications so users are never caught by surprise. You’ll work with Release Management so each platform release arrives with the enablement it needs.

What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

Several years of hands-on change delivery on large platform or systems transformations, with a recognised change management discipline. You solve a wide range of problems creatively and work with little supervision.

Experience in regulated, customer-facing operational environments, including live customer account migration, cutover and go-live, where you have shaped the approach rather than only followed one.

Strong communication and stakeholder management, credible with client programme leads and transformation sponsors.

Fluency in French and English, written and spoken.

Comfort working with data: you explore adoption and programme data yourself, report on it clearly and challenge decisions when evidence is weak.

Commercial awareness: you understand how Kaluza makes money and balance what the client needs against cost, working alongside SI partners and the client’s own change resources without duplicating effort.

What will set you apart: a background in energy retail or utilities, vendor-side experience on a SaaS implementation, and/or knowledge of contact centre operations and technology.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)

Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund

Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + bank holidays + RTT days, Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

Compensation: €56 – €75

title: Product Manager – Agent Experience ( Français/ Anglais)
description:
Product Manager – Agent Experience

Lieu : Paris de préférence, possibilité à Londres (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau)
Équipe : Customer Care
Langues : Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais
Contrat : CDI
Rattachement : Lead Product Manager

À noter : ce poste est ouvert à Paris et à Londres, et nécessite un droit de travailler déjà acquis dans le pays où vous serez basé(e) (UE pour Paris, Royaume-Uni pour Londres). Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de parrainage de visa, mais nous étudions le parrainage poste par poste : gardez un œil sur notre site carrières pour de futures opportunités.

Merci de soumettre votre CV en anglais.

À propos de Kaluza

Kaluza est la plateforme d’Energy Intelligence qui transforme la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les énergéticiens à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En associant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie de tous les jours.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des entreprises innovantes comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que vous ferez

Piloter la roadmap : porter la stratégie de bout en bout de Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE) sur le marché européen, en cohérence avec les objectifs produit globaux et affinée par les besoins clients locaux et les comportements des agents. Vous suivrez les indicateurs opérationnels clés (AHT, FCR, CSAT, adoption de l’IA, onboarding) pour vous assurer que chaque évolution améliore l’expérience des agents et des clients.

Concevoir les parcours et garantir la cohérence UX : être le garant de l’expérience agent sur l’ensemble de KAE. Vous travaillerez avec les équipes UX et métier pour appliquer des patterns communs, réduire la charge cognitive des agents et rester aligné avec le design system, y compris quand de nouvelles capacités d’automatisation et d’assistance par l’IA sont introduites.

Mener les intégrations et l’onboarding client : piloter les intégrations techniques et produit avec des plateformes tierces, et superviser de bout en bout le déploiement de nouvelles instances KAE pour les nouveaux clients, de la phase de découverte jusqu’à la mise en production.

Garantir l’accessibilité et la conformité : défendre les réglementations européennes d’accessibilité dès la conception, en traduisant les exigences réglementaires et spécifiques à chaque marché en besoins techniques concrets.

Accompagner les clients et créer de la valeur : être l’expert de confiance des clients sur l’expérience agent, en défendant une configuration native de la plateforme plutôt que des développements sur mesure.

Impacts du changement et planification de la préparation : diagnostiquer l’ensemble des impacts sur les rôles, les processus, les systèmes et l’expérience client, puis les traduire en un plan de préparation priorisé, séquencé en fonction du rythme de livraison, de migration et de mise en production.

Communication et résistances : soutenir la stratégie de communication et d’engagement d’ENGIE France, afin que leurs équipes et leurs clients entendent un discours cohérent et positif sur le programme. Votre profil

Plusieurs années d’expérience opérationnelle en conduite du changement sur de grandes transformations de plateformes ou de systèmes, avec une discipline de change management reconnue. Vous résolvez avec créativité une grande variété de problèmes et travaillez avec peu de supervision.

title: Lead Designer
description:
Lead Designer

Location: Paris, France (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Team: UX

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Head of UX

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in France. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

Own UX strategy for our EU programme end to end, with real judgement over what to prioritise and how, as the market and the team's shape itself still takes form

Partner directly with Product, Engineering, and Data on the ground locally, including wider teams and client-side engineers,bringing user needs into decisions from the start, not added on afterward

Use our established research methods to bring real insight into your own design work, and feed what you learn locally back into the wider team's shared understanding

Lead and grow two designers based in London, building one genuinely connected team across EU and the UK from early on

Shape how local work becomes part of our shared platform and design system, so what you build here compounds for every client after, not just this one

Build directly in code where useful, using AI-assisted tools to prototype or ship small front-end changes yourself, closing the gap between design and delivery

Go beyond representing UX, be an active voice in the trade-offs between PMs and Design, holding the right balance between client-specific needs and our global approach, including directly with clients and stakeholders in workshops, showcases, and pre-sales conversations across the EU market

Help define what design leadership looks like across a genuinely distributed function, UK, EU, and Australia, while it's still being built

What you’ll bring

Ideally you’ll have/be

A track record owning UX strategy and delivery end to end for a complex, multi-stakeholder product, ideally in a regulated or operationally complex industry

Experience designing in B2B or B2B2C environments, for professional, repeat users rather than casual consumers

Direct experience managing or mentoring other designers, comfortable leading a small team while still doing hands-on design work yourself

Experience working from, and contributing back to, a shared platform or design system, not just consuming one

Comfort working close to code, confident using AI-assisted development tools (such as Claude Code) to go from design to a working interface yourself

A genuine appetite for building something from an early stage, comfortable with ambiguity that comes with shaping a team and a market presence, not just operating inside one already settled

Where you'll work
We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Our Values

Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)

Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund

Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + bank holidays + RTT days, Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

Compensation: €63K – €78K

• Salary range €63K – €78K

description:
Job title: Product Manager

Location: Paris — Hybrid - 3 days in office

Team: Product Management - Customer Care Value Stream

Reporting to: Head of Product

This role is based in France and requires the successful candidate to be based in or willing to relocate to France.

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship

Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential for this position. Please submit your profile in English.

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners.

By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

Where in the world of Kaluza will I be working

You will be specifically working with the team building out our contact centre solution and the Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE). Our Customer Care platform powers AI-driven, cost-efficient service operations for global energy retailers, enabling personalised customer experiences across contact centres, digital channels, and case management.

This role is mission-critical to Kaluza’s vision. You will lead the product strategy, delivery, and client outcomes for Kaluza’s Customer Care solutions for ENGIE France, while contributing to the evolution of our Global Core capabilities.

What will I be doing?

As the Customer Care Product Manager, you are accountable for the outcomes delivered by your product. You will ensure design and engineering teams have absolute clarity on priorities and scope to drive meaningful results for end users and commercial value.

You will:

Lead Product Strategy: Own the Customer Care product strategy and roadmap for Kaluza clients in France, balancing Global Core reuse with specific French localisation requirements.

Build High-Value Solutions: Develop our suite of tools for the Contact Centre Solution, including CCaaS (Contact Centre as a Service) and Case Management, to enable efficient, high-value conversations.

Drive AI Innovation: Utilise the latest AI technology to automate and personalise the customer experience and champion agent productivity tools.

Foster Client Partnerships: Act as the senior product counterpart to client stakeholders (such as ENGIE), leading workshops and translating their needs into scalable capabilities.

Execute & Optimise: Lead cross-functional teams (engineering, design, data, and commercial) to ensure efficient delivery, removing blockers and resolving cross-team dependencies.

Deliver Operational Excellence: Define and track key contact centre metrics such as AHT, FCR, CSAT, and NPS to ensure solutions deliver measurable cost-to-serve improvements.

Is this the job for me?

You are the right person for us if you:

Have significant product leadership experience in enterprise SaaS and have worked in agile product organisations.

Possess deep knowledge of contact centre operations and agent workflows.

Have experience working with French enterprise clients and a strong understanding of localisation requirements, including language and regulation.

Are skilled at stakeholder management at the executive level, with the ability to manage trade-offs between speed and long-term value.

Are data-oriented, with an adeptness for using operational metrics to assess product performance and drive continuous improvement.

Have a background in energy retail or utilities (this will set you apart!).

Are excited by AI-driven automation, including voice bots and agent assist technology.

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

Find out more about working at Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn.

You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy here.

  • Drive AI Innovation: Utilise the latest AI technology to automate and personalise the customer experience and champion agent productivity tools.

  • Foster Client Partnerships: Act as the senior product counterpart to client stakeholders (such as ENGIE), leading workshops and translating their needs into scalable capabilities.

  • Execute & Optimise: Lead cross-functional teams (engineering, design, data, and commercial) to ensure efficient delivery, removing blockers and resolving cross-team dependencies.

  • Deliver Operational Excellence: Define and track key contact centre metrics such as AHT, FCR, CSAT, and NPS to ensure solutions deliver measurable cost-to-serve improvements.

Is this the job for me?

You are the right person for us if you:

  • Have significant product leadership experience in enterprise SaaS and have worked in agile product organisations.

  • Possess deep knowledge of contact centre operations and agent workflows.

  • Have experience working with French enterprise clients and a strong understanding of localisation requirements, including language and regulation.

  • Are skilled at stakeholder management at the executive level, with the ability to manage trade-offs between speed and long-term value.

  • Are data-oriented, with an adeptness for using operational metrics to assess product performance and drive continuous improvement.

  • Have a background in energy retail or utilities (this will set you apart!).

  • Are excited by AI-driven automation, including voice bots and agent assist technology.

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together

 

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

title: Legal Engineer Manager, Paris
description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As Harvey scales its pre-sales function across EMEA, we are hiring a Legal Engineer Manager to lead and grow the team in Paris. This role exists to provide senior leadership and strategic direction to a team of Legal Engineers who sit at the heart of Harvey's commercial motion - bringing legal credibility, product expertise, and consultative support to law firm and in-house prospects.

Harvey’s Legal Engineers are skilled lawyers from top-tier law firms who apply their legal experience to ensure that current and prospective customers understand how Harvey’s solutions enhance specific day-to-day workflows, working alongside Harvey’s Account Executives to support all aspects of our sales strategy. Legal Engineers build consultative relationships with law firm partners and associates and in-house attorneys at private equity firms and Fortune 500 companies, becoming trusted advisors on how Harvey’s AI solutions can make them more effective.

Similar to the way Solutions Architects secure the “technical win” in the sales process, Legal Engineers secure the “legal win” by performing in-depth customer discovery and education on Harvey’s solutions through targeted meetings and demos that resonate with the customer’s day-to-day workflows specific to their legal practice area.

Legal Engineers utilize their experience practicing law and their legal mindset to ask thoughtful questions to understand the needs of law firm and in-house attorneys, develop credibility, and then partner with Account Executives to educate them on Harvey’s value via large and small group sessions as well as one-to-one conversations.

What You'll Do

Lead, coach, and develop a team of Legal Engineers, setting clear performance expectations and building a high-trust, high-output team culture

Own the quality and consistency of Harvey's pre-sales legal engineering function, ensuring demos, discovery conversations, and deal support are delivered to the highest standard

Partner closely with Account Executives and GTM leadership to prioritise pipeline, develop deal strategy, and support conversion on complex or strategic opportunities

Engage with lawyers at prospective customers to understand and address their workflow challenges

Collaborate with Product and Marketing to ensure the team's field insights are feeding into positioning, roadmap, and go-to-market strategy

Lead product demonstrations tailored to the context of various law firm practice groups and in-house legal teams, asking questions to validate how Harvey can add value and then showcasing Harvey’s features and benefits relevant to each prospective client’s potential use cases.

Act as the “Voice of the Customer,” using your legal perspective to help the broader sales team to develop and implement more effective strategies and synthesize customer feedback for the product team through a legal lens.

Travel may be required from time to time, including visits to customer office locations and company offices.

What You Have

Qualified lawyer with 7+ PQE, with experience in a law firm or in-house legal environment

Must have prior experience managing a team, with a track record of developing talent and driving performance

Deep familiarity with legal technology and AI tools, with an ability to quickly develop and demonstrate platform expertise

Strong commercial instincts and the ability to engage credibly with senior stakeholders at law firms and in-house legal teams

Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience running training, workshops, or client-facing product sessions

Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a pragmatic, solutions-oriented approach

description:
SolarCare a pour ambition de devenir un acteur français de référence dans la Rénovation et la Maintenance de centrales photovoltaïques en BtoB.

Dans le cadre du développement de son activité, SolarCare cherche à intégrer de nouveaux talents pour travailler à sur les problématiques de maintenace, exploitation, rénovation des actifs photovoltaiques de nos clients.

Tu souhaites vite monter en compétence sur les différentes technologies utilisées sur les centrales PV notamment en toitures ? Tu souhaites traiter une grande diversité de sujets techniques ? Tu souhaites également sur des sujets de gestion d'entreprise (vision 360° d'une entreprise de 25 salariés) ? Alors envoie-nous ton CV !

Vos missions

Directement rattaché-e à la Direction de l'entreprise, tu interviendras principalement sur les aspects techniques de nos interventions de maintenance de centrales PV : support au Responsable Maintenance France dans la gestion des interventions de nos techniciens, la supervision des installations photovoltaïques et l'amélioration continue de nos process.

TACHES RELATIVES AUX PROJETS DE MAINTENANCE PHOTOVOLTAÏQUES (80% du temps)

Travailler sur le suivi de la performance de centrales photovoltaïques en exploitation (logiciel de supervision de référence du marché ENERGYSOFT - S4E)

Travailler sur le process de gestion de nos opérations de maintenance pour assurer les meilleurs standards de qualité et délais

Relire les rapports d'intervention des techniciens et vérifier leur complétude avant envoi aux clients

Savoir respecter en autonomie les délais et les objectifs donnés

Communiquer avec les autres parties prenantes des dossiers, notamment les responsables d'agences, les clients et nos partenaires

TACHES RELATIVES A L'AMELIORATION DES OUTILS INTERNES ET PROCEDURES (20% du temps)

Contribuer à l’amélioration des processus et des outils d’étude de l'entreprise (KIZEO, Microsoft Power BI, Macro sous Excel, etc..)

Assister la Direction sur des sujets relatifs à la gestion de l'entreprise (optimisation des achats, benchmark concurrents, développement commercial, etc..)

Vos compétences

De formation MASTER/INGENIEUR/ BAC +5 en énergies renouvelables ou génie électrique

Connaissance du fonctionnement d'un générateur photovoltaïque afin de pouvoir etre en support téléphonique des techniciens lors de leurs interventions sur le terrain

Maitrise du paramétrage d'un outil de formulaire et rapport en ligne : KIZEO

Être en capacité de travailler en équipe et en toute autonomie,

Sens des responsabilités et autonomie,

Goût du challenge, et envie d'agir sur une grande diversité de sujets au sein de l'entreprise pour en avoir une vision à 360°

Avantages

Travail dans des locaux agréables à Villeurbanne

Travail au sein d'une petite équipe ambitieuse, dans une entreprise en plein développement

Gratification de stage au taux légal + Tickets Restaurants de 12,10€ pris en charge à 60% par l'entreprise

Tu souhaites participer concrètement à la transition écologique et te former sur des sujets coeur d'une industrie en plein développement ? Tu souhaites voir de l'intérieur le développement d'une startup ? Tu souhaites te former aux métiers en pleine expansion du PV ? Envoie-nous ta candidature !

Démarrage souhaité en Janvier / Février et pour 5 mois minimum

title: Architecte CERT / Cyberdéfense
description:
U.NEAT est une société spécialisée en cybersécurité et propose des services d’expertises à travers ses pôles :

Cyber Defense Center : service SOC managé et CSIRT

Expertises : assistance technique SecOps / DevSecOps

Consulting : activités de conseil en SSI / GRC

Vos missions

Au sein d'une Direction Cyberdéfense, vous serez en charge de concevoir et faire évoluer l'architecture des capacités de cyberdéfense (SOC, CTI, CERT, Audit technique, VOC) et accompagner l'ensemble des projets du département, dans un environnement sensible et fortement régulé.

Responsabilités

Définir l'architecture cible de cyberdéfense (SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, NDR, TIP, plateformes VOC, outillage d'audit et forensics)

Garantir l'interopérabilité entre SOC, CTI, CERT, Audit et VOC (enrichissement CTI, automatisation, playbooks)

Accompagner les projets de bout en bout : cadrage, choix de solutions, revues d'architecture, recette, mise en production

Piloter la couverture de détection (MITRE ATT&CK) et l'amélioration continue à partir des incidents, exercices et audits

Assurer la conformité réglementaire des dispositifs : analyses de risques, homologation, préparation des audits

Assurer la veille technologique et menaces, et conseiller la direction sur les investissements

Profil

Bac+5 en cybersécurité ou équivalent ; 8 à 10 ans d'expérience, dont 3 à 5 ans en architecture de sécurité ou cyberdéfense

Expérience dans l'énergie ou la défense appréciée (ou tout environnement très régulé)

CISSP souhaité ; atouts : SABSA, TOGAF, GIAC, ISO 27001 LI/LA, EBIOS RM

Compétences : architecture de sécurité (Zero Trust, segmentation, IAM/PAM), SIEM/SOAR/EDR, MISP/OpenCTI, forensics, gestion des vulnérabilités, cloud, scripting (Python), notions OT/ICS

Qualités : influence et pédagogie, vision transverse, rigueur, discrétion, anglais professionnel

Cadre réglementaire

LPM / OIV, NIS2, RGPD, guides ANSSI, IEC 62443, ISO 27001/27005, EBIOS RM, PDIS / PRIS / PASSI

Avantages

Vous participez au développement d’une entreprise en croissance, spécialiste de la cybersécurité

Un parcours RSE et de développement professionnel personnalisé

Possibilité d'effectuer 50% du temps en télétravail

title: Responsable HSE (H/F) – Data centers / Infrastructures critiques – CDI
description:
L’entreprise
Notre client est un acteur de référence dans les infrastructures numériques et l’hébergement de données. Il exploite plusieurs sites stratégiques en France, au cœur de l’économie digitale. Dans le cadre de son développement, il recrute sa/son Responsable HSE France.

Le contexte
Vous évoluerez dans un environnement technique exigeant, opérant 24h/24 et 7j/7, où la continuité de service est un enjeu majeur : installations électriques haute puissance, groupes électrogènes, stockages de carburant, sécurité incendie et forte présence d’entreprises extérieures sur les sites.

Votre mission
Rattaché(e) à la Direction des opérations, vous définissez, déployez et animez la politique Hygiène, Santé, Sécurité et Environnement sur l’ensemble des sites français.

Vous garantissez la conformité réglementaire, la maîtrise des risques professionnels et environnementaux, et l’amélioration continue de la performance HSE.

Vous êtes un(e) véritable partenaire de la Direction et des équipes opérationnelles pour faire vivre une culture sécurité exigeante et partagée.

Vos responsabilités

Stratégie et pilotage HSE

Définir la politique HSE et ses objectifs à court, moyen et long terme, en cohérence avec la stratégie, la réglementation et les référentiels ISO.

La décliner en standards, procédures et plans d’actions applicables sur tous les sites.

Conseiller la Direction et les managers sur toute décision ayant un impact HSE.

Piloter les indicateurs de performance et assurer le reporting auprès des instances de gouvernance.

Culture sécurité et système de management

Promouvoir une culture de prévention fondée sur l’exemplarité, la remontée des situations dangereuses et l’amélioration continue.

Piloter le système de management HSE et les certifications ISO 45001 et ISO 14001.

Établir le programme d’audits internes et assurer le traitement des non-conformités.

Définir les besoins de formation avec les managers et les RH, et animer accueils sécurité, causeries, campagnes de prévention et retours d’expérience.

Conformité réglementaire

Assurer la veille réglementaire en santé-sécurité au travail et en environnement.

Évaluer la conformité des sites et piloter les plans de mise en conformité (Code du travail, ICPE, ISO, standards internes).

Préparer et accompagner les inspections et audits, et être l’interlocuteur des organismes de contrôle et des autorités (DREAL, inspection du travail, SDIS…).

Prévention des risques

Évaluer les risques professionnels et piloter la mise à jour du DUERP.

Superviser les plans de prévention, protocoles de sécurité, permis de travail et analyses de risques.

Garantir la maîtrise des activités à risque : travaux électriques, en hauteur, en espaces confinés, par point chaud, manutentions, produits chimiques.

Gestion des événements HSE

Organiser la déclaration et l’analyse des accidents, presqu’accidents et situations dangereuses.

Piloter les analyses de causes profondes et suivre l’efficacité des actions correctives

Contribuer aux plans d’urgence, à la gestion de crise et aux exercices de sécurité.

Environnement

Identifier et évaluer les aspects et impacts environnementaux des activités.

Piloter la gestion des déchets et des produits chimiques, de l’eau et de l’énergie, ainsi que la prévention des pollutions.

Définir les objectifs de réduction de l’empreinte environnementale avec les équipes techniques et RSE.

Maîtrise HSE des entreprises extérieures

Définir les exigences HSE applicables aux prestataires et sous-traitants.

Vérifier habilitations et documents avant intervention, réaliser inspections terrain et audits.

Suivre la clôture des écarts et contribuer à l’évaluation de la performance HSE des fournisseurs.

Votre profil

Indispensable

Au moins 10 ans d’expérience en HSE, dont 5 ans minimum en tant que Responsable HSE en entreprise (poste opérationnel, hors conseil exclusif)

Expérience d’un périmètre multisites et de la définition d’une politique HSE, pas uniquement de son déploiement

Maîtrise de la réglementation ICPE et expérience concrète du volet environnement

Pilotage de certifications ISO 45001 et ISO 14001

Solide expérience de la gestion des entreprises extérieures et des travaux à risque

Formation Bac+5 en HSE, QHSE, prévention des risques ou environnement

Atouts appréciés

Expérience en data center, énergie, télécoms, nucléaire ou autres infrastructures critiques

Expérience en management d’équipe

Anglais professionnel

Résultats mesurables en réduction de l’accidentologie

Vos qualités
Leadership, pédagogie et sens du terrain : vous savez convaincre aussi bien la Direction que les équipes opérationnelles et les prestataires.

title: Implementation Manager - Bilingual
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Benchling is building a world-class Professional Services team to drive implementations for our rapidly expanding customer base. Implementation Managers work with our customers, from small Biotech startups to the largest BioPharmas in the world to develop a deep understanding of their R&D Processes, and roll out solutions that transform how their research teams work together.

To be successful in this role, you will leverage your scientific background, project management skills, and product expertise to drive successful implementations of the Benchling platform. You will work hand in hand with the research scientists at our customers, and teams throughout Benchling to implement our solutions, and ensure our customers are successful. Implementation Managers lead all aspects of customer rollouts from requirements analysis and solution design, to configurations, testing, training, and onboarding users onto the system. Fluent or native French or German, plus experience supporting French- or German-speaking customers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Manage initial rollouts for new Benchling customers as well as expansion projects with new teams or for new processes at existing customers

Own implementation success from project kickoff to go-live, leveraging strong project management skills, scientific expertise, and deep product knowledge.

Build and execute detailed project plans, own project activities, work with other team members to execute on project deliverables to ensure on time, on budget, high quality deployments.

Understand customers' scientific workflows and determine how Benchling can best be leveraged to meet their key business needs.

Lead requirements and design workshops, perform data modeling & application configuration, develop test plans and guide UAT execution, train and onboard users.

Act as a trusted advisor for customers, guiding them through the implementation ensuring they leverage and apply Benchling Best Practices.

Understand and document customer pain points, advocate for them internally to influence product changes.

Identify and work with sales on opportunities for account expansion post go-live.

QUALIFICATIONS

MS or Ph.D. in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Immunology, Bioinformatics, Biological Engineering or a related field.

At least 2 years of experience in a lab or R&D setting, ideally in antibody discovery or strain engineering or process development. You must be able to empathize with scientists and quickly understand complicated scientific concepts.

Software Implementation experience, preferably with a SaaS software company.

Strong communication skills. You must be able to quickly and effectively connect with a range of stakeholders, including scientists, IT project leads, and executives.

Self-starter with the ability to be successful in a startup environment.

Curious, creative, and tenacious. You should be excited to collaborate with customers and other Benchling teammates as a thought partner.

Ability to travel up to 25% based on customer and project needs.

Fluent or native proficiency in French or German

Experience using Benchling, especially if you’ve been a Benchling administrator, is preferred but not required.

HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

#LI-Hybrid

#BI-Hybrid

Benchling welcomes everyone.

We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences.

We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.
