title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Imagine building intelligent systems that don’t just work in perfect lab conditions, but

perform reliably in the real world, where uncertainty is the norm and failure is not an

option. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will push the limits of computer vision by

designing, training, and validating neural networks that operate in complex, safety-critical

environments. Your work will directly influence how autonomous systems perceive and

interact with the world, combining deep learning, simulation, and rigorous verification into

one seamless pipeline.

At Destinus, we are shaping the future of defense through high-speed, autonomous flight

technologies. We develop next-generation unmanned aerial systems that deliver greater

speed, precision, and efficiency, supporting governments and defense organizations in

mission-critical operations worldwide. Daedalean AG, the AI and autonomy hub of the

Destinus Group, plays a key role in this vision. Developing safety-critical AI systems at the

intersection of advanced research and real-world aviation. Enabling machines to perceive,

understand, and make decisions in real time. Together, we combine aerospace

engineering and artificial intelligence to build the next generation of autonomous flight

systems, driving innovation where it matters most.

What You´ll Do

• Design, train, and optimize deep learning models for computer vision tasks in highly

dynamic and safety-critical environments

• Manage the development lifecycle of ML capabilities, from early-stage data

collection to the operational deployments of mature systems

• Develop robust evaluation pipelines to ensure models meet strict reliability and

safety requirements

• Leverage transfer learning and simulation to scale training and testing beyond realworld data limitations

• Collaborate closely with software, systems, and flight teams to integrate ML models

into real-world applications

• Continuously push model performance across edge cases, environmental

variability, and operational constraints

Requirements

Strong programming skills in C++ or Rust

• At least 5 years of hands-on experience in deep learning for computer vision

• Experience across the full ML stack, including model design, distributed training

frameworks, evaluation pipelines and resource-constrained inference platforms

• Experience with simulation environments or synthetic data generation is a strong

plus

• Experience with working with integrated sensors, including infrared cameras

• Master’s degree or PhD in computer science, physics, mathematics, or a related

technical field- or equal proven practical experience

title: Industrialization Engineer
description:
About the Role

The Destinus Industralization team is seeking an Industralization Engineer to help brining products from R&D to full scale production. The role requires expertise in balancing process and product optimization throughout the development cycle of the project as well as sound and realistic assessment where the improvements will bring the most impact in the given timeline.

The ideal candidate takes ownership of their work, leads by example and understands that approach to industrialization should be agile to fit best the fast-paced projects.

What You'll Do

• Enable R&D team to implement DFX from the beginning of the project.

• Review and optimise existing and new processes of assembly and manufacturing to assure repeatable quality of products.

• Find and audit suitable suppliers and manufacturers.

• Set up suppliers and manufacturers as partners.

• Establish and maintain communication with suppliers to enable manufacturing R&D, Batch Zero and Full Scale Production quantities.

• Be a link between R&D, production and qualification department, with thorough understanding how design choices impact assembly line.

• Perform material flow and value chain analysis

• Design assembly lines which comply to safety and quality requirements to assure repeatable processes and quality of the final product.

• Assemble prototypes and assure the product maturity necessary to pass review gates

• Write, maintain, and follow SOPs for assembly, integration, and testing operations, ensuring safety and repeatability at every step.

• Support troubleshooting and corrective actions in collaboration with engineering and QA teams.

• Contribute to continuous improvement of assembly workflows while maintaining compliance with safety and quality requirements.

Requirements

What You'll Need

• Several years of industrialization experience with maintaining full R&D to Production workflow

• Excellent hands-on engineering

• Experience with various manufacturing methods; milling, turning, plastic injection moulding, casting, 3D printing.

• Experience or willingness to work with energetic, pyrotechnic, or otherwise hazardous materials; knowledge of relevant safety requirements is a strong advantage.

• Experience with quality control, functional testing, and documentation standards in a production or engineering environment.

• Ability to write and execute SOPs in a detail-driven, safety-critical environment.

• High attention to detail and a disciplined, methodical approach to assembly and testing.

• Willingness to travel when setting up a suppliers and manufacturers

• Fluency in English and German required; any other language is a plus.

title: ML Hydrologist, Flood Forecasting
description:
About the Role
Global ML flood models now outperform traditional approaches on large rivers, but they still break down in the small, fast catchments where flash floods happen. Riverkin, a VC-backed ETH Zürich Spin-off, is closing that gap. We start from hydrological models trained across thousands of catchments worldwide and make them accurate locally, using a sensor network we deploy ourselves in exactly the places public datasets don't reach.

We are looking for an ML hydrologist to own that work. You will report to the CTO and work directly with our other hydrologist, who covers rainfall radar and short-term nowcasting.

Why this is interesting

Data nobody else has: Our own field-deployed sensors give you live streamflow observations in small, previously ungauged catchments.

An open problem: Whether large-sample models can be made reliable at flash-flood scale is unsolved, and you would be working on it with real data and real users.

Built to protect lives and critical infrastructure: Your models will power early flood warning systems safeguarding hydropower plants and giving first responders more time to protect communities

Publishing and open source: We encourage publishing results and contributing to open tools such as NeuralHydrology and Caravan.

Compute: GPU resources are available for training and experimentation.

What You'll Do

Bring global flood models to the local scale

Take state-of-the-art hydrological ML models (LSTMs, Transformers) trained on large-sample datasets and adapt them to the catchments our customers care about.

Use our own sensor data alongside public gauge, reanalysis and radar data to fine-tune and validate those models locally.

Tackle prediction in ungauged and data-scarce basins through transfer learning and regionalisation.

Own hydrological modelling end to end: set the technical direction, decide when to adapt pre-trained models or train our own, and lead the work from experimentation through validation to production.

Work as one modelling team

Make practical trade-offs between forecast accuracy, model complexity and development effort to build a reliable product that meets customer needs.

Work side by side with our hydrologist specialising in rainfall radar and nowcasting to directly integrate rainfall nowcasts into your flood models.

Work with software engineers to put models into production and monitor their performance.

Identify and test advances in ML flood forecasting, turning promising research into more accurate and reliable forecasts for our customers.

Stay close to the real world

We believe the best modellers understand the world behind their models. We encourage you to join field deployments and customer conversations to build that understanding firsthand.

You are an opinionated contributor to key technical decisions.

Who You Are

You’ve built and validated hydrological ML models across many catchments and have experience taking modelling work into real-world use.

You combine scientific rigour with product judgement: you test assumptions, understand uncertainty and focus on improvements that matter to customers.

You take ownership from an open question to a working solution. You set priorities, make decisions and keep moving without waiting for perfect information.

You care deeply about the quality of your work. You dig into why models fail, follow problems through and stay invested in how your forecasts perform after deployment.

You communicate clearly in writing and in person, can explain your reasoning and trade-offs, and work closely with people across hydrology, software, hardware and field operations.

Technical Requirements

Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning ML streamflow or flood models across many catchments at once (regional, continental or global), for example on CAMELS or Caravan. Experience with single-catchment models alone is not sufficient.

Experience transferring such models to new or data-scarce catchments through fine-tuning, regionalisation, or prediction in ungauged basins.

Strong understanding of rainfall-runoff processes and the limitations of hydrological observations and input data.

Experience validating models across unseen catchments and time periods, including assessing flood-peak magnitude, timing and predictive uncertainty.

Strong Python skills, with experience writing maintainable code for data processing, modelling and reproducible experiments.

Practical depth in deep learning for time series, including developing, training and debugging models in PyTorch or a comparable framework.

MSc or PhD in hydrology, water resources, atmospheric sciences, machine learning, or equivalent.

Nice to Have

Publications or open-source work on large-sample hydrology, transfer learning, or ungauged-basin prediction.

Experience with NeuralHydrology, ERA5 or similar global forcing datasets.

Experience with sub-daily or event-based flood modelling.

Experience processing large hydrometeorological datasets with tools such as xarray and Dask, and formats such as Zarr.

Previous early startup experience.

Role Details

Contract: Permanent, full-time (100% FTE).

Start date: immediately

Reports to: CTO.

Compensation: Commensurate with experience + equity

Growth: a key early hire with the opportunity to shape Riverkin's flood modelling as the team grows.

Location: Four days per week in our Zurich office and one day working from home.

Work authorisation: Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit, is required.

Working language: English. German is not required.

About Riverkin
We are a well-capitalized Swiss startup building real-time sensing and data infrastructure for rivers. Our own field-deployed sensors collect live water-level and sediment data, while our platform turns that data into decision-ready insights for customers. We work directly with the hydropower sector, where predicting flash floods is needed for daily operations. As we prove ourselves in this field, we will move towards the first responders market. We are a small, hands-on team working across hydrology, hardware, field engineering, software and market development.

Beobachten und analysieren steuer- und finanzpolitischer Entwicklungen auf nationaler Ebene

Verfassen von Vernehmlassungen, Publikationen, Medienbeiträgen und Präsentationen

Aufbau und Pflege eines starken Netzwerks zu Mitgliedern, Verbänden und politischen Entscheidungsträgern
Vertretung der Dossiers gegenüber Behörden, Parlament, Medien und Öffentlichkeit
Freude an “campaigning” für Finanz- und Steuerthemen

Universitäts- oder Fachhochschulabschluss, idealerweise mit ökonomischem, juristischem, politikwissenschaftlichem oder vergleichbarem Hintergrund

Freude und starke Motivation Rahmenbedingungen im Sinne der Wirtschaft engagiert mitzugestalten

Analytische Stärke, Eigeninitiative und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Anspruchsgruppen
Persönliche Integrität, hohe Zuverlässigkeit, glaubwürdiger Auftritt
Sehr gute Französisch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Wir bieten

Wir bieten Ihnen eine vielseitige Rolle an der Schnittstelle von Politik und Wirtschaft.
In einem dynamischen Team können Sie eigene Akzente setzen und sich in einem Umfeld weiterentwickeln, das Qualität und Eigeninitiative fördert.
Sie erhalten Einblick in aktuelle Entwicklungen und Zugang zu einem breiten Netzwerk aus Wirtschaft, Politik und Kampagnenarbeit.

title: IT Reliability Engineer
description:
Du möchtest Verantwortung übernehmen, moderne IT-Umgebungen zuverlässig betreiben und den Bereich IT Reliability Engineering aktiv mit aufbauen?

Als IT Reliability Engineer bist du Teil unseres Engineering-Teams und übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Stabilität, Überwachung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung bestehender Kundenumgebungen.

Du sorgst dafür, dass Systeme zuverlässig betrieben werden, technische Risiken frühzeitig erkannt werden und Monitoring-, Backup-, Update- sowie Lifecycle-Prozesse nachhaltig funktionieren. Dabei leistest du einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Servicequalität und zur langfristigen Stabilität unserer Kundenumgebungen.

Die Themen Monitoring, Betriebsstabilität, Lifecycle-Management und technische Qualitätsstandards haben bei MDigital bereits heute einen hohen Stellenwert und werden aktiv durch unser Engineering-Team gelebt. Aufgrund des Unternehmenswachstums und der zunehmenden Bedeutung dieser Aufgaben investieren wir nun gezielt in eine spezialisierte Rolle innerhalb des Engineering-Teams.

Da diese Position neu geschaffen wird, hast du die Möglichkeit, die zukünftige Ausgestaltung der Rolle aktiv mitzuprägen. Mit dem weiteren Wachstum des Unternehmens besteht zudem die Perspektive, den Bereich IT Reliability Engineering langfristig weiter auszubauen und zusätzliche Mitarbeitende in diesem Umfeld zu etablieren.

Aufgaben

Monitoring & Infrastruktur

Überwachung sämtlicher Kundensysteme über unsere Monitoring-Plattformen
Analyse, Priorisierung und Nachverfolgung von Warnmeldungen
Sicherstellung der vollständigen Integration produktiver Systeme ins Monitoring
Überwachung von Verfügbarkeit, Diensten, Hardware- und Storage-Zuständen
Frühzeitige Erkennung technischer und sicherheitsrelevanter Risiken
Eskalation kritischer Ereignisse
Kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Monitoring-Prozesse
Identifikation und Umsetzung von Verbesserungen zur Erhöhung der Betriebsstabilität
Förderung von Standardisierung und Automatisierung im täglichen Betrieb
Analyse wiederkehrender Incidents und Erarbeitung nachhaltiger Lösungen

Backup & Recovery

Sicherstellung funktionierender Backup- und Recovery-Prozesse
Nachverfolgung fehlerhafter Sicherungen
Integration neuer Systeme in bestehende Backup-Konzepte
Planung, Durchführung und Dokumentation regelmässiger Restore-Tests

Client-, Server- & Update-Management

Überwachung des Update- und Sicherheitsstatus von Clients und Servern
Sicherstellung aktueller Sicherheits- und Systemstände
Standardisierung und Automatisierung von Update-Prozessen
Verwaltung von Serversystemen über Microsoft Azure Arc
Verwaltung von Clients über Microsoft Intune und bestehende Endpoint-Management-Lösungen
Förderung einer möglichst zentralisierten und automatisierten Systemverwaltung

Evergreen & Lifecycle Management

Überwachung von EOL- und EOS-Systemen
Kontrolle von Firmware-, Software- und Security-Ständen
Identifikation technischer und sicherheitsrelevanter Altlasten
Erarbeitung von Handlungsempfehlungen für Engineering und Management
Unterstützung von Standardisierungsinitiativen

Lizenz-, Zertifikats- & Vertragsüberwachung

Überwachung von SSL-Zertifikaten und Laufzeiten
Kontrolle von Softwarelizenzen und Wartungsverträgen
Frühzeitige Meldung bevorstehender Verlängerungen
Vermeidung betrieblicher Risiken durch ablaufende Lizenzen oder Zertifikate
Nachvollziehbare Dokumentation relevanter Informationen

Dokumentation & Betriebsqualität

Pflege und Weiterentwicklung technischer Kundendokumentationen
Erstellung und Aktualisierung von Betriebsanleitungen
Dokumentation neuer Systeme und Änderungen
Sicherstellung eines nachvollziehbaren und professionellen Betriebsstandards
Unterstützung bei der Kommunikation kritischer technischer Ereignisse

Pikettdienst und Team-Integration

Als Teil unseres Engineering-Teams beteiligst du dich am rotierenden Pikettdienst und hilfst mit, den stabilen Betrieb unserer Kundenumgebungen auch ausserhalb der regulären Arbeitszeiten sicherzustellen. Die Teilnahme am Pikettdienst wird entsprechend geplant und vergütet.

Bei Bedarf unterstützt du zusätzlich das Engineering-Team bei Rollouts, technischen Umsetzungen oder klar definierten Projektaufgaben was zusätzliche Abwechslung mit sich bringt. Der Schwerpunkt bleibt jedoch bewusst auf der Sicherstellung eines professionellen Betriebs unserer Kundenumgebungen ausgerichtet.

Qualifikation

Das zeichnet Dich aus

Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und möchtest aktiv etwas aufbauen und mitgestalten.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und nachhaltig.
Du erkennst Risiken frühzeitig und kommunizierst diese verständlich.
Du hast Freude daran, Systeme stabil und sicher zu betreiben.
Du interessierst dich für Monitoring, Automatisierung und Prozessverbesserungen.
Du schätzt klare Standards und professionelle Betriebsprozesse.
Du arbeitest gerne selbstständig und denkst unternehmerisch.

Fachliche Qualifikationen

Erfahrung im Bereich System Engineering, IT-Betrieb, Managed Services, Monitoring oder Infrastruktur
Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft 365, Microsoft Azure, Windows Server und Netzwerktechnologien
Grundlegendes Verständnis von IT-Security und Cyber-Risiken
Erfahrung mit Monitoring-Lösungen von Vorteil
Kenntnisse im Bereich Backup- und Recovery-Lösungen
Erfahrung mit Microsoft Intune oder vergleichbaren Endpoint-Management-Lösungen
Kenntnisse von Microsoft Azure Arc von Vorteil
Strukturierte, selbstständige und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise
Freude an Standardisierung, Dokumentation und Automatisierung
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse
Führerausweis Kategorie B

Zertifizierungen

Folgende Zertifizierungen sind vorhanden oder deren Erreichung wird gemeinsam vereinbart. Die Zertifizierungskosten werden durch uns übernommen.

Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104)

Von Vorteil

Sophos Central Endpoint and Server Protection
Veeam Certified Engineer (VMCE)
Weitere Microsoft-, Sophos- oder Security-Zertifizierungen

Benefits

Aufbau eines neuen Fachbereichs

Du übernimmst nicht einfach eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltest den Bereich IT Reliability Engineering bei MDigital aktiv mit. Deine Ideen, Erfahrungen und Verbesserungen fliessen direkt in die Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen, Standards und Arbeitsweisen ein.

Hohe Eigenverantwortung

Du erhältst ein hohes Mass an Vertrauen, Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum und übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle für die Stabilität und Qualität unserer Kundenumgebungen.

Moderne Technologien

Arbeite mit Microsoft Azure, Azure Arc, Microsoft Intune, Site24x7, Sophos, Veeam und weiteren modernen Plattformen.

Weiterbildung & Zertifizierungen

Wir fördern deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung durch Schulungen, Zertifizierungen und praxisnahe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.

Entwicklungsperspektiven

Mit dem Wachstum des Unternehmens besteht die Möglichkeit, den Bereich IT Reliability Engineering weiter auszubauen und künftig zusätzliche Mitarbeitende fachlich zu begleiten oder ein eigenes Team mit aufzubauen.

Firmenfahrzeug

Für Kundentermine und Projekteinsätze stehen Dir Firmenfahrzeuge zur geschäftlichen Nutzung zur Verfügung. Du arbeitest dort, wo Resultate entstehen – im direkten Austausch mit den Kunden.

Weiterentwicklung garantiert

Wir investieren gezielt in Dich. Du arbeitest mit modernen Technologien wie Azure, Intune, Veeam oder Sophos und wirst aktiv in deiner Entwicklung unterstützt – inkl. Zeitbudget für Zertifizierungen und Trainings.

Professionelles Arbeitsumfeld

Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, klare Abläufe und nachvollziehbare Verantwortung. Home-Office ist möglich, wird aber als Mittel zum Ergebnis verstanden – Verantwortung hat Priorität.

Starke Rahmenbedingungen

40-Stunden-Woche, 30 Tage Ferien, pauschale Mobile-Spesen und moderne Arbeitsmittel gehören bei uns dazu.

Einsatzort

Diese Position richtet sich an Bewerberinnen und Bewerber mit Wohnsitz in der Schweiz oder im angrenzenden Ausland (Grenzregionen Deutschland, Österreich, Frankreich). Die Rolle beinhaltet regelmässige Kundenbesuche, die Teilnahme am Pikettdienst sowie eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Engineering-Team.

title: Azure Engineer
description:
Du willst nicht einfach ein paar Ressourcen in Azure anklicken. Du willst echte Kundenumgebungen modernisieren, Migrationen umsetzen und Verantwortung übernehmen.

Dann könnte das hier zu Dir passen.

Wir suchen einen Azure Engineer, der Kunden aktiv von klassischen OnPrem-Umgebungen in die Microsoft Cloud begleitet. Kein Konzern. Keine endlosen Hierarchien. Sondern echte Projekte, direkte Verantwortung und die Möglichkeit, unsere Microsoft Cloud Services aktiv mitzugestalten und weiter aufzubauen.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

Migration von Windows Server Workloads nach Microsoft Azure
Planung und Umsetzung von Azure Infrastruktur-Projekten

Technische Beratung unserer Kunden im Bereich Microsoft Cloud

Qualifikation

Das bringst Du mit

Abgeschlossene Ausbildung in der Informatik (EFZ oder vergleichbar) oder ausweisbare Qualifikation
Sehr gute Kenntnisse und Erfahrung im Betrieb von Server-Workloads und Services in Microsoft Azure

title: Senior Solutions Engineer | Switzerland | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity 

The Solutions Engineering team are the customer facing product experts. The team enables Grafana Labs worldwide growth by educating potential and existing customers to ensure that they are happy and successful. We share our technical and product expertise with customers through demos, hands on enablement, presentations, technical evaluations and ongoing interaction. We partner closely with our Sales team to help qualify and close opportunities. The Solutions Engineering team is one of the primary routes of communication from our customers to the Product Management and Engineering teams.

A Solutions Engineer is able to really listen to a prospect or customer, understand their requirements, ask the right questions to extract as much information as required and translate all that into a solution with Grafana Labs technology. They are the bridge between the highly technical engineering folks here at Grafana Labs, our customers and our Sales team.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Partnering with our Sales team to articulate the overall Grafana value proposition, vision and strategy to customers
  • Owning the technical engagement with customers and help close complex opportunities through advanced competitive knowledge, technical skill and credibility
  • Delivering product and technical presentations to potential and existing customers
  • Effectively communicate with customers and internal teams to provide feedback on our products and the competitive landscape
  • Driving product conversations based on need and problems with customers
  • Working with the team to enhance documentation, write blog posts, record videos, contribute knowledge base articles and create other public or private enablement material

What Makes you a Great Fit:

  • 5+ years of technical pre-sales experience
  • Be open to various and complex assignments, this will require strong judgment, collaboration, and leadership
  • You will need first class written and oral communication skills to collaborate with our remote-first internal teams and with our worldwide customers. You will need to be able to skillfully articulate our value proposition and the technical advantages of our products
  • You love solving technical challenges and thrive on bringing creative solutions to our customers
  • You should have a technical mindset and a desire to grow technically. 
  • Must be located in Switzerland  

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience with Open Source technologies, or in the Metrics/Monitoring space is an advantage 
  • Experience with sales methodologies like MEDD(P)ICC is a plus

Compensation & Rewards 

In Switzerland, the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is CHF 206,000 - CHF 246,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

title: Senior AI Engineer - VLA Foundation Model
description:
RIVR, part of Amazon is a robotics company pioneering Physical AI through real-world doorstep delivery. Founded in 2024 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, RIVR developed wheeled-legged robots designed to operate in complex, unstructured environments such as stairs, gates, doors, and uneven urban terrain. We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn from rich operational data at scale.

Following our acquisition by Amazon in March 2026, we are continuing this mission with greater reach and speed. By combining custom robot hardware, onboard autonomy, and cloud-based coordination, RIVR, part of Amazon is building the next generation of safe, reliable autonomous robots for last-mile delivery

Job Description

Our fleet of delivery robots operates globally today, generating vast amounts of robotic real-world data. By utilizing state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, large-scale generalist models (like Transformers), generative AI, and similar methods, we can leverage this pool of data to significantly enhance its autonomy, navigation, and manipulation skills. In this role, you will develop multi-modal models that enable robots to autonomously generate actions from demonstrations, real-time sensor data, and natural language commands. We are seeking an expert in VLA models, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques with a deep knowledge of supervised, and self-supervised learning algorithms. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI we invite you to join us in shaping the future of intelligent robotics.

What you’ll be doing

Develop and implement cutting-edge Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, generalist robot transformers, and imitation learning algorithms (e.g., diffusion policies) to enable robots to autonomously execute complex tasks.
Design, test, and refine your algorithms to meet the demands of complex real-world autonomy and navigation tasks, with a focus on spatial reasoning and generalization.
Streamline the data collection and training workflow to efficiently expand model capabilities with new tasks and data sources.
Collaborate with the reinforcement learning team to innovate methods that leverage both simulated and real-world data.
Optimize and distill networks for real-time deployment on the edge (e.g. Nvidia Jetson Thor).
Build, lead and mentor an exceptional team of software engineers.
Provide expert guidance to product managers and executives for strategic decision-making.
Create and maintain documentation, guidelines, and best practices to streamline knowledge sharing.
What you must have

Master’s degree or higher in a relevant field such as Engineering, Robotics, or Machine Learning.
A minimum of three years of industry or research experience, with PhD experience applicable.
Strong deep learning fundamentals including supervised learning, self-supervised learning, Transformer-based architectures, policy optimization algorithms, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques (including Diffusion Models).
Proven experience in developing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models or large-scale generalist robot models (e.g., RT-2, Octo, etc.).
Strong background in robotics including autonomy, navigation.
Experience with deploying artificial neural networks on hardware platforms.
Ability to prototype algorithms and train deep neural networks in Python (Pytorch)
Get some bonus points

PhD degree in Robotics, Engineering, Computer Science, Machine Learning or a similar discipline, or an equivalent amount of research experience.
Publications at top-tier conferences.
Experience in managing a software team.
Ability to write production-level code in modern C++ RIVR, part of Amazon is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that values every perspective. If you’re passionate about driving innovation in robotics and creating meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply and bring your unique self to our team.

We believe the best work is done when collaborating and therefore require in-person presence in our office locations.

title: Senior Airspace Engineer
description:
About Electra

Air travel is about to become something more: more direct, more accessible, and more connected to the places where people live, work and want to be. Every day in the U.S., people make 35 million trips of 50–500 miles, stuck in traffic or routed through crowded hubs. Chances are, you've been one of them. At Electra, we're changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology opens up thousands of new places to fly, beyond conventional runways, congested airports and long drives. We're backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Safran. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we're moving toward first test flights in 2027.

Getting a new kind of aircraft airborne takes more than ambition. It takes our kind of bold: people who think big while working in the real world. Who move ideas into action and collaborate without silos. Who put people first and make room at the table for everyone. Who challenge one another without diminishing one another.

Sound like you? Then look beyond what you thought were your own limits, and help us take flight beyond runways.

The Role

Electra.aero is seeking an experienced Senior Airspace Engineer to develop the methods, operational concepts, procedures, airspace solutions, and policies needed to safely integrate Ultra Short operations into the national airspace system, including at major airports and novel, distributed access points.

The engineer will shape flight demonstrations, tabletop exercises, simulations, and data collection to inform Ultra Short policy, guidance, and standards development in the US and Europe. Collaboration with the FAA, NATCA, and industry standards development organizations is central to the role.

This role requires a deep understanding of how aircraft performance, flight operations, airspace design, VFR/IFR procedures, PBN, RNAV/RNP operations, obstacle evaluation, navigation systems, FAA/EASA regulations, and real-world operational constraints intersect. The successful candidate will translate new aircraft capabilities and operational concepts into safe, certifiable, and operationally useful flight-path infrastructure.

The ideal candidate understands airspace design and air traffic management concepts, tools, and workflows across congested terminal and en route airspace, and has led or contributed to research translating novel aircraft capabilities into operational procedures. They are comfortable working directly with the FAA, international civil aviation authorities, air navigation service providers, airport authorities, and local stakeholders to advance integration projects. Firsthand experience in procedure design, airspace design, or air traffic control is valuable; working familiarity with the FAA’s 8260-series Orders is expected.

The engineer will collaborate with Electra and FAA teams through Electra’s Cooperative Research and Development Agreement (CRADA) with the FAA Tech Center, the FAA eIPP program, the Virginia Smart Airspace Program, and the International Test Arena in Norway, as well as through company-led testing and procedure development.

What You’ll Do

  • Translate EL9 performance characteristics into Ultra Short operational capabilities, including ground footprint, obstacle clearance, and maneuvering.
  • Collaborate with aircraft performance engineers to model EL9 capabilities under normal, degraded, and contingency conditions, incorporating system safety analysis to define feasible Ultra Short procedures.
  • Develop candidate procedures for novel urban access points and existing airports, taking into account EL2/EL9 Ultra Short performance, instrument procedure design criteria, airport traffic flows, and the obstacle environment.
  • Review FAA, EASA, ICAO, and national standards—including fixed-wing, heliport, and vertiport frameworks, FAA 8260-series Orders, and international equivalents—to identify regulatory and policy gaps affecting proposed procedures.
  • Evaluate candidate procedures with Electra’s product team, the FAA, airport operations teams, and local air traffic control to prepare for flight demonstrations, tabletop exercises, simulations, and future policy and standards development.
  • Define learning objectives and data collection requirements for flight demonstrations and simulations to validate operational concepts.
  • Synthesize flight test results, lessons learned, and operational insights to inform regulatory workstreams developing Ultra Short policy and standards.
  • Support Electra’s commercial and infrastructure partnerships teams in assessing the feasibility of candidate access points in urban settings and at airports.
  • Develop thought leadership materials that clearly explain novel Ultra Short operational concepts to regulators, local stakeholders, and airport authorities.
  • Represent Electra in FAA, EASA, and ICAO working groups and industry standards development organizations to help shape standards, guidance, and policy for Ultra Short airspace integration and operations.

What you Bring

  • Master’s degree or PhD in aerospace engineering, aviation management, airport planning, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in airspace management research, policy and regulatory development, airspace or procedure design, or a related domain.
  • Strong working knowledge of FAA and/or EASA regulatory frameworks, including the AC 150 series, Part 135, Part 23, TERPS/PANS-OPS, 8260-series Orders, and relevant airport design standards.
  • Experience working with regulators, air navigation service providers, airport operators, and industry partners.
  • Strong technical writing and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment with evolving requirements and limited precedent.

Bonus Points

  • Experience leading or contributing to airspace integration research, including FAA, NASA, or MITRE airspace modernization initiatives.
  • Experience as an air traffic controller or with a non-FAA service provider specializing in instrument procedure design and development.
  • Private or commercial pilot experience.

 

What We Offer

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance; STD, LTD, and life insurance
  • Generous PTO, sick leave, and company holidays
  • Paid winter break
  • 401(k) with immediate vesting
  • Free catered lunches, coffee, snacks, and drinks at our Manassas headquarters
  • Free on-site parking

Electra is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This position may be subject to ITAR requirements.

Aufgaben & Verantwortlichkeiten

Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für definierte Infrastrukturplattformen, Services und Kundenumgebungen und fungierst als kompetente technische Ansprechperson.

Du stellst die Verfügbarkeit, Leistungsfähigkeit und Sicherheit der Datacenter-Systeme und Managed Services sicher und optimierst diese kontinuierlich.

Du identifizierst Potenziale zur Effizienzsteigerung durch Automatisierung, Standardisierung und die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Prozesse.

Du gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung von Infrastruktur-Services aktiv mit – von technischen Konzepten über Service-Vorlagen bis hin zu Self-Service-Lösungen.

Du koordinierst die Bearbeitung komplexer Incidents, Service Requests und Infrastrukturänderungen und bringst dich zudem im 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Support, in Kundenprojekten sowie beim Wissensaustausch ein.

Anforderungen & Qualifikationen

Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium im Bereich Informatik, IT oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Eine weiterführende technische Ausbildung ist von Vorteil.

Du bringst mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Datacenter-Umfeld mit, insbesondere in den Bereichen Windows Server, Virtualisierung und komplexe Unternehmensinfrastrukturen.

Du besitzt fundierte Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Backup & Recovery, Netzwerktechnologien und Infrastruktur-Lösungen. Erfahrung mit Veeam oder Fortinet ist ein Plus.

Du hast Erfahrung im 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Support und verfügst über ein solides Verständnis von IT-Sicherheit, Datenschutz und Systemverfügbarkeit.

Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert, verfügst über ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz und hast Freude an Automatisierung, kontinuierlicher Verbesserung und technischer Verantwortung.

Benefits & Unternehmenskultur

Ein kollegiales und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Eigeninitiative, Wissensaustausch und gemeinsamer Erfolg gefördert werden.

Vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung durch Weiterbildungen, technische Schulungen und neue Herausforderungen.

Flexible Arbeitsmodelle, eine positive Teamkultur und attraktive Zusatzleistungen, die eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance unterstützen.

title: Senior Technical Sales Manager - AI-Driven Software Engineering
description:
About CREATEQ

CREATEQ is a Swiss software engineering company with more than 30 years of experience in delivering custom software solutions and modernizing complex legacy systems. We work with leading international companies across industries such as banking and fintech, insurance, aviation and transportation, telecommunications, and energy.

We design, build, and run high-quality software solutions, combining strong engineering expertise, modern technologies, AI-enabled approaches, and proven delivery practices. Our teams work across Java, .NET, PHP, mobile, and web development, helping clients modernize their technology landscapes, improve their software capabilities, and build solutions that are reliable, scalable, and ready for the future.

We are fully dedicated to long-term partnerships, working as one organization with our customers and taking ownership from the first idea through to reliable execution and smooth operation. With nearshore delivery centers across Europe, we bring together experienced engineering and delivery teams who combine technical excellence, business understanding, and a strong sense of ownership.

People, engineering excellence, and strong client relationships are at the heart of what we do.

The opportunity

We are looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial Senior Technical Sales Manager to drive new business for CREATEQ with full revenue responsibility. In this role, you will win new clients, shape their entry into AI-driven software engineering, and turn it into long-term engineering engagements delivered by our teams.

Many companies still develop software the traditional way, mostly on Java and .NET. They want to benefit from AI-driven development but lack the know-how, processes, and capacity to do so. This is where you come in: you understand the client's starting point, develop the right approach together with them – from assessment and proof of concept to dedicated nearshore teams – and close the deal.

You will work closely with management, Business Development, and our engineering leads, and you will be the face of CREATEQ to CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Engineering in Switzerland [and the DACH region].

What you'll do

Build and close your own pipeline with mid-sized and large companies in Switzerland [and the DACH region].
Assess clients' development processes, technology stacks, and AI maturity, and run workshops with engineering teams, IT leadership, and executive management.
Develop solution concepts and proposals – from assessment and proof of concept to dedicated nearshore engineering teams.
Lead commercial negotiations through to contract signature.
Grow existing client relationships and secure follow-on business.
Work closely with our engineering leads on team set-up, project kick-off, and quality assurance.
Track pipeline, order intake, and revenue against agreed targets and report on progress to management.

What we're looking for

This is a senior role with clear revenue responsibility. We are looking for someone who has successfully sold IT services before, brings a strong network in the Swiss market, and is equally credible in conversations with developers and with executive management.

Requirements

At least 8 years of experience selling IT services, software engineering, or nearshore/offshore capacity, including several years with personal revenue responsibility.
A proven track record in acquiring new clients and closing multi-year service engagements.
A strong network among CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Engineering in the Swiss market.
A technical background (computer science, business informatics, or equivalent practical experience) with a solid understanding of Java and/or .NET environments and modern engineering practices (CI/CD, automated testing, DevOps).
A solid understanding of AI-driven software development (AI coding assistants, agentic development tools) and a realistic view of its benefits and limitations.
An entrepreneurial, closing-oriented mindset and the ability to work independently.
Native/Fluent German and excellent written and spoken English.
Swiss or EU citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit.

Benefits

A key role with direct impact on CREATEQ's growth.
An offering that is high on clients' agendas: AI-driven software engineering, delivered by experienced engineering teams.
A compensation package with a fixed salary and a performance-based component.
Direct collaboration with management and short decision paths.
Freedom to shape the role, bring your ideas, and make a visible impact.
A long-term perspective in an international software engineering company with a strong presence in the European market.

title: Senior HR Manager (m/w/d) 100 Prozent
description:
Du suchst eine vielseitige HR-Rolle, in der Beratung, Mitgestaltung und operative Verantwortung zusammenkommen? Bei uns betreust und begleitest du unsere Netceterianer:innen und Führungskräfte in vielfältigen HR-Themen, bringst deine Ideen ein und gestaltest unsere HR-Prozesse aktiv mit. Dabei schätzt du die persönliche Beratung genauso wie eine professionelle und zuverlässige Umsetzung im operativen HR-Alltag.

Gemeinsam als Team stellen wir sicher, dass unsere Mitarbeiter:innen über das bestmögliche Arbeitsumfeld verfügen. Bei Netcetera teilen wir unser Fachwissen, fördern den Austausch und schätzen unterschiedliche Denkansätze. Wir glauben fest an die kontinuierliche berufliche Weiterentwicklung und bieten dir spannende Möglichkeiten, deine Stärken voll einzubringen und zu wachsen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du betreust eigenständig einen Fachbereich und berätst Führungskräfte und Mitarbeiter:innen kompetent in sämtlichen personalrelevanten Fragestellungen
Als kritische:r Sparringpartner:in unterstützt du Fühungskräfte bei personellen und organisatorischen Themen und begleitest anspruchsvolle arbeitsrechtliche Fälle in der Schweiz und in Liechtenstein
Du steuerst den gesamten Rekrutierungsprozess, von der Stellenausschreibung über die Bewerberauswahl und Interviews bis hin zum Vertragsangebot, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Hiring Managern
Du stellst eine professionelle HR-Administration entlang des gesamten Employee Lifecycles sicher. Dazu gehören insbesondere Arbeitsverträge, Vertragsänderungen, Kündigungen, Arbeitszeugnisse sowie Mutationen und Meldungen an die Sozialversicherungen
Gemeinsam mit einer Teamkollegin verantwortest du die monatliche Lohnverarbeitung in Abacus. Dazu gehören unter anderem Quellensteuer, Sozialversicherungen, Jahresendarbeiten sowie Unterstützung bei internen und externen Audits
Du hinterfragst bestehende Abläufe, bringst Verbesserungsvorschläge ein und entwickelst unsere HR-Prozesse und Standards kontinuierlich weiter

Requirements

Dein Profil

Du verfügst über eine fundierte HR-Ausbildung, beispielsweise als HR-Fachfrau/-mann mit eidg. Fachausweis oder gleichwertige Ausbildung
Du bringst mindestens fünf Jahre HR-Erfahrung mit, davon mehrere Jahre in einer beratenden HR-Funktion sowie praktische Erfahrung in der Lohnverarbeitung, Abacus-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil
Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse im Schweizer Arbeits- und Sozialversicherungsrecht
Du trittst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen sicher und souverän auf, vertrittst deine HR-Perspektive klar und kannst dich gegenüber unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern gut positionieren
Du bringst eine hohe Zahlenaffinität und Genauigkeit mit und hast gleichzeitig Freude daran, operative und administrative HR-Themen selbständig und zuverlässig umzusetzen
Du kommunizierst sehr gut auf Deutsch und Englisch und bereicherst unser kleines, humorvolles und innovatives Team mit deiner offenen und herzlichen Persönlichkeit

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

title: Programmatic Advertising Specialist - BENELUX
description:
Programmatic Advertising Specialist (Dutch Speaking)

Publisher Success | Amsterdam, Netherlands (Onsite) | Full Time | Permanent

About Refinery89

Refinery89 is a Dutch AdTech company headquartered in Madrid, working with premium publishers worldwide to optimize programmatic advertising performance.

Through advanced, data-driven technology, we help publishers maximize advertising revenue, improve monetization efficiency, and gain greater transparency across their advertising operations.

Our international team brings together specialists in programmatic advertising, publisher monetization, technology, and account management to deliver measurable results for our partners.

About the Role

Are you currently working in Programmatic Advertising, Ad Operations, Campaign Management, or Publisher Monetization and looking to take the next step in your career?

We're looking for a Dutch-speaking Programmatic Advertising Specialist to join our Publisher Success team in Amsterdam.

This opportunity is ideal for someone with a solid understanding of digital advertising who wants to move beyond campaign execution and take on a more strategic, publisher-facing role.

You don't need previous Account Management experience. We're particularly interested in candidates who understand the programmatic advertising ecosystem, enjoy analyzing performance, solving technical challenges, and communicating with clients.

You'll work directly with Dutch publishers, helping them optimize their advertising performance, maximize revenue, and develop long-term partnerships with Refinery89.

You'll collaborate closely with our Technical Account Managers, AdTech specialists, Product, and Sales teams to deliver the best possible experience for our publishing partners.

Key Responsibilities

Publisher Relationship Management

Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers in the Netherlands.
Serve as a primary point of contact for publisher inquiries, performance discussions, and ongoing support.
Develop a deep understanding of each publisher's business needs and monetization objectives.
Build trust through proactive communication, responsiveness, and problem-solving.

Programmatic Performance & Revenue Optimization

Monitor and analyze advertising performance, including revenue, eCPM, fill rates, and other relevant programmatic metrics.
Identify opportunities to improve publisher monetization and overall advertising performance.
Translate advertising data into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
Collaborate with technical specialists to implement and evaluate optimization initiatives.

Technical Coordination & Troubleshooting

Help publishers identify and resolve advertising-related issues.
Work closely with internal AdTech and Technical Account Management teams to investigate technical challenges.
Coordinate solutions and ensure publishers receive timely updates.
Develop a strong understanding of Refinery89's advertising technology and monetization solutions.

Strategic Growth & Publisher Success

Identify opportunities to grow existing publisher accounts.
Support publisher performance reviews and strategic discussions.
Share insights about market trends, advertising technologies, and monetization opportunities.
Contribute to long-term publisher satisfaction, retention, and growth.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with Publisher Sales, Technical Account Managers, AdTech, Product, and Finance teams.
Communicate publisher feedback and market insights internally.
Help improve processes, workflows, and the overall publisher experience.

What We're Looking For

Must-Have Qualifications

Native-level Dutch proficiency, with professional working proficiency in English.
1 to 3 years of experience in programmatic advertising, AdTech, digital advertising, campaign management, or publisher operations.
Familiarity with the programmatic advertising ecosystem, including technologies such as Google Ad Manager, SSPs, DSPs, or ad exchanges.
Comfortable working with advertising performance data, reports, and dashboards.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
Proactive, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
Interest in working directly with publishers and developing long-term business relationships.

Nice to Have

Experience with Google Ad Manager or other advertising platforms.
Knowledge of header bidding, Prebid.js, or publisher monetization strategies.
Previous experience working with publishers, media owners, or advertising technology companies.
Experience in campaign optimization, yield management, or programmatic trading.
Previous client-facing or Account Management experience.

Previous Account Management experience is NOT required.

Who Should Apply?

We encourage applications from professionals currently working in roles such as:

Programmatic Advertising Specialist
Programmatic Trader
Ad Operations Specialist
Campaign Manager (Programmatic)
Publisher Operations Specialist
Yield Optimization Specialist
Digital Advertising Specialist
Technical Account Specialist (AdTech)

If you have a technical understanding of digital advertising and want to develop your career in publisher relationship management, we'd love to hear from you.

Why Join Refinery89?

Work at a growing international AdTech company with Dutch roots.
Develop expertise in publisher monetization and programmatic advertising.
Transition into a more strategic, client-facing position while building on your existing technical knowledge.
Collaborate with experienced AdTech professionals across multiple departments.
Gain exposure to premium publishers and advanced advertising technologies.
Build your career in a dynamic and rapidly evolving industry.

Interview Process

Our recruitment process consists of four stages:

Initial Screening: Introductory call with our Talent Acquisition team.
First Interview: Video interview with members of the Publisher Success team.
Second Interview: Interview with the Hiring Manager and/or senior stakeholders.
Final Interview: In-person meeting with the Hiring Manager and key team members (location to be confirmed).

Ready to Take the Next Step?

Whether you're currently managing advertising campaigns, optimizing programmatic performance, or supporting publisher monetization, this could be your opportunity to take on greater responsibility and develop your career in AdTech.

Apply today and join Refinery89's Publisher Success team in Amsterdam.Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Campaign Analyst
description:
Onze missie is helder: beter eten voor meer mensen bereikbaar maken. Als Campaign Analyst in het Customer Retention team speel je hierin een cruciale rol door onze klanten beter vast te houden. Jij zorgt ervoor dat we al onze verhalen, over al onze producten, op de juiste manier aan de juiste klant vertellen. Je bent continu, datagedreven op zoek naar verbetering; zodat we het volgende verhaal nóg beter vertellen.

Wat je gaat doen

Onze retentiestrategie wordt steeds geavanceerder. We sturen niet simpelweg 'een korting' naar alle klanten maar werken met gelaagde acties, inspirerende verhalen en gepersonaliseerde extra’s.

Enerzijds ben jij de analytische drijfkracht achter de executie van onze campagnes. Je bouwt, beheert en verbetert de analytische tooling en dashboards zodat we kunnen blijven leren. Daarmee creëer je begrip van - en grip op - de commerciële impact van campagnes, en alle onderliggende onderdelen (zoals kanaalstrategie, product-samenstelling of klantdoelgroep). Vervolgens vertaal je de verworven inzichten effectief naar succesfactoren, verbeteringstrajecten en/of toekomstige experimenten. Anderzijds werk je inhoudelijk mee. Je bepaalt samen met de Campaign Specialist welk aanbod naar welke klanten gaat, via welk kanaal en met welke verwachting en zet je ook (nieuwe) acties zelf op.

Een aantal van jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de performance van campagnes. Je analyseert de impact, en je gebruikt inzichten om toekomstige campagnes te verbeteren, zodat we kunnen blijven innoveren in onze retentiestrategie.

Je werkt actief mee met het team: je levert niet alleen de inzichten, maar bent ook zelf verantwoordelijk voor de implementatie van campagnes.

Je bepaalt en draait de experimentagenda: welke hypotheses testen we over aanbod, doelgroep en kanaal, en wat leren we ervan?

Je bouwt, onderhoudt en verbetert zelf de datamodellen (SQL/dbt) en dashboards (Data Studio) waarop het team stuurt.

Dit ben jij

Je hebt een afgeronde WO of HBO-opleiding op zak.

Je hebt 2-5 jaar ervaring met marketing (intelligence) en data/business analytics.

Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands.

Je bent analytisch sterk en je werkt datagedreven en gestructureerd. Je kunt vloeiend SQL, hebt ervaring met het maken van dashboards en datamodellen en je gebruikt graag AI-tools om je werk efficiënter te maken. Ervaring met dbt is een pré.

Je hebt ervaring met A/B-tests, holdout-tests en hypothese gedreven werken.

Je hebt commercieel gevoel: je denkt net zo graag mee over het aanbod als over de cijfers erachter.

Je bent een sterke sparringpartner: je daagt collega’s uit met data en laat je zelf ook uitdagen.

Je bent kritisch, hands-on en niet bang om de status quo uit te dagen.

Wat wij bieden

Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem.

27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden.

Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen.

Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp.

Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL.

Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University.

Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven.

Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor.

Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen.

En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten.

Onze selectieprocedure

Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter.

Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
At Deeploy, we help organisations roll out AI they can trust. Banks, insurers and pharma companies have to show they control their AI use, and most don’t yet have the tooling to do so. title: Senior Customer Success Manager - Dutch-speaking
description:
About the Role 🎯

As a Senior Customer Success Manager at DataSnipper, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring our customers achieve their goals using our innovative, AI-powered solutions. You will own the customer journey, from onboarding to driving long-term value and retention, fostering strong relationships built on trust and collaboration. You’ll help customers unlock their potential value while contributing to the growth and success of our business.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with professionals who are the backbone of global capital markets, deliver exceptional service, and build a thriving community for our customers. If you’re passionate about customer success and ready to own the moment, we’d love to hear from you!

About DataSnipper

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers.

Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

For our Customer Success teams, this is where things get exciting.

Alwin has just launched, demand is growing, and we're expanding into new markets and segments. With a product customers already rely on, there's a huge opportunity to make your mark.

What You Will Do

Act as a Trusted Advisor: Serve as a strategic partner to key stakeholders including Audit Partners and Managers, Controllers, Finance Directors, and IT decision-makers, guiding them through business transformation enabled by DataSnipper.

Drive Business Transformation: Help customers reimagine their workflows and processes, demonstrating how DataSnipper’s AI-powered capabilities can deliver measurable efficiency gains, cost savings, and quality improvements across audit and finance functions.

Deliver Strategic Consultative Solutions: Provide expert guidance tailored to each customer’s unique business challenges, helping them optimise audit and finance workflows and achieve their strategic objectives using DataSnipper.

Champion Product Adoption and Value Realisation: Conduct comprehensive training sessions, establish regular Business Reviews, and develop success plans that ensure customers adopt DataSnipper features and realise maximum business value.

Build Deep Customer Relationships: Cultivate strong, long-term partnerships built on trust, deep industry understanding, and a genuine commitment to your customers’ success and business outcomes.

Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Solutions Engineering teams, sharing customer insights on workflow challenges, use cases, and technical requirements to drive product innovation.

Advocate for Customer Success: Deeply understand your customers’ audit methodologies, compliance requirements, and business goals, providing feedback internally to ensure DataSnipper addresses real-world needs.

Support Strategic Growth: Identify and drive expansion opportunities within your portfolio, working with Sales to demonstrate ROI, facilitate pilots, and expand adoption across teams and service lines.

Ensure Seamless Technical Implementation & Platform Expertise: Partner with customers on onboarding, including setup, AI configuration, and workflow customisation, while staying current on DataSnipper’s platform, AI capabilities, and automation best practices.

Lead Strategic Engagements: Plan and facilitate in-person and virtual sessions with audit and finance teams to drive adoption, share transformation best practices, and address challenges that could impact retention.

Develop Comprehensive Success Plans: Create strategic roadmaps for each customer, outlining transformation goals, adoption milestones, expansion opportunities, engagement tactics, and success metrics.

Monitor Health and Business Impact: Track and forecast key metrics including user engagement, feature utilisation, business value delivered, expansion opportunities, retention risks, and technical health indicators.

What You Bring

Customer Success Experience: 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or another client-service role in B2B SaaS, with a strong grasp of the customer success motion (onboarding, adoption, renewals, and expansion).

Trusted Advisor Mindset: Passion for being a strategic partner to customers, building deep trust-based relationships, and driving business transformation that delivers exceptional value.

Business Transformation Focus: Proven ability to help customers reimagine processes and workflows, demonstrating how technology can drive measurable business outcomes.

Accountability and Ownership: Strong sense of ownership and the drive to master your craft, take initiative, and ensure no detail is overlooked.

Collaborative Spirit: Thrives in cross-functional teamwork and builds meaningful partnerships with customers and internal stakeholders.

Adaptability and Growth Mindset: Learns quickly and thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where customer needs and priorities evolve.

Excellence in Communication: Professional fluency in English and Dutch is a must

Audit Background: Hands-on experience in external or internal audit, or assurance is nice to have

What we offer

Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact.

Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share in the company’s success and growth.

Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary.

28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance.

Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office.

Daily, freshly prepared lunches to keep you energised.

NS business card for easy commuting to the office.

A structured onboarding programme designed to set you up for success, including dedicated time to learn our product and customers before you hit the ground running.

Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills.

Engage with a vibrant international team spread across seven global offices.

Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together.

Access to Nilo, a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing.

Recruitment Process

Recruiter Screen (30 minutes, online)

Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes, online)

Assessment Interview (1 hour, on-site)

Final Interview (30 minutes, online)

At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience.

Our hiring decisions are merit based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role.

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.

What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper

title: Quantum Processor Development Lead
description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As a Quantum Processor Development Lead you own people management and project leadership for our quantum processor developement. You rapidly grow the team by recruiting key members, while maintaining a high level of care and support for the team members. You report to the VP of Product and work closely with them to shape the team that defines the direction of key technical development at QuantWare. You will work with some of the smartest and most passionate people in the field, helping us build the world's most powerful quantum processors, as fast as possible.

What You’ll Be Doing

Own and drive processor development

Manage development work - particularly chip design and cryogenic measurement.

Run smaller, self-contained projects within your team - supporting both department and company-wide initiatives.

Partner with assigned Program Managers on larger, cross-department programs, particularly regarding technical execution and requirements compliance of QPUs.

Manage uncertainty and technical risk

Identify technical risks and bottlenecks early

Plan for potential failure modes and contingencies

Adapt experimental strategies dynamically based on new information

Develop engineering practices within the team

Develop a deep technical understanding of quantum processor technology to guide sound, well-informed decisions.

Implement strong and lean technical processes that support sound decision making processes. For example: requirements flowdown, trade studies, root cause corrective action methods, etc.

Support growth and development of the team

Contribute to defining role profiles and act as hiring manager for new roles across the programme.

Mentor engineers and project leads in programme execution and collaborative leadership.

Manage the engineers in your technology area: hire, coach, review performance, and grow careers.

Your Profile

Technical background

MSc, PhD, or equivalent experience in physics, electrical engineering, microwave/RF engineering, semiconductor technology, or a related field.

Understanding of the development lifecycle for chip-level technologies; experience with superconducting qubits or cryogenic systems is a strong plus.

Leadership experience

4+ years delivering complex, research-intensive chip hardware projects in a project management capacity.

Show people-management experience: hiring, coaching, and performance management.

Lead projects as part of a larger program, with control over one’s own domain.

Run smaller projects directly, without needing dedicated program-management support.

Proven ability to work with highly specialised technical experts.

Experience working in a fast-moving start-up or scale-up environment balancing hands-on technical leadership with growing a team, as a strong plus.

Approach

Translate a long-term technical strategy into an execution plan for your team.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to make pragmatic, informed decisions under uncertainty.

Draw a clear line between technical leadership and program management, and partner with Program Managers instead of duplicating their function.

Communication

Excellent communicator who can motivate teams, facilitate alignment, adept at communicating technical ideas.

Communicate fluently in English.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

title: Model-Based Systems Engineer
description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

Our Systems Integration Team is seeking a Model-Based Systems Engineer to build the tools and framework we use to design the systems that operate our VIO and QPU technology. This role is focused on establishing QuantWare’s MBSE methodology and turning knowledge from cryogenics, wiring, control electronics and software into a single, executable system model. You will define how we model our systems and build the libraries, analyses and integrations that make the model useful day to day. Working closely with processor, hardware and software teams, you will play an important role in enabling the design of the large-scale quantum computers built around VIO-powered QPUs.

What are you going to do?

Define and own QuantWare’s MBSE methodology, modelling conventions and architecture framework for quantum computing systems, covering the quantum processor, cryostat, signal chain, control and readout electronics, and software stack.

Select, set up and maintain the MBSE toolchain (e.g. SysML v2, Capella or Cameo), including version control, model reviews and integration with existing engineering tools.

Build reusable model libraries for key subsystems, including QPU interfaces, cryogenic wiring and attenuation, microwave signal paths, and control electronics.

Develop automated analyses on top of the model, such as heat-load, signal-integrity and noise budgets, channel counts, scalability, and full-system metrics such as power consumption as qubit counts grow.

Establish requirements traceability from customer and system-level requirements down to component specifications and verification tests.

Connect the system model to simulation and measurement data, creating a digital thread between design and test.

Support system architecture and trade studies for new VIO and QPU generations and customer system integrations.

Drive adoption across the company, training and supporting engineers in using the models and tools in their day-to-day work.

Qualifications

Core Requirements:

BSc. or MSc. in systems engineering, electrical engineering, physics, mechanical engineering or a related field.

3+ years of hands-on MBSE experience, including building or extending a modelling framework rather than only using existing ones.

Hands on experience with hardware system models that encompass multiple subsystems with differing requirements and interfaces.

Strong working knowledge of SysML (v1 and/or v2) and at least one MBSE tool, such as Cameo, Capella or equivalent.
