Je helpt het team om AI en agentic development verantwoord en effectief in te zetten binnen het ontwikkelproces.

Daarnaast vind jij het leuk om:

De behoeften van verschillende belanghebbenden, waaronder onze klanten en gebruikers, in kaart te brengen, documenteren en met elkaar in overeenstemming te brengen;

Eén of meer of meerdere scrum teams aan te sturen, die je begeleid in het ontwikkelproces volgens de SCRUM methodiek (planning, retrospective, refinements, e.d.);

De kwaliteit van de producten te waarborgen en continu te verbeteren door afstemming met de ontwikkelteams en alle betrokken stakeholders;

De schakel te zijn tussen klant en organisatie, waarbij je de klantwensen vertaalt naar concrete voorstellen en deze prioriteert op een product backlog;

AI in te zetten ter ondersteuning van bijvoorbeeld analyse, requirements, prototyping, documentatie en voorbereiding van refinements (natuurlijk zorg je ook voor een grondige controle, review en validatie op de output van AI;

De kwaliteit van producten bewaken en borgen dat deze voldoen aan de kwaliteits-, product- en informatiebeveiligingsnormen, in afstemming met ontwikkelteams en stakeholders;

De product backlog creëren, prioriteren en onderhouden, zodat het developmentteam aan de juiste ontwikkelingen werkt.

Werken met AI en agentic development

AI verandert de manier waarop software wordt ontwikkeld. Binnen PharmaPartners werken R&D-teams toe naar een gedeelde agentic way of working. De mens blijft verantwoordelijk voor keuzes en resultaten, terwijl AI ondersteunt bij onderdelen van het werk. Daarom zoeken we iemand die kansen ziet, kritisch blijft en nieuwe werkwijzen snel eigen maakt.

Heb je al ervaring met AI-tools, AI-agents, skills, prompten of agentic development? Dan is dat een duidelijke pré. Heb je die ervaring nog niet, maar ben je nieuwsgierig, leergierig en bereid je hierin actief onder te dompelen? Dan nodigen we je ook van harte uit om te reageren.

Waar kom je terecht?

Je werkt in een enthousiast Portfolio- en R&D-team en rapporteert aan de Teamlead Portfolio. Je levert een zichtbare bijdrage aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een van de grootste eHealth-platformen van Nederland en hebt als senior invloed op de koers van het product en de werkwijze van het team. Dat doe je samen met open, eerlijke, en behulpzame collega’s in een hechte en informele organisatie.

Herken jij je hierin?

Jij hebt minimaal HBO+ werk- en denkniveau in de richting van bedrijfskunde, IT, zorgtechnologie of iets soortgelijks;

Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in de zorg-ICT, in een rol als business analist of product owner;

Jouw kennis van de Nederlandse taal zit op minimaal C2-niveau. Ook in het Engels kun jij je zowel mondeling als schriftelijk goed uitdrukken;

Ruime ervaring met business analysetechnieken en het documenteren van requirements, ook bij complexe vraagstukken;

Je hebt ervaring met het bijdragen aan productvisie en roadmap en met het prioriteren op basis van strategische doelen;

Je vindt het niet erg als jouw werkdag soms anders loopt, of buiten een vast 9 tot 5 patroon valt;

Je deelt gemakkelijk kennis (van de Nederlandse zorgmarkt) en informatie met anderen;

Je staat stevig in je schoenen, ook als de druk op je werk toeneemt en houdt altijd overzicht.

Je bent communicatief vaardig, ambitieus en gedisciplineerd. Je durft vragen te stellen, keuzes te onderbouwen en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, en je neemt anderen mee in je koers. Tegelijk werk je graag samen, sta je open voor feedback en heb je de nieuwsgierigheid en het lef om nieuwe technologie verantwoord toe te passen.

Je draagt bij aan de productvisie en roadmap en vertaalt die naar heldere prioriteiten voor de teams. Je begrijpt de behoeften van gebruikers en vertaalt deze naar functionele vereisten, technische specificaties en concrete ontwikkelvoorstellen.

Je werkt in een complexe en veranderende omgeving en houdt overzicht wanneer er veel tegelijk speelt. Je kijkt niet alleen naar wat vandaag nodig is, maar vooral naar wat morgen waarde levert: nieuwe marktontwikkelingen, innovatiekansen en de mogelijkheden van AI. Je neemt eigenaarschap over de volledige levenscyclus van je producten en je coacht collega’s in het vak. Je helpt het team om AI en agentic development verantwoord en effectief in te zetten binnen het ontwikkelproces.


Daarnaast vind jij het leuk om:

  • De behoeften van verschillende belanghebbenden, waaronder onze klanten en gebruikers, in kaart te brengen, documenteren en met elkaar in overeenstemming te brengen;

  • Eén of meer of meerdere scrum teams aan te sturen, die je begeleid in het ontwikkelproces volgens de SCRUM methodiek (planning, retrospective, refinements, e.d.);

  • De kwaliteit van de producten te waarborgen en continu te verbeteren door afstemming met de ontwikkelteams en alle betrokken stakeholders;

  • De schakel te zijn tussen klant en organisatie, waarbij je de klantwensen vertaalt naar concrete voorstellen en deze prioriteert op een product backlog;

  • AI in te zetten ter ondersteuning van bijvoorbeeld analyse, requirements, prototyping, documentatie en voorbereiding van refinements (natuurlijk zorg je ook voor een grondige controle, review en validatie op de output van AI;

  • De kwaliteit van producten bewaken en borgen dat deze voldoen aan de kwaliteits-, product- en informatiebeveiligingsnormen, in afstemming met ontwikkelteams en stakeholders;

  • De product backlog creëren, prioriteren en onderhouden, zodat het developmentteam aan de juiste ontwikkelingen werkt.

Werken met AI en agentic development

AI verandert de manier waarop software wordt ontwikkeld. Binnen PharmaPartners werken R&D-teams toe naar een gedeelde agentic way of working. De mens blijft verantwoordelijk voor keuzes en resultaten, terwijl AI ondersteunt bij onderdelen van het werk. Daarom zoeken we iemand die kansen ziet, kritisch blijft en nieuwe werkwijzen snel eigen maakt.

Heb je al ervaring met AI-tools, AI-agents, skills, prompten of agentic development? Dan is dat een duidelijke pré. Heb je die ervaring nog niet, maar ben je nieuwsgierig, leergierig en bereid je hierin actief onder te dompelen? Dan nodigen we je ook van harte uit om te reageren.

Waar kom je terecht?

Je werkt in een enthousiast Portfolio- en R&D-team en rapporteert aan de Teamlead Portfolio. Je levert een zichtbare bijdrage aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een van de grootste eHealth-platformen van Nederland en hebt als senior invloed op de koers van het product en de werkwijze van het team. Dat doe je samen met open, eerlijke, en behulpzame collega’s in een hechte en informele organisatie.


Herken jij je hierin?

  • Jij hebt minimaal HBO+ werk- en denkniveau in de richting van bedrijfskunde, IT, zorgtechnologie of iets soortgelijks;

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in de zorg-ICT, in een rol als business analist of product owner;

  • Jouw kennis van de Nederlandse taal zit op minimaal C2-niveau. Ook in het Engels kun jij je zowel mondeling als schriftelijk goed uitdrukken;

  • Ruime ervaring met business analysetechnieken en het documenteren van requirements, ook bij complexe vraagstukken;

  • Je hebt ervaring met het bijdragen aan productvisie en roadmap en met het prioriteren op basis van strategische doelen;

  • Je vindt het niet erg als jouw werkdag soms anders loopt, of buiten een vast 9 tot 5 patroon valt;

  • Je deelt gemakkelijk kennis (van de Nederlandse zorgmarkt) en informatie met anderen;

  • Je staat stevig in je schoenen, ook als de druk op je werk toeneemt en houdt altijd overzicht.

Je bent communicatief vaardig, ambitieus en gedisciplineerd. Je durft vragen te stellen, keuzes te onderbouwen en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, en je neemt anderen mee in je koers. Tegelijk werk je graag samen, sta je open voor feedback en heb je de nieuwsgierigheid en het lef om nieuwe technologie verantwoord toe te passen.

Klaar om samen met ons de koers van eHealth en softwareontwikkeling te bepalen?

Dan zoeken we jou!

En is dit wat je zoekt?

  • Een passend salaris: Voor deze vacature geldt een range van € 4.000 - € 5.500 bruto p/m op basis van een fulltime werkweek.

  • €500,- persoonlijk budget: Gebruik het voor een sportabonnement, of investeer in je eigen ontwikkeling.

  • 26 vakantiedagen en 8,33% vakantiegeld: Eventueel kun je zelfs nog 5 extra vakantiedagen erbij kopen (naar rato).

  • Beschikbare pensioenpremie: wij zijn aangesloten bij Allianz en bieden een premie met een eigen bijdrage van 4,8%.

  • Ruimte voor groei: Binnen PharmaPartners bieden wij diverse Talentenprogamma’s aan, die gericht zijn op persoonlijke ontwikkeling, het inzetten van jouw talent en kracht en een programma om erachter te komen of dat jij jezelf in een leidinggevende rol ziet!

  • Een hechte, open werksfeer: Ervaar een warme, open werkomgeving waar collega’s samen successen vieren. Binnen PharmaPartners zorgt de Brabantse gezelligheid voor een laagdrempelige benadering en een sterke teamspirit.

  • Leaseauto : Wij bieden jou een leaseregeling aan zodat jij met goed vervoer jouw klanten kunt bezoeken.

  • Uitdagende functie: Ga de uitdaging aan bij een organisatie die impact maakt in de samenleving in de zorgsector. Je draagt direct bij aan de maatschappij door te werken voor de zorg, waar jouw inzet het verschil maakt.

  • Sporten onder werktijd: Bij PharmaPartners moedigen we een gezonde levensstijl aan, inclusief sporten onder werktijd. Op dinsdag en donderdag heb je de mogelijkheid om samen met collega’s aan het eind van de dag te gaan sporten.

  • Hybride werken: Hybride werken bij ons betekent dat je twee keer per week op kantoor wordt verwacht, terwijl je de rest van de tijd de vrijheid hebt om vanuit huis te werken. Deze aanpak zorgt voor een balans van interactie en flexibiliteit.

  • Teamspirit: Versterk de teamgeest door deel te nemen aan diverse sportevenementen, zoals een tennistoernooi of de singelloop in Breda. Bouw samen met je collega's aan een hechter team.

title: Data Scientist – Statistisch Onderzoek
description:
Je bent recent afgestudeerd van een bèta / kwantitatieve opleiding, bent statistisch goed onderlegd en je hebt ook al enige ervaring opgedaan met R, SPSS en/of Python en op zoek naar een mogelijkheid om je eerste stappen in de wereld van Data te zetten. Wij hebben dan een erg gave uitdaging in de aanbieding waarin je je kunt ontwikkelen binnen een publieke omgeving waarin je met onderzoek data het verschil kunt maken binnen maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

title: Data & Analytics traineeship Noord-Brabant
description:
Je weet dat data belangrijk is. Je voelt dat het iets voor jou is. Maar waar begin je? Met het Data & Analytics traineeship van TTC ontdek je waar jouw kracht ligt; of dat nou het slim bouwen van dashboards is, het analyseren van processen of het strategisch adviseren met cijfers. Samen zorgen we dat jij groeit tot een datagedreven professional die impact maakt vanaf dag één.

Wat kan je verwachten?

In 2 jaar groei jij uit tot een professional in data met sterke technische en communicatieve skills. Je haalt erkende certificaten, werkt bij één van onze toffe opdrachtgevers en ontwikkelt jezelf met behulp van persoonlijke coaching.

Je start met een onboarding van twee weken bij ons op kantoor waar je je medetrainees ontmoet, gevolgd door twee jaar waarin je werkt, leert en groeit. Je volgt trainingen op ons kantoor in Bunnik, doet werkervaring op bij één van onze opdrachtgevers, en wordt begeleid door een eigen people manager.

Het traject is opgedeeld in twee fasen. Gedurende fase 1 geven we niet alleen je persoonlijke ontwikkeling een boost, maar dompelen we je ook onder in de verschillende facetten van Data & Analytics. De tweede fase is aan jou om in te vullen, uiteraard word je daarin begeleid door ons: we stellen samen jouw unieke ontwikkelplan op!

Dit bieden wij jou

Geef je carrière binnen Data & Analytics een voorsprong

Alles draait om jouw persoonlijke groei. Daarom krijg je één-op-één begeleiding tijdens je hele traject

Een startsalaris tussen de €2600-€2800 dat past bij jouw ervaringsniveau

Je ontwikkeling blijft niet onopgemerkt: na een jaar ligt er, afhankelijk van evaluatie, tot €500 bruto salarisverhoging voor je klaar als erkenning voor jouw inzet.

Talloze interessante trainingen en masterclasses van experts én certificaten die je onderscheiden op de arbeidsmarkt

25 Vakantiedagen, vakantiegeld en reiskostenvergoeding op maat

Work hard, play hard! Met leuke borrels, toffe teamuitjes en evenementen houden we het teamgevoel hoog!

Dit vragen wij van jou

Een afgeronde hbo-of wo-opleiding

Een vlotte babbel, oplossingsgerichtheid en professionaliteit

Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal

Sterk analytisch vermogen

title: Junior Solution Architect
description:
Ben jij nieuwsgierig naar de wereld van GEO-data, architectuur en digitale innovatie binnen de overheid? Wil je werken aan oplossingen die dagelijks impact hebben op Nederland? Dan is de rol van Solution Architect GIS/GEO bij DICTU precies wat bij jou past.

In deze functie werk je op de ICT-afdeling van DICTU, waar je bijdraagt aan geografische producten en diensten die door meerdere ministeries worden gebruikt. Je leert hoe complexe GIS-vraagstukken worden vertaald naar heldere architecturen en robuuste oplossingen. Je ontwikkelt je tot een expert die de brug vormt tussen DevOps-teams, architecten en opdrachtgevers.

Solution Architect GIS/GEO

Als Solution Architect GIS/GEO speel je een sleutelrol in het ontwerpen, standaardiseren en verbeteren van GEO-diensten. Je ontwikkelt productarchitecturen op basis van functionele en niet-functionele eisen en maakt slim gebruik van rijksbrede standaarden zoals NORA, EAR, BIO en de AVG. Je werkt nauw samen met scrum teams en Product Owners binnen het SAFe-framework en legt jouw keuzes vast volgens het DICTU Agile Architectuurproces, gebaseerd op TOGAF.

Je adviseert, overtuigt en neemt collega’s mee in jouw visie. Je ziet de samenhang tussen processen, data en systemen, en begrijpt hoe krachtig GIS-functionaliteit kan zijn in die keten. Samen met DevOps-teams ontwikkel je nieuwe bouwblokken en zorg je dat bestaande diensten optimaal worden benut.

Met jouw communicatieve vaardigheden, analytisch vermogen en oog voor kwaliteit draag je bij aan veilige, efficiënte en toekomstbestendige GEO-oplossingen die direct bijdragen aan het werk van ministeries en uitvoeringsorganisaties.

Wat neem jij mee

Een glinsterend HBO- of WO diploma

Kennis van GIS/GEO

Kennis van Infrastructuur en Solution Architectuur

Een vlotte babbel, oplossingsgerichtheid en professionaliteit

Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal

Dit bieden wij

Een flitsende start van jouw carrière in Business & IT, in de vorm van een tweejarig traineeship bomvol interessante trainingen & masterclasses, waardevolle certificaten en uitdagende opdrachten

Bij ons draait alles om jouw persoonlijke groei, en dat menen we serieus. We staan je met één-op-één begeleiding bij gedurende het hele traject.

Een startsalaris tussen de €2.600 - €2.800 dat past bij jouw ervaringsniveau

De mogelijkheid om je kennis een extra boost te geven met betaalde cursussen en opleidingen

25 vakantiedagen, vakantiegeld en reiskostenvergoeding op maat

Aan de slag bij een opdrachtgever die bij jou past

Work hard, play hard! Met leuke borrels, toffe teamuitjes en evenementen houden we het teamgevoel hoog!

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
ShyftOff connects independent customer service professionals with opportunities to support leading brands across industries like healthcare, financial services, insurance, retail, and technology.

As an independent agent on the ShyftOff platform, you'll have opportunities to help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and deliver exceptional service, all from the comfort of your home.

Compensation: $14–$20 per hour, depending on the program and applicable compensation structure.

Why Join ShyftOff?

Choose your own schedule: Select available shifts in 30-minute increments. Accept opportunities that fit your life, with no minimum hour commitments.
100% remote: Provide customer service from home, without a commute or traditional office schedule.
Competitive earnings: Access opportunities with competitive, program-specific compensation rates disclosed before you commit.
Weekly payments: Get paid weekly for completed services, subject to program terms.
Multiple opportunities: Explore customer service programs across a variety of industries based on your qualifications and availability.
Priority Boarding: Top-performing, reliable agents receive priority access to available shifts, helping maximize their earning opportunities.
Work on your terms: Operate as a 1099 independent contractor with the freedom to choose which opportunities you accept.

Qualifications

We're looking for dependable, customer-focused independent professionals who take pride in delivering great service.

3+ years of customer service experience preferred.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong problem-solving abilities, empathy, and active listening skills.
Ability to fulfill accepted service commitments and meet client quality standards.
Comfortable navigating multiple computer systems and learning new technology.
Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum).
Quiet, professional workspace suitable for customer calls.
Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding requirements.

Location: Remote, United States only. Eligibility is limited to ShyftOff-approved states.

How to Get Started

Sign up: Create your free ShyftOff account, complete your application, and submit your video interview.
Explore opportunities: Review available programs, compensation rates, and qualification requirements to find the right fit.
Get qualified: Complete any required program-specific certifications or onboarding.
Choose your shifts: Select available 30-minute shifts that work for your schedule.
Get paid weekly: Earn money by delivering great customer service.

Join 26,000+ agents who have discovered a more flexible way to work. Sign up today at https://app.shyftoff.com/r/QPFQWH

Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed. There is no fee to join ShyftOff. When you opt into a specific client program, you pay for that program's non-refundable background check ($40 for most programs; $199 for the Financial Services program). Program-specific certification and onboarding requirements are explained in the ShyftOff app.

title: International Junior Consultant Healthcare LATAM & North America at CPC
description:
About Chameleon Pharma Consulting

We at Chameleon Pharma Consulting Group are supporting medium sized to bigger Pharma, Consumer Health, Aesthetic Medicine & Derma clients in Market Entry in Latin America, US/Canada, Asia, Europe and MENA.

Our unique services range from Complex Market Entry Cube Analysis, International Regulatory Strategy, registration, GMP, variations over to Systematic Local Partner Company Identification.

In order to expand our CPC team, we are looking for an International Junior Consultant with focus on Latin America and US/Canada.

Do you enjoy working in an international team, analyzing complex interrelationships, and organizing various projects and topics?

Are you looking to work independently and take personal responsibility within a successful team?

We are an innovative international consulting firm specializing in the healthcare sector (pharmaceuticals, consumer health & aesthetic medicine).

To support our company’s continued growth, we are seeking a motivated International Consultant to join us on a full-time basis.

We are a small team working face to face in our Berlin office, together with our Mexico office and our CPC Experts in 15-20 countries – no remote work.

Your responsibilities

Analysis of international commercial and regulatory healthcare topics regarding market entry and market expansion

Breakdown of complex situations and to identify solutions

Coordination and planning of international client projects

Ownership for corporate content and digital strategy (Webpage, LinkedIn, Webinars, ...)

Marketing Mix, Segmentation, Positioning work wih client products

What we are looking for:

Maybe you have a professional service background from a different industry, project manager or similar

Ability to structure complex information clearly and communicate findings effectively

Strong Research and problem-solving skills, Multi-Tasking

Strong customer Service mindset

Willingness to work with international client project responsibilities and deadlines.

Proficiency in English is mandatory, Spanish or Portuguese would be an additional plus

Good knowledge of MS Office

A proactive mindset and willingness to work independently

Bachelor’s/Master’s degree with first 1-2 years working experience or practical internships, strong interest in Consulting

Your personality is more important than your professional experience – we welcome career changers!

What we offer:

Responsibility from day one – your work directly contributes to international client projects and decisions

Industry insights from contacts to our international clients

Possibility to gain experience in different projects like Systematic Market Analysis, Market Entry, M&A, etc.

Being able to see your work input in the project’s results

A small and international team with flat hierarchies

Annual performance bonus

Deutschlandticket

Join our team!

If you are looking for a role where you can learn quickly, take responsibility and work on international healthcare projects, we would be happy to meet you.

Our highly motivated, friendly and international team looks forward to welcoming you at our office in Berlin Kreuzberg.

Interested?

Please send us your CV, cover letter, current salary and relevant certificates.
We are looking forward to your application!

For further questions, please contact us:

Chameleon Pharma Consulting Group

A Business Unit of Mammut Pharma GmbH
Am Tempelhofer Berg 6
10965 Berlin Germany

Tel: +49-30-648-35-164

title: Senior Game Designer - Systems & Economy - Fully Remote
description:
At SOFTGAMES, we build games played by millions of players worldwide. We are looking for a Senior Game Designer (Systems & Economy) to help evolve our leading games. You will own the long-term evolution of one or two existing games with a loyal player base, balancing player satisfaction, engagement, and commercial performance.

In this role, you will own the design and optimization of progression, economy, events, and monetization systems. Your mission is to continuously evolve these games by creating compelling short-, mid-, and long-term goals that keep players engaged for months and years while maximizing player satisfaction and business performance.

*Qualified applicants will be expected to complete a design test.

This is a remote position.

Your Role:

Design, balance, and optimize the game’s economy, progression, and reward systems.

Create engaging player motivation loops across events, features, and monetization.

Develop and maintain a cohesive ecosystem of LiveOps events, ensuring they work together rather than compete for player attention.

Design systems that improve retention, engagement, and monetization while preserving a great player experience.

Build and maintain economy models, balancing spreadsheets, and simulations.

Use data to identify player friction points, progression bottlenecks, and monetization opportunities.

Collaborate closely with Product, BI, UA, Art, and Development teams to improve game performance.

Analyze KPIs such as Retention, ARPDAU, Conversion, LTV, and Engagement to guide design decisions.

Drive feature and event improvements through continuous testing, iteration, and experimentation.

Clearly communicate design rationale, trade-offs, and recommendations across the team.

Your Profile:

5+ years of experience designing and operating successful F2P mobile games.

Strong experience in systems design, economy design, progression design, and LiveOps.

Proven track record working on casual or puzzle games.

Deep understanding of player motivation, retention mechanics, and monetization design.

Strong analytical mindset with the ability to design and evaluate A/B tests and translate data into actionable improvements.

Comfortable making decisions based on KPIs and player behavior.

Self-driven and proactive, with the ability to identify opportunities without waiting for direction.

Ability to quickly understand new games, systems, and player audiences and take ownership when moving between projects.

Advanced spreadsheet skills and experience building balancing, simulation, and forecasting models.

Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written.

Passion for creating engaging and sustainable player experiences.

Proficient in using AI tools to improve productivity, analysis, and decision making.

Benefits:

SOFTGAMES offers a competitive package, including:

Remote-first, your way — Work fully remote from wherever you do your best work, or drop into our modern Berlin office whenever you like. You choose

Flexible hours — Structure your working hours to your needs. No crunch culture. No overtime

Generous vacation — Time to recharge, wherever in the world you are

Home office budget — We fund your setup so your home office actually works for you

Learning & development — Training budget for everyone, whether you're deepening expertise or picking up something entirely new

Top-tier equipment — A high-spec laptop, ready to get your best work done

Meal allowance — A monthly budget dedicated to your lunches

Home office utility grant — We cover a monthly contribution toward your electricity and internet costs

Company swag — Hoodies, bags, mugs — the good stuff

Annual company retreat — At least once a year, the whole company comes together to connect, align, and celebrate. Our events in general are epic but our off-site Retreat is one of a kind.

At SOFTGAMES, we value a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone's ideas are heard and valued. Join our dynamic team and be part of the exciting world of mobile gaming. Apply now and let your expertise shine!

SOFTGAMES is the leading instant gaming company. We develop casual, truly social games that can be played instantly across all devices. Our hypersocial blockbuster game “Bubble Shooter Pro” became a global top grossing game on Facebook and is played by millions of people around the world every day. We partner closely with Facebook, Samsung and more to craft the next generation of instant games that billions of people can play together. SOFTGAMES is a remote first company and the home of 100 people from all over the world. We believe in proactive, independent teams with the freedom to take initiative, challenge the status quo, and with the mission to create fun and everlasting Instant Games.

At SOFTGAMES, we believe that different perspectives and background in our teams contribute to the quality of our work. We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion / worldview, disability, age as well as sexual orientation and identity.

Have we caught your interest? Then we look forward to your detailed application.

Als Werkstudent (Mensch) für unseren Kunden Estee Lauder erlebst du Mediaarbeit für eines der weltweit führenden Prestige-Beauty-Unternehmen aus nächster Nähe. Du packst im Tagesgeschäft mit an, lernst vom Team und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt eigene Aufgaben.

  • Kampagnenunterstützung: Du unterstützt das Team bei Planung, Umsetzung und Steuerung crossmedialer Kampagnen für die Marken von Estée Lauder
  • Reporting: Du erstellst Reportings und Präsentationen und bereitest Kampagnenergebnisse verständlich auf
  • Analyse: Du wertest Mediadaten aus und leitest erste Optimierungsansätze ab
  • Marktbeobachtung: Du behältst Trends im Beauty-Markt und Aktivitäten im Wettbewerb im Blick
  • Koordination: Du pflegst Daten in unseren Tools und unterstützt die Abstimmung mit Vermarktern und Partnern

 

Das zeichnet dich aus:

  • Studium: Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben, idealerweise in Wirtschaft, Medien, Marketing, Kommunikation oder einem vergleichbaren Fach

  • Zahlenaffinität: Du arbeitest gern mit Daten und bist sicher in Excel und PowerPoint
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch (mind. C1) und gut auf Englisch
  • Organisationstalent: Du arbeitest strukturiert und sorgfältig und behältst auch bei parallelen Aufgaben den Überblick

Darüber hinaus bist du: #neugierig #zuverlässig #teamorientiert

Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.

Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen.   • Spezialisierung & Innovation: Du hast die Möglichkeit, dich auf eigene Verantwortungsbereiche zu spezialisieren, diese weiterzuentwickeln und aktiv Trends sowie Innovationen im Paid Search Umfeld voranzutreiben.

 

Das zeichnet dich aus:

  • SEA-Expertise: Im Bereich der Suchmaschinenwerbung (SEA) kennst du dich bestens aus und das Setup sowie die Steuerung von komplexen Kampagnen sind dir vertraut.
  • Führungskompetenz: Du bringst erste Führungserfahrung mit und hast Freude daran, juniorige Teammitglieder anzuleiten und dein Wissen aktiv weiterzugeben.
  • Strategisches Denken: Deine Fähigkeit, strategisch zu denken, ermöglicht es dir, umfassende Konzepte für die Kundenweiterentwicklung zu erarbeiten und überzeugend zu präsentieren.

  • Eigenverantwortung: Eine hohe Eigeninitiative und der Wunsch, eigene Verantwortungsbereiche zu spezialisieren und weiterzuentwickeln, zeichnen deine Arbeitsweise aus.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Warum wir tun, was wir tun

Unsere Psyche ist das Fenster, durch das wir die Welt sehen – mal grau, mal hell. Wer lernt, dieses Fenster zu verstehen, kann jeden Tag eine neue Perspektive gewinnen. Aus psychischen Herausforderungen können Chancen zum Wachsen werden. Und weil Glück ansteckend ist, verändert sich so die Gesellschaft: one mind at a time.

Warum es diese Rolle braucht

Immer mehr Arbeitgebende und Versicherungen machen Aepsy für ihre Mitarbeitenden zugänglich – vom KMU bis zum Grossunternehmen. So erhalten mehr Menschen frühzeitig Zugang zu passender psychologischer Unterstützung.

Doch ein Angebot allein reicht nicht. Mitarbeitende müssen Aepsy kennen, verstehen und ihm vertrauen. Sie müssen wissen, wie sie das Angebot nutzen können, wenn sie Unterstützung brauchen.

Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio an Partnerunternehmen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Partnerschaften echte Wirkung entsteht. Dafür entwickelst du Aktivierungsmassnahmen, koordinierst Projekte und arbeitest eng mit HR-Verantwortlichen sowie unseren Teams aus Sales, Marketing, Operations und Product zusammen.

Was du bewegen wirst

Partnerschaften gestalten: Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio an Partnerunternehmen, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und verstehst, was deine Ansprechpersonen bewegt.

Menschen erreichen und aktivieren: Du entwickelst Kommunikations- und Aktivierungsmassnahmen, die Mitarbeitende auf Aepsy aufmerksam machen und zur Nutzung motivieren.

Projekte ins Rollen bringen: Du planst und koordinierst Projekte von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, behältst Deadlines im Blick und bringst alle Beteiligten zusammen.

Wirkung sichtbar machen: Du analysierst Aktivierungs- und Nutzungszahlen und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungsmassnahmen ab.

Dinge besser machen: Du hinterfragst Abläufe, bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst unsere Partnerschaften, Prozesse und das Produkt weiter.

Was du mitbringst

Du musst nicht bereits alles können. Viel wichtiger ist uns, wie du denkst, wie du mit Menschen umgehst und was dich antreibt.

Erste Berufserfahrung in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, HR oder einem verwandten Bereich. Einen Hintergrund in Psychologie oder Gesundheitsförderung ist ein Plus aber kein Muss.

Freude am Aufbau von Beziehungen, Begeisterungsfähigkeit und ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick zu behalten

Analytisches Denken, Interesse an Zahlen und Freude daran, Prozesse zu hinterfragen und zu verbessern

Freude an einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem nicht immer alles vorgegeben ist und Eigeninitiative gefragt ist

Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Bereitschaft, in einem 100-%-Pensum zu arbeiten und mehrheitlich vor Ort in unserem Büro im Herzen von Zürich tätig zu sein. Eine reine Remote-Tätigkeit ist nicht möglich.

Was wir dir bieten

Arbeit, die etwas bewirkt. Deine Arbeit hilft Menschen, psychologische Unterstützung zu finden, wenn sie sie brauchen. Du trägst dazu bei, mentale Gesundheit zugänglicher zu machen.

Ein Team, das dich stärkt. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Marketing, Product und unserer Psycholog:innen-Community zusammen. Unterschiedliche Perspektiven, viel Know-how und eine gemeinsame Mission prägen unseren Alltag.

Raum, Dinge zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns weiter. Deine Ideen sind willkommen, deine Verantwortung ist real und du kannst direkt mitgestalten, wie wir unsere Partner betreuen und Mitarbeitende erreichen.

Gemeinsam mit uns

Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Team mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen und Überzeugungen. Wir lieben Gespräche über das grosse Ganze genauso wie über die kleinen Details. Wir glauben an das, was wir tun, und arbeiten hart für eine etwas bessere Welt.

Gleichzeitig sind wir Mütter, Väter, Ehemänner und Ehefrauen, Weinliebhaber, Stand-up-Comedians, Musiker, Tänzer, Yoga-Begeisterte und Zen-Mönche, die das Leben schätzen und geniessen.

Bereit, etwas zu bewegen?

Schlaf darüber. Lies das Inserat nochmals. Und wenn du das Gefühl hast, dass du zu Aepsy passen könntest, freuen wir uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein persönliches Bewerbungsschreiben. Erzähl uns, was dich antreibt, warum dir unsere Mission wichtig ist und weshalb dich genau diese Rolle anspricht. Wir lesen jedes Schreiben aufmerksam.

title: Junior Marketing Manager - DACH
description:
Über AMBOSS & den DACH Campus
AMBOSS ist ein international etabliertes MedTech-Unternehmen mit Sitz in Berlin, das weltweit mehr als eine Million Nutzer:innen in über 180 Ländern erreicht. Die Plattform liefert medizinisches Wissen und Entscheidungsunterstützung über eine umfangreiche Bibliothek, Fragendatenbank und KI-gestützte Anwendungen – zuverlässig und überall verfügbar.

Der DACH Campus-Bereich umfasst alle Nutzer:innen, die sich in der Ausbildung für einen medizinischen oder gesundheitsnahen Beruf befinden – von der Humanmedizin über Zahnmedizin bis hin zu Physician Assistants und perspektivisch weiteren Fachrichtungen. Mit einem Marktanteil von rund 95 % in der Humanmedizin ist AMBOSS klarer Marktführer im DACH-Raum. Um diese Position zu festigen und den Erfolg auf weitere Fachbereiche auszuweiten, entwickeln wir Marketingmaßnahmen, die passgenau auf die Bedürfnisse, Sprache und Lernkultur unserer Community zugeschnitten sind.

Dafür suchen wir Verstärkung im Bereich Marketing Management (DACH Campus) – mit Verantwortung für das gesamte Marketing-Spektrum von B2C- und B2B-Kampagnen über Social Media bis hin zu Events und Konferenzen.

Deine Aufgaben

Ganzheitliche Marketingverantwortung: Verantwortung für sämtliche Marketingaktivitäten im DACH Campus Raum einschließlich B2C und B2B.

Multichannel-Marketing: Steuerung und Umsetzung von Kampagnen über verschiedene Kanäle hinweg (z.B. CRM, Graphics, Performance Marketing) – inkl. Priorisierung, Zeitplanerstellung und Einhaltung von Deadlines

Zielgruppenverständnis: Fähigkeit, dich tief in die Welt der Studierenden und Auszubildenden im Gesundheitswesen einzudenken, deren Bedürfnisse und Realität zu verstehen und dies in die Kommunikation einfließen zu lassen

Campaign-Plan & Budget: Unterstützung bei der Jahresplanung, Budgetkontrolle, Reporting und Ergebnisanalyse im Bereich Marketing

Content & Copy: Erstellen prägnanter, zielgruppenorientierter Kommunikation im Rahmen von Landingpages, Newsletter, Social Media und Event Materialien

Projektmanagement & Events: Mitwirken an der Organisation und Durchführung von Events, Konferenzen und weiteren Marketingprojekten – inklusive Abstimmung mit internen Teams und Partner:innen

Interne Kommunikation & Reporting: Erstellung interner Präsentationen für Market Reviews (auf Englisch) und Visualisierung von Ergebnissen

AI- & Tool-Nutzung: Effektiver Einsatz moderner AI-Tools für Content, Analyse und Reporting

Was du mitbringen solltest

Hohe Lernbereitschaft und Eigeninitiative – du packst Themen proaktiv an, probierst Neues aus und arbeitest lösungsorientiert

Umsetzungsstärke – du denkst nicht nur in Konzepten, sondern setzt diese auch aktiv und effizient um

Zielgruppenverständnis: Fähigkeit, dich tief in die Welt der Studierenden und Auszubildenden im Gesundheitswesen einzudenken, deren Bedürfnisse und Realität zu verstehen und dies in die Kommunikation einfließen zu lassen

Hervorragendes Sprachgefühl und Copywriting-Fähigkeiten – du beherrschst prägnantes, zielgruppenorientiertes Schreiben und triffst den richtigen Ton für unsere Community

Marketingerfahrung: wichtig ist uns eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und Motivation, idealerweise hast du schon Erfahrungen in B2C, B2B, Performance oder Content Marketing sammeln können, gerne in einem Start-up- oder dynamischen Umfeld

Exzellente Sprachkompetenz – Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau für exzellentes Copywriting sowie fließendes Englisch (Business-Niveau) für interne Kommunikation, Präsentationen & Reporting

Projektmanagement & Events: Mitwirken an der Organisation und Durchführung von Events, Konferenzen und weiteren Marketingprojekten – inklusive Abstimmung mit internen Teams und Partner:innen

Campaign-Plan & Budget: Unterstützung bei der Jahresplanung, Budgetkontrolle, Reporting und Ergebnisanalyse im Bereich Marketing

Interne Kommunikation & Reporting: Erstellung interner Präsentationen für Market Reviews (auf Englisch) und Visualisierung von Ergebnissen

Erfahrung mit AI- und digitalen Marketing-Tools für Content, Analyse und Automatisierung

Pluspunkte

Erfahrung im Start-up-Umfeld oder in wachstumsstarken Organisationen

Projektmanagement-Erfahrung (z. B. Eventorganisation)

Kenntnisse im Performance Marketing oder Social Media Marketing

Erfahrung oder Bezug zum Gesundheits- oder Bildungsbereich

Benefits:

AMBOSSSians erzählen uns, dass eine innovative Arbeit ihnen Antrieb gibt und sie sich durch Mitarbeiter-Benefits wertgeschätzt und in ihrer Arbeit bestärkt fühlen. Wir investieren in jeden AMBOSSian mit unseren Mitarbeiter-Benefits, die extra zugeschnitten wurden, um die finanzielle, physische und mentale Gesundheit zu unterstützen und zu einer positiven Work-Life-Balance beizutragen.

🌴 Erholung und Freizeit: 30 bezahlte Urlaubstage, ein AMBOSS-Feiertag, ein persönlicher Purpose Day und Tenure Days

🥙 Verpflegung und Office-Komfort: Täglich gesundes Frühstück und Mittagessen von unseren hauseigenen Küchenchefs, die AMBOSS-Kita in unserem Berliner Büro; sowie die Möglichkeit, remote aus unseren Büros in Köln, Sardinien, New York oder Kapstadt zu arbeiten

🏃 Gesundheit, Fitness und Mobilität: zur Auswahl Urban Sports Club - M-Plan, Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland-Ticket

Erfahre hier mehr über unsere Benefit-Pakete:

http://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt ein starker Motor für Innovation und Fortschritt ist. Deshalb engagieren wir uns für ein inklusives, respektvolles und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem alle Menschen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, ethnischer oder kultureller Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, sexueller Orientierung oder geschlechtlicher Identität – wertgeschätzt werden und die gleichen Chancen erhalten, ihr Potenzial zu entfalten.

Wir heißen Menschen aller Herkunft herzlich willkommen, uns bei unserer Mission zu unterstützen: medizinisches Fachpersonal darin zu stärken, die bestmögliche Versorgung zu gewährleisten.

Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen der Stellenbeschreibung erfüllst, ermutigen wir dich dennoch, dich zu bewerben. Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören!

title: UI Engineer (Based in CA or NC only)
description:
Mission: Live at the intersection of app runtime & security. Protect applications in a fundamental way so that developers can build great application services and not be constantly looking over their shoulder. BlueRock is changing the landscape of App runtime security.

The role

Location: Must be based in CA (preferably San Francisco Bay Area) or North Carolina

You will work alongside BlueRock's product designers and the control plane development team on our operator consoles. These are the React front ends that engineers and security teams use to manage large fleets of protected nodes, see what AI agents are actually doing across those fleets, and author the policy that constrains them.

The domain is AI and agentic systems, seen from the operations and security side. When an agent calls an MCP server, spawns a subagent, runs a shell command in a sandbox, or burns $40 of tokens in an afternoon, our UI is where a person sees it, understands it, and decides what to allow. So the interesting problems are visibility problems (how do you show a thousand agent sessions so someone can find the one that matters?) and control problems (how do you author an enforcement policy without a mistake taking production down?).

This is a mid-level role. We expect about 3–5 years of professional front-end experience, or equivalent work that clearly shows the same judgment. The ideal candidate is passionate about user experience, design, and AI-assisted software development, with a demonstrated grounding in engineering best practices. The title says UI, but the work doesn’t stop there: you’ll work closely with our backend services, and a feature is finished when it’s proven working live, not when the screen looks right.

Working with design delivered as code

At BlueRock, product designers design and collaborate in code. Instead of handing off static mockups, they build working UI with AI coding tools, against real data, and open merge requests. Iteration happens so quickly that it has outpaced our capacity for robust engineering collaboration and review.

This role closes that gap. You will collaborate directly with product designers and backend developers to keep UI development fast, by bridging the gap between vibe code and high-quality, sustainable, well-tested code. Some days that means reviewing and hardening a designer's branch so it can merge. Other days it means building the shared components, tests and guardrails that make the next branch need less hardening.

Beyond reviewing and hardening code, you'll help shape how it gets made. Working with designers and the AI tools they use, you'll turn what each review teaches us into shared components, conventions, tests and agent instructions. Over time the whole practice becomes more predictable, and each new branch arrives closer to production-ready.

Roles and collaboration

Software development roles are blurring more than ever. This role reports to product design, with API and data-layer guidance from our control plane engineering lead. You must be attuned to the perspectives of both UX/Design and Engineering, acting as a bridge between the goals and priorities of both sides, while ultimately deferring to UX/design partners on matters of style, copy, and information architecture.

In practice: when a designer's branch makes a choice about layout, copy or flow, you protect the intent and fix the implementation. When the implementation can't support the intent, because of performance, data shape or maintainability, you say so early and bring options rather than quietly changing the design.

What you'll do

Review designer-authored merge requests and bring them to production quality: structure, types, tests, accessibility, performance, and both light and dark themes.

Turn one-off UI from fast iteration into shared, documented components in our design system and Storybook, and migrate the apps onto them.

Make data-dense views hold up at real scale. Dashboards, tables, charts, and time-range and filter controls that work on a demo tenant also have to work on one with billions of events.

Wire UI to the API layer (GraphQL), and work with backend developers when a view needs a new query, field or endpoint.

Own UI test coverage: Vitest for units and Playwright for end-to-end flows, kept green in CI.

Test UI end to end in live, secured environments, with full authentication and authorization, real data and realistic load, before calling it done.

Keep UI work moving across release lines: shipping behind feature flags, and carrying fixes between branches when a release is frozen.

Fix UI bugs across the consoles and the Windows, Mac and Linux clients: layout and overflow, tooltips and popovers, empty and zero states, things that are technically correct and still confusing.

When needed, design new interfaces within the existing design system, and bring them to design for review.

Help set the guardrails that make AI-assisted UI development safe: lint rules, conventions, review checklists, and the instructions our AI coding tools follow.

How we expect you to work

These are the habits of a careful engineer. They matter more here, not less, because so much of the code you touch was drafted quickly by someone else or by an AI tool.

Diagnose before you change. Find the actual cause, which is usually a layer away from the symptom, and be able to explain why your fix addresses it. A change that makes the symptom disappear is not the same as a fix.

Small, deliberate diffs. Solve the problem in front of you. Don't refactor adjacent code on the way past, and don't build the abstraction you may need later.

Fix it in one place. When the same bug shows up in three panels, the fix belongs in the shared component, not copied three times. Knowing where a change belongs is most of the skill.

Verify, then claim. Run it, look at it, check both themes and a narrow viewport, get types and lint clean, and write the test where a test is what proves it. Then say plainly what you checked and what you did not. This applies double to AI-assisted work: you own the diff, whoever drafted it.

Say when you're unsure. A requirement with two readings is a question, not a guess. Surfacing a problem early is always cheaper than discovering it in review.

Our UI stack and design system

Our front ends are several React and TypeScript apps that share one codebase: our enterprise operator consoles and our cloud product for builders.

All of them are built on our own design system. It is a shared React component library on top of Ant Design, with design tokens for color, type and spacing, light and dark themes, and a shared app shell for navigation, page layout and headers. Every component is documented in Storybook, published from CI, which serves as the reference for designers, engineers and AI coding tools alike. The library also carries written instructions for AI coding assistants, so generated code reaches for the system's components and tokens instead of inventing its own.

A large part of this role is the design system itself. That means promoting patterns out of individual apps into shared components, writing their stories, keeping tokens and themes consistent so the apps don't drift, and making the system the easiest path for anyone, or any agent, building UI.

Front end: React, TypeScript, Vite

Design system: our component library built on Ant Design, including design tokens and light and dark themes

Documentation: Storybook, published to GitLab Pages

Data and charts: GraphQL; ECharts for the data-dense views

Testing: Vitest, Playwright, and contract and smoke suites in CI

Delivery: GitLab merge requests and pipelines, release branches, feature flags

Further back: TypeScript and Rust services over graph and columnar stores, built on OpenTelemetry, plus desktop apps and services across Mac, Windows and Linux

You don't need experience with all of it. You do need to be strong in TypeScript and React, and willing to read code before changing it.

What you bring

About 3–5 years building production front ends in TypeScript and modern React: hooks, composition, state that lives at the right level, and an understanding of why a re-render happens.

An end-to-end view of the systems behind the UI. Designing in code gets a feature most of the way to working, and you close the rest of the gap. For you, “done” doesn’t stop at the UI working. It means the UI is integrated and shown to work live, in a secured environment with full authentication and authorization, under realistic load.

Integration testing against complex backends. Tests that only run against mock data in a standalone dev stack aren’t enough here. You can create, integrate and run tests in live environments to check data validity, load, security and scale, and you keep unit, integration and end-to-end suites green in CI.

Performance instincts for data-heavy UI: pagination, virtualization, server-side filtering, and knowing when a slow page is a query problem rather than a rendering problem.

A track record of reviewing other people’s code and improving it without rewriting it.

Git in complex repositories with several active release branches, where a single fix may need to be cherry-picked, ported or graft-merged onto more than one of them. Readable commits, and responding to review without taking it personally.

Hands-on use of AI coding tools in real work, with clear habits for checking what they produce.

CSS that holds up: flexbox and grid, overflow and scroll containers, responsive behaviour, and why a tooltip or popover ends up clipped.

Experience building or contributing to a component library or design system, ideally with Storybook and design tokens.

Careful attention to visual detail and real interest in UX. Much of this work is noticing that something is two pixels wrong, or that a label is technically correct and still confusing.

Genuine interest in the AI and agentic space, and in the operational and security questions it creates.

Nice to have: Ant Design; GraphQL; ECharts or other charting libraries; design training or a portfolio; experience on a team where designers commit code; writing conventions or instructions for AI coding tools; desktop UI across Mac, Windows and Linux; dense operational tooling such as observability, security or infrastructure products.

Not required: a computer science degree, if your work shows the same rigor. Deep backend, security or infrastructure expertise, or any knowledge of our domain (fleet management, telemetry, agent observability, policy enforcement). We will teach that.

Your first 90 days

First month: land changes safely. Ship scoped fixes in the consoles. Learn the component library, theme tokens and API layer. Start reviewing designer merge requests alongside an engineer.

Second month: own review on a surface. Become the primary reviewer for designer-authored UI on one product area, and extract at least one repeated pattern into a shared component.

Third month: make the next branch easier. Get the flows you own covered by tests in CI, and write down the conventions and guardrails that make designer branches need less hardening.

About BlueRock:

BlueRock is a well-funded, early stage cybersecurity company founded by experienced security minded entrepreneurs. Our mission is to change the game in cybersecurity. Attackers are exploiting in hours. The dependency tree is exploding. Developers are drowning in vulnerability debt. BlueRock changes the game, enabling organizations to shift from chasing CVEs and exploits to proactively protecting the foundations of applications and computing, so that developers can build great applications without looking over their shoulders.

title: Trainee Redaktion YouTube (all genders)
company: Miss Germany Studios GmbH & Co. KG
description:
Miss Germany ist kein Schönheitswettbewerb, sondern eine Plattform für Frauen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und etwas bewegen wollen. Auf YouTube entwickeln wir eigene Formate, die Frauen zwischen 16 und 35 ansprechen – nicht nur mit den Geschichten und Perspektiven unserer Kandidatinnen, sondern mit allen Themen, die diese Generation bewegen.

Gute Formate stehen und fallen mit der Vorbereitung. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der gründlich recherchiert, Zusammenhänge schnell versteht und aus Fakten, Stimmen und Hintergründen eine Grundlage baut, mit der wir vor der Kamera überzeugen.

Als Trainee Redaktion YouTube bei Miss Germany Studios bereitest du unsere eigenen Formate inhaltlich vor – von der Themenidee über die Recherche bis zum festen Briefing für Dreh und Moderation. Dabei lernst du redaktionelles Arbeiten von Grund auf in der Praxis und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung.

Was du bei uns machst:

Recherche: Du recherchierst Themen, Fakten, Studien und Hintergründe – gründlich, schnell und mit sauberen Quellen.

Themenfindung: Du behältst im Blick, was gerade diskutiert wird, und schlägst Themen und Gäst:innen für unsere Formate vor.

Briefings: Du bereitest deine Recherche so auf, dass Moderation und Team direkt damit arbeiten können: Fragen, Thesen, Argumente und Fakten.

Casting & Gäste: Du findest passende Gäst:innen und Protagonist:innen, nimmst Kontakt auf, führst Vorgespräche und bereitest sie inhaltlich auf den Dreh vor.

Faktencheck: Du prüfst Inhalte vor der Veröffentlichung auf Richtigkeit.

Wir haben ein Match, wenn Folgendes auf dich zutrifft:

Du bist neugierig. Du gibst dich nicht mit der ersten Antwort zufrieden, sondern gräbst weiter.

Du liebst Youtube. Du bist selbst gerne auf der Plattform unterwegs und konsumierst regelmäßig Formate.

Du recherchierst sauber. Du erkennst seriöse Quellen und weißt, wie man Fakten prüft.

Du bringst Dinge auf den Punkt. Aus viel Material machst du ein klares, kurzes Briefing.

Du bist hands-on und kommunikativ. Du greifst auch mal zum Telefon und hast keine Scheu vor Gesprächen. Erfahrung im Casting ist ein Plus.

Du verstehst YouTube. Du weißt, was ein Thema spannend macht und warum Menschen bis zum Ende dranbleiben.

Du übernimmst Ownership. Du hältst Deadlines, denkst mit und gehst einen Schritt weiter, statt auf Antworten zu warten.

Du willst durchstarten. Du hast dein Studium oder deine Ausbildung abgeschlossen – idealerweise in Journalismus, Medien, Kommunikation oder Sozialwissenschaften – oder bringst vergleichbare Erfahrung mit, z. B. aus Redaktion, Podcast oder eigenen Kanälen. Ab dem 15. Januar 2027 bist du mit 40 Stunden pro Woche dabei.

Du möchtest etwas aufbauen. Nicht verwalten, sondern gestalten.

Was wir bieten:

Build Something Big: 2027 wird Miss Germany 100 Jahre alt. Du gestaltest die Inhalte unserer YouTube-Formate in genau dieser Phase aktiv mit.

Impact Driven: Wir unterstützen mit Herzblut Frauen bei ihrer persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung und tragen zu einer vielfältigeren und gleichberechtigteren Gesellschaft bei.

Raum für Ideen: Deine Themen und Formatideen landen nicht in der Schublade, sondern im nächsten Video.

Ownership statt Micromanagement: Viel Vertrauen, kurze Entscheidungswege und echte Verantwortung statt endloser Abstimmungsschleifen.

Base Köln: Du arbeitest von Köln aus – remote oder im Co-Working-Space. Ein festes Muster gibt es nicht, wir schauen gemeinsam, was passt. Für dein Onboarding sowie regelmäßige Team- und Produktionstage kommst du nach Oldenburg in unser Head Office.

Work with Inspiring People: Du arbeitest mit beeindruckenden Frauen, spannenden Persönlichkeiten, Partnern und einem Netzwerk, das weit über Miss Germany hinausgeht.

Learn Fast: Recherche, Redaktion, Storytelling, YouTube, Personal Brands und Medien – du wirst in kurzer Zeit unglaublich viel lernen.

Top Gear: Neueste Hardware (Apple) und moderne Tools für deine tägliche Arbeit.

Team Fun: Regelmäßige Team-Events und gemeinsame Erlebnisse – zuletzt waren wir Fallschirm springen.

Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

 

About Fanatics Markets:

Fanatics Markets is the real-money prediction and trading app where you can invest in moments you care about. Built on a secure platform, we let users predict real-world outcomes and trade on events they actually follow - from sports and entertainment to political elections and beyond. Our mission is to redefine how fans engage with the moments and markets that matter most. We're looking for the right people to help us build the future of prediction markets.

Overview:

Fanatics recently acquired a CFTC-registered Designated Contract Market and Derivatives Clearing Organisation, giving Fanatics Markets its own fully regulated exchange and clearinghouse infrastructure. We are now building the engineering team that will run it.

This Senior Software Engineer (Backend) role sits at the heart of that build. You will have significant ownership over the core exchange platform, working on the systems that power order processing, market data distribution, trade lifecycle management and regulatory reporting for a CFTC-regulated exchange. The engineering challenges are those of any serious regulated trading environment, high-availability, low-latency, mission-critical infrastructure, but built for a consumer audience with the reach and distribution of Fanatics behind it.

You will be joining a team modernising an existing Java codebase and building new services in Java, working alongside engineers with deep backgrounds in regulated financial infrastructure. You will be joining a team with a clear ambition: to bring this platform to the bleeding edge of financial infrastructure. This is not a clean slate but the technical ambition is real, and engineers who join now will have a level of architectural influence and ownership that is hard to find anywhere else.

We are pioneering the use of AI as a code collaborator. We need engineers who have gone beyond experimentation and who actively use Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools to ship production code faster while maintaining exceptional quality standards.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design, development, testing, and deployment of high-performance, fault-tolerant distributed backend services supporting the FMX exchange platform.
  • Own services and features end-to-end: spec writing, implementation, instrumentation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration based on metrics.
  • Work within and help modernise the existing Java codebase while contributing to new service development in Java and potentially Kotlin.
  • Contribute to the architecture for order processing, market data distribution, and trade lifecycle management on a CFTC-regulated exchange.
  • Build and maintain reliable daily reporting pipelines, ensuring data integrity and full audit trails across all trading activity.
  • Participate in 24/7 on-call rotations, contribute to SLO definition, alerting strategy, and incident response for mission-critical trading infrastructure.
  • Model and manage data for contracts, orders, positions, and settlements with an emphasis on correctness, integrity, and regulatory auditability.
  • Collaborate with the DevOps/Platform team to ensure services are observable, scalable, and compliant with MNPI and insider trading restrictions.
  • Conduct thorough code reviews, raising the bar on code quality, readability, security, and maintainability.
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate development velocity while maintaining high standards for security, correctness, and regulatory compliance.
  • Establish and document team standards for AI usage, prompt patterns, code review checklists, and validation strategies.
  • Contribute to a fast-paced environment, unblocking others and taking initiative where processes are still being defined.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience building highly scalable, high-performance backend applications or distributed systems.
  • Background in regulated exchange or financial infrastructure strongly preferred, brokerage, futures or derivatives exchanges (e.g. CBOE, CME, ICE), market makers, or hedge funds with relevant trading infrastructure experience, or similar CFTC/SEC-regulated environments.
  • Strong production experience with Java; Kotlin experience a plus.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka, Kinesis, PubSub, or similar) in a financial or high-throughput context.
  • Strong understanding of data integrity and transaction management in PostgreSQL or equivalent RDBMS, including financial-grade data modelling.
  • Solid grasp of software design principles (SOLID, DRY) and testing methodologies (unit, integration, end-to-end).
  • Familiarity with CFTC compliance requirements, MNPI handling, and audit trail obligations in a regulated trading environment.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and safe deployment practices for backend services.
  • Production reliability experience: monitoring, logging, alerting, on-call, and SLO definition.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) to ship production code; able to articulate specific workflow improvements.
  • Communicates complex technical concepts clearly to engineering, compliance, and business stakeholders.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where priorities evolve and decisions are made quickly.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience at a US-regulated financial exchange or licensed trading platform (e.g. CBOE, CME, or similar).
  • Familiarity with low-latency trading systems, order book design, or market data infrastructure.
  • Experience with low-latency in-memory systems and the performance engineering techniques required to operate them at scale.
  • Experience with Aeron or similar high-performance messaging frameworks used in financial trading environments.
  • Experience modernising legacy Java codebases in a financial services context.
  • Previous experience in a high-growth or scale-up environment.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or the technical community.

Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE, a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connections and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.

Ready to build the future of regulated prediction markets? If you possess some of these skills but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply! Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position. We are open to fully remote candidates based in the United Kingdom. Remote employees may also be eligible for a home office setup stipend.

Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it

title: Senior Engineer - Athlete Performance
description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

 

Your Role

We're hiring Senior Engineers to join one of our cross-functional product teams in our Athlete Performance group, which is focused on building cutting-edge solutions for athletes and sports teams that directly impact how they train, compete and achieve peak performance. In this role, you'll build hardware-agnostic ingestion layers and time-series architectures that fuse live video with biomechanical data streams, solving complex real-time data sync and ML inference challenges to give elite coaches and medical teams instant, objective insight into injury prevention and matchday tactics.

As a Senior Engineer, you'll:

  • Work with a cross-functional team. You'll collaborate with Engineering, Quality Assurance, Product, Design and Scrum disciplines to deliver full-stack web features. 
  • Develop and deliver. Your team has the autonomy to make a meaningful impact across the entire product area, listen to customers' needs and deliver game-changing features to push the boundaries of what they can achieve. Your team is empowered to take ownership of the user experience to support our coaches and athletes.
  • Test new ideas. At Hudl, we iterate rapidly, deploying changes to the product hundreds of times daily across our Engineering team. In addition to working on concrete features, you'll have the opportunity to propose solutions to more ambiguous technical problems and provide guidance to less experienced engineers.
  • Mentor. You'll share your expertise and educate others on development best practices and trade-offs, setting an example in planning, designing and delivering complex projects. 

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We're currently considering applicants within commuting distance of London. You'll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have  the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team. We're also open to remote candidates in the UK.

Must-Haves

  • Experienced. You have either led or played a key role in developing large-scale applications.
  • A team player. You understand that problem-solving is a team effort and will help others on our Engineering team learn and develop their skills.
  • User-focused. You're excited to have your work used by real people to solve real problems.
  • Willing to learn. You have solid engineering skills but are always willing to dive into specific areas to gain the expertise needed to be successful in your role.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Tech stack knowledge. Our core stack is C#/Node, React, TypeScript, MongoDB/SQL/ElasticSearch and AWS, so experience with these is ideal.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.
  • Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you're located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

Compensation

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices. 

This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion.

title: Strategic Account Manager
description:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

As Omnea's Account Manager, you own the relationship with our customers across their entire lifecycle, working with some of our largest and most strategic accounts. Your job is to make sure customers get real, measurable value from Omnea from day one, and to turn that value into renewals, expansion, and upsell.

Omnea's product is sticky: it's a business transformation, not a point tool, so once a customer is live, expansion tends to follow. Your focus skews heavily toward that expansion motion, not just keeping accounts renewed.

You'll build deep, long-term relationships with your champions and become a trusted advisor to stakeholders at every level, from procurement managers up to CFOs. You'll be the internal voice of the customer, working closely with both technical and commercial teams to keep Omnea customer-centric at its core.

This is an early hire on the customer team, working directly with Abs, Ben, and Rebe to build the function from the ground up. There's no fixed playbook yet: you'll help write it.

What You'll Do

Own a revenue number: You'll carry an NRR quota covering both expansion and retention across your enterprise book. That means proactively identifying upsell opportunities, running commercial conversations at exec level, and owning the renewal process end-to-end.

Build relationships that go all the way to the top: Your relationships will run from procurement managers to CFOs. You'll multi-thread across each account, building genuine trust across multiple stakeholders, and you'll be the person customers call when something goes wrong or when they're thinking about what's next.

Build the playbook from scratch: There's no fully built playbook yet - you'll help shape it. You'll work alongside an exceptional implementation team, product experts, and leadership that have scaled world-class companies to define the commercial rhythms, norms, and processes to set the standard as the function grows.

Shape what Omnea builds next: You're the closest person to what our customers will and won't pay for. You'll feed that signal directly to Product and Revenue leadership, surfacing what's blocking adoption, what's driving expansion, and where we should be investing.

What's Different About This Role

This isn't a traditional post-sale account management role. Omnea's product is a business transformation, not a point tool, so most of your quota comes from expansion, not just renewal.

We're not looking for a narrow "Account Manager" background. We want people from GTM roles broadly or from customer-facing roles with heavy commercial/GTM crossover.

There's no fully built playbook. You'll define the commercial rhythms and processes as you go, working directly with Abs, Ben, and Rebe.

You'll be as close to the product roadmap as anyone outside Product itself: what you hear from customers directly shapes what gets built next.

About You

We don't expect you to know exactly how to do all of this when you join. We're looking for someone with the right attitude and skillset to take this on.

TL;DR: you're commercially sharp, and you instinctively know how to navigate complex organisations. You might come from a GTM role (sales, customer success, partnerships) or a customer-facing role with heavy GTM crossover. What matters is that you've worked in real enterprise environments, managed senior stakeholders with high expectations, and have a track record of getting things done.

4-8 years of experience in a top-tier, fast-paced environment: a startup, scale-up, VC, consulting, banking, or something you built yourself

If you've been in a commercial role, you've worked six-figure ARR+ accounts, navigated multi-stakeholder buying committees, and built genuine executive relationships

You build rapport, influence people, and drive change, whether with a distinguished exec or a junior operator. You have the gravitas to engage senior leadership, ideally up to CFOs, Legal, or Procurement

You're comfortable in ambiguity. You don't need a fully built playbook: you'll build it as you go and improve it as you learn. You're organised enough to manage a complex book of business without dropping anything, and confident enough to push back on customers when they're wrong

You're ambitious, competitive, and care about doing excellent work, with a track record of high performance in whatever you've turned your hand to: sales, academia, sport, or something of your own. You take ownership seriously, and you'd rather work hard on something meaningful than coast on something safe

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!
